Recall Description: THE HEADLAMP SWITCH IS NOT IDENTIFIED AS REQUIRED BY FMVSS 101.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLE DOES NOT MEET REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 101.
Corrective Action: MANUFACTURER WILL SUPPLY VEHICLE OWNERS A DECAL WHICH IS TO BE PLACED ADJACENT TO THE HEADLAMP SWITCH.

Subject: STRUCTURE:DOOR ASSEMBLY
Recall Description: THE LOCATION OF THE DOOR HANDLE TO THE DOOR LATCH MAY BE OUT OF TOLERANCE, WHICH CAN CAUSE THE DOOR TO OPEN, IF JARRED.
Consequence Summary: AN OPEN DOOR WOULD SUBJECT THE OCCUPANT OF THE CAB TOPOSSIBLE EJECTION.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE DOOR HANDLE ASSEMBLY WITH A MODIFIED ONE IF THE SPECIFIED MINIMUM FREE TRAVEL IS NOT ACHIEVED.

Subject: TIRES:MARKINGS
Recall Description: TIRES HAVE INCORRECT TIRE LOAD RANGES, LOAD, AND INFLATION PRESSURES MARKED ON THE SIDEWALLS.
Consequence Summary: TIRES USED INCORRECTLY ARE SUBJECT TO PREMATURE FAILUREAND COULD RESULT IN A VEHICLE ACCIDENT; TIRES DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 119.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE INCORRECTLY MARKED TIRES FREE OF CHARGE WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM OWNER'S RECEIPT OF RECALL NOTICE OR 60 DAYS FROM DATE REPLACEMENT TIRES ARE AVAILABLE TO REGISTERED OWNERS.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:WATER PUMP:FIRE TRUCK
Recall Description: IN THE EVENT THAT THE PROPER PUMP ENGAGEMENT SEQUENCE IS NOT FOLLOWED THE "OK TO PUMP" INDICATOR LIGHT WILL ILLUMINATE WHEN THE TRANSMISSION IS IN A DRIVE GEAR.
Corrective Action: AN ELECTRONIC CIRCUIT AND MODULE WILL BE INSTALLED TO LOCK-OUT THE PUMP THROTTLE ON ELECTRONICALLY CONTROLLED TRANSMISSIONS IF THE CORRECT LOCK-OUT PROCEDURES ARE NOT CARRIED OUT.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:DISC:CALIPER
Recall Description: BRAKES MAY HAVE MISSING REAR AXLE OUTER BEARING RETAINING RING AND OR GREATER THAN SPECIFIED BEARING END PLAY. EITHER CONDITION ALLOWS THE ROTOR AND HUB ASSEMBLY TO SHIFT POSITION RELATIVE TO THE SPINDLE. THIS MOVEMENT CAN CAUSE BRAKE CALIPER PISTON RECEDE FARTHER THAN NORMAL INTO THE PISTON BORE WHICH WOULD REQUIRE GREATER THAN NORMAL BRAKE FLUID DISPLACEMENT WHEN THE SERVICE BRAKES ARE APPLIED.
Consequence Summary: THIS CONDITION LEADS TO INCREASED STOPPING DISTANCE, ANDSHOULD MINIMUM STOPPING DISTANCE BE REQUIRED, IT COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENTWITHOUT WARNING.
Corrective Action: REPLACE BOTH REAR AXLE HUBS.

Subject: STEERING:GEAR BOX
Recall Description: BECAUSE OF A MACHINING INCONSISTENCY, THERE IS A HIGH PISTON-TO-BALL CONTACT ANGLE IN THE STEERING GEAR WORM DRIVE. THIS CONTACT CAUSES THE BALLS TO TRY TO ROTATE ON TWO DIFFERENT ROLLING RADII AT TWO DIFFERENT SPEEDS, CAUSING THE BALL TO DAMAGE THE CONTACT SURFACES OF THE PISTON AND SPINDLE DURING STATIC OR LOW SPEED MANEUVERS INVOKING FULL OR NEAR FULL TURNS.
Consequence Summary: STEERING ABILITY DETERIORATES AND EVENTUALLY STEERINGLOCKUP OCCURS DURING THESE LOW SPEED MANEUVERS RESULTING IN LOSS OF STEERINGCONTROL AND AN INCREASED RISK OF VEHICLE ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE BENDIX C300N STEERING GEARS WITH NEW GEARS.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL PUMP
Recall Description: ENGINES FAIL TO START DUE TO A COMBINATION OF INCORRECT SOLENOID-TO-LEVER ADJUSTMENT AND APPLICATION ISSUES AFFECTING POWER TO THE SOLENOID.
Consequence Summary: EMERGENCY VEHICLES CAN BECOME UNAVAILABLE FOR EMERGENCYSERVICES.
Corrective Action: WHERE NECESSARY, REPLACE SOLENOID SPRING, ADJUST SOLENOID, REPLACE WIRES, AND VERIFY MAXIMUM POWER REQUIREMENTS TO THE SOLENOID.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC:OTHER PARTS
Recall Description: THE TRANSMISSION FLUID LEVEL GAUGES (DIP STICKS) INSTALLED IN THESE VEHICLES ARE NOT TO DESIGNED SPECIFICATIONS. THE GAUGE INDICATES THAT TRANSMISSION FLUID SHOULD BE ADDED WHEN IT IS AT THE CORRECT LEVEL.
Consequence Summary: ADDING MORE TRANSMISSION FLUID THAN REQUIRED WILL CAUSETHE FLUID TO LEAK THROUGH THE FLUID LEVEL GAUGE TUBE ONTO THE MANIFOLD AS THEENGINE TEMPERATURE RISES. THIS CREATES A POTENTIAL FOR A FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE OIL LEVEL GAUGE AND NOTIFY OWNERS TO USE ONLY THE SPECIFIED AMOUNT OF AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION FLUID.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN
Recall Description: FRONT OUTBOARD SAFETY BELT MAY BECOME DIFFICULT TO LATCH AND OR UNLATCH DUE TO A WEBBING STIFFENER ENTERING THE BUCKLE HOUSING AND DISLODGING THE BUCKLE LATCH GUIDE.
Consequence Summary: LATCH MAY OPEN DURING ACCIDENT OR SUDDEN STOP, EXPOSINGSEAT OCCUPANT TO INCREASED RISK OF INJURY.
Corrective Action: REPLACE BUCKLE LATCH ENGAGEMENT.

Subject: FURNACE:RECREATIONAL VEHICLE
Recall Description: FURNACE EXHAUST VENT TUBE MAY NOT HAVE BEEN PROPERLY ALIGNED DURING INSTALLATION. IMPROPER ALIGNMENT ALLOWS FURNACE EXHAUST AIR TO DISCHARGE AGAINST THE INTERIOR SURFACE OF MOTORHOME WALL.
Consequence Summary: FURNACE EXHAUST AIR DISCHARGE INTO THE INTERIOR WALL CANCAUSE MELTING OR BURNING OF INTERIOR WALL COMPONENTS, PRODUCING COMBUSTIONBY-PRODUCTS (INCLUDING CARBON MONOXIDE) WHICH CAN POISON INDIVIDUALS IN THEMOTOR HOME.
Corrective Action: ALIGN EXHAUST FURNACE EXHAUST VENT TUBE.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN
Recall Description: SAFETY BELT ANCHORAGES DID NOT MEET LOAD REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 210; BELT ANCHORAGE BAR PULLED THROUGH THE FLOOR OF VEHICLE WHEN SUBJECTED TO LOADS OF FMVSS 210 TEST.
Consequence Summary: SEAT OCCUPANTS WOULD NOT HAVE ADEQUATE PROTECTION IN THEEVENT OF A SUDDEN STOP OR ACCIDENT AND WOULD BE SUBJECT TO INCREASED RISKOF INJURY.
Corrective Action: SECURE SAFETY BELT ANCHORAGE BAR TO VEHICLE FRAME FOR ADDED STRENGTH.

Subject: AIR CONDITIONER
Recall Description: LEAKING HOSES CAUSED REFRIGERANT LEVELS TO DECREASE CAUSING EXCESSIVE CYCLING OF THE AC CLUTCH.
Consequence Summary: EXCESSIVE CYCLING OF THE AC CLUTCH COULD CAUSE COILOVERHEATING AND ULTIMATELY A FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE HOSES, CHANGE CONNECTION FITTINGS ON THE AC COMPRESSOR AND INSTALL A LOW PRESSURE CUT-OUT SWITCH.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:FUSE AND RECEPTICLE:CIRCUIT BREA
Recall Description: MALFUNCTIONING 30 AMP CIRCUIT BREAKERS DURING OPERATION CAN RESULT IN DISRUPTION OF THE ELECTRICAL SYSTEM, INCLUDING LIGHTS, IGNITION, AND ACCESSORIES WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Consequence Summary: DISRUPTION OF THE ELECTRICAL SYSTEM RESULTS IN LOSS OFHEADLIGHTS AND STOPLIGHTS, MAKING VEHICLE LESS VISIBLE AND INCREASING ACCIDENTPOTENTIAL OF THE RIDER.
Corrective Action: REPLACE 30 AMP CIRCUIT BREAKER.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT TRACK ANCHORS AND SEATS
Recall Description: SOME OF THE SPECIAL FASTENERS ATTACHING THE SEATS TO THE FLOOR TRACKS ARE OF SUBSTANDARD QUALITY AND ARE NOT CAPABLE OF HOLDING THE SEAT TO THE FLOOR.
Consequence Summary: IN THE EVENT OF A SUDDEN STOP OR ACCIDENT, SEAT OCCUPANTSWOULD BE PLACED AT INCREASED RISK OF INJURY FROM SEATS BREAKING FREE OF THEFLOOR; BUSES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 222.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SUBSTANDARD FASTENERS WITH NEW FASTENERS.

Subject: STEERING:COLUMN
Recall Description: THE TWO BRACKETS USED TO MOUNT THE TILT/TELESCOPING STEERING COLUMNS TO THE DASH MAY EXPERIENCE FAILURE DUE TO FATIGUE STRESS; CRACKS IN THE RADIUS AREA AT THE BOTTOM OF THE LEFT BRACKET COULD PROPAGATE UPWARD UNTIL BRACKET FAILURE OCCURS.
Consequence Summary: FAILURE OF THE STEERING BRACKETS CAN LEAD TO LOSS OFVEHICLE CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW REDESIGNED STEERING COLUMN MOUNTING BRACKETS.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK
Consequence Summary: FUEL LEAKAGE CAN LEAD TO FIRE WHEN NEAR AN IGNITIONSOURCE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE FUEL TANK WITH AN IMPROVED TANK.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING
Recall Description: INAPPROPRIATE INSTALLATION, TIGHTENING OF THE TERMINAL NUT, OR INADEQUATE ELECTRICAL CABLE ROUTING ALLOWS THE TERMINAL RING TO MOVE, CAUSING THE CABLE TO RUB AGAINST METALLIC COMPONENT AND WEAR THROUGH THE INSULATION OR CAUSE THE RING TERMINAL TO BREAK, CAUSING THE CABLE TO FALL. CONSEQUENCE OF DEFECT: CHAFING OF THE ELECTRICAL CABLE INSULATION OR THE BREAKAGE OF THE RING TERMINAL CAN CAUSE AN ELECTRICAL SHORT WHICH MAY RESULT IN A FIRE.
Corrective Action: REINSTALL ELECTRICAL CABLING TO AVOID THESE HAZARDS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN
Recall Description: LAP AND SHOULDER SEAT BELT ARRANGEMENT FOR FIXED (NON-SUSPENSION) SEATS DOES NOT MEET THE SEAT BELT LOADING REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 210. THE INBOARD CLINCH NUT IN CAB SILL, WHERE THE BUCKLE FOR THE SHOULDER AND LAP BELT IS MOUNTED, PULLED OUT OF THE SILL DURING THE TESTS.    CONSEQUENCE OF DEFECT: IF SEAT BELT ANCHIRAGE FAILS, THE SEAT OCCUPANT FACES AN INCREASED RISK OF INJURY IN AN ACCIDENT OR SUDDEN STOP.
Corrective Action: RELOCATE THE INBOARD SEAT BELT MOUNTING FROM TOP OF THE SILL TO THE FORWARD FLANGE OF THE SILL ON THE CAB FLOOR, AND ADD A 3MM FILLET WELD AROUND THE 2 INBOARD CLINCH NUTS.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:TRAILER HITCHES AND ATTACHM
Recall Description: WHEN DIESEL FUEL TANK IS FILLED, THE WEIGHT OF THE UNIT EXCEEDS THE RATED CAPACITY OF THE TIRES AND, IN SOME INSTANCES, THE RATED CAPACITY OF THE AXLE.   CONSEQUENCE OF DEFECT: OVERLOADED TIRES COULD BLOWOUT CAUSING THE TRAILER TO SWERVE AND EVENTUALLY BREAK ITS HITCH; THIS COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE WHEEL ASSEMBLIES AND ADJUST AXLE RATING, AS  NECESSARY; ALSO, INSTALL STICKER SHOWING CORRECT RATING OF REPLACEMENT TIRES.

Subject: LIGHTING:LAMP OR SOCKET:UNSPECIFIED LIGHT
Recall Description: THE BULBS IMPORTED FROM KOREA HAVE THE WRONG DEFLECTION, DIMENSION, AND PHOTOMETRIC VALUES, AND DO NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 108.
Consequence Summary: HEADLIGHTS WITH NON-STANDARD LAMP BULBS MIGHT NOTILLUMINATE SUFFICIENTLY FOR SAFE VEHICLE OPERATION.
Corrective Action: REPLACE HEADLIGHT LAMP BULB.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL SYSTEM OTHER PARTS
Recall Description: VEHICLES HAVE BEEN SHIPPED WITH THE FUEL TANK SENDER SEAL OUT OF POSITION.
Consequence Summary: IN THE EVENT OF ROLLOVER ACCIDENT, AN OUT OF POSTIONSEAL COULD ALLOW FUEL SPILLAGE IN EXCESS OF THE AMOUNT PRESCRIBED BY FMVSS 301.SPILLED FUEL COULD IGNITE NEAR AN IGNITION SOURCE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SENDER SEALS.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:METALLIC
Recall Description: FRONT BRAKE HYDRAULIC LINE MAY CONTACT AND RUB AGAINST FUEL TANK OR SPEEDOMETER CABLE RESULTING IN SCUFFING AND SUBSEQUENT WEARING ON BRAKE LINES OUTER SURFACE WHICH COULD CAUSE A HYDRAULIC FLUID LEAK.   CONSEQUENCE OF DEFECT: HYDRAULIC FLUID LEAK DUE TO THE DAMAGED LINES IMPAIRS BRAKE PERFORMANCE.
Corrective Action: A SPIRAL HOSE TO PROTECT THE BRAKE LINE FROM CONTACT WILL BE INSTALLED, AS WELL AS A HOSE CLAMP AND SUPPORT, SO BRAKE LINE WILL NOT CHANGE.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CERTIFICATION LABEL
Recall Description: INCORRECT CERTIFICATION LABELS WERE INSTALLED.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH PART 567.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW CERTIFICATION LABELS.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:LIFT:WRECKER
Recall Description: BOLT FAILURE, POSSIBLY DUE TO HYDROGEN EMBRITTLEMENT,  COULD OCCUR.
Consequence Summary: FAILURE OF FRONT MOUNTING BOLTS COULD RESULT IN BODYLIFTING OFF FRAME, HOIST FRAME TWISTING AND POSSIBLE  PROPERTY DAMAGE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE BOLTS WITH BOLTS OF IMPROVED QUALITY AND USE ATTACHING HARDWARE TO PREVENT FAILURE.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL LINES:HOSES:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: DUE TO ROUTING OF FUEL LINE FROM THE FUEL TANK TO REAR FUEL PUMP, THE FUEL LINE MAY BE DAMAGED UNDER CERTAIN DRIVING CONDITIONS.  ON FULL TRAVEL OF LEFT REAR SUSPENSION (JOUNCE), THE BRACKET FOR THE BRAKE PAD WEAR INDICATOR WIRE ON LEFT REAR CONTROL ARM COULD CONTACT AND DAMAGE FUEL LINE.
Consequence Summary: A DAMAGED FUEL LINE MAY RESULT IN A FUEL LEAK WHICH MAYIGNITE, RESULTING IN A FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE DAMAGED FUEL LINE: IN ADDITION ALL FUEL LINES WILL BE REROUTED SO THAT THE BRAKE PAD WEAR INDICATOR WIRE BRACKET CANNOT CONTACT FUEL LINE.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:SHOE AND DRUM WHEEL CYLINDERS
Recall Description: REAR WHEEL BRAKE CYLINDERS ARE TOO SMALL TO ALLOW FOR PROPER BRAKING.
Consequence Summary: STOPPING DISTANCE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 105 ARE NOT METWITH POWER ASSIST BRAKING UNITS INOPERATIVE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ORIGINAL 1" REAR WHEEL BRAKE CYLINDER WITH A 1 1/16" CYLINDER.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:SHOE AND DRUM WHEEL CYLINDERS
Recall Description: REAR WHEEL BRAKE CYLINDERS ARE TOO SMALL TO ALLOW FOR PROPER BRAKING.
Consequence Summary: STOPPING DISTANCE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 105 WERE NOT METWITH POWER BRAKING ASSIST UNIT INOPERATIVE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ORIGINAL 1" REAR WHEEL BRAKE CYLINDER WITH A 1 1/16" CYLINDER.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:SHOE AND DRUM WHEEL CYLINDERS
Recall Description: REAR WHEEL BRAKE CYLINDERS ARE TOO SMALL TO ALLOW FOR PROPER BRAKING.
Consequence Summary: STOPPING DISTANCE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 105 ARE NOT METWITH POWER ASSIST BRAKING UNIT INOPERATIVE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ORIGINAL 1" REAR WHEEL BRAKE CYLINDER WITH A 1 1/16" CYLINDER.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:SHOE AND DRUM WHEEL CYLINDERS
Recall Description: REAR WHEEL BRAKE CYLINDERS ARE TOO SMALL TO ALLOW FOR PROPER BRAKING.
Consequence Summary: STOPPING DISTANCE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 105 ARE NOT METWITH POWER BRAKING ASSIST UNIT INOPERATIVE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ORIGINAL 1" REAR WHEEL BRAKE CYLINDER WITH A 1 1/16" CYLINDER.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:SHOE AND DRUM WHEEL CYLINDERS
Recall Description: REAR WHEEL BRAKE CYLINDERS ARE TOO SMALL TO ALLOW FOR PROPER BRAKING.
Consequence Summary: STOPPING DISTANCE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 105 ARE NOT METWITH POWER BRAKING ASSIST UNIT INOPERATIVE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ORIGINAL 1" REAR WHEEL BRAKE CYLINDER WITH A 1 1/16" CYLINDER.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:SHOE AND DRUM WHEEL CYLINDERS
Recall Description: REAR WHEEL BRAKE CYLINDERS TOO SMALL TO ALLOW FOR PROPER BRAKING.
Consequence Summary: STOPPING DISTANCE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 105 ARE NOT METWITH THE POWER ASSIST UNIT INOPERATIVE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ORIGINAL 1" REAR WHEEL BRAKE CYLINDER WITH A 1 1/16" CYLINDER.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:SHOE AND DRUM WHEEL CYLINDERS
Recall Description: REAR WHEEL BRAKE CYLINDERS ARE TOO SMALL TO ALLOW FOR PROPER BRAKING.
Consequence Summary: STOPPING DISTANCE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 105 ARE NOT METWITH POWER BRAKING ASSIST UNIT INOPERATIVE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ORIGINAL 1" REAR WHEEL BRAKE CYLINDER WITH A 1 1/16" CYLINDER.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:SHOE AND DRUM WHEEL CYLINDERS
Consequence Summary: STOPPING DISTANCE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 105 ARE NOT METWITH POWER BRAKING ASSIST UNIT INOPERATIVE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ORIGINAL 1" REAR WHEEL BRAKE CYLINDER WITH A 1 1/16" CYLINDER.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:SHOE AND DRUM WHEEL CYLINDERS
Consequence Summary: STOPPING DISTANCE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 105 ARE NOT METWITH POWER BRAKING ASSIST UNIT INOPERATIVE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ORIGINAL 1" REAR WHEEL BRAKE CYLINDER WITH A 1 1/16" CYLINDER.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:HARNESS:FRONT:UNDERHOOD
Recall Description: ENGINE WIRING HARNESS MAY COME IN CONTACT WITH THE ALTERNATOR HOUSING. WITH NORMAL ENGINE MOVEMENT OVER A PERIOD OF TIME, THE ALTERNATOR HOUSING COULD WEAR THROUGH THE WIRE INSULATION OF THE HARNESS.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CAUSE A SHORT CIRCUIT WHICH WOULD AFFECTENGINE OPERATION BY CUTTING OFF FUEL DELIVERY AND WHICH COULD RESULT IN ANELECTRICAL FIRE.
Corrective Action: INSPECT AND REPAIR ENGINE WIRING HARNESS.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:HELMETS
Recall Description: HELMETS DID NOT COMPLY WITH THE PENETRATION AND IMPACT REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 218.
Consequence Summary: HELMET USER MAY SUFFER SERIOUS HEAD INJURIES FROM HELMETBEING INSUFFICIENT TO WITHSTAND IMPACTS.
Corrective Action: OWNERS WILL RECEIVE A REPLACEMENT HELMET OR A REFUND OF PURCHASE PRICE.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN
Recall Description: THE SEAT BELTS FOR THE FRONT AND MID-SHIP SEATS DID NOT REST ON PELVIS AS REQUIRED BY FMVSS 209.
Consequence Summary: SEAT BELTS MAY NOT RESTRAIN SEAT OCCUPANT, AND COULDINJURE THE SEAT OCCUPANT IN THE EVENT OF A SUDDEN STOP OR ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: RELOCATE SEAT BELT ANCHOR BOLTS TO ADJUST BELTS FOR SEAT  LOCATIONS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:RESTRAINT:BELT ANCHOR AND ATTACHM
Recall Description: DRIVER SEATS HAVE SAFETY BELT TETHER STRAPS WHICH ARE IMPROPERLY ANCHORED TO THE STEEL SEAT BASE AND NOT TO THE FLOOR AS RECOMMENDED.
Consequence Summary: DUE TO IMPROPER ANCHORING LOCATION, THE SPACER WHICHHOLDS THE SAFETY BELT AWAY FROM THE SEAT BASE IS RESTRICTED BY THE TETHER STRAPSTRAP WHEN THE SEAT MOVES, CAUSING INCREASED SLACK IN THE BELT THAT WOULD NOTPROPERLY RESTRAIN DRIVER IN AN ACCIDENT OR SUDDEN STOP.
Corrective Action: MOVE THE ANCHOR POINT FOR SAFETY BELT TETHER STRAP, REVISE THE MODESTY PANEL TO ADD CLEARANCE, AND REPLACE THE ICP BARS.

Subject: LIGHTING:LAMP OR SOCKET:TAIL LIGHTS
Recall Description: SOCKET FOR  THE REAR STOP/TAIL/TURN LAMP IS STAKED INTO THE ASSEMBLY 180 DEGREES OUT OF POSITION.
Consequence Summary: LAMPS FAIL THE MAXIMUM ALLOWABLE READING ABOVEHORIZONTAL FOR TAIL LAMP FUNCTION AS SPECIFIED.
Corrective Action: REPLACE DEFECTIVE TAIL LAMPS. MODELS 016519-05 AND 0016535-05

Subject: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC
Recall Description: TRANSMISSION SHIFT LINKAGE MAY BE INCORRECTLY ADJUSTED AND WOULD NOT BE ENGAGED IN A FULL PARK POSITION WHEN PLACED IN PARK.
Consequence Summary: IF TRANSMISSION PARK MECHANISM IS NOT IN PARK WHILE THEVEHICLE IS RUNNING OR ON AN INCLINE, A RUNAWAY SITUATION WOULD OCCUR WHICHCOULD RESULT IN A VEHICLE ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPAIR THE TRANSMISSION PARK MECHANISM.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: VEHICLES HAVE AN INCORRECT FRONT WHEELHOUSE SPLASH SHIELD THAT MAY CONTACT RUBBER PORTION OF FRONT BRAKE HOSE.
Consequence Summary: CHAFING OR SERATION OF FRONT BRAKE HOSE COULD RESULT IN ASUDDEN FAILURE OF FRONT HYDRAULIC BRAKE SYSTEM.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FRONT WHEELHOUSE SPLASH SHIELD.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:SHOE AND DRUM WHEEL CYLINDERS
Recall Description: REAR WHEEL BRAKE CYLINDERS TOO SMALL TO ALLOW FOR PROPER BRAKING.
Consequence Summary: STOPPING DISTANCE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 571 ARE NOT METWITH POWER ASSIST BRAKING UNIT INOPERATIVE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ORIGINAL 1" REAR WHEEL BRAKE CYLINDER WITH A 1 1/16" CYLINDER.

Subject: STEERING:WHEEL AND COLUMN
Recall Description: NUT ATTACHING STEERING WHEEL MAY NOT HAVE BEEN PROPERLY TIGHTENED DURING INSTALLATION.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD ALLOW STEERING WHEEL TO SEPARATE FROM STEERINGCOLUMN; LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL AND A CRASH COULD OCCUR WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: TIGHTEN THE NUT TO THE PROPER TORQUE AS NECESSARY.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:WINDSHIELD WIPER LINKAGE:PIVOT:DRIV
Recall Description: SPRAGUE WIPER ASSEMBLY PIVOT CAN SEIZE DUE TO GALVANIC CORROSION BETWEEN THE ZINC-PLATED STEEL SHAFT AND THE BRONZE BUSHINGS.
Consequence Summary: THIS CORROSION CAN CAUSE WIPER ARM/BLADE ASSEMBLY TO STOPWIPING WINDSHIELD, THIS COULD AFFECT DRIVER VISIBILITY AND RESULT IN ANACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SPRAGUE WIPER ASSEMBLY PIVOT WITH AN ASSEMBLY NOT SUSCEPTIBLE TO GALVANIC CORROSION.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:OTHER PART
Recall Description: POWER ELECTRONIC SOLENOID FAILS CAUSING LOSS OF POWER TO THE EIGHT WAY WARNING LIGHT SYSTEM, THE WINDSHILED WIPERS AND/OR THE DEFROSTER SYSTEM.
Consequence Summary: FAILURE OF ANY OF THE AFFECTED SYSTEMS WILL EXPOSE SCHOOLBUS OCCUPANTS TO INCREASED RISK OF VEHICLE ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SOLENOID.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:ARM:PITMAN
Recall Description: DUE TO OPERATIONAL CONDITIONS, STEERING ARMS COULD CRACK AND BREAK.
Consequence Summary: STEERING ARM FAILURE CAUSES LOSS OF STEERING CONTROLWITHOUT WARNING RESULTING IN LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL AND IN THE POSSIBILITY OFAN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE STEERING ARM WITH ONE REDESIGNED TO ENHANCE FATIGUE LIFE OF ARM.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:ARM:PITMAN
Recall Description: STEERING ARMS CRACK AND BREAK FROM PRESSURES EXERTED IN OPERATIONS IN URBAN TRAFFIC ENVIRONEMNTS.
Consequence Summary: CRACKED AND BROKEN STEERING ARMS CAN RESULT IN LOSS OFSTEERING CONTROL WITHOUT WARNING AND POSSIBLE VEHICLE ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: NOTIFICATION WILL BE SENT TO MANUFACTURERS AND USERS TO REPLACE THE STEERING ARM AFTER TEN YEARS SERVICE.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT
Recall Description: THE FOAM SEAT CUSHIONS FAIL TO CONFORM TO FMVSS 213; THE SEAT BURNS AT A RATE FASTER THAN PERMITTED.
Consequence Summary: OCCUPANTS OF THE SEAT WOULD BE EXPOSED TO INCREASED RISKOF INJURY IN THE EVENT OF FIRE OR EXTREME HEAT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE FOAM SEAT CUSHION WITH NEW SEAT CUSHION.

Subject: FURNACE:RECREATIONAL VEHICLE
Recall Description: CONTAMINANTS COULD BLOCK THE INTERNAL ORIFICES IN THE ITT VALVES, CAUSING THE GAS CONTROL VALVE TO FAIL IN OPEN POSITION: THIS WOULD ALLOW UNBURNED GAS TO REACH VEHICLE'S LIVING QUARTERS.
Consequence Summary: HAZARDS OF LIQUID PROPANE GAS IN THE LIVING QUARTERS OF ARECREATIONAL VEHICLE INCLUDE RISK OF EXPLOSION AND FIRE WHEN EXPOSED TO A SOURCEOF IGNITION, AND RESPIRATORY DISTRESS FROM THE GAS ITSELF.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE ITT VALVES WITH REDUNDANT GAS CONTROL VALVES.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:ARM:PITMAN
Recall Description: STEERING GEARS HAVE NO END-OF-TRAVEL STOPS. EXTREME LEFT AND RIGHT TURNS PLACE ADDED LOADS ON THE AXLE STEERING ARM WHICH CAN CAUSE THE ARM TO LOOSEN AND SHEAR MOUNTING STUDS.
Consequence Summary: LOOSENING OF THE STEERING ARM OR SHEARING OF THEMOUNTING STUDS RESULT IN LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL, AND A POSSIBLE VEHICLEACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL STEERING ARM STOP AND NEW STUDS.

Subject: STRUCTURE:FRAME:MEMBERS AND BODY:OTHER PARTS
Recall Description: STEP TREAD WAS DESIGNED WITH AN UPTURNED EDGE.  ALSO, INCORRECT BOLTS WERE USED TO ATTACH THE STEPS TO VEHICLE; INCORRECT BOLTS MAY FATIGUE AND BREAK ALLOWING THE STEPS TO SEPARATE FROM CAB.
Consequence Summary: PERSONS EXITING THE CAB CAN TRIP AND FALL ON UPTURNEDEDGES.  ALSO, FATIGUE OR BROKEN BOLTS COULD CAUSE THE STEPS TO BREAK AWAY AT THETIME THAT A PERSON IS ENTERING OR EXITING THE VEHICLES.
Corrective Action: REPLACE INCORRECTLY DESIGNED STEPS, REPLACE INCORRECT BOLTS.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL LINES:METALLIC
Recall Description: METAL FUEL LINES WITH AN INCORRECT CONTOUR WERE INSTALLED IN THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT. THE INCORRECT CONTOUR CAN CAUSE THE METAL FUEL LINE TO RUB AGAINST THE INTAKE MANIFOLD.
Consequence Summary: PROLONGED RUBBING OF THE FUEL LINE AGAINST THE INTAKEMANIFOLD COULD CAUSE A FUEL LINE LEAK, AND RESULT IN AN ENGINE COMPARTMENT FIREIF THE LEAKING FUEL LINE IS EXPOSED TO A SOURCE OF IGNITION.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FUEL LINE WITH CORRECTLY CONTOURED FUEL LINE.

Subject: STEERING:WHEEL AND COLUMN
Recall Description: MALFORMED STEERING WHEEL CENTER SECTION COULD RESULT IN A FRACTURE OF THE UPPER HUB CASTING.  THIS MAY LEAD TO SEPARATION OF THE STEERING WHEEL FROM THE STEERING COLUMN MOUNTING HUB.
Consequence Summary: FRACTURED UPPER HUB CASTING COULD RESULT IN LOSS OFSTEERING CONTROL WITHOUT WARNING AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REMOVE AND REPLACE THE UPPER HUB CASTING AND INSTALL A HUB PLATE.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:MIRRORS:REARVIEW:EXTERIOR
Recall Description: THE REAR VIEW MIRRORS ON EACH SIDE OF THESE VEHICLES HAVE THIRTY-NINE SQUARE INCHES OF REFLECTIVE SURFACE, LESS THAN THE FIFTY SQUARE INCHES REQUIRED BY FMVSS 111.
Consequence Summary: REDUCED REFLECTIVE AREA ON OUTSIDE REAR VIEW MIRRORSREDUCES THE DRIVER'S APPARENT AREA OF VISIBILITY IN THE REAR OF THE TRUCK. THISREDUCED AREA OF VISIBILITY INCREASES THE LIKELIHOOD OF VEHICLE COLLISION.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE NON-CONFORMING REAR VIEW MIRRORS.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC
Recall Description: UNDER CERTAIN LOAD CONDITIONS, THE PARK GEAR MAY NOT DISENGAGE IMMEDIATELY WHEN THE TRANSMISSION LEVER IS MOVED FROM PARK TO REVERSE.
Consequence Summary: DELAYED RELEASE OF TRANSMISSION FROM PARK CAUSES DELAYEDAND POSSIBLY ABRUPT VEHICLE MOVEMENT THAT COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF VEHICLECONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A MODIFIED PARKING BRAKE PAWL TO PREVENT DELAYED RELEASE INTO REVERSE GEAR.

Subject: FURNACE:RECREATIONAL VEHICLE
Recall Description: CONTAMINANTS COULD BLOCK THE INTERNAL ORIFICES IN THE ITT VALVES, CAUSING THE GAS CONTROL VALVE TO FAIL IN OPEN POSITION; THIS WOULD ALLOW UNBURNED GAS TO REACH VEHICLE'S LIVING QUARTERS.
Consequence Summary: HAZARDS OF LIQUID PROPANE GAS IN THE LIVING QUARTERS OF ARECREATIONAL VEHICLE INCLUDE RISK OF EXPLOSION AND FIRE WHEN EXPOSED TO A SOURCEOF IGNITION, AND RESPIRATORY DISTRESS FROM THE GAS ITSELF.
Corrective Action: INSTALL RETROFIT KIT TO REPLACE THE ITT VALVE WITH A WHITE ROGER GAS CONTROL VALVE.

Subject: STEERING:POWER ASSIST:HYDROBOOST UNIT
Recall Description: INCORRECT MANUFACTURE OF THE HYDROBOOST CYLINDER ALLOWS THE BALL SOCKET CLAMP TO CONTACT RIGHT SIDE STEERING LEVER ON AN EXTREME LEFT TURN AND CAUSE FLEXING OF THE CYLINDER ROD .
Consequence Summary: THIS FLEXING CAN CAUSE SEAL FAILURE OR CYLINDER FAILUREOF THE HYDROBOOST UNIT AND RESULT IN LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL AND RESULT IN AVEHICLE ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE INCORRECTLY BUILT BOOST CYLINDERS.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT
Recall Description: CHILD RESTRAINT SYSTEMS FAILED TO MEET HEAD EXCURSION REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 213 BECAUSE OF CHILD SEAT BASE DESIGN.
Consequence Summary: SEAT OCCUPANT WOULD FACE INCREASED RISK OF INJURY IN THEEVENT OF A SUDDEN STOP OR ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE CHILD SEAT BASE WITH CORRECTED BASE AND REPAIR KIT FROM THE MANUFACTURER.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT
Recall Description: CHILD RESTRAINTS HAVE STRIPED SEAT COVERS WHICH FAILED THE FLAMMABILITY REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 213.
Consequence Summary: SEAT OCCUPANT WOULD FACE INCREASED RISK OF INJURY FROM AFIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SEAT COVERS.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT
Recall Description: THE BREAST SHIELD COULD SEPARATE FROM THE TONGUE OF THE RESTRAINT ASSEMBLY IN CRASH CONDITIONS BECAUSE OF A FAULTY BUCKLE FRAME.
Consequence Summary: BREAST SHIELD SEPARATION DURING A SUDDEN STOP OR CRASHWOULD EXPOSE SEAT OCCUPANT TO INCREASED RISK OF INJURY. SEAT FAILS TO COMPLYWITH REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 213.
Corrective Action: REPLACE BREAST SHIELD ASSEMBLIES.

Subject: HEATER:COMBUSTION(GAS):DEFROSTER:DEFOGGER
Recall Description: INTERNAL STRESSES OF THE HEATER MAY CAUSE THE COVER TO THE HEATER UNIT FUEL PUMP TO LOOSEN, RESULTING IN A FUEL LEAK.
Consequence Summary: LEAKING FUEL RESULTS IN VEHICLE FIRE WHEN EXPOSED TO ASOURCE OF IGNITION.
Corrective Action: REPLACE AND STRENGTHEN BOLT CONNECTIONS BETWEEN THE PUMP HOUSING AND THE PUMP COVER WITH LONGER BOLTS.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:JACKS:STAND
Recall Description: JACK STAND CANNOT HOLD THE RATED CAPACITY OF 8,000 POUNDS ON A SINGLE POST OF THE SADDLE.
Consequence Summary: JACK STAND FAILURE TO HOLD THE RATED WEIGHT CAPACITY CANRESULT IN INJURY IF A PERSON IS WORKING UNDER OR NEAR THE VEHICLE ON THE JACKSTAND.
Corrective Action: NEW WARNING LABELS SHOWING A 6500 POUND CAPACITY FOR THE JACK STAND WILL BE DISTRIBUTED.

Subject: EMERGENCY PARKING BRAKE:MECHANICAL:LINKAGES AND CA
Recall Description: MISMATCHED PARKING BRAKE CABLE LENGTHS TO THE REAR WHEELS REDUCES BRAKING ABILITY OF ONE OF THE REAR WHEELS, IN VIOLATION OF FMVSS 105.
Consequence Summary: INSUFFICIENT BRAKING ABLITY COULD RESULT IN INADVERTENTVEHICLE ROLLAWAY WHICH COULD RESULT IN A VEHICLE ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE MISMATCHED PARKING BRAKE CABLE WITH ONE OF CORRECT LENGTH.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:BELTS
Recall Description: AUTOMATIC SHOULDER BELT ASSEMBLY MAY MALFUNCTION DURING ABRUPT BRAKING OR CORNERING. THE ASSEMBLY MAY TIGHTEN AGAINST THE OCCUPANT  RESTRICTING MOVEMENT. ALSO, THE RETRACTOR DRIVER UNIT MAY STALL IN ANY POSITION, LEAVING THE BELT LOOSE. IN EITHER CASE, THE BELT WOULD NOT RETRACT WHEN THE DOOR IS OPENED.
Consequence Summary: THE AUTOMATIC SHOULDER RESTRAINT SYSTEM WOULD NOT ALLOWSEAT OCCUPANT TO EXIT THE VEHICLE WITHOUT DISCONNECTING THE SAFETY BELT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE AUTOMATIC SAFETY BELT ASSEMBLIES.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:ANTI-SKID SYSTEM
Recall Description: A RETURN FLUID LINE OF THE FRONT BRAKE SYSTEM IS MISCONNECTED TO A REAR BRAKE FLUID RETURN. WHEN THE ABS SYSTEM COMES INTO USE, ALL THE FLUID FROM THE FRONT BRAKES GOES TO THE REAR BRAKE SYSTEM. THE FLUID RETURNS TO THE FRONT SYSTEM WHEN THE BRAKE PEDAL IS RELEASED.
Consequence Summary: TOTAL LOSS OF FLUID IN THE FRONT BRAKE SYSTEM LEADS TOINCREASED STOPPING DISTANCES, AND COULD RESULT IN VEHICLE COLLISION.
Corrective Action: REPLACE DEFECTIVE ABS SYSTEMS.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT
Recall Description: THE CHILD SEATS FAIL TO MEET THE HEAD EXCURSION REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 213 (EXCEEDED PRESCRIBED 32 INCH HEAD EXCURSION LIMIT).
Corrective Action: MANUFACTURER WILL FURNISH A REPAIR KIT CONSISTING OF A HARNESS RETAINER WITH INSTALLATION AND USE INSTRUCTIONS.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:JACKS:STAND
Recall Description: SADDLE ON THE CENTER COLUMN OF THE JACK STAND ALLOWS OFF-CENTER LOADING, AND THE BASE AND INNER TUBE ASSEMBLY MATERIALS ARE OF INSUFFICIENT STRENGTH TO WITHSTAND PIN-HOLE DISTORTION UNDER LOAD.
Consequence Summary: OFF-CENTER LOADING AND/OR INSUFFICIENT STRENGTH OFTHE BASE AND INNER TUBE ASSEMBLY MATERIALS COULD CAUSE JACK STAND COLLAPSE. THISCOULD RESULT IN INJURY TO ANYONE IN VICINITY OF THE JACK STAND WHEN COLLAPSEOCCURS.
Corrective Action: MANUFACTURER WILL REPLACE JACK STANDS WITH REDESIGNED SADDLE AND STRENGTHENED MATERIAL MODELS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN
Recall Description: SAFETY BELTS ARE DESIGNED TO BE ROUTED UNDER A DIAGONAL CROSS BRACE DURING FASTENING. THE INSTRUCTIONAL LABELS FOR THE BELT ROUTING ARE INADEQUATE, AND CAN RESULT IN INADVERTENT RELEASE OF THE BELT BUCKLE.
Consequence Summary: CONSEQUENCE OF DEFECT:  SAFETY BELT MISUSE COULD CAUSE THE SEAT OCCUPANT TO FACE GREATER RISK OF INJURY IN A SUDDEN STOP OR VEHICLE ACCIDENT IF AN INADVERTENT RELEASE OF THE SAFETY BELT OCCURRED.
Corrective Action: INSTALL LABELS TO INSTRUCT THE USER IN PROPER SAFETY BELT ROUTING; ALSO REPLACE SAFETY BELT BUCKLES.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:WINDSHIELD WIPER:MOTOR
Recall Description: THE NUTS WHICH HOLD WINDSHIELD WIPER MOTOR TO THE WIPER MODULE MAY NOT HAVE BEEN SUFFICIENTLY TIGHTENED AND MAY LOOSEN OR COME OFF. THIS CAUSES CHANGED WIPER PATTERNS, OR THE WIPERS MAY JAM IF TWO OF THE THREE NUTS COME OFF.
Consequence Summary: CHANGES IN THE WIPER PATTERN OR JAMMING OF THE WIPERSWOULD RESULT IN REDUCED DRIVER VISIBILTY IN INCLEMENT WEATHER CONDITIONS.
Corrective Action: APPLY TORQUE RETENTION MATERIAL TO WIPER MOTOR STUDS AND NUTS AND RETORQUE.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:FRONT BUCKET SEAT LATCH
Recall Description: THE FRONT SEAT UPPER HINGE COVER SCREWS ARE TOO LONG, AND INTERFERE WITH THE SEAT BACK INERTIA LOCK. THIS PREVENTS THE SEAT BACK FROM LOCKING PROPERLY.
Consequence Summary: IN THE EVENT OF A SUDDEN STOP OR VEHICLE IMPACT, ANUNLOCKED SEAT BACK WOULD INCREASE THE RISK OF INJURY TO THE SEAT OCCUPANT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SCREWS SECURING UPPER HINGE TRIM COVER WITH CORRECT LENGTH SCREWS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN
Recall Description: THE REAR SEAT SAFETY BELT ANCHORAGE FAILED TO SUSTAIN THE LOADS REQUIRED BY FMVSS 210. SAFETY BELTS ARE ANCHORED TO A BAR ATTACHED TO THE FLOOR OF THE VEHICLE.
Consequence Summary: OCCUPANTS OF SEATS WITH UNSAFE BELTS HAVE INCREASED RISKOF INJURY IN THE EVENT OF A SUDDEN STOP OR VEHICLE ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE FLOOR MOUNTED SAFETY BELT ANCHORAGE WITH A FRAME MOUNTED ASSEMBLY.

Subject: STRUCTURE:HOOD ASSEMBLY:LATCHES
Recall Description: THE PRIMARY HOOD LATCH CAN RELEASE WHEN VEHICLE IS DRIVEN IN THE CONDITION OF HIGH WIND GUSTS. THE PRIMARY HOOD LATCH FAILURE WILL ALSO CAUSE THE SECONDARY HOOD LATCH TO FAIL SIMULTANEOUSLY.
Corrective Action: REPLACE DEFECTIVE PRIMARY AND SECONDARY LATCH MECHANISMS WITH A LARGER SPRING ON THE PRIMARY LATCH, AND A REDESIGNED CATCH ON THE SECONDARY LATCH.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:METALLIC
Recall Description: THE RIGHT REAR METAL BRAKE LINE COULD COME IN CONTACT WITH THE TOP OF THE RIGHT REAR SHOCK ABSORBER. THIS COULD LEAD TO AN EVENTUAL FLUID LEAK IN ONE OF THE TWO BRAKE CIRCUITS.
Consequence Summary: THE LEAK OF FLUID FROM THE REAR METAL BRAKE LINE COULDCAUSE REDUCED BRAKING EFFECTIVENESS AND INCREASE STOPPING DISTANCE.
Corrective Action: REROUTE REAR METAL BRAKE LINES TO AVOID CONTACT WITH THE REAR SHOCK ABSORBER, AND REPLACE BRAKE LINES THAT HAVE CONTACTED THE SHOCK ABSORBERS.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL:CAM:FAST IDLE
Recall Description: THE THROTTLE CABLE WHICH RUNS FROM THE ACCELERATOR TO THE GOVERNOR ASSEMBLY HOUSING MAY HAVE BEEN KINKED DURING ASSEMBLY, CAUSING EXCESSIVE WEAR OF THE CABLE HOUSING INNER LINING. THIS COULD RESULT IN EITHER FRACTURE OR STICKING OF THE CABLE.
Consequence Summary: IF THE THROTTLE CABLE FRACTURES, ENGINE SPEED WILL RETURNTO IDLE. IF THE CABLE JAMS OR STICKS, THE ENGINE WILL REMAIN AT THE SPEED ATWHICH IT WAS RUNNING WHEN THE JAMMING OCCURRED. A STUCK THROTTLE COULD RESULT INLOSS OF CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE GOVERNOR ASSEMBLIES, WHICH INCLUDE THE THROTTLE CABLE.

Subject: LIGHTING:GENERAL OR UNKNOWN COMPONENT:TAIL LIGHTS
Recall Description: THE STOP LAMPS ON THESE TRAILERS FAILED TO COMPLY WITH PHOTOMETRIC REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 108.
Consequence Summary: INADEQUATE STOP LIGHTS CAN CAUSE MOTORIST FOLLOWING THETRAILER TO MISS A STOP OR TURN SIGNAL, AND AN ACCIDENT MAY RESULT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE LENSES OF THE STOP LAMPS TO COMPLY WITH FMVSS 108.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:ARM:PITMAN
Recall Description: STRESSES IMPOSED ON THE LEVER DURING TURNING MANEUVERS AND/OR IMPACT INCIDENTS, SUCH AS WOULD BE CAUSED BY CURBS OR ROAD SURFACE IRREGULARITY, REDUCE THE LIFE EXPECTANCY OF THE PART. THE STEERING LEVER MAY CRACK AND EVENTUALLY THE STRESSES COULD CAUSE THE STEERING LEVER TO BREAK.
Consequence Summary: A BROKEN STEERING LEVER WILL CAUSE LOSS OF STEERINGCONTROL WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING WHICH MAY RESULT IN A VEHICLE CRASH.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE DEFECTIVE STEERING ARMS.

Subject: EMERGENCY PARKING BRAKE:AIR:VALVE:CONTROL
Recall Description: THE BENDIX MV-2 PARKING CONTROL VALVE INSTALLED IN VEHICLES WITHOUT A DESICCANT STYLE AIR DRYER MAY EXPERIENCE A SEAL FAILURE. THIS FAILURE MAY ALLOW THE VALVE TO MOVE FROM THE PARK POSITION TO THE RELEASE POSITION, ALLOWING THE PARKING BRAKES TO RELEASE.
Consequence Summary: RELEASE OF THE PARKING BRAKES WHILE THE VEHICLE ISUNATTENDED OR WITHOUT WARNING COULD RESULT IN A VEHICLE ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REBUILD THE BENDIX MV-2 PARKING CONTROL VALVE.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL PUMP
Recall Description: THE FUEL FILTER HOUSING, WHICH SERVES AS THE BASE FOR THE FUEL PUMP (LOCATED IN THE FUEL TANK) COULD DEFORM, RESULTING IN THE FUEL PUMP BECOMING LOOSE.
Consequence Summary: A LOOSE AND IMPROPERLY SEATED FUEL PUMP CAN CAUSEREDUCED FUEL FLOW TO THE ENGINE RESULTING IN POSSIBLE DRIVABILITY PROBLEMS ANDSTALLING OF THE VEHICLE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FUEL FILTER.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN
Recall Description: THE METAL LATCHPLATES MAY NOT ENGAGE THE BUCKLE ASSEMBLIES, CAUSING A "NO LATCH" CONDITION. MOVEMENT OF THE SEAT OCCUPANT IN THIS CONDITION COULD CAUSE LATCHPLATE RELEASE FROM THE BUCKLE.
Consequence Summary: UNBELTED OR INCORRECTLY BELTED SEAT OCCUPANTS ARESUBJECTED TO INCREASED RISK OF INJURY IN THE EVENT OF SUDDEN STOP OR ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE RETRACTOR ASSEMBLY FOR THE SAFETY BELT (FRONT AND REAR IN COUPES AND FRONT ONLY IN CONVERTIBLES).

Subject: ENGINE COOLING SYSTEM:FAN
Recall Description: THE ENGINE FAN MAY EXPERIENCE A RESONANT FREQUENCY CAUSING PREMATURE FAN FAILURE, AND SEPARATION FROM THE ENGINE.
Consequence Summary: ENGINE FAN SEPARATION CAN CAUSE DEATH OR INJURY TO ANYPERSON IN THE PATH OF THE FAN.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ENGINE FAN WITH FAN FROM ANOTHER MANUFACTURER.

Subject: TIRES:TREAD
Recall Description: UNDERCURED TIRES MAY DEVELOP BELT OR TREAD SEPARATION CAUSED BY A LACK OF ADHESION OF THE BELT TO THE TREAD.
Consequence Summary: TREAD SEPARATION WOULD LEAD TO A THUMPING NOISE ANDVIBRATION IN USE. IF NOT SERVICED, TREAD SEPARATION COULD LEAD TO PLY CORDSBREAKING AND TEARING OF THE TUBELESS LINER, RESULTING IN LOSS OF INFLATING AIRAND STEERING CONTROL.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE UNDERCURED TIRES.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC
Recall Description: TRANSMISSION SHIFT CABLE BRACKET CAN BE DAMAGED BY THE ENGINE ROCKING FORWARD ON ENGINE MOUNTS IN A MINOR COLLISION.
Consequence Summary: WHEN THE SHIFT CABLE BRACKET IS DAMAGED, THE SHIFT LEVERPOSITION MAY NOT CORRECTLY INDICATE THE TRANSMISSION GEAR POSITION. THIS COULDRESULT IN UNANTICIPATED MOVEMENT OF THE CAR AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE TRANSMISSION SHIFT CABLE AND ATTACHING HARDWARE WITH REDESIGNED ASSEMBLIES.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: IMPROPER INSERTION/CRIMPING OF THE HOSE-TO-END FITTINGS OF THE HIGH PRESSURE HOSE ON THE ANTI-LOCK BRAKE SYSTEM CAN CAUSE DETACHMENT OF THE HOSE FROM THE ABS SYSTEM, AND DISCHARGE OF HYDRAULIC FLUID.
Consequence Summary: DETACHMENT OF THE HOSE FROM THE ABS SYSTEM CAUSES THELOSS OF THE ABS FUNCTION AND HYDRAULIC BRAKE ASSIST, LEAVING ONLY MANUAL BRAKESAND DECREASING STOPPING ABILITY, WHICH COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT. DISCHARGE OFHYDRAULIC FLUID IN THE AREA OF THE HOT EXHAUST SYSTEM COULD RESULT IN AN ENGINECOMPARTMENT FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE ABS HIGH PRESSURE HOSE.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:SPEED CONTROL:LINKAGES(12:83)
Recall Description: THE LOCK NUT OF THE CRUISE CONTROL ROD FOR THE OPERATING SERVO MAY NOT HAVE BEEN PROPERLY TORQUED DURING MANUFACTURE.
Consequence Summary: INADEQUATE TORQUE OF THE LOCK NUT COULD ALLOW THE RODADJUSTMENT TO CHANGE. THIS COULD INCREASE THE ENGINE IDLE SPEED, AND POSSIBLYINCREASE STOPPING DISTANCE WITH A POTENTIAL FOR A VEHICLE ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: CHECK AND ASSURE PROPER LOCK NUT TORQUE ON THE CRUISE  CONTROL ROD.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN
Recall Description: DRIVER'S SAFETY BELT IS TOO SHORT TO MEET LENGTH REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 209.
Consequence Summary: SHORT SAFETY BELTS WOULD DISCOURAGE DRIVER FROM USINGTHEM. SEAT OCCUPANT NOT USING SAFETY BELT WOULD NOT HAVE ADEQUATE PROTECTION INCASE OF A SUDDEN STOP OR ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE BELT ASSEMBLY WITH A COMPLIANT VERSION.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:TRAILER HITCHES AND ATTACHM
Consequence Summary: HITCH TOW BAR COULD SEPARATE FROM THE VERTICAL MOUNTINGPLATE, RESULTING IN TOW BAR ATTACHMENT FAILURE AND SEPARATION OF TRAILER FROMTOW VEHICLE WITHOUT WARNING.
Corrective Action: A COMPONENT WILL BE SUPPLIED TO CUSTOMER TO BE ATTACHED TO THE VEHICLE TOWING LOOP, TO ELIMINATE CYCLIC STRESS IN THE VERTICAL LOAD PLATE. UNITS FOUND WITH EXISTING FATIGUE FRACTURES WILL BE REPLACED WITH MODIFIED HITCHES.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:AXLE ASSEMBLY
Recall Description: REAR AXLE BEARINGS MAY FAIL DUE TO A BENDING MOMENT CREATED BY THE AFTERMARKET DUAL REAR WHEELS FROM A VARIETY OF FACTORS AND ESPECIALLY WHEN OVERLOADED. FAILURE OF THE BEARINGS CREATE STRESSES ON THE  REAR AXLE, RESULTING IN THE BREAKAGE OF THE AXLE.
Consequence Summary: A BROKEN AXLE WILL CAUSE SEPARATION OF THE DUAL REARWHEEL ASSEMBLY FROM THE MOTORHOME, CAUSING LOSS OF CONTROL WHICH COULD RESULT AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE REAR AXLE ASSEMBLIES WITH FULL-FLOATING REAR AXLE ASSEMBLIES. ALSO, LITERATURE WILL BE CIRCULATED CAUTIONING VEHICLE OWNERS NOT TO OVERLOAD THE MICRO-MINI MOTORHOMES.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:AXLE ASSEMBLY
Recall Description: REAR AXLE BEARINGS MAY FAIL DUE TO A BENDING MOMENT CREATED BY THE AFTERMARKET DUAL REAR WHEELS FROM A VARIETY OF FACTORS AND ESPECIALLY WHEN OVERLOADED. FAILURE OF THE BEARINGS CREATE STRESSES ON THE REAR AXLE, RESULTING IN THE BREAKAGE OF THE AXLE.
Consequence Summary: A BROKEN AXLE WILL CAUSE SEPARATION OF THE DUAL REARWHEEL ASSEMBLY FROM THE MOTORHOME, CAUSING LOSS OF CONTROL WHICH COULD RESULT INAN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE REAR AXLE ASSEMBLIES WITH FULL-FLOATING REAR AXLE ASSEMBLIES.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:AXLE ASSEMBLY
Recall Description: REAR AXLE BEARINGS MAY FAIL DUE TO A BENDING MOMENT CREATED BY THE AFTERMARKET DUAL REAR WHEELS FROM A VARIETY OF FACTORS AND ESPECIALLY WHEN OVERLOADED. FAILURE OF THE BEARINGS CREATE STRESSES ON THE REAR AXLE, RESULTING IN THE BREAKAGE OF THE AXLE.
Consequence Summary: A BROKEN AXLE WILL CAUSE SEPARATION OF THE DUAL REARWHEEL ASSEMBLY FROM THE MOTORHOME, CAUSING LOSS OF CONTROL WHICH COULD RESULT INAN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE REAR AXLE ASSEMBLIES WITH FULL-FLOATING REAR AXLE ASSEMBLIES.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:AXLE ASSEMBLY
Recall Description: REAR AXLE BEARINGS MAY FAIL DUE TO A BENDING MOMENT CREATED BY THE AFTERMARKET DUAL REAR WHEELS FROM A VARIETY OF FACTORS AND ESPECIALLY WHEN OVERLOADED. FAILURE OF THE BEARINGS CREATE STRESSES ON THE THE REAR AXLE, RESULTING IN BREAKAGE OF THE AXLE.
Consequence Summary: A BROKEN AXLE WILL CAUSE SEPARATION OF THE DUAL REARWHEEL ASSEMBLY FROM THE MOTORHOME, CAUSING LOSS OF CONTROL WHICH COULD RESULT INAN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE REAR AXLE ASSEMBLIES WITH FULL-FLOATING REAR AXLE ASSEMBLIES.

Subject: EMERGENCY PARKING BRAKE:MECHANICAL
Recall Description: PARKING BRAKE ADJUSTER FAILS TO OPERATE AND DO NOT WORK AFTER BRAKE PAD WEAR.
Consequence Summary: PARKING BRAKES WILL NOT COMPLETELY HOLD A PARKED VEHICLEWHEN PARKED ON A SLOPE, CAUSING UNINTENDED VEHICLE ROLLAWAY WHICH COULD RESULTIN A VEHICLE ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE NONFUNCTIONING PARKING BRAKE ADJUSTERS.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:CLUTCH ASSEMBLY
Recall Description: A MISALIGNMENT OF AN OIL SUPPLY HOLE IN A BUSHING PREVENTS OIL DELIVERY TO A PORTION OF THE CLUTCH ACTIVATING MECHANISM.
Consequence Summary: INCONSISTENT CLUTCH OPERATIONS CAUSED BY LACK OF OILDELIVERY TO CLUTCH ACTIVATING MECHANISM COULD CAUSE UNEXPECTED LOSS OF VEHICLECONTROL.
Corrective Action: REPLACE DEFECTIVE NEEDLE BEARING RACES AS NECESSARY.

Subject: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR
Recall Description: REAR SUSPENSION TRAILING ARM-TO-HANGER BRACKET PIVOT BOLTS MAY FAIL FROM STRESS CORROSION CRACKING POSSIBLY CAUSED BY PROCESSING DEVIATIONS IN THE CONSTRUCTION OF THE PIVOT BOLT.
Consequence Summary: FAILURE OF BOLTS MAY RESULT IN PARTIAL SEPARATION OF THEREAR SUSPENSION FROM THE VEHICLE, RESULTING IN LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL WITHOUTWARNING AND A VEHICLE CRASH.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE REAR SUSPENSION TRAILING ARM-TO-HANGER BRACKET PIVOT BOLT WITH A PROPERLY PROCESSED BOLT.

Subject: BMW/DRIVER SIDE KNEE BOOSTER
Recall Description: DURING TESTING, INCORRECTLY INSTALLED DRIVER-SIDE KNEE BOLSTER PREVENTED STEERING COLUMN FROM MOVING FORWARD AS DESIGNED TO ABSORB IMPACT ENERGY FROM DRIVER DUMMY.
Consequence Summary: CHEST DECELERATION EXCEEDS MAXIMUM ALLOWABLE LIMIT WHICHRESULTS IN INCREASED RISK OF OCCUPANT INJURY IN A SUDDEN STOP OR ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPAIR THE KNEE BOLSTER TO ALLOW CLEARANCE AND AVOID IMPEDANCE OF STEERING COLUMN MOVEMENT DURING FRONTAL IMPACT.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT BUCKLES
Recall Description: INBOARD FRONT SEAT BELT BUCKLE ASSEMBLY STRAPS CAN SUFFER FATIGUE FAILURE OF THE STRAP NEAR ITS ANCHOR POSITION.
Consequence Summary: FATIGUE FAILURE OF SAFETY BELTS IN A SUDDEN STOP ORACCIDENT CONDITION RESULTS IN INCREASED LIKELIHOOD OF INJURY TO SEAT OCCUPANT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FATIGUED STRAPS OR RETROFIT STRAPS WITH A REINFORCEMENT PLATE AND REMOVAL OF AN ANTIROTATION TAB TO PREVENT FATIGUE FAILURE.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:PIPE:FILLER:NECK
Recall Description: FUEL FILLER AND VENT HOSE CAME OFF DURING FMVSS 301 COMPLIANCE TEST.
Consequence Summary: SEPARATION OF FUEL FILLER AND VENT HOSE FROM FUEL TANKCAUSES FUEL TO SPILL FROM THE FUEL TANK. THE SPILLED FUEL COULD CATCH FIRE NEARAN IGNITION SOURCE; VEHICLE WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 301.
Corrective Action: TIGHTEN THE CLAMPS HOLDING THE HOSES TO THE TANK AND THE FUEL FILLER TUBE.

Subject: STEERING:WHEEL AND COLUMN
Recall Description: THE STEERING WHEEL MAY CRACK AT ITS MOUNTING HUB WELD ATTACHMENT BECAUSE OF FATIGUE LOADING AND EVENTUALLY SEPARATE FROM THE HUB.
Consequence Summary: SEPARATION OF THE STEERING WHEEL FROM ITS MOUNTING HUBRESULTS IN LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL AND A VEHICLE CRASH COULD OCCUR WITHOUTWARNING.
Corrective Action: REPLACE STEERING WHEELS WITH REVISED WHEEL WITH ARC WELDS ADDED AT THE WHEEL STAMPING-TO-HUB ATTACHMENT.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:JACKS:STAND
Recall Description: JACKSTANDS CANNOT SUPPORT THE RATED CAPACITY OF WEIGHT OF 3,500 POUNDS UNDER OFF CENTER LOADING CONDITIONS, AND IT CANNOT SUPPORT THE ONE HUNDRED AND FIFTY PERCENT CAPACITY OF 5250 POUNDS UNDER CENTERED LOADING CONDITIONS.
Consequence Summary: INABILITY OF THE JACKSTAND TO SUPPORT THE RATED CAPACITYWEIGHT COULD LEAD TO FAILURE , WITH INCREASED RISK OF INJURY TO ANYONE UNDER ORNEAR THE UNIT BEING SUPPORTED WHEN THE JACKSTAND FAILS.
Corrective Action: WARNING STICKERS WILL BE PROVIDED REMINDING USERS NOT TO LOAD THE JACKSTAND OFF CENTER, OR WITH MORE THAN 2000 POUNDS.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:JACKS
Recall Description: INSTRUCTION LABEL IN THE TRUNK OF VEHICLE IS INCORRECT FOR THE JACK SUPPLIED WITH THE VEHICLE.
Consequence Summary: INCORRECT USE CAN RESULT IN THE JACK COLLAPSING, WITHINJURY TO INDIVIDUALS UNDER OR NEAR VEHICLE DURING COLLAPSE.
Corrective Action: SUPPLY INSERT TO OWNER'S MANUAL NOTING CORRECT USAGE, AS WELL AS A CORRECTED INSTRUCTION LABEL FOR THE TRUNK.

Subject: SUSPENSION:TANDEM AXLE:REAR:LEAF SPRING ASSEMBLY:H
Recall Description: THE TANDEM AXLE REAR LEAF SUSPENSION SPRING HANGER CAN FRACTURE.
Consequence Summary: BROKEN SPRING HANGER CAN LEAD TO SEPARATION OF SUSPENSIONCOMPONENTS, LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL, POSSIBLE PROPERTY DAMAGE, AND PERSONALINJURY.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SPRING HANGER.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:TRACKS AND ANCHORS:FRONT SEAT:MAN
Recall Description: THE DRIVER'S SEAT AND THE PASSENGER FRONT OUTBOARD OCCUPANT SEAT ARE DESIGNED WITH THE SAFETY BELT ANCHORAGE ON THE SEAT STRUCTURE. THE WELDS ON THE ALUMINUM WELD MOUNT ASSEMBLY ATTACHING THE SEAT PEDESTAL TO THE CHASSIS COULD FRACTURE IN AN ACCIDENT AND WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 207 AND FMVSS 210.
Consequence Summary: FAILURE OF THE SEAT ASSEMBLY AND OR THE SEAT BELTASSEMBLY COULD RESULT IN INCREASED RISK OF INJURY TO SEAT OCCUPANT IN THE EVENTOF A SUDDEN STOP OR ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: A STEEL MEMBER WILL BE INSTALLED ATTACHING THE SEAT PEDESTAL TO THE CHASSIS FRAME.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:PEDAL
Recall Description: BRAKE PEDAL TRAVEL BEYOND HALF THE DISTANCE TO THE FLOOR IS IMPAIRED DUE TO THE MOUNTING OF A MURPHY THROTTLE INTERLOCK SOLENOID BETWEEN THE BRAKE PEDAL SHAFT AND FLOORBOARD.
Consequence Summary: THE INTERFERENCE WITH BRAKE PEDAL TRAVEL COULD IMPAIRTHE BRAKE SYSTEM AND EXTEND VEHICLE STOPPING DISTANCE, WHICH COULD RESULT IN ANACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPOSITION MURPHY THROTTLE INTERLOCK SOLENOID AWAY FROM ANY POSSIBLE INTERFERENCE WITH BRAKE PEDAL TRAVEL.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC
Recall Description: THE PARK ROD ASSEMBLY CONTAINS A PARK CAM WITH INADEQUATE SURFACE HARDNESS, WHICH COULD LEAD TO PARK DISENGAGEMENT OR NO PARK ENGAGEMENT WHEN THE LEVER IS PLACED IN PARK.
Consequence Summary: IF PARK IS NOT ENGAGED AND THE PARKING BRAKE IS OFF, AVEHICLE ROLL-AWAY COULD RESULT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE PARK ROD ASSEMBLY ON AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSIONS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN
Recall Description: A RIGHT HAND SEAT/SHOULDER BELT RETRACTOR MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED IN THE SECOND ROW LEFT HAND SEAT POSITION (DIRECTLY BEHIND DRIVER).
Consequence Summary: THE INCORRECT RETRACTOR MAY CAUSE THE BELTS TO LOCK UPIF THE VAN IS PARKED ON A STEEP GRADE. AS A RESULT OF THIS, THE OCCUPANT COULDNOT EXTEND THE BELT FOR USE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SHOULDER BELT ASSEMBLY.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS
Recall Description: AIR BRAKE SYSTEM WAS MODIFIED BY ADDING A LONGER AIR LINE BETWEEN THE ABS SOLENOID AND THE TRANSFER TEE TO SIMPLIFY MANUFACTURING. THIS MODIFICATION CAUSED THE TRUCKS TO BE IN NON-COMPLIANCE WITH FMVSS 121, BRAKE TIMING TEST.
Consequence Summary: THE MISTIMED BRAKE AND ABS SYSTEM MAY CAUSE THE TRUCK TOFAIL THE STOPPING DISTANCE REQUIREMENT OF THE FMVSS, WHICH MAY LEAD TO ANACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REMOVE THE EXTRA LENGTH OF AIR LINE AND INSTALL THE TRANSFER TEE AT THE ABS SOLENOID.

Subject: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:SWAY BAR
Recall Description: REAR AXLE STABILIZER (SWAY) BAR MAY NOT HAVE BEEN PROPERLY HEAT TREATED.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE STABILIZER BAR.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: THE AIR BRAKE HOSE OF THE ASSEMBLY DOES NOT MEET ADHESION REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 106.
Consequence Summary: THE LOW ADHESION PROPERTY OF THE HOSE LEADS TO AIR BEINGTRAPPED BETWEEN THE PLIES, BALLOONING INWARD, CAUSING HOSE BLOCKAGE. HOSEBLOCKAGE RESULTS IN SLOW BRAKING OR COMPLETE BRAKE FAILURE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE NONCOMPLYING AIR BRAKE HOSE ASSEMBLIES.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:BATTERY:OTHER PART
Recall Description: ROUTING OF BATTERY MAIN FEED WIRING MAY ALLOW IT TO CONTACT THE AIR CLEANER BRACKET AND CONTNUED CONTACT MAY LEAD TO AN ELECTRICAL SHORT CIRCUIT.
Consequence Summary: THE ELECTRICAL SHORT CAUSED BY CONTINUOUS CONTACT COULDRESULT IN THE IGNITION OF THE WIRING INSULATION, AND AN UNDERHOOD FIRE.
Corrective Action: THE MAIN FEED ON ALL INVOLVED VEHICLES WILL BE REROUTED AND SECURED WITH TIE STRAPS AWAY FROM THE AIR CLEANER BRACKET.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:BENCH
Recall Description: SEAT BACK OF THE REAR BENCH SEAT MAY BREAK AWAY FROM THE SEAT CUSHION IN AN ACCIDENT.
Consequence Summary: SEAT OCCUPANT WOULD BE SUBJECT TO GREATER INJURY; VEHICLEWOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 207.
Corrective Action: INSTALL REINFORCEMENT THAT RUNS FROM SIDE OF SEAT BACK FRAME ASSEMBLY TO SEAT CUSHION FRAME ASSEMBLY, STRENGTHENING THE SEAT BACK.

Subject: LIGHTING:FLASHER:TURN SIGNAL
Recall Description: INCORRECT TURN SIGNAL FLASHER INHIBITS INDICATION OF SIGNAL LAMP OUTAGE.
Consequence Summary: INOPERATIVE TURN SIGNAL LAMPS WOULD NOT INFORM DRIVERTHAT A LAMP WAS OUT, OR WARN OTHER DRIVERS OF INTENT TO TURN, CREATING A RISKOF ACCIDENT; VEHICLE DOES NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 108.
Corrective Action: REPLACE TURN SIGNAL FLASHER WITH PROPER FLASHER.

Subject: TIRES
Recall Description: TIRES WERE MOLDED WITH PROPER TUBE-TYPE LABEL, BUT MARKED TUBELESS.
Consequence Summary: IMPROPERLY LABELED TIRES MAY BE MISUSED  AND FAIL WITHOUTWARNING.
Corrective Action: TIRES WILL BE REPLACED AT NO COST WITHIN 60 DAYS OF NOTIFICATION.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:TRACKS AND ANCHORS:FRONT SEAT:MAN
Recall Description: INCORRECT SEAT BASE WELDS ON THE DRIVER AND FRONT PASSENGER SEATS CAUSES FAILURES OF THE SEAT BASE, AND CONSEQUENT FAILURE OF THE SAFETY BELT ANCHORAGES, WHICH DOES NOT MEET THE FMVSS 210 STANDARDS.
Consequence Summary: IN A SUDDEN STOP OR ACCIDENT, THE FAILURE OF THE SEATBASE AND THE SUBSEQUENT FAILURES OF THE SAFETY BELT ANCHORAGES MAY CAUSE SEATSTO NOT PROPERLY RESTRAIN OCCUPANTS, INCREASING THE RISK OF INJURY.
Corrective Action: CHANGE THE WELD PATTERN OF THE SEAT PEDESTALS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:TRACKS AND ANCHORS:FRONT SEAT:MAN
Recall Description: SEAT PEDESTALS ON MIDSHIP SEATS WERE IMPROPERLY WELDED; THIS FAILURE OF THE SEAT BASE ADDS TO THE LOAD ON THE SAFETY BELT ANCHORAGE, WHICH IN TURN CAUSES A FAILURE TO MEET THE FMVSS 210 STANDARDS.
Consequence Summary: SEAT FAILURES CAUSE THE SAFETY BELTS TO NOT PROPERLYRESTRAIN  OCCUPANTS IN A SUDDEN STOP OR ACCIDENT, INCREASING THE RISK OF INJURY.
Corrective Action: CHANGE THE WELD PATTERN ON THE SEAT PEDESTALS.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT
Recall Description: CHILD RESTRAINT FAILED HEAD AND KNEE EXCURSION REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 213.
Consequence Summary: CHILD WOULD BE SUBJECT TO GREATER INJURY IN A SUDDEN STOPOR ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ULTARA II SEAT SHELLS WITH CHAMPION SEAT SHELLS, AND USE THE ULTARA II T-SHIELDS WITH THE CHAMPION SEAT SHELLS.  FOR MORE INFORMATION PLEASE CONTACT EVENFLO AT 800-233-5921.

Subject: HEATER:ELECTRICAL:DEFROSTER:DEFOGGER:FAN MOTOR
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN MELT DOWN OF SURROUNDING PLASTICHOUSING AND POSSIBLE IGNITION OF THE MELTED MATERIAL, RESULTING IN A FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE BLOWER SWITCH RESISTOR WITH RESISTOR WITH FUSIBLE LINK, AND RELOCATE THE RESISTOR TO A LOCATION WITH INCREASED FLOW OF COOLING AIR.

Subject: HEATER:WATER:DEFROSTER:DEFOGGER:CIRCUIT BREAKER FU
Recall Description: FUSE BLOCK WIRING TERMINALS MAY NOT ADEQUATELY CLAMP THE POSITIVE ELECTRICAL CONNECTION OF HEATER BLOWER MOTOR FUSE BLADES.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD INCREASE ELECTRICAL RESISTANCE THAT COULDOVERHEAT AND IGNITE THE FUSE BLOCK AND TERMINAL WIRING, RESULTING IN ANINSTRUMENT PANEL FIRE.
Corrective Action: MODIFY FUSE BLOCK TERMINAL TO ENSURE ADEQUATE RETENTION CLAMP LOAD ON HEATER BLOWER FUSE BLADES.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEATS
Recall Description: THE POWER SEAT SWITCH WIRING IS ROUTED OVER RATHER THAN UNDER THE FRONT SEAT SUPPORT BRACE, ALLOWING DAMAGE BY SEAT CUSHION SPRING ENDS WHEN SEAT IS OCCUPIED.
Consequence Summary: POWER SEAT SWITCH WIRING INSULATION MAY BECOME ABRADED,OR PUNCTURED, AND AN ELECTRICAL SHORT COULD OCCUR THAT COULD RESULT IN A FIREIN THE SEAT CUSHION MATERIAL.
Corrective Action: REVISE ROUTING OF POWER SEAT WIRING TO PREVENT DAMAGE FROM SEAT CUSHION SPRING CONTACT.

Subject: LIGHTING:SWITCH:BUTTON:RING:HIGH/LOW BEAM DIMMER
Recall Description: CARS WERE BUILT MISSING A WIRE BETWEEN THE DIGITAL CLUSTER AND THE DIMMER CONTROL, THEREBY FAILING TO PROVIDE AT LEAST TWO LEVELS OF LIGHTING.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 101.
Corrective Action: REWIRE CONNECTION BETWEEN THE DIMMER SWITCH AND THE DIGITAL CLUSTER.

Subject: TIRES
Recall Description: SUSPECT TIRES HAVE AN UNACCEPTABLE NUMBER OF PLY SEPARATIONS.
Consequence Summary: PLY SEPARATION COULD CAUSE LOSS OF AIR PRESSURE AND LOSSOF STEERING CONTROL.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SUBJECT TIRES.

Subject: TIRES:TREAD
Recall Description: TREAD SEPARATION AND LOSS OF AIR PRESSURE; FAILS TO COMPLY WITH FMVSS 119.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SUSPECT TIRES.

Subject: EMERGENCY PARKING BRAKE:AIR:VALVE:CONTROL
Recall Description: IMPROPER PARK BRAKE CONTROL VALVES MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED; THE SUSPECT VEHICLE HAVE DISK BRAKES WITH PARK BRAKE VALVE DESIGNED FOR DRUM BRAKES.
Consequence Summary: TRUCKS LEFT WITH PARK BRAKES ENGAGED COULD BEGIN TO ROLLAFTER THE DISK BRAKES COOLED, AND COULD RESULT IN A VEHICLE CRASH WITHOUTWARNING.
Corrective Action: REPLACE CONTROL VALVE WITH THE CORRECT DISK BRAKE VALVE.

Subject: TIRES
Recall Description: TIRES MAY BE UNDERCURED BECAUSE THEY DID NOT RECIEVE HIGH PRESSURE STEAM TREATMENT DURING THE CURE CYCLE OF MANUFACTURE.
Consequence Summary: UNDERCURED TIRES ARE SUBJECT TO TREAD SEPARATION ANDBUBBLE IN THE SIDEWALL, WHICH COULD LEAD TO LOSS OF AIR PRESSURE AND LOSS OFSTEERING CONTROL.
Corrective Action: TIRES WILL BE REPLACED AT NO COST TO CONSUMER WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM THE DATE OF NOTIFICATION.

Subject: EMERGENCY PARKING BRAKE:MECHANICAL:DRIVELINE TYPE:
Recall Description: THE PARKING BRAKE DRUM ATTACHMENT BOLTS MAY LOOSEN AND CAUSE A DRIVELINE LOCKUP CONDITION WHEN THE BUS IS STOPPED OR ALMOST STOPPED.
Consequence Summary: DRIVELINE LOCK-UP COULD CAUSE LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROLWITHOUT PRIOR NOTICE, AND RESULT IN A VEHICLE CRASH.
Corrective Action: REMOVE ALL OF THE PARKING BRAKE DRUM BOLTS, APPLY A RETAINING COMPOUND TO NEW BOLTS, AND TORQUE THE NEW BOLTS TO SPECIFICATION.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT RETRACTORS
Recall Description: AUTOMATIC SHOULDER BELT RETRACTION MECHANISM DOES NOT FULLY RETRACT THE BELT AFTER IT IS EXTENDED, EITHER BY MOVEMENT OF THE UPPER TORSO OR AFTER REMOVAL BY OCCUPANT.
Consequence Summary: SEAT BELT SHOULDER HARNESS WOULD NOT PROVIDE ADEQUATEPROTECTION TO OCCUPANT IN A VEHICLE CRASH.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE WASHER BETWEEN THE SHOULDER BOLT AND UPPER MOUNTING BRACKET WITH SMALLER WASHER; THIS WILL ALLOW RETRACTOR TO OPERATE.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:GLASS:WINDSHIELD
Recall Description: POOR BOND ADHESION BETWEEN THE WINDSHIELD GLASS AND THE MOUNTING, WHICH COULD ALLOW THE WINDSHIELD TO SEPARATE FROM THE VEHICLE DURING A COLLISION. THIS FAILS TO CONFORM WITH FMVSS 212.
Consequence Summary: IF WINDSHIELD SEPARATION OCCURS IN A COLLISION, ANUNBELTED OCCUPANT COULD BE EJECTED FROM THE VEHICLE, AND PERSONAL INJURY COULDOCCUR.
Corrective Action: REMOVE ALL SEALER FROM WINDSHIELD AND MOUNTING; APPLY NEW BONDING AND SEALANT MATERIAL, AND REINSTALL WINDSHIELD.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL:SOLENOID:VALVES
Recall Description: INSUFFICIENT AXIAL CLEARANCE EXISTS FOR THROTTLE VALVE, SHAFT, AND HOUSING DUE TO THE DIFFERENT THERMAL EXPANSION RATES OF THE SEPARATE PARTS WHEN VEHICLE REACHES NORMAL OPERATING TEMPERATURES AND AMBIENT TEMPERATURE IS 40 DEGREES FAHRENHEIT OR LESS.
Consequence Summary: THE LIMITED AXIAL CLEARANCE CAN CAUSE THE MOVEMENT OF THETHROTTLE VALVE TO BE IMPEDED, THE VALVE IS UNABLE TO CLOSE. THIS IMPEDANCE WOULDKEEP THE VEHICLE FROM DECELERATING AT THE USUAL RATE AFTER THE GAS PEDAL ISRELEASED; THIS COULD CAUSE UNEXPECTED MAINTENANCE OF SPEED AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSPECT AND REPAIR THE VEHICLE BY REPLACING THROTTLE HOUSING IF INSUFFICIENT AXIAL CLEARANCE IS FOUND.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:AXLE ASSEMBLY:BEARING:AXLE SHAFT
Recall Description: BEARINGS USED IN THE REAR AXLE HUBS ON THESE VEHICLES ARE IMPROPERLY MACHINED; BEARING COULD SEIZE AT LOW MILEAGES BEFORE SUFFICIENT RUN IN IS ACHIEVED.
Consequence Summary: IF THE BEARING SIEZED, THE AXLE HUB WOULD BE NOISY ATBEST, AND IN THE WORST CASE, THE AXLE SHAFT COULD FALL OUT CAUSING LOSS OFVEHICLE CONTROL WHICH MAY RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW REAR WHEEL INNER AND OUTER BEARINGS.

Subject: TIRES
Recall Description: TIRES FAILED TO MEET ENDURANCE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 119.
Consequence Summary: TIRES WOULD WEAR TOO QUICKLY, WHICH COULD LEAD TO LOSSOF AIR PRESSURE AND LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SUSPECTED TIRES.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT
Recall Description: THE SEAT FAILS TO MEET THE HEAD AND KNEE EXCURSION REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 213, S5.1.3.
Consequence Summary: THE CHILD SEAT OCCUPANT WOULD BE SUBJECT TO INCREASEDRISK OF HEAD AND NECK INJURY IN THE EVENT OF AN ACCIDENT OR SUDDEN STOP.
Corrective Action: OWNERS ARE TO INSTALL A PLASTIC REINFORCEMENT TUBE KIT TO THE REAR OF THE SEAT SHELL TO REINFORCE THE SHELL. THIS TUBE KIT WILL BE SUPPLIED BY THE MANUFACTURER.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:FITTINGS:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: REAR BRAKE TUBE ROUTING IS CONTACTED BY FUEL TANK HEAT SHIELD WHEN SUSPENSION IS IN FULL JOUNCE POSITION. THIS DAMAGES THE BRAKE FLUID TUBE, CAUSING A LEAK.
Consequence Summary: LOSS OF FLUID FROM HALF OF THE DIAGONALLY SPLIT BRAKEHYDRAULIC SYSTEM AFFECTS BRAKING CAPABILITY, WHICH COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: MODIFY HEAT SHIELD TO ELIMINATE POTENTIAL FOR SHIELD CONTACTING BRAKE TUBE.

Subject: STRUCTURE:BUMPER ASSEMBLY:ATTACHMENTS/SUPPORT BARS
Recall Description: REAR BUMPER MAY BE SUSCEPTIBLE TO FATIGUE CRACKING UNDER EXTENDED TRAILER TOW SERVICE WHEN USING A BUMPER MOUNTED TRAILER HITCH.
Consequence Summary: BUMPER COULD SEPARATE FROM VEHICLE WHEN USING A BUMPERMOUNTED TRAILER HITCH BALL.
Corrective Action: INSTALL TWO ADDITIONAL BRACKETS, ONE ADDITIONAL BAR AND ASSOCIATED FASTENERS TO PREVENT BUMPER SEPARATION.

Subject: STRUCTURE:BUMPER ASSEMBLY:ATTACHMENTS/SUPPORT BARS
Recall Description: REAR BUMPER REINFORCEMENT MAY BE SUBJECT TO FATIGUE CRACKING UNDER EXTENDED TRAILER TOW SERVICE WHEN USING A BUMPER-MOUNTED TRAILER HITCH BALL.
Consequence Summary: UNDER EXTREME CONDITIONS, BUMPER COULD SEPARATE FROM THEVEHICLE WHEN USING A BUMPER MOUNTED TRAILER HITCH BALL.
Corrective Action: INSTALL TWO BRACKETS TO REINFORCE THE BUMPER.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:FITTINGS:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: IMPROPERLY INSTALLED BRAKE FLUID TUBE MAY ALLOW THE TUBE TO CONTACT THE STEERING INTERMEDIATE SHAFT DAMAGING THE TUBE.
Consequence Summary: BRAKE FLUID LEAKAGE COULD OCCUR AND RESULT IN PARTIALLOSS OF BRAKING CAPABILITY.
Corrective Action: REPOSITION BRAKE TUBE TO AVOID CONTACT WITH STEERING SHAFT; ALSO, REPLACE ANY DAMAGED BRAKE TUBES.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK
Recall Description: THE FRONT HEAT SHIELD MAY CONTACT THE FRONT OF THE PLASTIC FUEL TANK, CAUSING CUTS OR OTHER DAMAGE TO THE EXTENT OF PENETRATION.
Consequence Summary: THIS PENETRATION OF THE FUEL TANK CAUSES VAPORS TO ESCAPEAND POSSIBLY FUEL TO SPILL, WHICH COULD CATCH FIRE IN THE PRESENCE OF ANIGNITION SOURCE.
Corrective Action: RELOCATE THE HEAT SHIELD; INSPECT AND REPLACE DAMAGED FUEL FUEL TANKS.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK
Recall Description: THE HOT PLATE WELD WHICH ATTACHES THE VAPOR VENT VALVE CARRIER TO THE TOP OF THE PLASTIC FUEL TANK MAY PARTIALLY FRACTURE, ALLOWING VAPOR OF FUEL TO ESCAPE FROM THE TOP OF THE TANK.
Consequence Summary: THE ESCAPED VAPOR OR LEAKED FUEL COULD CAUSE A FIRE INTHE PRESENCE OF A SOURCE OF IGNITION.
Corrective Action: FUEL TANK WILL BE REMOVED AND INSPECTED FOR WELD INTEGRITY. FUEL TANKS WITH INADEQUATE WELDS WILL BE REPLACED.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:BELTS
Recall Description: IMPROPER BELT GUIDE PERFORMANCE CAN CAUSE FRAYING OF THE SHOULDER SAFETY BELTS NEAR THE RETRACTOR.
Consequence Summary: THE FRAYING OF THE SHOULDER SAFETY BELT WEBBING CAN CAUSEIMPROPER RETRACTION OF THE BELT, WHICH WOULD LEAD TO INADEQUATE PROTECTION OFSEAT OCCUPANT DURING A SUDDEN STOP OR ACCIDENT, AND COULD RESULT IN INCREASEDRISK OF INJURY.
Corrective Action: MODIFY THE SAFETY BELT GUIDES TO PREVENT FRAYING; AND OR REPLACE RETRACTOR ASSEMBLY IF FRAYING IS PRESENT.

Subject: TIRES:TREAD
Recall Description: SEPARATION BETWEEN TREAD AND CARCASS CAUSED A SMALL REDUCTION IN TIRE INFLATION PRESSURE DURING ENDURANCE TEST REQUIRED BY FMVSS 119.
Consequence Summary: TIRES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 119.
Corrective Action: RETURN TIRES TO DEALER FOR REPLACEMENT WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM RECEIPT OF NOTICE.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT
Recall Description: BUCKLE RELEASE FORCE MAY EXCEED 16 POUNDS WHEN NOT USED IN APPROPRIATE FORWARD LATCH POSITION FOR A CHILD WEIGHING 30 POUNDS AND MORE.
Consequence Summary: BUCKLE RELEASE FORCE WHICH EXCEEDS THE FMVSS 213REQUIREMENT OF 16 POUNDS MAY CAUSE PROBLEMS IN REMOVING A CHILD FROM THE CARSEAT AND VEHICLE IN POST ACCIDENT SITUATIONS.
Corrective Action: ISSUE NOTIFICATION, CHANGE INSTRUCTIONS AND LABELING TO INDICATE THAT THE REAR LATCH POSITION IS NOT TO BE USED WITH CHILDREN WEIGHING 30 POUNDS OR MORE.

Subject: LIGHTING:SWITCH:BUTTON:RING:HEAD LIGHTS
Recall Description: UNDERSIZED CRIMP ON WIRE FROM HEADLIGHT SWITCH TO DIMMER SWITCH CREATES ELECTRICAL RESISTANCE AND CAN CAUSE A SHORT IN THE HEADLIGHT WIRING SYSTEM.
Consequence Summary: A SHORT COULD RESULT IN HEADLIGHT LOSS WHICH PRESENTS APOTENTIAL FOR AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE DIMMER SWITCH WITH NEW 14 GAUGE WIRE WITH PROPERLY CRIMPED CONNECTIONS.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:POWER ASSIST:CHECK VALVE
Recall Description: WHEN THE VEHICLE IS EXPOSED TO TEMPERATURES BELOW 5 DEGREES FAHRENHEIT (-15 DEGREES C), THE NEUTRAL DETERGENT USED AS AN ASSEMBLY LUBRICANT MAY STICK TO THE CHECK VALVE, PREVENTING VALVE FROM FUNCTIONING.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CAUSE AN INOPERATIVE BRAKE POWER ASSIST WHICHDESCREASES BRAKING ABILITY, AND PRESENTS A POTENTIAL FOR AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE VACUUM HOSE ASSEMBLY.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:AUXILLIARY GENERATOR
Recall Description: THE MATERIAL USED IN THE PAWL AND SHAFT OF THE TWO TOP LOCKING MECHANISMS IN CONTAINER CLIP-ON DIESEL SETS DOES NOT HAVE ADEQUATE TENSILE STRENGTH OR WAS NOT PROPERLY HEAT TREATED, AND COULD CAUSE THE PAWL AND SHAFT TO FRACTURE.
Consequence Summary: FRACTURE OF SHAFT WHILE GENERATOR IS IN USE MAY CAUSEFLYING DEBRIS AND RESULT IN INJURY TO ANYONE IN VICINITY.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE CAST IRON SHAFTS WITH FORGED STEEL SHAFTS.

Subject: STRUCTURE:HOOD ASSEMBLY:LATCHES
Recall Description: LUGGAGE IN THE LUGGAGE COMPARTMENT AND OR PLASTIC TRIM SURROUNDING THE SAFETY LATCH MAY PREVENT THE LATCH ON THE FRONT HOOD FROM PROPERLY LOCKING.
Consequence Summary: LATCH FAILURE COULD CAUSE HOOD TO OPEN AND OBSTRUCT THEDRIVER'S FRONT VIEW WHICH COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE PLASTIC TRIM PIECE AND INSTALL A BRACKET BEHIND THE SAFETY LATCH TO PREVENT INTERFERENCE.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:IGNITION
Recall Description: IGNITION SWITCH COULD ENGAGE STARTER SOLENOID AND START ENGINE WITH AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION GEAR SHIFT LEVER IN ANY POSITION DUE TO AN INCORRECT COIL CONNECTION IN THE STARTER SOLENOID.
Consequence Summary: UNEXPECTED VEHICLE MOTION COULD OCCUR BASED ON POSITION OF SHIFT LEVER WHEN ENGINE STARTS; THIS COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL REPLACEMENT STARTER SOLENOIDS.

Subject: LIGHTING:SWITCH:BUTTON:RING:HEAD LIGHTS
Recall Description: HEADLIGHT SWITCH COULD MALFUNCTION CAUSING SUDDEN HIGH BEAMS FAILURE.
Consequence Summary: SUDDEN HIGH BEAMS FAILURE COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE HEADLIGHTS SWITCH.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:SHOE AND DRUM SYSTEM
Recall Description: LIMOUSINE FAILED TO MEET STOPPING DISTANCE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 105.
Consequence Summary: INCREASED STOPPING DISTANCE COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT;VEHICLES DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 105.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ORIGINAL REAR WHEEL BRAKE CYLINDER WITH A LARGER CYLINDER.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC
Consequence Summary: HOSE RUPTURE AND LEAKAGE COULD OCCUR WHEN EXPOSED TOHYDROSTATIC PRESSURES BELOW 800 PSI AND NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 106.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ALL HOSE ASSEMBLIES MADE PRIOR TO AUGUST 1989, AND NOT YET INSTALLED IN VEHICLES.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL LINES FITTINGS AND PUMP
Recall Description: DISTORTED FUEL LINES IN ENGINE COMPARTMENT MAY CONTACT THE STEERING COLUMN UNIVERSAL JOINT AND CAUSE DAMAGE TO THE FUEL LINE.
Consequence Summary: FUEL LEAKAGE COULD OCCUR FROM THE DAMAGED FLUID LINE AND,IN THE PRESENCE OF AN IGNITION SOURCE, COULD RESULT IN A FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPOSITION FUEL LINE TO PREVENT CONTACT WITH UNIVERSAL JOINT; IF FUEL LINES ARE ALREADY DAMAGED, REPAIR OR REPLACE FUEL LINES.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL PUMP
Recall Description: IF CONDITIONS OF HIGH AMBIENT TEMPERATURE, OVERFILLING OF THE FUEL TANK, AND INSUFFICIENT TORQUE ON THE SENDING UNIT LOCK RING EXIST SIMULTANEOUSLY, FUEL SEEPAGE MAY OCCUR FROM THE TOP OF THE TANK.
Consequence Summary: FUEL SEEPAGE COULD RESULT IN FIRE IN THE PRESENCE OF ANIGNITION SOURCE.
Corrective Action: RETORQUE SENDING UNIT LOCK RING; REPLACE LOCK RING GASKET IF FUEL SEEPAGE IS DETECTED.   NOTE: THE ONLY 940 MODEL SUBJECT TO THIS RECALL IS THE 940SE.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC:COOLING UNIT AN
Recall Description: THE RUBBER TUBE THAT CONNECTS THE TRANSMISSION TO THE TRANSMISSION OIL COOLER (IN THE RADIATOR) MAY DISCONNECT CAUSING DISCHARGE OF FLUID.
Consequence Summary: DISCHARGED TRANSMISSION FLUID MAY STRIKE THE EXHAUSTMANIFOLD OR THE EXHAUST PIPE AND RESULT IN A FIRE.
Corrective Action: INSTALL REVISED LINE AND CLAMPS TO IMPROVE LINE RETENTION TO THE TRANSMISSION.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:ARM:PITMAN
Recall Description: A CASTING FLAW IN THE STEERING BOX PITMAN AND OR IDLE ARMS MAY CAUSE METAL FATIGUE FAILURE.
Consequence Summary: FAILURE OF THE STEERING BOX PITMAN OR IDLE ARM COULDRESULT IN SUDDEN LOSS OF CONTROL WITHOUT WARNING WITH A POTENTIAL FOR ANACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE COMPONENTS WITH CASTING FLAW.

Subject: BRAKES:FLUID:HYDRAULIC (FLUID CONTAMINATION/WRONG
Recall Description: BRAKE FLUID EXHIBITED AN EVAPORATION RATE OF 85 PERCENT, EXCEEDING THE 80 PERCENT MAXIMUM ALLOWED BY FMVSS 116.
Consequence Summary: BRAKE FLUID WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 116. LOSS OFBRAKE FLUID THROUGH EVAPORATION COULD LEAD TO LOSS OF BRAKES IF THE FLUID LEVELIS NOT CHECKED REQULARLY.
Corrective Action: AFFECTED BRAKE FLUID CONTAINERS WILL BE REPLACED.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:ARM:PITMAN
Recall Description: PITMAN ARM PINCH BOLTS MAY HAVE BEEN INADEQUATELY TORQUED.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD ALLOW PITMAN ARM TO SLIP ON THE STEERING GEAROUTPUT SHAFT RESULTING IN LOSS OF CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: RETORQUE PINCH BOLTS AND RESET AS NECESSARY.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK
Recall Description: FRONT HEAT SHIELD EXTENSION MAY CONTACT THE UPPER FRONT CORNER OF PLASTIC FUEL TANK DAMAGING OR PUNCTURING THE FUEL TANK.
Consequence Summary: SUCH FUEL TANK DAMAGE COULD ALLOW VAPOR AND OR FUEL TOESCAPE; THIS COULD RESULT IN A FIRE IF A SOURCE OF IGNITION IS PRESENT.
Corrective Action: RELOCATE HEAT SHIELD; REPLACE FUEL TANK IF DAMAGED OR PUNCTURED.

Subject: STEERING:COLUMN
Corrective Action: REPLACE STEERING COLUMN ASSEMBLY.

Subject: STEERING:WHEEL AND COLUMN
Recall Description: THE STEERING WHEEL HUB TAPER MAY BE LARGER THAN THE SPECIFIED TOLERANCES.
Consequence Summary: PROGRESSIVE WEAR OF THE MATING PARTS COULD RESULT IN HUBSPLINE WEAR, CAUSING THE STEERING WHEEL FIT TO BECOME LOOSE. A LOOSE FIT IN THESTEERING WHEEL HUB CAN CAUSE LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL AND POTENTIAL VEHICLECRASH WITHOUT WARNING.
Corrective Action: REPLACE DEFECTIVE STEERING WHEEL HUBS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:RESTRAINT:BELT ANCHOR AND ATTACHM
Recall Description: BRACKETS MOUNTING AUTOMATIC SHOULDER BELT RETRACTOR ASSEMBLY MAY HAVE AN UNDERSTRENGTH SPOT WELD.
Consequence Summary: SHOULDER BELT COULD FAIL IN A COLLISION INCREASING THERISK OF INJURY TO THE OCCUPANT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL TWO BOLTS IN THE BRACKETS TO PREVENT SHOULDER BELT FAILURE.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:MIRRORS:OTHER
Recall Description: HEATING ELEMENT IN OUTSIDE MIRROR, WHICH ADHERES TO THE REFLECTIVE ACRYLIC LENS, MAY SHORT DUE TO WATER BUILDUP IN MIRROR HOUSING.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN MELTING OF THE LENS; DRIVER'S VIEWTHROUGH REAR VIEW MIRROR WOULD BE AFFECTED.
Corrective Action: REPLACE MIRRORS WITH UNITS DESIGNED TO PREVENT WATER BUILDUP.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:WINDSHIELD WIPER
Recall Description: WINDSHIELD WIPERS MAY OSCILLATE BEYOND THE PERIMETER OF THE WINDSHIELD FRAME CAUSING WIPER FAILURE.
Consequence Summary: WIPER FAILURE COULD RESULT IN OBSCURED VISION THROUGHTHE WINDSHIELD WITH POTENTIAL FOR AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW MOTOR BRACKET THAT WILL CORRECTLY POSITION WIPER MOTOR DRIVE SHAFT TO PREVENT OSCILLATION BEYOND THE WINDSHIELD FRAME.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:TIE ROD:INNER
Recall Description: IMPROPER HEAT TREATMENT OF TIE ROD ARMS CAUSES ARMS TO BE SUBJECT TO YIELDING AND FATIGUE CRACKS.
Consequence Summary: TIE ROD ARM COULD FRACTURE AND CAUSE LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL, WHICH COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE TIE ROD ARMS WITH ARMS THAT HAVE BEEN HEAT TREATED TO THE PROPER SPECIFICATIONS.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:METALLIC
Recall Description: SUSPENSION JOUNCE BUMPER COULD CONTACT LEFT REAR WHEEL BRAKE TUBE WHEN SUSPENSION IS AT FULL JOUNCE (BOUNCE).
Consequence Summary: CONTACT AT FULL JOUNCE MAY CAUSE THE BRAKE TUBE TOCOLLAPSE AND RESTRICT THE HYDRAULIC BRAKE FLUID PRESSURE TO THE LEFT REAR BRAKEWHICH AFFECTS THE BRAKING CAPABILITY OF THE VEHICLE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE LEFT REAR BRAKE TUBE WITH TUBE DESIGNED TO ELIMINATE CONTACT WITH BUMPER.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: ROUTING OF THE FRONT BRAKE HOSE MAY CAUSE EXCESSIVE HOSE FLEXING RESULTING IN PREMATURE FATIGUE CRACKING OF THE OUTER HOSE COVER.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD LEAD TO HOSE FAILURE AND LOSS OF BRAKE FLUIDREDUCING BRAKING EFFECTIVENESS.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FRONT BRAKE HOSES WITH HOSES REDESIGNED TO PROVIDE A MODIFIED ROUTING CONFIGURATION.

Subject: WHEELS:CAP:COVER:HUB
Recall Description: SCREWS THAT ATTACH WHEEL COVERS ON ORIGINAL EQUIPMENT WHEELS WERE NOT FULLY TORQUED AND MAY GRADUALLY LOOSEN AND SEPARATE FROM WHEELS UNDER EXTREME DRIVING CONDITIONS.
Consequence Summary: WHEEL COVERS COULD SEPARATE FROM WHEELS; THIS COULDPRESENT A HAZARD TO OTHER VEHICLES AND PEDESTRIANS IN VICINITY OF OCCURRENCE.
Corrective Action: APPLY "LOCTITE 242 (BLUE) TO THE WHEEL COVER ATTACHING SCREWS TO PREVENT SCREWS FROM LOOSENING.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:TRAILER HITCHES AND ATTACHM
Recall Description: THE PINS LOCKING THE TRAILER TAILGATE CLOSED MAY BREAK OR SHEAR.
Consequence Summary: THE TAILGATE COULD OPEN WITHOUT WARNING, ALLOWING TRAILERCONTENTS TO SPILL ONTO ROADWAY CREATING A HAZARD FOR OTHER VEHICLES ON THE ROAD.
Corrective Action: REPAIR TAILGATE LATCHPINS TO PREVENT SHEARING BT INSTALLING A TUBE OVER THE PINS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN
Recall Description: ADJUSTABLE LENGTH TETHER BELT ON DRIVER'S AIR SUSPENSION TYPE SEAT MAY NOT HAVE BEEN ADJUSTED TO THE CORRECT LENGTH DURING MANUFACTURE.
Consequence Summary: INCORRECT LENGTH BELTS WILL NOT PROPERLY RESTRAIN DRIVERIN AN ACCIDENT OR SUDDEN STOP AND WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 207 AND FMVSS 210.
Corrective Action: PROPERLY ADJUST TETHER BELTS TO CORRECT LENGTH.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: ROUTING OF BRAKE VACUUM HOSE FROM THE VACUUM PUMP TO THE STEEL VACUUM PIPE COULD ALLOW THE HOSE TO BE PINCHED WHEN CAB ASSEMBLY IS RAISED OR LOWERED.
Consequence Summary: THIS WOULD CAUSE AN INCREASE IN BRAKE PEDAL EFFORT, WHICHCOULD RESULT IN INCREASED STOPPING DISTANCE AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE BRAKE VACUUM HOSE WITH NEW-STYLE BRAKE VACUUM HOSE.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR:ANTILOCK SYSTEM
Recall Description: AUXILIARY TURN SIGNAL WIRE INSTALLED ON THE BRAKE SWITCH AT THE PEDAL INTERFERES WITH THE ANTI-LOCK BRAKE CIRCUIT ELECTRICAL SYSTEM; THIS INHIBITS FUNCTION OF THE ANTI-LOCK BRAKES.
Consequence Summary: THE ANTI-LOCK BRAKES WOULD NOT FUNCTION IN A SUDDEN STOP.
Corrective Action: REMOVE AUXILIARY TURN SIGNAL WIRE FROM BRAKE PEDAL SWITCH AND INSTALL IN DIFFERENT LOCATION OF ELECTRICAL CIRCUIT.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:BATTERY:CABLE
Recall Description: WHEN BRAKE AIR LINES AND BATTERY ELECTRICAL CABLES ARE ROUTED THROUGH THE ANGLE BRACKETS ON THE FRAME RAILS, THE LEAF SPRING MAY RUB AGAINST THE BATTERY CABLES OR AIR LINES, CAUSING FRAYING AND EVENTUALLY RUPTURE.
Consequence Summary: IF THE BATTERY CABLES ARE SUFFICIENTLY FRAYED, THE CABLESMAY CAUSE A SHORT CIRCUIT AND RESULT IN A FIRE. IF THE BRAKE AIR LINES ARERUPTURED OR PUNCTURED, SEVERELY DECREASED BRAKING ABILITY MAY ENSUE.
Corrective Action: REROUTE BATTERY AND AIR LINE HOSES AWAY FROM THE REAR TRANSMISSION SUPPORT SPRING.

Subject: STEERING:POWER:SHAFT LOWER WORM
Recall Description: HARD BRAKING OCCURRING DURING A TURNING MANEUVER CAN CAUSE THE FIREWALL MOUNTED STEERING SHAFT KNUCKLE AND THE ENGINE MOUNTED FUEL FILTER BRACKET TO COME IN CONTACT.
Consequence Summary: THE CONTACT BETWEEN THE STEERING SHAFT KNUCKLE AND THEFUEL FILTER BRACKET CAN RESULT IN A STEERING LOCK, LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL,AND A VEHICLE ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE FUEL FILTER BRACKET WITH NEW BRACKETS WHICH WILL PROVIDE GREATER CLEARANCE BETWEEN THE BRACKET AND THE STEERING SHAFT KNUCKLE.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:TRAILER HITCHES AND ATTACHM
Recall Description: THE MATING SURFACE ON SOME LAMINATED "J" HOOKS MAY BE UNEVEN, OR THE SWING DOWN ARMS UNEQUAL IN LENGTH, EITHER OF WHICH COULD RESULT IN UNEVEN LOAD BEARING OF THE HOOKS.
Consequence Summary: UNEVEN LOAD BEARING ON "J" HOOKS COULD CAUSE FAILURE OFEITHER HOOK, WHICH RESULTS IN TRAILER SEPARATION AND A VEHCILE CRASH WITHOUTWARNING.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SWING DOWN ARMS IF THEY ARE UNEQUAL IN LENGTH, AND INSPECT AND REPAIR "J" HOOKS TO ASSURE SYMMETRICAL LOADING.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEATS
Recall Description: THE SEAT DO NOT COMPLY WITH ENERGY ABSORPTION REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 222.
Consequence Summary: THE REAR FACING SEATS HAD ONLY ONE THIRD OF THE REQUIREDENERGY ABSORPTION; A PASSENGER USING THIS SEAT COULD BE INJURED IN A SUDDEN STOPOR AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW FOLDUP SEATS WITH APPROPRIATE FASTENERS.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:GLASS:OTHER
Recall Description: EMERGENCY EXIT WINDOWS MAY NOT HAVE ALIGNMENT BLOCKS PERMITTING EXCESSIVE PLAY IN THE EXIT HANDLE PORTION OF THE WINDOW.
Consequence Summary: WINDOW COULD OPEN UNEXPECTEDLY CAUSING PERSONAL INJURY OR INVOLUNTARY EJECTION FROM THE VEHICLE; WINDOWS DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 217.
Corrective Action: INSTALL ALIGNMENT BLOCKS TO ASSURE PROPER OPERATION OF EMERGENCY EXIT WINDOW.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES
Recall Description: TURBULENCE CAUSED BY AERODYNAMIC QUALITES OF THE MOTORHOMES AT HIGHWAY SPEED CAN CAUSE THE AWNING TO UNROLL AND BREAK FREE FROM ITS MOUNTING SECUREMENT.
Consequence Summary: DETACHMENT OF AWNING WIHTOUT WARNING CREATES A BALLISTICOBJECT SHEARING FROM VEHICLE WHICH COULD CAUSE INJURY TO PERSON IN THE VICINITY.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:AIR BAG IMPACT
Recall Description: THE TWO AIR BAG SYSTEM FRONT IMPACT SENSORS MAY NOT BE SECURED TO THEIR MOUNTING BRACKETS.
Consequence Summary: AIR BAG WILL NOT DEPLOY IN A FRONTAL COLLISION IF THEFRONT IMPACT SENSORS ARE NOT ATTACHED.
Corrective Action: REPAIR TO ASSURE PROPER ATTACHMENT OF FRONT IMPACT SENSORS TO BRACKETS.

Subject: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT CONTROL ARM:LOWER
Recall Description: NUTS USED TO ATTACH LOWER CONTROL ARMS, REAR SPRING AND SHACKLE, AND REAR SHOCK ABSORBERS DO NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS AND COULD "STRIP".
Consequence Summary: STRIPPING OF THE NUTS IN THE REAR SUSPENSION COULD REDUCECLAMP LOAD ON LOWER CONTROL ARM, WHICH COULD ALLOW THE ARM TO DETACH, RESULTINGIN LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE LOWER CONTROL ARM ATTACHMENT NUTS AS WELL AS REAR SPRING AND SHACKLE, AND REAR SHOCK ABSORBER NUTS.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:WINDSHIELD WIPER ARM
Recall Description: THE TWO SECTIONS OF WIPER ARM MAY CONTACT OR CROSS EACH OTHER AND BIND WITH EVENTUAL FAILURE OF ATTACHMENT RIVET; ALSO, WIPER BLADE COULD CONTACT WINDOW MOULDING WITH INCREASED POTENTIAL FOR WIPER ARM FAILURE.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN WINDSHIELD WIPER FAILURE WITHOUTWARNING, AFFECTING DRIVER VISIBILITY WITH POTENTIAL FOR AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REDUCE BLADE SWEEP AREA TO AN ARC SPECIFICATION OF 85 DEGREES THROUGH A RETROFIT CONLINK KIT.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:PEDALS AND LINKAGES
Recall Description: LOWER END OF BRAKE ROD, WHICH CONNECTS BRAKE PEDAL ARM TO BELL CRANK OF POWER BRAKE ASSEBLY, MAY HAVE INADEQUATE WALL THICKNESS.
Consequence Summary: BELLCRANK WALL COULD FRACTURE WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING ANDRESULT IN LOSS OF SERVICE BRAKING CAPABILITY WITH POTENTIAL FOR AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW BRAKE ROD WITHW ADEQUATE WALL THICKNESS.

Subject: WHEELS:LUGS:NUTS:BOLTS
Recall Description: LUG NUTS THAT RETAIN WHEELS AND WHEEL COVERS MAY HAVE BEEN TORQUED TO LOWER THAN RECOMMENDED SPECIFICATIONS.
Consequence Summary: INSUFFICIENT CLAMPING OF LUG NUTS RETAINING THE WHEELCOVER AND WHEEL COULD RESULT IN A LOOSE WHEEL THAT COULD FALL OFF WITH POTENTIALFOR LOSS OF CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REMOVE ORIGINAL WHEEL COVER, TORQUE LUG TO SPECIFICATION, AND INSTALL FULL WHEEL COVERS THAT ARE RETAINED BY SPRING CLIPS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT TRACKS AND ANCHORS
Recall Description: UNDERSIZED BOLTS, LOCK WASHERS, AND NUTS MAY BEEN USED TO ATTACH THE DRIVER'S PEDESTAL TO THE FLOOR.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CAUSE PREMATURE SEPARATION OF THE SEAT ANDSEAT BELT ATTACHMENT FROM THE FLOOR DURING A CRASH WITH POTENTIAL FOR INJURY TOTHE DRIVER; ALSO, BUSES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 210.
