Corrective Action: REPLACE NON-COMPLYING DRIVER'S SEAT ATTACHING HARDWARE.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:BATTERY:CABLE
Recall Description: A SHORT CIRCUIT COULD DEVELOP DUE TO POSSIBLE CHAFING WHERE THE BATTERY CABLE IS CLOSE TO THE EVAPORATIVE EMISSIONS CONTROL SYSTEM.
Consequence Summary: BATTERY CABLE MIGHT OVERHEAT AND RESULT IN A FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE BATTERY CABLE AND OTHER APPROPRIATE PARTS.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:IGNITION:SWITCH:NEUTRAL START
Recall Description: ABRASION ON THE PRINTED CIRCUIT CARD IN THE COMBINATION NEUTRAL SAFETY/BACKUP LAMP SWITCH OPERATED BY THE AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION GEAR SELECTOR MAY CAUSE RESIDUE TO COLLECT IN ELECTRICAL AREA ON THE CIRCUIT CARD.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CAUSE OVERHEATING OF THE SWITCH ASSEMBLY WITHSMOKE AND POSSIBLY A FIRE IN THE CENTER CONSOLE AREA.
Corrective Action: ADD AN ELECTRICAL CIRCUIT, INCLUDING A RELAY, TO THE BACKUP LAMP CIRCUIT TO REDUCE THE CURRENT THAT CAN FLOW THROUGH THE COMBINATION SWITCH.

Subject: BRAKES:BRAKE FOOT VALVE (TREADLE)
Recall Description: THE HOOK-UP FOR THE BRAKE FOOT PEDAL FOR THE DRIVER ASSISTANT ON THE CURB SIDE MAY NOT BE CORRECTLY INSTALLED.
Consequence Summary: A SERVICE LINE FAILURE IN THE "A" OR "B" SYSTEM AIRSUPPLY COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF OPERATION OF THE BRAKE PEDAL FOR THE DRIVERASSISTANT.
Corrective Action: REPAIR PLUMBING HOOK-UP TO THE ASSISTANTS OPERATING STATION FOOT WCONTROLLED BRAKE VALVE.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:DISC:CALIPER
Recall Description: THE UPPER MOUNTING BOLT FOR FRONT BRAKE CALIPER(S) MIGHT FRACTURE WHILE IN USE.
Consequence Summary: THE FRONT BRAKE SYSTEM WILL REMAIN FUNCTIONAL, HOWEVER,THE BOLT'S MATING THREADED BUSHING CAN GRADUALLY MOVE OUT OF POSITION FAR ENOUGHFOR THE BUSHING TO CONTACT SPOKES ON THE MOTORCYCLE'S FRONT WHEEL. FRONT WHEELLOCKUP COULD OCCUR AND RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE UPPER CALIPER MOUNTING BOLTS.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:BATTERY:OTHER PART
Recall Description: POSITIVE JUMP START FEED STUD OR CABLE COULD MAKE ELECTRICAL CONTACT WITH MOUNTING BRACKET ON LEFT REAR UNDERSIDE OF SLEEPER BOX, CAUSING THE GROUND PATH TO BE THROUGH A SMALLER GAUGE WIRE.
Consequence Summary: HAVING THE GOUND PATH THROUGH A SMALLER GAUGE WIRE COULDCAUSE THE WIRE TO HEAT ENOUGH TO CAUSE AN IN CAB FIRE.
Corrective Action: REVISE JUMP START FEED STUD MOUNTING TO PREVENT CONTACT BETWEEN THE STUD OR CABLE WITH THE BRACKET.

Subject: HEATER:WATER:DEFROSTER:DEFOGGER:CONTROL SWITCH
Consequence Summary: IF SUCH CONTACT OCCURS WHEN HEATER FAN IS ON MEDIUMSPEED, AN ELECTRICAL SHORT OCCURS, CAUSING THE FAN SPEED CONTROL RESISTOR TOOVERHEAT AND MELT THE PLASTIC FAN HOUSING; THIS WOULD CREATE A POTENTIAL FORA FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPOSITION AIR RIDE SUSPENSION VALVE TO PREVENT ITS CONTACT WITH THE HEATER FAN CONTROL SWITCH.

Subject: TIRES:SIDEWALL
Recall Description: TIRES FROM DEFECTIVE MOLD MAY HAVE A HOLE IN THE UPPER SIDEWALL ON THE DOT SERIAL SIDE OF THE TIRE.
Consequence Summary: TIRES WILL LEAK WHEN INFLATED WHEN A HOLE IS PRESENT IN THE SIDEWALL.
Corrective Action: TIRES WILL BE REPLACED AT NO COST TO CONSUMER WITHIN 60 DAYS OF NOTIFICATION.

Subject: TIRES:TREAD
Recall Description: TIRES WERE MOLDED WITHOUT TREAD WEAR INDICATORS.
Consequence Summary: DRIVER MAY NOT BE AWARE OF EXTENT OF TIRE WEAR AND COULD CONTINUE TIRES IN USE, CREATING A SAFETY HAZARD; TIRES DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 109.
Corrective Action: TIRES WILL BE REPLACED AT NO COST TO CONSUMER WITHIN 60 DAYS OF NOTIFICATION.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:AIR BAG:DRIVER
Recall Description: THREADED INFLATOR COMPONENTS MAY HAVE BEEN DAMAGED DURING ASSEMBLY WHICH MAY ALLOW COMPONENTS TO SEPARATE WHEN INFLATOR RECEIVES A SIGNAL TO DEPLOY THE AIR BAG.
Consequence Summary: INFLATOR COMPONENT SEPARATION ALLOWS HOT COMBUSTION GASES TO ESCAPE INTO THE PASSENGER COMPARTMENT WHICH COULD RESULT IN INJURIES TO VEHICLE OCCUPANTS.
Corrective Action: REPLACE AIR BAG MODULES CONTAINING POTENTIALLY DEFECTIVE INFLATORS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:AIR BAG:DRIVER
Recall Description: THREADED INFLATOR COMPONENTS MAY HAVE BEEN DAMAGED DURING ASSEMBLY WHICH MAY ALLOW COMPONENTS TO SEPARATE WHEN INFLATOR RECEIVES A SIGNAL TO DEPLOY THE AIR BAG.
Consequence Summary: INFLATOR COMPONENT SEPARATION ALLOWS HOT COMBUSTION GASESTO ESCAPE INTO THE PASSENGER COMPARTMENT WHICH COULD RESULT IN INJURIES TO VEHICLE OCCUPANTS.
Corrective Action: REPLACE AIR BAG MODULES CONTAINING POTENTIALLY DEFECTIVE INFLATORS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:AIR BAG:DRIVER
Recall Description: THREADED INFLATOR COMPONENTS MAY HAVE BEEN DAMAGED DURING ASSEMBLY WHICH MAY ALLOW COMPONENTS TO SEPARATE WHEN INFLATOR RECEIVES A SIGNAL TO DEPLOY THE AIR BAG.
Consequence Summary: INFLATOR COMPONENT SEPARATION ALLOWS HOT COMBUSTION GASES TO ESCAPE INTO THE PASSENGER COMPARTMENT WHICH COULD RESULT IN INJURIES TO VEHICLE OCCUPANTS.
Corrective Action: REPLACE AIR BAG MODULES CONTAINING POTENTIALLY DEFECTIVE INFLATORS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:AIR BAG:DRIVER
Recall Description: THREADED INFLATOR COMPONENTS MAY HAVE BEEN DAMAGED DURING ASSEMBLY WHICH MAY ALLOW COMPONENTS TO SEPARATE WHEN INFLATOR RECEIVES A SIGNAL TO DEPLOY THE AIR BAG.
Consequence Summary: INFLATOR COMPONENT SEPARATION ALLOWS HOT COMBUSTION GASES TO ESCAPE INTO THE PASSENGER COMPARTMENT WHICH COULD RESULT IN INJURIES TO VEHICLE OCCUPANTS.
Corrective Action: REPLACE AIR BAG MODULES CONTAINING POTENTIALLY DEFECTIVE INFLATORS.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT
Recall Description: SEAT METAL LAMINATE SHIELD, LOCATED INSIDE SHIELD BUCKLE, CAN BREAK AFTER REPEATED USE.
Consequence Summary: THIS WOULD ALLOW THE SHIELD TO SEPARATE FROM THE BUCKLE AND THUS NOT PROPERLY RESTRAIN THE CHILD IN A SUDDEN STOP OR ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW SHIELD THAT WILL BE SENT BY FISHER PRICE TO INVOLVED SEAT OWNERS WHO CALL TOLL FREE NUMBER 800-527-1034.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT
Recall Description: PLASTIC PIN INSIDE THE BUCKLE SHIELD CAN BREAK AFTER FORCE IS APPLIED IN REPEATED USE.
Consequence Summary: THE BROKEN SHIELD WOULD MAKE THE BUCKLE DIFFICULT TO FASTEN; IF THE BUCKLE IS NOT SECURELY FASTENED, THE CHILD WOULD NOT BE PROPERLY RESTRAINED IN A SUDDEN STOP OR ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW SHIELD THAT WILL BE SENT BY FISHER PRICE TO INVOLVED SEAT OWNERS CALLING THE TOLL FREE NUMBER 800-527-1034.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT
Recall Description: BUTTON ON SHIELD STRAP CAN BECOME LOOSE AND BE REMOVED BY A CHILD.
Consequence Summary: CHILDREN COULD PUT PIECES OF BUTTON IN THEIR MOUTHS AND CHOKE.
Corrective Action: REMOVE THE BUTTON AND INSTALL REPLACEMENT BUTTON THAT WILL BE SENT BY MANUFACTURER TO INVOLVED SEAT OWNERS WHO CALL THE TOLL FREE TELEPHONE NUMBER 800-527-1034.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER LABELS
Recall Description: CAMPERS EXCEED THE MAXIMUM WEIGHT ON THE CERTIFICATION LABEL.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD LEAD TO OVERLOADING OF THE CAMPER'S VEHICLE WITH POTENTIAL FOR ACCIDENTS FROM ADVERSE EFFECTS ON HANDLING AND BRAKING;  CAMPERS DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 126.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A NEW CERTIFICATION LABEL WITH CORRECT WEIGHT.

Subject: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT ATTACHING MECHANISMS:
Recall Description: THE SUSPENSION COIL SPRING BOX MOUNTING BRACKETS, WHICH ARE FASTENED TO THE MAIN CHASSIS FRAME, MAY FAIL.
Consequence Summary: BRACKET FAILURE ALLOWS THE COIL SPRING BOX TO MOVE AND,CONSEQUENTLY, DAMAGE THE REAR BRAKE LINES AFFECTING BRAKE PERFORMANCE.
Corrective Action: REPAIR TO PREVENT MOUNTING BRACKET FAILURE.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER LABELS
Recall Description: OWNER'S MANUAL DOES NOT CONTAIN LABEL INFORMATION AND A PICTURE SHOWING A PROPER TRUCK AND CAMPER MATCH.
Consequence Summary: OMITTED INFORMATION COULD LEAD TO OVERLOADING WITH POTENTIAL FOR ACCIDENTS FROM ADVERSE EFFECTS ON HANDLING AND BRAKING;  CAMPERS DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 126.
Corrective Action: PROVIDE NEW OWNER'S MANUAL PAGES FOR SECTION HEADED: "LOADING YOUR WESTERN WILDERNESS."

Subject: EQUIPMENT:MOTORCYCLE KICKSTAND
Recall Description: RIGHT SIDE FOOTREST MOUNTS MAY FRACTURE IF SUBJECTED TO HEAVY IMPACT LOADS, SUCH AS WHEN A PARKED MOTORCYCLE FALLS ON ITS RIGHT SIDE.
Consequence Summary: SUCH FRACTURES MIGHT RESULT IN LOSS OF RIGHT SIDEFOOTREST AND WILL HINDER THE ABILITY OF THE RIDER TO CONTROL THE FUNCTION OF THE REAR BRAKES.
Corrective Action: REPLACE RIGHT SIDE FOOTREST MOUNT.

Subject: LIGHTING:SWITCH:BUTTON:RING:BRAKE LIGHTS
Recall Description: BRAKE STOPLAMPS MAY NOT ILLUMINATE OR, IN SOME CASES, STOPLAMPS WILL NOT STAY ILLUMINATED ALL THE TIME WHEN BRAKES ARE APPLIED DUE TO A FAULTY STOPLAMP SWITCH. ALSO IN VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH CRUISE CONTROL, A FAULTY STOPLAMP SWITCH CAN RESULT IN RESUMPTION OF THE CRUISE CONTROL FUNCTION UPON RELEASE OF THE BRAKE PEDAL.
Consequence Summary: A TRAILING VEHICLE MAY NOT RECOGNIZE A BRAKING ACTIONIN TIME TO RESPOND APPROPRIATELY. ALSO, CRUISE CONTROL WILL REENGAGE UPONRELEASE OF THE BRAKE PEDAL AND RESUME THE SET SPEED. IN EITHER CASE, IT COULDRESULT IN A CRASH WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: INSTALL AN IMPROVED DESIGN STOPLAMP SWITCH.

Subject: LIGHTING:SWITCH:BUTTON:RING:HEAD LIGHTS
Recall Description: HEADLAMP SWITCH CONTROL MAY NOT BE IDENTIFIED ON EITHER CONTROL KNOB OR ADJACENT TO THE CONTROL KNOB AS REQUIRED BY FMVSS 101.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN THE DRIVER'S ATTENTION BEINGDIVERTED WHEN SELECTING CONTROLS WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL HEADLAMP SWITCH CONTROL IDENTIFIER EITHER ON OR ADJACENT TO THE SWITCH.

Subject: STRUCTURE:DOOR ASSEMBLY:LATCHES AND LOCKS
Recall Description: TORQUE OF LATCH SCREWS ON FRONT DOORS MAY LOOSEN OVER TIME DUE TO A GAP BETWEEN THE LATCH BASE PLATE AND INNER DOOR PANEL UNDER THE SCREW HEAD.
Consequence Summary: THE AFFECTED DOOR MAY NOT BE OPENED FROM INSIDE,PREVENTING EXIT FROM THAT DOOR.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FRONT DOOR LATCH SCREWS WITH "LOCK-TIGHT" SCREWS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:RESTRAINT:BELT ANCHOR AND ATTACHM
Recall Description: NUT AND LOCK WASHER USED TO MOUNT LOWER OUTSIDE SEAT BELT TO DRIVER AND PASSENGER FRONT SEAT BASE MAY HAVE BEEN LEFT OFF.
Consequence Summary: SEAT BELT SYSTEM COULD BECOME DISENGAGED; THIS COULDRESULT IN GREATER INJURY TO OCCUPANTS IN EVENT OF AN ACCIDENT OR SUDDEN STOP.
Corrective Action: INSTALL MISSING NUT AND LOCK WASHER.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CERTIFICATION LABEL
Recall Description: OWNER MANUAL DOES NOT CONTAIN LOADING AND CENTER OF GRAVITY INFORMATION;  ALSO, CAMPER MAY EXCEED MAXIMUM WEIGHT SPECIFIED.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD LEAD TO OVERLOADING OF THE CAMPER'S VEHICLE WITH POTENTIAL FOR ACCIDENTS FROM ADVERSE EFFECTS ON HANDLING AND BRAKING;  CAMPERS DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 126.
Corrective Action: PROVIDE NEW OWNER'S MANUAL PAGE WITH LOADING AND CENTER OF GRAVITY INFORMATION.  INSTALL NEW CERTIFICATION LABELS WITH CORRECT WEIGHT ON OVERWEIGHT CAMPERS.

Subject: BRAKES:121 WHEEL BRAKE ASSEMBLY
Recall Description: TRAILER AXLE ASSEMBLIES MAY CONTAIN SHOE AND LINING ASSEMBLIES THAT DO NOT COMPLY WITH THE BRAKE RETARDATION FORCE PERFORMANCE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 121.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SHOE AND LINING  ASSEMBLIES WITH COMPONENTS THAT COMPLY WITH STANDARD.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CERTIFICATION LABEL
Recall Description: MAXIMUM WEIGHT ON CERTIFICATION LABEL IS UNDERSTATED.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD LEAD TO OVERLOADING OF THE CAMPER'S VEHICLE WITH POTENTIAL FOR ACCIDENTS FROM ADVERSE EFFECTS ON HANDLING AND BRAKING; CAMPERS DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 126.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW CERTIFICATION LABEL WITH CORRECT WEIGHT.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN
Recall Description: THE COMBINATION OF TYPE 2 ELR SEAT BELT AND SUSPENSION TYPE DRIVER'S SEAT CAUSES SAFETY BELT CINCHING WHICH BECOMES SEVERE ENOUGH TO DISTRACT OR HINDER DRIVER FROM NORMAL OPERATION OF BUS.
Consequence Summary: DISTRACTION OF DRIVER COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL SEAT BELT THAT INCORPORATES SOME ANTI-CINCHING FEATURES AND A NEW SET OF TETHER STRAPS FOR SUSPENSION SEAT.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:TIRE RESERVE LOAD LABEL (GLOVE COMPARTME
Recall Description: CERTIFICATION LABEL DOES NOT CONTAIN REQUIRED TIRE AND WHEEL INFORMATION.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 120.
Corrective Action: INSTALL SUPPLEMENTAL TIRE INFORMATION LABELS ADJACENT TO CERTIFICATION LABELS.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL INJECTION:IDLE SPEED CONTROL UNIT
Recall Description: MALFUNCTION OF FUEL INJECTION SYSTEM THROTTLE POSTITION SENSOR COULD CAUSE INTERMITTENT HIGH ENGINE IDLE SPEED IMMEDIATELY AFTER STARTING ENGINE.
Consequence Summary: HIGH ENGINE IDLE WHEN CAR IS FIRST PLACED IN GEAR COULDRESULT IN UNEXPECTED ACCELERATION.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THROTTLE POSITION SENSORS WITH SENSORS THAT WOULD SEND CORRECT SIGNALS TO THE FUEL INJECTION SYSTEM.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL LINES:HOSES:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: STEEL BRAIDED FUEL HOSE ROUTING MAY ALLOW CONTACT BETWEEN THE HOSE AND TRANSMISSION WIRING HARNESS.
Consequence Summary: THIS CONTACT COULD CAUSE HOSE DAMAGE AND FUEL LEAKAGETHAT, IN THE PRESENCE OF AN IGNITION SOURCE, COULD RESULT IN A FIRE.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A TIE STRAP TO SECURE THE TRANSMISSION WIRING AWAY FROM THE FUEL HOSE.

Subject: TIRES:LINER
Recall Description: TIRES MAY CONTAIN A CRACK IN THE RUBBER IN THE LOWER PORTION OF THE WHITE SIDEWALL.
Consequence Summary: IF TIRES ARE IN USE OVER AN EXTENDED PERIOD OF TIME CRACK MAY PROPOGATE AND RESULT IN LOSS OF AIR WITH POTENTIAL FOR AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE TIRES WITHIN 60 DAYS OF NOTIFICATION.

Subject: TIRES:TREAD
Recall Description: TIRES WERE PRODUCED WITH A THINNER THAN SPECIFIED TREAD GAUGE.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CONTRIBUTE TO FASTER THAN NORMAL WEAR AND IRREGULAR TIRE WEAR PATTERNS, WHICH COULD RESULT IN BLOW OUT AT AN EARLIER THAN EXPECTED STAGE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE TIRES FREE OF CHARGE WITHIN 60 DAYS OF NOTIFICATION.

Subject: FUEL:LPG CONTAINER (TANK) ATTACHMENTS (STRAPS/BOLT
Recall Description: EXTERNAL MOUNTS, ON WHICH LIQUID PROPANE GAS TANKS ARE FASTENED, COULD FAIL.
Consequence Summary: TANK MAY FALL CAUSING DAMAGE TO THE TANK AND POSSIBLELEAKAGE OF PROPANE GAS, WHICH COULD CAUSE A FIRE OR EXPLOSION.
Corrective Action: REPAIR TANK MOUNTING TO PREVENT FAILURE AND INSTALL HEAT SHIELD, AS NECESSARY.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: FRONT BRAKE HOSES OF INSUFFICIENT LENGTH WERE INSTALLED IN SOME VEHICLES. THESE SHORT HOSES COULD STRETCH AND DEVELOP CRACKS.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN BRAKE FLUID LEAKAGE, WITH LOSS OFFLUID PRESSURE AND BRAKING ABILITY.
Corrective Action: REPLACE BOTH BRAKE HOSES.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL:PEDAL
Recall Description: ELECTRONIC FOOT PEDAL SPRINGS COULD FAIL DUE TO IMPROPER HEAT TREATMENT, PREVENTING THE PEDAL FROM RETURNING TO ITS NORMAL IDLE POSITION.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CAUSE AN UNINTENDED FULL THROTTLE CONDITION THAT COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ASSEMBLY WITH ONE CONTAINING PROPERLY HEAT TREATED SPRING AND OR INSTALL A FAILSAFE SWITCH ONTO FOOT PEDAL ASSEMBLY TO PREVENT UNINTENDED THROTTLE CONDITION FROM OCCURRING.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:TRAILER HITCHES AND ATTACHM
Recall Description: IMPROPER MATERIAL IN THE ELEVATING NUT OF THE LANDING GEAR COULD REDUCE THE LOAD BEARING CAPACITY OF THE ASSEMBLY.
Consequence Summary: FAILURE OF THE NUT COULD RESULT IN COLLAPSE OF THE LANDING GEAR WITH POTENTIAL FOR AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE LANDING GEAR ASSEMBLY AS NECESSARY.

Subject: ENGINE COOLING SYSTEM:HOSES
Recall Description: IMPROPERLY INSTALLED HOSE ON THE OIL COOLER COULD COME IN CONTACT WITH THE EXHAUST MANIFOLD AND COULD MELT.
Consequence Summary: ENGINE OIL COULD LEAK OUT WITH POTENTIAL FOR ENGINESEIZURE AND DAMAGE AND COULD RESULT IN A FIRE.
Corrective Action: PROPERLY INSTALL COOLER HOSE CLIP TO PREVENT CONTACT WITH EXHAUST MANIFOLD.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL SYSTEM OTHER PARTS
Recall Description: IN A REAR IMPACT COLLISSION, FUEL TANK MAY LEAK FUEL IN EXCESS OF AMOUNT ALLOWED BY FMVSS 301 BECAUSE OF MISBUILT FUEL TANK SKID PLATES.
Consequence Summary: IN THE PRESENCE OF AN IGNITION SOURCE, THIS COULD RESULTIN A FIRE. VEHICLE WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 301.
Corrective Action: INSTALL FLANGE ON FUEL TANK SKID PLATE.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC:OTHER PARTS
Recall Description: PUTTING IN MORE TRANSMISSION OIL THAN SPECIFIED CAN CAUSE OIL TO BLEED THROUGH AIR GROOVE ON TO THE EXHAUST MANIFOLD IF OIL TEMPERATURE RISES.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CAUSE SMOKE EMISSION FROM THE MANIFOLD, WHICHCOULD IGNITE RUBBER HOSES AND RESULT IN A FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE OIL LEVEL GAUGE AND NOTIFY OWNERS TO USE ONLY THE SPECIFIED AMOUNT OF AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION FLUID.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CERTIFICATION LABEL
Recall Description: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  LIMOUSINE CONVERSION BY KRYSTAL KOACH.  ALTERER'S LABEL STATING THAT VEHICLE COMPLIES WITH STANDARDS, INCLUDING WEIGHT OF VEHICLE, MAY BE ABSENT OR INCOMPLETE.
Consequence Summary: OWNER WOULD NOT BE AWARE OF CORRECT WEIGHT RATING ANDTIRE SIZE AS REQUIRED BY 49 CFR PART 567.
Corrective Action: INSTALL CORRECT ALTERER'S PLACARD.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:TIRE RESERVE LOAD LABEL (GLOVE COMPARTME
Recall Description: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  LIMOUSINE CONVERSION BY KRYSTAL KOACH.  TIRE PLACARD LISTING RECOMMENDED TIRE PRESSURES CAN BE ABSENT OR CAN CONTAIN INCORRECT INFORMATION.
Consequence Summary: USE OF INCORRECT TIRE PRESSURES COULD CAUSE INCREASEDTIRE WEAR THAT COULD RESULT IN DIFFICULTY IN VEHICLE HANDLING OR STEERING.
Corrective Action: INSTALL LABEL WITH CORRECT TIRE INFORMATION.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT
Recall Description: SEAT BUCKLE AND TONGUE MAY NOT PROPERLY ENGAGE WHEN LATCHED AND WOULD NOT MEET REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 213.
Consequence Summary: LATCH MECHANISM MAY APPEAR TO BE LOCKED, BUT IT IS FALSELY LOCKED; THE LATCH COULD COME OPEN AND EJECT THE CHILD IN AN ACCIDENT OR SUDDEN STOP, SUBSTANTIALLY REDUCING THE PROTECTION PROVIDED TO THE CHILD.
Corrective Action: INSTALL REPLACEMENT BUCKLE TONGUE AVAILABLE FROM MANUFACTURER.  FOR MORE INFORMATION, PLEASE CONTACT EVENFLO AT 800-233-5921.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT
Recall Description: SEAT BUCKLE AND TONGUE MAY NOT PROPERLY ENGAGE WHEN LATCHED AND WOULD NOT MEET REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 213.
Consequence Summary: LATCH MECHANISM MAY APPEAR TO BE LOCKED, BUT IT IS FALSELY LOCKED; THE LATCH COULD COME OPEN AND EJECT THE CHILD IN AN ACCIDENT OR SUDDEN STOP, SUBSTANTIALLY REDUCING THE PROTECTION PROVIDED TO THE CHILD.
Corrective Action: INSTALL REPLACEMENT BUCKLE TONGUE AVAILABLE FROM MANUFACTURER.  FOR MORE INFORMATION, PLEASE CONTACT EVENFLO AT 800-233-5921.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN
Recall Description: TRUCKS CAN CONTAIN INCORRECT INSTRUCTIONS ON HOW TO PROPERLY ADJUST REAR SEAT LAP-SHOULDER BELTS AS REQUIRED BY FMVSS 209.
Consequence Summary: INCORRECTLY ADJUSTED SEAT BELT WOULD NOT PROPERLYRESTRAIN OCCUPANT IN AN ACCIDENT OF SUDDEN STOP; TRUCKS WOULD NOT COMPLY WITHFMVSS 209.
Corrective Action: PROVIDE OWNER'S MANUAL INSERT CONTAINING THE CORRECT REAR LAP-SHOULDER BELT INSTRUCTIONS.

Subject: TIRES:TREAD
Recall Description: SEPARATION MAY OCCUR IN THE TREAD, CAUSING A BREAKDOWN OF SUBASSEMBLY AREAS IN THE TIRE.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CAUSE TIRE FAILURE AND COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: RETURN TIRE(S) TO DEALER WITHIN 60 DAYS FOR REPLACEMENT TIRE.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL SYSTEM OTHER PARTS
Recall Description: FUEL DAMPER LOCATED BEHIND THE FUEL LINE AND THE FUEL RAIL MAY BE IMPROPERLY ASSEMBLED. OVER TIME, THE SOLDER JOINTS COULD ALLOW A SMALL AMOUNT OF FUEL TO LEAK.
Consequence Summary: FUEL LEAKAGE, IN THE PRESENCE OF AN IGNITION SOURCE,COULD RESULT IN A FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FUEL DAMPER.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC:LEVER AND LINKA
Recall Description: TRANSAXLE SHIFT CONTROL CABLE MAY DISENGAGE FROM THE FROM THE FLOOR SHIFT CONTROL WITH LOSS OF GEAR INDICATOR REFERENCE AND SHIFT SELECTOR OPERATION.
Consequence Summary: DRIVER WOULD NOT BE ABLE TO DETERMINE ACTUAL GEARPOSITION THE TRANSAXLE IS IN, WHICH COULD RESULT IN UNEXPECTED VEHICLE MOVEMENTAND AN ACCIDENT WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A TRANSAXLE SHIFT CONTROL CABLE RETAINING CLIP TO PREVENT CABLE DISENGAGEMENT.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:SHOE AND DRUM SYSTEM:DRUM
Recall Description: HUB MOUNTING FACE DIAMETER OF DRUM MAY BE IMPROPERLY MACHINED CAUSING A LINE CONTACT INTERFERENCE OF THE HUB AND DRUM ASSEMBLY, LOOSENING OF THE WHEEL NUT AND WHEEL STUD FRACTURE.
Consequence Summary: FRACTURE OF ALL WHEEL STUDS COULD RESULT IN SEPARATION OF THE WHEEL SET FROM THE VEHICLE AFFECTING VEHICLE CONTROL AND STABILITY.
Corrective Action: REPLACE DRUMS WITH NEW DRUMS MACHINED TO PROPER DIMENSION.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CERTIFICATION LABEL
Recall Description: THE CERTIFICATION LABEL CAN BE ABSENT OR INCOMPLETE; THIS IS NOT IN COMPLIANCE WITH 49 CFR 567.
Consequence Summary: THE VEHICLE OWNERS WOULD NOT HAVE CORRECT INFORMATIONABOUT APPLICABLE FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARDS OR GROSS VEHICLE WEIGHT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE OR INSTALL CORRECT LABEL OR TAG.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT
Recall Description: THE METALLIC LABEL GLUED TO THE BREAST SHIELD OF THE SEAT CAN BECOME LOOSE OVER TIME.
Consequence Summary: THERE IS A HAZARD OF CHOKING FROM A CHILD REMOVING THE LOOSE LABEL AND PLACING IT IN HIS OR HER MOUTH.
Corrective Action: INSPECT THE BREAST SHIELD PERIODICALLY, AND IF THE LABEL IS LOOSE, PEEL IT OFF AND DISCARD IT.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES
Recall Description: HITCHES, ATTACHED TO SMALL TRAILERS THAT ATTACH TO MOTORCYCLES,  MAY CONTAIN SUBSTANDARD MATERIALS IN THE CHROME BALL COUPLER.
Consequence Summary: COUPLER COULD FAIL, ALLOWING TRAILER TO SEPARATE FROM MOTORCYCLE, WHICH COULD RESULT IN THE TRAILER CRASHING INTO ANOTHER VEHICLE OR OBJECT IN THE VICINITY.
Corrective Action: INSTALL REPLACEMENT CHROME BALL COUPLER THAT CONTAINS PROPER MATERIALS.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:TIRE RESERVE LOAD LABEL (GLOVE COMPARTME
Recall Description: THE TIRE SELECTION AND RIMS PLACARD CAN BE ABSENT OR FAIL TO CONFORM WITH FMVSS 110.
Consequence Summary: CORRECT TIRE INFORMATION IS NECESSARY TO PREVENT OVERLOADING AND RIM PERFORMANCE REQUIREMENTS UNDER THE CONDTIONS OF TIRE DEFLATION.
Corrective Action: REPLACE OR INSTALL CORRECT TIRE SELECTION AND RIMS PLACARDS.

Subject: LIGHTING:LAMP OR SOCKET:BRAKE LIGHTS
Recall Description: THE HIGH CENTER MOUNTED REAR STOP LAMP IS EITHER MISSING OR OBSTRUCTED; VEHICLES DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 108.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLES WITH MISSING OR OBSTRUCTED CENTER HIGH MOUNTREAR STOP LIGHTS DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 108; AND MOTORISTS FOLLOWING THEVEHICLE WOULD NOT RECEIVE APPROPRIATE WARNING OF A STOP OR SLOW DOWN, WHICHCOULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REMOVE REAR WINDOW TINTING OR INSTALL MISSING CENTER HIGH MOUNT STOP LAMP.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:DISC:CALIPER
Recall Description: FRONT DISC BRAKE CALIPER GUIDE PIN BOLTS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN ADEQUATELY TORQUED AND COULD LOOSEN.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CAUSE REDUCED BRAKING EFFECTIVENESS AND COULDRESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: PROPERLY TORQUE FRONT BRAKE CALIPER GUIDE PIN BOLTS TO 250 POUNDS.

Subject: EMERGENCY PARKING BRAKE:AIR:VALVE:CONTROL
Recall Description: TWO SCREWS THAT HOLD DETENT RAIL TO VALVE BODY CAN LOOSEN AND BACK OUT. ALSO, VALVE BODY CAN BREAK AT POINT WHERE DETENT RAIL ATTACHING SCREWS ARE THREADED INTO BODY.
Consequence Summary: DETENT RAIL WOULD BECOME FREE RESULTING IN PARKING BRAKECONTROL HANDLE JAMMING AND NOT RELEASING OR ENGAGING THE PARKING BRAKE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SUSPECT VALVE WITH IMPROVED VALVE.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:TIRE RESERVE LOAD LABEL (GLOVE COMPARTME
Recall Description: INCORRECT TIRE PRESSURE PLACARD WAS INSTALLED ON CARS; DOES NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 110.
Corrective Action: INSTALL CORRECT PLACARD CONTAINING PROPER PRESSURE INFORMATION.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES:ACCELERATOR:FLEXIBLE
Recall Description: WITH USE, ACCELERATOR CABLE CAN BECOME FRAYED AND BIND OR BREAK IN ITS HOUSING, WIHTOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Consequence Summary: THROTTLE WOULD NOT OPERATE PROPERLY; THIS COULD RESULT INLOSS OF TRUCK CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ORIGINAL STYLE ACCELERATOR CABLE WITH CABLE DESIGNED TO PREVENT FRAYING.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC
Recall Description: DUE TO AN IMPROPERLY MACHINED INTERNAL SHAFT IN THE TRANSMISSION, THE PAWL MECHANISIM MAY NOT FULLY ENGAGE WHEN TRANSMISSION IS IN THE PARK POSITION.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLE COULD ROLL WHILE THE TRANSMISSION IS IN THE PARKPOSITION AND A CRASH COULD RESULT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL AN IMPROVED PARKING PAWL SHAFT.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CERTIFICATION LABEL
Recall Description: ALTERER'S LABEL MAY NOT BE INSTALLED.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH PART 567.
Corrective Action: INSTALL ALTERER'S LABEL.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN
Recall Description: SEAT BELTS MAY NOT HAVE BEEIN INSTALLED FOR ALL DESIGNATED SEATING POSITIONS.
Corrective Action: INSTALL SEAT BELTS AT ALL DESIGNATED SEATING POSITIONS.

Subject: WHEELS:DISC:SPIDER
Recall Description: WHEELS MAY CONTAIN CRACKS THAT COULD PROPOGATE IN RAISED PORTION OF WHEEL CENTER.
Consequence Summary: UNDER SEVERE DUTY, THIS COULD RESULT IN EVENTUALSEPARATION OF WHEEL RIM FROM CENTER WITH LOSS OF CONTROL AND POSSIBLY ACOLLISION.
Corrective Action: REPLACE WHEELS WITH WHEELS OF A REVISED DESIGN.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CARRIER RACK:AUXILIARY
Recall Description: INCORRECT LUG BOLTS MAY HAVE BEEN USED IN THE  MANUFACTURING OF THE SPARE WHEEL CARRIER. THESE LUG BOLTS MAY BREAK ALLOWING THE SPARE WHEEL TO FALL OFF.   CONSEQUENCE OF DEFECT: BREAKAGE OF THE LUG BOLTS ALLOWING THE SPARE WHEEL TO FALL TO THE ROAD WAY WILL CREATE A ROAD HAZARD FOR OTHER VEHICLES.
Corrective Action: INSTALL PROPER SIZE WHEEL LUG BOLTS.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL LINES:HOSES:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: INCORRECT SIZE EAR TYPE CLAMPS WERE USED TO SECURE NYLON GASOLINE LINES TO BARBED CONNECTOR FITTINGS.
Consequence Summary: GASOLINE LINES UNDER PRESSURE FROM FUEL PUMP COULD LEAK;IN THE PRESENCE OF A SOURCE OF IGNITION, FUEL LEAK COULD RESULT IN A FIRE.
Corrective Action: INSTALL PROPER SIZE EAR TYPE CLAMPS.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:JACKS:STAND
Recall Description: SUPPORT TAB IN FRONT SIDE OF JACK STAND MAY BE INADEQUATELY WELDED OR THE METAL TAB MAY REQUIRE HEAVIER GAUGE STEEL.
Consequence Summary: JACK STAND COULD FAIL OR COLLAPSE WITH OVER 3000 POUNDLOAD WITH RISK OF INJURY TO USER OR OTHERS IN THE VICINITY.
Corrective Action: INSTALL HEAVIER GAUGE METAL FOR SUPPORT TAB AND WELD MORE SECURELY ON BOTH SIDES OF THE METAL SUPPORT TAB.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:GLASS:OTHER
Recall Description: THERE MAY BE AN INADEQUATE NUMBER OF EMERGENCY EXITS ON THE LEFT SIDE OF THE BUS.
Consequence Summary: THE BUSES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 217; THIS COULD BEHAZARDOUS TO PASSENGERS IN AN EMERGENCY.
Corrective Action: INSTALL ADDITIONAL WINDOW EMERGENCY EXIT ON LEFT SIDE OF BUS.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL SYSTEM OTHER PARTS
Recall Description: GLASS ELEMENT THAT SEPARATES ELECTRONIC CIRCUITRY FROM PRESSURIZED FUEL MAY LOOSEN AND CREATE AN OPENING THAT COULD ALLOW PRESSURIZED FUEL TO ENTER BODY OF SENSOR.
Consequence Summary: UNDER THESE CONDITIONS OF SEAL DETERIORATION, THE HOUSINGCOVER WOULD NOT CONTAIN FUEL, CAUSING A FUEL LEAK WHICH, IN THE PRESENCE OF ASOURCE OF IGNITION, COULD RESULT IN A FIRE.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW OPTICAL SENSORS.

Subject: STEERING:WHEEL AND COLUMN
Recall Description: WITH APPROXIMATELY TWO THREADS ENGAGEMENT OF STEERING WHEEL RETAINING NUT WITH STEERING SHAFT, THE STEERING WHEEL COULD SEPARATE FROM THE STEERING COLUMN IF NUT LOOSENS AND FALLS OFF.
Consequence Summary: STEERING WHEEL SEPARATION FROM THE STEERING COLUMN COULDRESULT IN LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE STEERING WHEEL WITH NEW DESIGN WHEEL THAT ALLOWS FULL THREAD ENGAGEMENT OF STEERING WHEEL RETAINING NUT.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:EMERGENCY EXIT LABEL
Recall Description: THERE IS AN INADEQUATE NUMBER OF EMERGENCY EXITS ON THE RIGHT SIDE OF THE THE BUS; DRIVER'S DOOR EMERGENCY EXIT LABEL AND INSTRUCTIONS ARE NOT PROPERLY LOCATED. WINDOW EMERGENCY EXIT INSTRUCTIONS ARE NOT LEGIBLE.
Consequence Summary: BUSES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 217, AND COULD CONFUSEPASSENGERS TRYING TO EXIT IN AN EMERGENCY.
Corrective Action: PROPERLY LABEL RIGHT EXIT DOOR AS 'EMERGENCY EXIT'; RELOCATE EMERGENCY EXIT LABELS; AND INSTALL LEGIBLE WINDOW EMERGENCY EXIT INSTRUCTIONS.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:EMERGENCY EXIT LABEL
Recall Description: THE EMERGENCY ROOF EXIT RELEASE MECHANISM WAS INSTALLED IN AN INCORRECT DIRECTION; OPERATING INSTRUCTIONS FOR THE ROOF EXIT ARE NOT CONCISE; AND INSTRUCTIONS FOR EXIT ARE INCORRECT.
Consequence Summary: BUSES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 217; INCORRECT OR TOOLONG EXIT INSTRUCTIONS COULD LEAD TO CONFUSION AND FURTHER HAZARD TOPASSENGERS ATTEMPTING TO EXIT THE BUS IN AN EMERGENCY.
Corrective Action: MODIFY ROOF RELEASE MECHANISM; REVISE WORDING OF LABELS; AND RELOCATE LABELS WITHIN 6 INCHES OF RELEASE MECHANISM.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL LINES:HOSES:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: FUEL RETURN HOSES MAY BREAK AT EITHER CRIMPED COUPLING, CAUSING A LEAKAGE OF FUEL.
Consequence Summary: IN THE EVENT OF A FUEL RETURN LINE SEPARATION, A FUELLEAK OCCURRING IN THE PRESENCE OF AN IGNITION SOURCE COULD CAUSE A FIRE.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A PROPERLY CRIMPED FUEL RETURN HOSE.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:DIFFERENTIAL:PROPORTIONAL VALVE
Recall Description: INCORRECT SCREWS MAY HAVE BEEN USED IN INSTALLING THE LOAD SENSING BRAKE PROPORTIONING VALVE TO ITS BRACKET CAUSING THE CLAMPING LOAD TO BE LESS THAN INTENDED.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN INCONSISTENT FRONT TO REAR BRAKEBALANCE WITH POTENTIAL FOR REAR BRAKE SKID UNDER HEAVY BRAKING CONDITIONS.
Corrective Action: REPLACE PROPORTIONING VALVE TO BRACKET SCREWS WITH PROPER LENGTH SCREWS.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL
Recall Description: LOSS OF RETENTION OF AN INTEGRAL OVER-TRAVEL SPRING ON THROTTLE CABLE COULD CAUSE SPRING DISLOCATION.
Consequence Summary: A DISLOCATED SPRING CAN CAUSE INCREASED IDLE POSITIONTHROTTLE OPENING AND HIGHER THAN NORMAL IDLE SPEED.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THROTTLE CABLES WITH CABLES DESIGNED TO PROVIDE POSITIVE RETENTION OF THE OVER-TRAVEL SPRING.

Subject: LIGHTING:GENERAL OR UNKNOWN COMPONENT:REFLECTIVE L
Recall Description: RED REFLECTORS TESTED DID NOT MEET MINIMUM OF 4.5 CANDLE POWER PER FOOT CANDLE  BY AS MUCH AS 92 PERCENT.
Consequence Summary: REFLECTORS DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 108.
Corrective Action: RETURN REFLECTORS TO STORE FOR A FULL REFUND OF PURCHASE PRICE.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:DISC:CALIPER
Recall Description: OMISSION OF AIR DUCTS INTENDED TO GUIDE FLOW OF COOLING AIR TO LEFT AND RIGHT FRONT BRAKE CALIPERS COULD ALLOW BRAKE FLUID TO EXCEED ALLOWABLE OPERATING TEMPERATURE UNDER CERTAIN OPERATING CONDITIONS.
Consequence Summary: IF BRAKE FLUID BOILS, THIS COULD RESULT IN REDUCEDBRAKING PRESSURE WITH POTENTIAL FOR AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL MISSING LEFT AND RIGHT FRONT AIR DUCTS.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:ATTACHMENTS
Recall Description: FUEL TANK MOUNTING STRAPS MAY ALLOW MINOR AMOUNT OF SHIFTING BY FUEL TANK IN A REAR END CRASH WITH FUEL LEAKAGE IN EXCESS OF AMOUNT ALLOWED BY STANDARD.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLES WOULD NOT MEET REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 301; IN THEPRESENCE OF AN IGNITION SOURCE, FUEL LEAKAGE COULD RESULT IN A VEHICULAR FIRE.
Corrective Action: RETROFIT VEHICLES WITH FUEL MOUNTING STRAPS OF ORIGINAL DESIGN.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT LATCH
Recall Description: THE SECOND ROW RIGHT HAND SEAT ASSEMBLY HAS A TILT FORWARD FUNCTION. A LATCH RETAINS THE SEAT IN THE NORMAL RIDE POSTION, AND THIS LATCH  MAY RELEASE UNDER SEVERE FRONTAL IMPACT CONDITIONS, ALLOWING THE SEAT TO PIVOT FORWARD.
Consequence Summary: IN THE EVENT OF VEHICLE ACCIDENT, THE SEAT COULD PIVOTFORWARD, INCREASING THE RISK OF INJURY TO THE OCCUPANT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SEAT PAWL ASSEMBLY WITH A REVISED DESIGN ASSEMBLY.

Subject: STEERING:POWER ASSIST:HOSE:FLUID
Recall Description: POWER STEERING HOSES MAY LEAK FLUID THAT CAN SPREAD TO THE EXHAUST MANIFOLD.
Consequence Summary: UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS, THE MANIFOLD MAY BECOME HOTENOUGH TO IGNITE THE POWER STEERING FLUID AND RESULT IN AN ENGINE COMPARTMENTFIRE.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW HEAT RESISTANT POWER STEERING HOSES. ALSO, INSTALL NEW FAN COUPLING TO INCREASE AIR FLOW VOLUME THROUGH ENGINE COMPARTMENT AND REPLACE ANY OTHER DAMAGED COMPONENTS.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:FUSE AND RECEPTICLE:OTHER PART
Recall Description: MISWIRED GROUND FAULT INTERRUPTER (GFI) RECEPTACLE IN BATHROOM DOES NOT PROVIDE GROUND FAULT PROTECTION AT THAT RECEPTACLE.
Consequence Summary: THE MISWIRED BATHROOM RECEPTACLE WOULD NOT PROTECT USERFROM AN ELECTRICAL SHOCK SITUATION THAT COULD BE AVOIDED BY A PROPERLY GROUNDEDGROUND FAULT RECEPTACLE.
Corrective Action: AUTHORIZED DEALERS WILL CORRECTLY REWIRE THE GROUND FAULT INTERRUPTER RECEPTACLE FOR PROPER FAULT PROTECTION.

Subject: ENGINE:OTHER PARTS
Recall Description: INCORRECT TORQUE ON THE GOVERNOR INPUT ASSEMBLY COULD CAUSE IT TO LOOSEN AND BACK OUT, INTERFERING WITH THE GOVERNOR HOUSING OPERATION. ALSO THE TORSION SPRING ON THE ACCELERATOR INPUT WAS INSTALLED INCORRECTLY AND COULD DISLODGE, PREVENTING THE GOVERNOR AND ACCELERATOR FROM PROPERLY CONTROLLING THE ENGINE SPEED.
Consequence Summary: WITHOUT GOVERNOR OPERATION, THE DRIVER COULD OVERSPEED THE ENGINE, CAUSING LOSS OF CONTROL OF VEHICLE SPEED.
Corrective Action: ASSURE PROPER ASSEMBLY AND TORQUE ON 8C8580 BOLT, AND PROPER INSTALLATION OF 7W9526 TORSION SPRING.

Subject: STEERING:GEAR:SHAFT LOWER FLEXIBLE PINION
Recall Description: CAPSCREW THAT ATTACHES STEERING GEAR TO THE STEERING BRACKET MAY LOOSEN AND CAUSE THE GEAR TO SEPARATE FROM ITS SUPPORTING BRACKET.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD AFFECT STEERING CONTROL AND RESULT IN ANACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: PROPERLY TORQUE CAPSCREWS.

Subject: STEERING:GEAR:SHAFT LOWER FLEXIBLE PINION
Recall Description: CAPSCREW THAT ATTACHES STEERING GEAR TO THE STEERING BRACKET MAY LOOSEN AND CAUSE THE GEAR TO SEPARATE FROM ITS SUPPORTING BRACKET.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD AFFECT STEERING CONTROL AND RESULT IN ANACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE STEERING BRACKET AND CAPSCREWS.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CERTIFICATION LABEL
Recall Description: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION: STRETCH LIMOUSINES ALTERED BY KELLY/COACHWORKS.  LIMOUSINES MAY NOT CONTAIN ALTERERS CERTIFICATION LABEL IN VIOLATION OF 49 CFR PART 567.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLES WOULD NOT BE IN COMPLIANCE WITH FEDERALREGULATIONS.
Corrective Action: INSTALL ALTERERS LABELS AS REQUIRED.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CERTIFICATION LABEL
Recall Description: GROSS VEHICLE WEIGHT RATINGS AND TIRE INFORMATION MAY BE INCORRECT ON LABELS.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH 49 CFR PART  567.
Corrective Action: INSTALL REVISED CERTIFICATION LABELS.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:TIRE RESERVE LOAD LABEL (GLOVE COMPARTME
Recall Description: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION: STRETCH LIMOUSINES ALTERED BY KELLY/COACHWORKS, INC.  LIMOUSINE MAY NOT HAVE ALTERERS TIRE PLACARD WITH CORRECT TIRE SIZE AND LOAD INFORMATION, AS REQUIRED BY FMVSS 110.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH STANDARD AND CONSUMERRELYING ON THE WRONG INFORMATION MIGHT EXPERIENCE TRAUMATIC TIRE DAMAGE WITHLOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL.
Corrective Action: INSTALL CORRECT TIRE PLACARD.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:TIRE RESERVE LOAD LABEL (GLOVE COMPARTME
Recall Description: TIRE PLACARD MAY CONTAIN INCORRECT GROSS VEHICLE WEIGHT RATINGS AND TIRE INFORMATION.
Consequence Summary: LIMOUSINES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 110 AND CONSUMERMIGHT UNKNOWINGLY OVERLOAD THE VEHICLE BECAUSE OF PLACARD MISINFORMATION.
Corrective Action: INSTALL REVISED TIRE PLACARDS.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL SYSTEM OTHER PARTS
Recall Description: A THREAD ENGAGEMENT PROBLEM MAY CAUSE FUEL LEAKAGE.
Consequence Summary: FUEL LEAKAGE COULD RESULT IN A FIRE WHEN EXPOSED TO A SOURCE OF IGNITION.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FUEL FILTERS WITH NEW FILTERS WITH NEW PART NUMBERS.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL SYSTEMS
Recall Description: DUE TO OVERPRESSURIZED FUEL SYSTEM AND CLOSED EMISSIONS CONTROL SYSTEM, THERE MAY BE EXCESSIVE HYDROCARBON IGNITION IN EXHAUST STAGE OF ENGINE OPERATION.
Consequence Summary: THIS CAN RESULT IN FIRES FROM BURNED THROUGH MUFFLERS,DEGRADATION OF HOSES, OR LIQUID OR EXCESSIVE VAPOR RELEASE FROM EMISSIONCANISTERS.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FUEL TANK FILLER CAP WITH HIGH FLOW, TWO-STAGE RETENTION CAPS; REPLACE ENGINE COMPARTMENT HEATER HOSES WITH HIGH-TEMP NOMEX HOSES; PROVIDE AN ADDITIONAL HEAT SHIELD BETWEEN COACH BODIES AND MUFFLER; AND PROVIDE DECALS FOR ATTACHMENT TO THE FUEL SYSTEM ADVISING USERS NOT TO COMPLETELY FILL THEIR FUEL TANKS.

Subject: LIGHTING:LAMP OR SOCKET:UNSPECIFIED LIGHT
Recall Description: THESE LAMPS FAIL TO MEET THE LIGHTING REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 108.
Consequence Summary: INAPPROPRIATE, NON-STANDARD LIGHTS AND REFLECTORS COULD REDUCE VISIBILITY OF VEHICLES AND INCREASE POTENTIAL FOR A CRASH.
Corrective Action: RETURN DEVICES FOR FULL CREDIT OR REPLACEMENT.

Subject: LIGHTING:LAMP OR SOCKET:UNSPECIFIED LIGHT
Recall Description: THESE REPLACEMENT LAMPS MAY NOT MEET LIGHTING REQUIREMENT OF FMVSS 108.
Consequence Summary: INADEQUATE LIGHTING COULD REDUCE VISIBILITY OF VEHICLE AND INCREASE THE POTENTIAL FOR A CRASH.
Corrective Action: REPLACEMENT WITH LAMPS THAT MEET FMVSS REQUIREMENTS.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:GLASS:WINDSHIELD
Recall Description: WINDOW TINT DOES NOT MEET LUMINOUS TRANSMITTANCE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 205.
Consequence Summary: LIMOUSINES DO NOT COMPLY WITH STANDARDS; ALSO, INCREASEDPOTENTIAL FOR ACCIDENTS BECAUSE OF LIMITED VISIBILITY.
Corrective Action: REMOVE WINDOW FILM, AS NECESSARY.

Subject: AIR CONDITIONER:EVAPORATOR
Recall Description: ELECTRICAL FUSES FOR THE REAR EVAPORATOR WIRING HARNESS WERE OMITTED, PRESENTING A POTENTIAL FOR CURRENT OVERLOAD IF A FAN ROTOR LOCKS UP DURING NORMAL OPERATION OF THE EVAPORATOR.
Consequence Summary: CURRENT OVERLOAD HAS THE POTENTIAL FOR IGNITINGCOMBUSTIBLE MATERIALS IN THE VICINITY OF THE EVAPORATOR WIRING HARNESS.
Corrective Action: INSTALL REDESIGNED WIRING HARNESS AND FUSES TO PROVIDE OVERLOAD PROTECTION.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:PEDAL
Recall Description: RETAINING CLIP FOR LINK BOLT THAT CONNECTS THE BRAKE/CLUTCH PEDAL TO THE PUSHROD MAY LOOSEN AND FALL OFF.
Consequence Summary: BOLT MAY FALL OFF ASSEMBLY, LEADING TO LOSS OF CONTROL OFSERVICE BRAKES WITH NO WARNING, WHICH COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW DESIGN LINK BOLT AND SPLIT PIN TO PREVENT CLIP FROM LOOSENING.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN
Consequence Summary: OCCUPANTS WOULD NOT BE ADEQUATELY PROTECTED IN EVENT OFAN ACCIDENT OR SUDDEN STOP.
Corrective Action: INSTALL PROPER MOUNTING HARDWARE AND SEAT BELTS.

Subject: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:LEAF SPRING ASSEMBLY
Recall Description: REAR WHEEL TIE ROD ASSEMBLY MAY FATIGUE AND FRACTURE AT INBOARD BEARING DUE TO HIGH INNER JOINT ROCKING TORQUE.
Consequence Summary: FRACTURE COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF CONTROL AND A CRASH WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FAULTY TIE ROD ASSEMBLIES AS DIRECTED. THIS RECALL IS ASSOCIATED WITH GM PRODUCT SAFETY CAMPAIGN 89C17.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:PIPE:FILLER:NECK
Recall Description: DESIGN DEFECT OF THE SEALING GROMMET CAUSES INADEQUATE SEALING OF FUEL FILLER NECK AT THE FUEL TANK, WHICH MAY RESULT IN FUEL LEAKAGE.
Consequence Summary: LEAKING FUEL COULD CATCH FIRE IF AN IGNITION SOURCE IS
Corrective Action: INSTALL REPLACEMENT FUEL TANK AND HARDWARE.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:GLASS:WINDSHIELD
Recall Description: POOR ADHESION MAY OCCUR BETWEEN PAINT LAYERS IN THE WINDSHIELD MOUNTING AREA DUE TO DEFECTIVE PAINT BATCHES OR OVERSPRAYING.
Consequence Summary: PAINT SEPARATION IN THE WINDSHIELD AREAS WOULD LEADTO NON-COMPLIANCE WITH FMVSS 212 RETENTION REQUIREMENTS. LOSS OF WINDSHIELDRETENTION ABILITY COULD CAUSE WINSHIELD TO SEPARATE FROM VEHICLE WITHOUT WARNINGAND HARM VEHICLE OCCUPANTS AND OTHERS IN THE VICINITY.
Corrective Action: REINSTALL WINDSHIELD TO INSURE PROPER RETENTION.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:ELECTRIC EQUIPMENT:RADIO:TAPE DECK ETC.
Recall Description: MOLDING DEFECTS ON FUSE HOLDERS COULD CAUSE THEM TO BREAK AND SHORT CIRCUIT BETWEEN THE POSITIVE LEAD AND THE CHASSIS.
Consequence Summary: WIRING AROUND SHORT CIRCUIT COULD BURN SINCE THE FUSE IS BYPASSED IN CIRCUIT TO THE BATTERY, AND A VEHICLE FIRE COULD RESULT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE DEFECTIVE FUSE HOLDERS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN
Recall Description: VEHICLES ARE NOT EQUIPPED WITH AN AUTOMATIC PASSIVE RESTRAINT SYSTEM AS REQUIRED BY FMVSS 208.
Consequence Summary: AUTOMATIC PASSIVE RESTRAINT SYSTEM REQUIRING NOPARTICIPATION FROM THE DRIVER OR FRONT SEAT PASSEMGER WILL REDUCE THE RISK OFSERIOUS INJURY OR DEATH TO THESE OCCUPANTS IF AN ACCIDENT OCCURS.
Corrective Action: EXCALIBUR WILL REFUND PURCHASE PRICE, MINUS DEPRECIATION, FOR ANY VEHICLES RETURNED FOR LACK OF COMPLIANCE WITH FMVSS 208.

Subject: STRUCTURE:BUMPER ASSEMBLY
Recall Description: IN A REAR END COLLISION, THE PICKUP BOX CROSSMEMBER COULD CONTACT THE FUEL PUMP MODULES FUEL LINE, CAUSING A FUEL LEAK WHICH WOULD BE IN NON-COMPLIANCE WITH FMVSS 301.
Consequence Summary: CONSEQUENCE OF DEFECT:  LEAKAGE OF FUEL COULD CAUSE A FIRE IF A SOURCE OF IGNITION IS PRESENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL TWO PICKUP BOX REINFORCEMENT BLOCKER BRACKETS TO THE UNDERCARRIAGE TO ELIMINATE CONTACT WITH FUEL LINE.

Subject: TIRES:MARKINGS
Recall Description: INCORRECT MAXIMUM LOAD AND INFLATION PRESSURES ARE STAMPED ON TIRES WHICH COULD CAUSE TIRES TO BE USED IN AN OVERLOADED CONDITION.
Consequence Summary: OVERLOADED TIRES COULD FAIL RESULTING IN SUDDEN LOSS OF AIR PRESSURE THAT COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE AFFECTED TIRES AT NO CHARGE WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM DATE OF NOTIFICATION.   D.O.T. IDENTIFICATION NUMBERS: AD60H8B070, AD60H8B080, AD60H8B090, AD60H8B100.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT
Recall Description: LATCH TONGUES BROKE DURING IMPACT IN ROUTINE INFANT CAR SEAT CRASH TESTING AT 30 MPH.
Consequence Summary: DURING SEVERE IMPACT, CHILD MIGHT SUBMARINE OUT OF SEAT WITH POTENTIAL FOR SEVERE INJURY OR DEATH.
Corrective Action: REPLACE LATCH TONGUE.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:LIFT:WRECKER
Recall Description: IMPROPER AMOUNTS OF WELD ON MOUNTING FLANGE COULD CAUSE MOUNTING FLANGE TO LOOSEN AND SLIDE UP THE CYLINDER BARREL.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CAUSE THE BOX IT HOISTED TO DROP WHICH COULD RESULT IN PERSONAL INJURY TO ANYONE STANDING UNDER THE UNIT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE DEFECTIVE CYLINDER WITH CYLINDERS THAT ARE WELDED ALL THE WAY AROUND THE MOUNTING FLANGE.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL SYSTEM OTHER PARTS
Recall Description: FILTERS MAY HAVE FAULTY WELD OR INCOMPLETELY SEALED WELDS ALLOWING THE FILTERS TO LEAK AN EXCESSIVE AMOUNT OF GASOLINE WHILE IN USE.
Consequence Summary: DURING HIGH TEMPERATURE OPERATING CONDITIONS GASOLINE COULD BE RELEASED INTO ENGINE COMPARTMENT WHICH COULD RESULT IN A VEHICLE FIRE.
Corrective Action: REMOVE AND REPLACE WITH COMPARABLE FILTER WITH NON-AFFECTED DATE SETTING, ASSURING THAT WELDS ARE PROPERLY SEALED.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK
Recall Description: EXCESSIVE FUEL VAPOR PRESSURE CAN OCCUR THAT, AFTER PROLONGED CYCLING, COULD WEAKEN THE FUEL TANK STRUCTURE.
Consequence Summary: THIS CAN CAUSE FUEL TANK LEAKS WHICH, IN THE PRESENCE OFAN IGNITION SOURCE, COULD RESULT IN A VEHICLE FIRE.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A REVISED FUEL PURGE SYSTEM WHICH ELIMINATES EXCESSIVE VAPOR PRESSURE BUILD-UP.

Subject: TIRES:TREAD
Recall Description: TIRES MAY DEVELOP SEPARATION IN THE TREAD AREA THAT WILL CAUSE A THUMPING VIBRATION WHEN TIRE IS IN USE.
Consequence Summary: CONTINUED USE MAY CAUSE PLY CORDS TO BREAK AND TUBELESS LINER TO TEAR CAUSING LOSS OF TIRE INFLATION AND COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE AFFECTED TIRES AT NO CHARGE WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM THE DATE OF NOTIFICATION.

Subject: LIGHTING:LAMP OR SOCKET:UNSPECIFIED LIGHT
Recall Description: RETROFIT LIGHT SOCKETS FOR REAR STOP, TURN, TAIL AND BACKUP LIGHT ASSEMBLIES WOULD CAUSE THE BUSES TO BE IN NON-COMPLIANCE WITH FMVSS 108.
Consequence Summary: THESE BUSES WOULD NOT MEET THE PHOTOMETRIC REQUIREMENTSOF FMVSS 108, AND MAY NOT HAVE THE DESIRED EFFECT FOR MOTORISTS FOLLOWING THESEBUSES AND COULD CAUSE A VEHICLE ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW LIGHT SOCKETS AND NEW REAR LIGHT HOUSINGS ON BUSES.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:PEDALS:LINKAGES AND VALVES
Recall Description: SECONDARY SERVICE RESERVOIR AIR CHECK VALVES MAY NOT SEAT PROPERLY DUE TO A MECHANICAL INTERFERENCE CONDITION BETWEEN A CIRCULAR BRASS GUIDE AND THE WALL OF A CYLINDRICAL FERRULE IN WHICH THE BRASS GUIDE IS INTENDED TO MOVE FREELY.
Consequence Summary: IN THE EVENT OF PRESSURE LOSS IN THE SUPPLY RESERVOIR,A DEFECTIVE CHECK VALVE WOULD ALLOW PRESSURE EQUALIZATION BETWEEN PRIMARY ANDSECONDARY SERVICE RESERVOIRS, PRESENTING THE POTENTIAL FOR LOSS OR ABSENCE OFFRONT BRAKING ABILITY, WHICH COULD CAUSE LOSS OF CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL REVISED DESIGN SECONDARY SERVICE RESERVOIR CHECK VALVE COMPONENTS.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL LINES:HOSES:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: IMPROPERLY TORQUED CONNECTIONS OF FRONT FUEL FEED AND RETURN HOSES TO FUEL PIPES AT THE BODY RAIL COULD LOOSEN AND LEAK FUEL INTO THE UNDERHOOD AREA.
Consequence Summary: FUEL LEAKS IN THE PRESENCE OF AN IGNITION SOURCE, COULDRESULT IN AN UNDERHOOD FIRE.
Corrective Action: PROPERLY TORQUE THE FRONT FUEL FEED AND RETURN HOSES AT THE BODY RAIL LINES TO PREVENT FUEL LEAKAGE.

Subject: STEERING:UNKNOWN TYPE:GEAR BOX
Recall Description: WELDING DEFICIENCIES CAN CAUSE TWO-PIECE STEERING GEAR MOUNTING BRACKET TO PROGRESSIVELY SEPARATE.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL, WITHOUTPRIOR WARNING, AND A VEHICLE CRASH.
Corrective Action: REPLACE STEERING GEAR MOUNTING BRACKETS WITH PROPERLY WELDED BRACKETS.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:IGNITION
Recall Description: IGNITION SWITCH TERMINAL MAY MALFUNCTION.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN FAILURE OF WINDSHIELD WIPERS,WINDSHIELD WASHER, ENGINE COOLING FAN, HEATER BLOWER, AND AIR CONDITIONINGCOMPRESSOR. FAILURE OF WINDSHIELD CLEARING DEVICES COULD CAUSE REDUCEDVISIBILITY, WHICH COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE IGNITION SWITCHES.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL LINES:HOSES:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: FUEL RETURN HOSES MAY BREAK AT EITHER CRIMPED COUPLING.
Consequence Summary: IF THIS COUPLING SEPARATED, ALLOWING GASOLINE TO LEAK,AND AN IGNITION SOURCE WAS PRESENT, AN ENGINE COMPARTMENT FIRE COULD OCCUR.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A PROPERLY CRIMPED FUEL RETURN HOSE.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL LINES:HOSES:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: FUEL FEED HOSES MAY PULL OUT OF THE CRIMPED COUPLING AT THE ENGINE END OF THE HOSE ASSEMBLY.
Consequence Summary: IF THIS COUPLING SEPARATED, ALLOWING GASOLINE TO LEAK,AND AN IGNITION SOURCE IS PRESENT, AN ENGINE COMPARTMENT FIRE COULD OCCUR.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A REDESIGNED FUEL FEED HOSE.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:GAUGE:FUEL
Recall Description: PLASTIC FUEL GAUGE MOUNTING NUT MAY CRACK AND ALLOW FUEL TO LEAK FROM THE FUEL TANK.
Consequence Summary: IF FUEL COMES INTO CONTACT WITH A HOT EXHAUST SYSTEM OROTHER IGNITION SOURCE, IT COULD RESULT IN A FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE MOUNTING NUTS WITH NUTS OF AN IMPROVED MATERIAL.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT BELTS:LAP:FRONT
Recall Description: THE CONNECTOR HALF OF THE SAFETY BELT IS NOT LONG ENOUGH TO ACCOMMODATE A 95TH PERCENTILE ADULT MALE.
Consequence Summary: NONUSE OF THE SAFETY BELT WOULD INCREASE THE RISK ANDSEVERITY OF INJURY IN A SUDDEN STOP OR ACCIDENT; ALSO, TRUCKS WOULD NOT COMPLYWITH FMVSS 209.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SHORT SAFETY BELT CONNECTOR WITH CONNECTORS LONG ENOUGH TO COMPLY WITH STANDARD.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:ARM:PITMAN
Recall Description: STEERING ARM MAY FRACTURE DUE TO ENVIRONMENTAL, MAINTENANCE, OR OTHER FACTORS.
Consequence Summary: STEERING ARM COULD FAIL WITHOUT WARNING, RESULTING IN LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL AND POSSIBLY A CRASH.
Corrective Action: INSTALL REDSIGNED STEERING ARM.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:SPEED CONTROL
Recall Description: IF THE WIRING OF CRUISE CONTROL SYSTEM BECOMES WET WHILE ENGAGED, THERE IS A POSSIBILITY OF CREATING A SHORT CIRCUIT AND CRUISE CONTROL MALFUNCTION.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CAUSE THE SPEED TO BEGIN INCREASINGAUTOMATICALLY WITH POTENTIAL FOR LOSS OF CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE CRUISE CONTROL MODULE.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SHOULDER BELTS
Recall Description: OWNERS MANUALS DID NOT FULLY EXPLAIN HOW FRONT SHOULDER BELT COMFORT FEATURE WORKS.
Consequence Summary: CARS WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 208, AND INCORRECT USE OF SAFETY RESTRAINTS COULD LEAD TO PERSONAL INJURY TO OCCUPANTS IF AN ACCIDENTSHOULD OCCUR.
Corrective Action: INSERT STICKER THAT PROVIDES MISSING INFORMATION IN OWNERS MANUALS.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:GLASS:WINDOW:REAR-VIEW BACKLIGHT
Recall Description: THE EMERGENCY EXIT WINDOW RELEASE MECHANISM MAY REQUIRE MANUAL RELEASE FORCE THAT EXCEEDS THE MAXIMUM ALLOWABLE FORCE OF 20 LBS.
Consequence Summary: WINDOWS WOULD BE DIFFICULT TO OPEN IN AN EMERGENCY ANDWOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 217.
Corrective Action: REMOVE LEAD SEALS ON LEVERS OF EMERGENCY WINDOWS AND INCREASE PLAY BETWEEN INTERNAL AND EXTERNAL FRAME.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:PEDAL
Recall Description: LOOSE PIVOT BOLT HOLDING THE BRAKE PEDAL TO ITS SUPPORT BRACKET COULD DISENGAGE FROM THE NUT.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CAUSE LOSS OF BRAKING ACTIVITY THAT COULDRESULT IN A TRUCK CRASH WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: RETORQUE BRAKE PEDAL PIVOT BOLTS TO SPECIFICATIONS TO PREVENT LOOSENING.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:OTHER PART
Recall Description: MIS-WIRED POWER SELECTOR SWITCH MOUNTED IN MOTORHOME WALL COULD CAUSE POWER CORD TO BECOME ENERGIZED BY THE GENERATOR WHILE THE CORD IS STILL STOWED.
Consequence Summary: TOUCHING ONE OF THE EXPOSED METAL BLADES ON THE POWERCORD PLUG CAN RESULT IN AN ELECTRICAL SHOCK, OR IN EXTREME CASES, ELECTROCUTION.
Corrective Action: CORRECTLY RE-WIRE POWER SWITCH SELECTOR.

Subject: HEATER:ELECTRICAL:DEFROSTER:DEFOGGER
Recall Description: THE DEFROSTER LEVER PIN OF THE DEFROSTER SHUTTER DOOR MAY BECOME DISLOCATED AND ALLOW THE SHUTTER TO CLOSE, PREVENTING DEFROSTER FROM FUNCTIONING.
Consequence Summary: NON-FUNCTIONING DEFROSTER WOULD ADVERSELY AFFECT DRIVERVISIBILITY.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A POSITIONING STOPPER DEVICE TO PREVENT DISLOCATION OF DEFROSTER LEVER PIN TO ASSURE DEFROSTER OPERATION.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT BUCKLES
Recall Description: THE BUCKLE ASSEMBLY COULD HAVE A LARGE PAWL TO BASE CLEARANCE WHICH MAY NOT ALLOW THE PROPER ENGAGEMENT OF THE CONNECTOR.
Consequence Summary: THE PAWL TO BASE CLEARANCE PRECLUDES THE INABILITY TOENGAGE THE SEAT BELT CONNECTOR.
Corrective Action: INSPECT AND REPLACE ALL BUCKLE ASSEMBLIES FOUND WITH IMPROPER CLEARANCE.

Subject: STEERING:WHEEL AND COLUMN
Recall Description: THE HOLES IN THE STEERING WHEEL SPOKE ARE TOO LARGE TO PROPERLY FIT OVER THE MATING PINS ON THE HUB ALLOWING ROTATIONAL "FREE PLAY" AND CAUSING THE PINS TO SHEAR OFF.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CAUSE LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL THAT COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: RETROFIT WITH HUB PLATE TO PREVENT STEERING WHEEL FROM COMING LOOSE FROM THE HUB.

Subject: TIRES:MARKINGS
Recall Description: TIRES MAY BEAR WRONG SIZE PAPER LABEL ON THE TREAD OF THE TIRE, ALTHOUGH PROPER SIZE IS MOLDED ON THE SIDEWALL.
Consequence Summary: MOUNTING AND INFLATION OF 16 INCH TIRES ON 16.5 INCH RIMS COULD BE EXTREMELY HAZARDOUS AND CAN CAUSE INJURY OR DEATH.
Corrective Action: RETURN MISLABELED TIRES TO DEALER FOR REMOVAL OF LABEL AND INSTALLATION OF CORRECT REPLACEMENT LABELS.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:GLASS:WINDSHIELD
Recall Description: USE OF IMPROPER PRIMER ON METAL SURFACES OF WINDSHIELD AND SIDE WINDOW OPENINGS COULD CAUSE LOW ADHESION TO THE METAL SURFACE AND WOULD NOT PROVIDE RETENTION REQUIRED BY FMVSS 212.
Consequence Summary: WINDSHIELD AND SIDE WINDOW GLASS WOULD NOT PREVENT THEEJECTION OF VEHICLE OCCUPANTS DURING A VEHICLE CRASH, WHICH CAUSES SERIOUSINJURIES AND FATALITIES.
Corrective Action: REMOVE AND REINSTALL GLASS USING PROPER PRIMER.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR:OVER:HYDRAULIC:DISC:LINES:HOSE:NON-META
Recall Description: HOSE LAYER SEPARATION OCCURRED AT APPLIED TEST LOAD BELOW MINIMUM REQUIRED LOAD.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 106;  AND AIR BRAKE HOSE FAILURE COULD CAUSE LOSS OF BRAKING CONTROL, AND RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE HOSES WITH HOSES THAT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 106.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:BATTERY:CABLE
Recall Description: WIREFORM THAT SECURES RUBBER GROMMETS, WHICH SERVE AS A ROUTING GUIDE FOR THE POSITIVE BATTERY CABLE, MAY NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS.
Consequence Summary: WIREFORMS COULD CHAFE THE POSITIVE BATTERY CABLE ANDCAUSE A SHORT CIRCUIT TO THE MOTORCYCLE CHASSIS DURING OPERATION.
Corrective Action: REPLACE POSITIVE BATTERY CABLE WIREFORM WITH WIREFORM THAT THAT MEETS SPECIFICATIONS.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC:INDICATOR:LEVER
Recall Description: UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS, THE SNAP RING THAT LOCATES THE PARK GEAR ON THE OUTPUT SHAFT OF THE TRANSMISSION MAY FRACTURE.
Consequence Summary: WHEN THE GEAR IS PLACED IN PARK, THE PARK GEAR WOULD NOTENGAGE, ALLOWING THE TRUCK TO ROLL FREELY IF THE PARKING BRAKE IS NOT PROPERLYSET. THIS COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL IMPROVED SNAP RING AND REVISED TRANSMISSION EXTENSION HOUSING.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:ARM:PITMAN
Recall Description: IMPROPER DRILLING OF HOLE TAPERS IN THE STEERING ARM AND PITMAN ARM MAY CAUSE INADEQUATE SEATING OF THE DRAG LINK BALL STUD ON EITHER THE PITMAN ARM OR THE STEERING ARM AND TIE ROD END ON THE STEERING ATTACHMENTS.
Corrective Action: REPLACE DEFECTIVE COMPONENTS WITH NEW ASSEMBLIES AND TORQUE TO PROPER SPECIFICATIONS.

Subject: TIRES:TREAD
Recall Description: SOME TIRES MAY DEVELOP TREAD SEPARATION IN TREAD SHOULDER AREA CAUSING TREAD TO BULGE AND A THUMPING VIBRATION WHEN TIRE IS IN USE; CONTINUED USE MAY CAUSE PLY CORD TO BREAK AND LINER TO TEAR AND LOSE INFLATING AIR PRESSURE.
Consequence Summary: SUDDEN LOSS OF AIR COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL WITH POTENTIAL FOR A CRASH.
Corrective Action: TIRES WILL BE REPLACED AT NO COST TO CONSUMERS WITHIN 60 DAYS OF NOTIFICATION.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:GLASS:WINDSHIELD
Recall Description: DILUTED PRIMER MAY HAVE BEEN USED ON THE WINDSHIELD OPENING FLANGES PRIOR TO WINDSHIELD GLASS INSTALLATION WHICH WOULD NOT PROVIDE THE RETENTION REQUIRED BY FMVSS 212.
Consequence Summary: WINDSHIELDS WOULD NOT PREVENT EJECTION OF VEHICLEOCCUPANTS DURING A VEHICLE CRASH, WHICH CAUSES SERIOUS INJURIES AND FATALITIES.
Corrective Action: REPLACE WINDSHIELDS, ASSOCIATED PARTS, AND PRIMER.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:GLASS:WINDSHIELD
Recall Description: DILUTED PRIMER MAY HAVE BEEN USED ON THE WINDSHIELD OPENING FLANGES PRIOR TO WINDSHIELD GLASS INSTALLATION WHICH WOULD NOT PROVIDE THE RETENTION REQUIRED BY FMVSS 212.
Consequence Summary: WINDSHIELDS WOULD NOT PREVENT EJECTION OF VEHICLEOCCUPANTS DURING A VEHICLE CRASH, WHICH CAUSES SERIOUS INJURIES AND FATALITIES.
Corrective Action: REPLACE WINDSHIELDS, ASSOCIATED PARTS, AND PRIMER.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:MASTER CYLINDER
Recall Description: INCORRECT SIZE MASTER CYLINDER INSTALLED WILL PROVIDE LESS LINE PRESSURE TO WHEEL CYLINDERS FOR A GIVEN PEDAL PRESSURE.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN INCREASED STOPPING DISTANCES ORINCREASED PEDAL PRESSURE REQUIRED FOR A GIVEN STOPPING DISTANCE, WHICH COULDCAUSE AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL THE CORRECT 1.75 INCH MASTER CYLINDER.

Subject: STEERING:WHEEL AND COLUMN
Recall Description: LOCK PINS IN STEERING WHEEL AND HUB ASSEMBLY MY SHEAR OFF, ALLOWING STEERING WHEEL TO SPIN.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CAUSE LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL THAT COULDRESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPAIR USING A POSITIVE LOCKING METHOD.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:HYDROBOOST UNIT
Recall Description: INTERCONNECTION OF RETURN LINE PLUMBING FROM HYDROBOOST STEERING GEAR MAY CAUSE LIGHT APPLICATION OF HYDROBOOST UNIT WITHOUT APPLYING BRAKE PEDAL.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN DRAGGING BRAKES, BRAKE FADE, ORPREMATURE WEAR AND/OR HEAT DAMAGE TO BRAKE SYSTEM COMPONENTS, REDUCING BRAKINGEFFICIENCY WHICH COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL REVISED RETURN LINES AND REPLACE DAMAGED BRAKE SYSTEM COMPONENTS.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:SUN ROOF HINGES (8/82)
Recall Description: IF SUNROOF GLASS IS REMOVED AND REINSTALLED BY VEHICLE OPERATOR, HINGE ASSEMBLIES CAN BE ACCIDENTALLY IMPROPERLY MATED.
Consequence Summary: SUNROOF COULD DETACH FROM THE VEHICLE WHILE BEING DRIVEN,CREATING A RISK TO FOLLOWING VEHICLES OR PEOPLE IN THE VICINITY, OR TO VEHICLEOCCUPANTS IF THE GLASS SHOULD FALL INTO THE CABIN.
Corrective Action: INSTALL REVISED SUNROOF HINGES THAT WILL ADEQUATELY RETAIN SUNROOF ASSEMBLY.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL SYSTEM OTHER PARTS
Recall Description: PLASTIC FUEL FILTER ASSEMBLIES MAY DEVELOP LEAKS.
Consequence Summary: FUEL LEAKS COULD RESULT IN A VEHICLE FIRE DUE TO STATICCHARGE BUILD UPS FOUND IN  THE PLASTIC FUEL LINES AND FUEL FILTER WHICH MAY ACTAS AN IGNITION SOURCE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE PLASTIC ASSEMBLY WITH METAL FUEL FILTER AND BRACKET.

Subject: ENGINE COOLING SYSTEM:FAN
Recall Description: AT HIGH ENGINE SPEEDS, THE COOLING FAN ADAPTER PLATE, WHICH CONNECTS THE COOLING FAN AND THE FAN PULLEY, HAS INSUFFICIENT STRENGTH, ALLOWING CRACKS TO DEVELOP IN THE ADAPTER PLATE.
Consequence Summary: COOLING FAN COULD BE DISLODGED, DAMAGING RADIATOR AND FAN GUIDE; AND FAN COULD BREAK LOOSE, FLY OUT OF ENGINE COMPARTMENT, AND INJURE PERSONS IN THE IMMEDIATE VICINITY.
Corrective Action: REPAIR OR REPLACE ADAPTER PLATE TO PREVENT CRACKS AND DAMAGE.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT BUCKLES
Recall Description: PLASTIC COMPONENTS OF SEAT BELT BUCKLE ASSEMBLIES DO NOT CONTAIN AN ULTRA VIOLET STABILIZER, AND EXPOSURE TO DIRECT SUNLIGHT AND ELEVATED INTERIOR TEMPERATURES COULD WEAKEN THE PLASTIC COMPONENTS.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN BREAKAGE OF PLASTIC COMPONENTS WHICHCOULD PREVENT BUCKLE FROM LATCHING AND PROTECTING OCCUPANT IN A SUDDEN STOP ORACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE OR REPAIR SEAT BELT BUCKLE.

Subject: TIRES:MARKINGS
Recall Description: TIRES DO NOT HAVE TREADWEAR INDICATOR MOLDED IN THE TIRE TO ENABLE A PERSON TO VISUALLY DETERMINE WHEN TIRE IS WORN DOWN TO ONE-SIXTEENTH OF AN INCH AND MUST BE REPLACED.
Consequence Summary: VISUAL DETERMINATION AS TO WHEN TO REPLACE WOULD BE MORE DIFFICULT AND TIRES DO NOT CONFORM TO FMVSS 119.
Corrective Action: REPLACE DEFECTIVE TIRES WITH NEW ONES AT NO COST TO CONSUMER WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM DATE OF NOTIFICATION.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT
Recall Description: CHILD RESTRAINT SYSTEM FAILED TO MEET PRE-IMPACT BUCKLE RELEASE FORCE REQUIREMENTS AND BACK SUPPORT ANGLE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 213.
Consequence Summary: BELT COULD BE MORE EASILY UNLATCHED THAN EXPECTED. ALSO, DUE TO BACK SUPPORT ANGLE, CHILD MAY NOT BE PROPERLY RESTRAINED IN THE EVENT OF A SUDDEN STOP OR ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW BUCKLE AND STRAP AND LONGER BOLT FOR THE BACK OF SEAT.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CERTIFICATION LABEL
Recall Description: ALTERER'S LABEL CONTAINING GROSS VEHICLE WEIGHT RATING INFORMATION MAY BE ABSENT OR INCOMPLETE.
Consequence Summary: LIMOUSINE MAY NOT COMPLY WITH PART 567.
Corrective Action: INSTALL APPROPRIATE INFORMATION PLATE.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CERTIFICATION LABEL
Recall Description: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  LIMOUSINES BUILT BY EMPIRE COACH.   VEHICLE ALTERERS LABEL MAY BE MISSING OR INCOMPLETE.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLES DO NOT COMPLY WITH PART 567.
Corrective Action: ADD COMPLIANCE LABEL.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:TIRE RESERVE LOAD LABEL (GLOVE COMPARTME
Recall Description: REVISED TIRE INFORMATION LABEL NEEDED.
Consequence Summary: LIMOUSINES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 110.
Corrective Action: INSTALL APPROPRIATE INFORMATION PLATE.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:TIRE RESERVE LOAD LABEL (GLOVE COMPARTME
Recall Description: TIRE PRESSURE PLACARD REQUIRED BY FMVSS 110 MAY BE INCORRECT OR MISSING.
Consequence Summary: INCORRECT TIRE INFLATION PRESSURE CAN DAMAGE TIRES ANDCOULD EFFECT HANDLING; ALSO, LIMOUSINES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 110.
Corrective Action: INSTALL CORRECT PLACARD.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN
Recall Description: ALL DESIGNATED SEATING POSITIONS DO NOT CONTAIN SEAT BELTS AS REQUIRED BY FMVSS 208.
Consequence Summary: PASSENGERS IN SEATING POSITIONS WITHOUT SEAT BELTS WOULD BE SUBJECT TO GREATER INJURY THAN IF PROPERLY BELTED.
Corrective Action: INSTALL SEAT BELTS AT DESIGNATED SEATING POSITIONS WHERE MISSING AND ASSURE SEAT BELTS ARE ANCHORED WITH MATERIALS THAT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 209.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN
Recall Description: SAFETY BELTS WERE NOT PROVIDED FOR EVERY SEATING POSITION ON THE REAR FACING SEATS.
Consequence Summary: OCCUPANTS OF THESE SEATS WOULD BE MORE LIKELY TO SUSTAIN INJURY IN A SUDDEN STOP OR ACCIDENT; ALSO VEHICLES WOULD NOT CONFORM TO FMVS S208.
Corrective Action: INSTALL SEAT BELTS FOR REAR FACING SEATS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN
Recall Description: SAFETY BELTS MAY NOT EXTEND EASILY FROM THEIR RETRACTORS WHEN VEHICLE IS PARKED ON SLIGHT SLOPE AS REQUIRED BY FMVSS 208. REAR STOP LIGHTS AND TURN SIGNALS DO NOT MEET MINIMUM PHOTOMETRIC STRENGTH, AND FRONT TURN INDICATOR - SIDE MARKER LIGHTS ARE BELOW HEIGHT REQUIRED BY FMVSS 108. WARNING LABEL (NEAR FILLER OF BRAKE FLUID RESERVOIR) TO CLEAN FILLER CAP BEFORE REMOVING MAY BE MISSING, WHICH VIOLATES REQUIREMENT OF FMVSS 105. INSIDE WINDSCREEN MOULDING MAY BE TOO HIGHLY REFLECTIVE AND NOT IN COMPLIANCE WITH FMVSS 107.
Consequence Summary: NON-WORKING SEAT BELTS COULD CONTRIBUTE TO INJURY TOVEHICLE OCCUPANT IN SUDDEN STOP OR ACCIDENT. INSUFFICIENT PHOTOMETRIC STRENGTHOF THE BRAKE AND REAR SIGNAL LIGHTS COULD LEAD TO A VEHICLE COLLISON. THEMISSING WARNING LABEL ON THE OIL FILLER CAP COULD LEAD TO IMPROPER MAINTENANCE,AND RESULT IN AN UNDERHOOD FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPAIR VEHICLE TO ASSURE ALL THE DEFECTS MENTIONED ARE CORRECTED.

Subject: LIGHTING:GENERAL OR UNKNOWN COMPONENT:HIGH MOUNTED
Recall Description: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  LIMOUSINES BUILT BY EMPIRE COACH.  SAFETY BELTS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN INSTALLED FOR REAR FACING SEATS.
Consequence Summary: OCCUPANT OF THESE SEATS WOULD BE SUBJECT TO INCREASED INJURY IN EVENT OF A SUDDEN STOP OR ACCIDENT AND VEHICLES DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 208.
Corrective Action: INSTALL ADDITIONAL SAFETY BELTS.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:GLASS:WINDOW:DOOR AND SIDE
Recall Description: SIDE AND REAR WINDOWS ARE TINTED.
Consequence Summary: SUCH TINTING COULD AFFECT DRIVER VISIBILITY AND LIMOUSINES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 205.
Corrective Action: REMOVE TINT FROM SIDE AND REAR WINDOWS.

Subject: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR
Recall Description: CONTINUOUS EXPOSURE TO ROAD SALT COULD CAUSE CORROSION OF REAR SUSPENSION COMPONENTS, ESPECIALLY THE INNER ARMS.
Consequence Summary: THE CORROSION COULD AFFECT THE OPERATION AND CONTROL OF THE VEHICLE.
Corrective Action: RUST PROOF OR REPLACE REAR SUSPENSION, AS NECESSARY.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:GLAZING MATERIAL STICKER
Recall Description: WINDOW INSERT IN DRIVER'S BARRIER ENCLOSURE WAS NOT MARKED IN ACCORDANCE WITH FMVSS 205.
Consequence Summary: BUSES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 105 STANDARD.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A DECAL CONTAINING THE REQUIRED DATA ON THE GLAZING.

Subject: LIGHTING:GENERAL OR UNKNOWN COMPONENT:HIGH MOUNTED
Recall Description: CENTER HIGH MOUNTED STOP LAMP MAY BE OBSTRUCTED OR ABSENT.
Consequence Summary: THE OBSTRUCTION OR LACK OF A CENTER HIGH MOUNTED STOP LAMP WOULD INCREASE THE HAZARD OF A REAR END COLLISION AND THE VEHICLE WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 108.
Corrective Action: REMOVE OBSTRUCTING WINDOW TINTING OR INSTALL HIGH CENTER STOP LAMP WHEN MISSING.

Subject: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:NON-POWER AXLE:SPINDLE
Recall Description: A NUMBER OF FACTORS COULD CAUSE LONGITIDUNAL AND - OR TRANSVERSE CRACKS IN THE SPINDLE END THAT COULD LEAD TO SPINDLE END FAILURE AND SEPARATION OF WHEELS FROM VEHICLE.
Consequence Summary: WHEEL SEPARATION COULD OCCUR AFFECTING VEHICLE CONTROL AND STABILITY AS WELL AS PRESENTING A HAZARD TO OTHER HIGHWAY USERS, BYSTANDERS, AND PROPERTY.
Corrective Action: REPLACE AXLES WITH AXLES MANUFACTURED WITH BUTTWELD SPINDLES, RATHER THAN ORIGINAL INTEGRAL SPINDLES.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: AIR BRAKE HOSE LAYERS SEPARATED AT AN APPLIED LOAD OF 6.29 POUNDS RATHER THAN THE FMVSS 106 MINIMUM REQUIRED LOAD OF 8.0 POUNDS.
Consequence Summary: HOSE SEPARATION COULD CAUSE AIR LEAKAGE AND CAUSE THE BREAKAWAY VALVE TO START APPLYING TRAILER BRAKES AND POSSIBLY THE AUTOMATIC SPRING BRAKES; SUCH UNEXPECTED BRAKE APPLICATION COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL AIR BRAKE HOSE THAT MEETS FMVSS 106 REQUIREMENTS.

Subject: LIGHTING:GENERAL OR UNKNOWN COMPONENT:HEAD LIGHTS
Recall Description: HEADLAMPS HAVE NO PROVISION FOR MECHANICAL AIMING, DO NOT COMPLY WITH ENVIRONMENTAL CRITERIA,  AND DO NOT CONTAIN THE D.O.T. SYMBOL AS REQUIRED BY FMVSS 108.
Consequence Summary: THIS WOULD CAUSE IMPROPER LIGHTING,  AND VEHICLES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 108.
Corrective Action: REFUND PURCHASE PRICE.

Subject: AIR CONDITIONER
Recall Description: UNDER CERTAIN OPERATING CONDITIONS, THE PLASTIC COVER OF THE PRERESISTOR FOR THE AUXILIARY FAN MAY MELT, POSSIBLY IGNITING THE PRERESISTOR.
Consequence Summary: THIS RESULTS IN AN UNDERHOOD FIRE THAT WOULD BE HAZARDOUS TO OCCUPANTS.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE PRERESISTOR WITH VERSION HAVING A METAL COVER.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL:PEDAL
Recall Description: ELECTRONIC FOOT PEDAL SPRINGS COULD FAIL PREVENTING THE THE PEDAL FROM RETURNING TO ITS NORMAL IDLE POSITION.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CAUSE AN UNINTENDED FULL THROTTLE CONDITION THAT COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A FAILSAFE SWITCH ONTO FOOT PEDAL ASSEMBLY TO PREVENT UNINTENDED FULL THROTTLE CONDITION FROM OCCURING.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:ARM:PITMAN
Recall Description: AN INCORRECT PINCH BOLT WAS USED IN THE STEERING GEAR PITMAN ARM THAT DOES NOT ALLOW PROPER CLAMPING FORCE ON THE ARM SPLINE.
Consequence Summary: PITMAN ARM SPLINES COULD WEAR AND AFFECT STEERING WHICH COULD RESULT IN A VEHICLE ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL THE CORRECT PINCH BOLT.

Subject: TIRES:SIDEWALL
Recall Description: LEFT FRONT AND LEFT REAR TIRES MAY HAVE BEEN DAMAGED BY A WORN CHAIN DRIVE OF THE CONVEYOR SYSTEM.
Consequence Summary: DAMAGED OR CUT TIRES COULD FAIL DURING USE AND RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT WITH POSSIBLE INJURIES.
Corrective Action: REPLACE DAMAGED TIRES WITH TIRES OF THE SAME BRAND NAME.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:AIR BAG IMPACT
Recall Description: AIR BAG INFLATOR MODULES MAY NOT CONTAIN DIFFUSER HOLES BETWEEN THE IGNITOR AND PROPELLANT CHAMBERS.
Consequence Summary: AIR BAGS WOULD NOT DEPLOY IN AN IMPACT SITUATION, WHICH COULD LEAD TO DRIVER INJURY.
Corrective Action: REPLACE AIR BAG INFLATOR MODULES WITH PROPERLY MACHINED MODULES.

Subject: BRAKES:WARNING SIGNAL
Recall Description: LOW AIR WARNING PRESSURE SWITCH MAY NOT ACTIVATE THE WARNING SIGNAL UNTIL PRESSURE HAS DROPPED TO 55 PSI, RATHER THAN AT THE REQUIRED 60 PSI.
Consequence Summary: DRIVER WOULD NOT RECEIVE PROPER WARNING OF LOW AIR PRESSURE IN AIR BRAKE SYSTEM AND THIS CONDITION COULD RESULT IN A VEHICLE CRASH;  ALSO, VEHICLE WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 121.
Corrective Action: REPLACE INAPPROPRIATE AIR WARNING PRESSURE SWITCHES.

Subject: ENGINE
Recall Description: PCV GROMMET OIL LEAKS, TRANSMISSION OIL COOLER LEAKS, PISTON CONNECTING ROD FAILURES BREAKING THROUGH ENGINE WALL CAUSING OIL SPILLAGE, FUEL RAIL LEAKS, COOLANT LEAKS, ROCKER COVER OIL LEAKS, AND MAINTENANCE OR SERVICE RELATED FACTORS, COULD CAUSE ENGINE COMPARTMENT FIRES.
Consequence Summary: AN ENGINE COMPARTMENT FIRE CAN SPREAD TO THE PASSENGERCOMPARTMENT AND INJURE OCCUPANTS.
Corrective Action: CORRECT OR INSTALL NEW COMPONENTS TO PREVENT UNREASONABLE FIRE RISK.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:AIR BAG CHARGE
Recall Description: AIR BAG INFLATOR CASE WAS INCORRECTLY MACHINED.
Consequence Summary: IN AN ACCIDENT, THE AIR BAG MAY NOT DEPLOY, WHICH COULD RESULT IN INCREASED INJURY TO THE DRIVER.
Corrective Action: REPLACE AIR BAG INFLATOR UNIT.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:POWER ASSIST:BOOSTER
Recall Description: BENDIX HYDRAULIC BRAKE BOOSTER MAY MALFUNCTION UNDER CERTAIN COMBINATIONS OF FLUID TEMPERATURE AND BRAKE PEDAL FORCE.
Consequence Summary: THIS WOULD CAUSE THE BRAKE BOOSTER TO SELF-APPLY AND RESULT IN FULL BRAKE APPLICATION, WITHOUT WARNING, WHICH COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE HYDRAULIC BRAKE BOOSTER.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:TIRE RESERVE LOAD LABEL (GLOVE COMPARTME
Recall Description: INCORRECT TIRE INFLATION PRESSURES WERE PRINTED ON CERTIFICATION LABELS.
Consequence Summary: INCORRECT TIRE INFLATION COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL CORRECTED TIRE INFORMATION LABEL ON DOORPOST CERTIFICATION LABEL.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL:PEDAL
Recall Description: INTERFERENCE OCCUR BETWEEN BOLT THAT SECURES A FUEL LINE SHIELD TO THE LOWER PORTION OF THE DASH PANEL AND THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CAUSE THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL TO STICK AT THE WIDE OPEN THROTTLE POSITION AND RESULT IN LOSS OF CONTROL WITH THE RISK OF A VEHICLE ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: CUT OFF EXTRA LENGTH OF BOLT THAT PROTRUDES ABOVE SURFACE OF WELD NUT TO PREVENT INTERFERENCE.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:AIR SUPPLY SYSTEM
Recall Description: AIR BRAKES MAY NOT MEET THE RELEASE TIME REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 121.
Consequence Summary: THERE MAY BE A SLIGHT FRONT AXLE BRAKE DRAG AND TRUCKS WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 121.
Corrective Action: REPLACE PARTS AND RE-WORK SYSTEM TO CORRECT AIR BRAKE RELEASE TIME.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:TIE ROD:INNER
Recall Description: IMPROPERLY TORQUED TIE ROD CLAMP FASTENERS COULD ALLOW THE TIE ROD TO LOOSEN AND EVENTUALLY SEPARATE.
Consequence Summary: IF TIE ROD SEPARATES AND AFFECTED WHEEL HITS A HUMP OR IS SUBJECTED TO MODERATE TO HEAVY BRAKING FORCES, THIS COULD RESULT IN LOSS OFSTEERING CONTROL AND A VEHICLE CRASH.
Corrective Action: PROPERLY TORQUE TIE ROD CLAMPS AND RE-ADJUST TOE-IN AS NECESSARY.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:METALLIC
Recall Description: THERE IS INSUFFICIENT CLEARANCE BETWEEN THE RIGHT FRONT BRAKE CALIPER HYDRAULIC LINE AND THE ENGINE OIL COOLER LINE. IF THE LINES COME IN CONTACT WITH EACH OTHER, THE CHAFING MAY DAMAGE THE BRAKE LINE AND CAUSE A FLUID LEAK.
Consequence Summary: HYDRAULIC FLUID LEAK COULD RESULT IN A LOSS OF BRAKES WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: ADD A PROTECTIVE SHIELD TO PREVENT CONTACT AND REPLACE ANY DAMAGED HYDRAULIC PIPE.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT LATCH
Recall Description: A SECURING CLIP ON THE OUTSIDE OF HINGES OF THE LEFT AND RIGHT FRONT SEAT BACK MAY NOT BE PROPERLY SEATED DUE TO INTERFERENCE WITH SEAT COVERING MATERIAL.
Consequence Summary: AN IMPROPERLY SECURED CLIP COULD CAUSE THE SEAT BACKHINGE TO SEPARATE FROM ITS ANCHOR IN A REAR-END ACCIDENT AND COULD RESULT IN AN INJURY TO OCCUPANT(S).
Corrective Action: REALIGN SEAT COVERING MATERIAL WHERE INTERFERENCE IS PRESENT.

Subject: STEERING:COLUMN LOCKING:ANTI-THEFT DEVICE
Recall Description: IMPROPERLY MANUFACTURED STEERING LOCK BOLTS COULD BREAK IF DRIVER APPLIES EXCESSIVE FORCE TO A LOCKED STEERING WHEEL IN AN ATTEMPT TO DISENGAGE THE STEERING LOCK.
Consequence Summary: BOLT BREAKAGE WOULD CAUSE STEERING WHEEL TO REMAIN LOCKED EVEN AFTER THE DRIVER TURNS THE IGNITION KEY AND ATTEMPTS TO MOVE THE CAR; THIS TOTAL LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE COMPLETE STEERING LOCK ASSEMBLY, INCLUDING A MODIFIED LOCK BOLT.

Subject: STRUCTURE:BODY:GRAB BAR:STRAP MOUNTING ASSIST
Recall Description: CURB SIDE CAB ENTRY GRAB HANDLE REINFORCEMENTS MAY HAVE BEEN OMITTED.
Consequence Summary: GRAB HANDLE COULD LOOSEN AND EVENTUALLY PULL LOOSE; THIS COULD RESULT IN INJURY TO USER OF THE HANDLE
Corrective Action: INSTALL MISSING CURB SIDE CAB ENTRY GRAB HANDLE REINFORCEMENTS.

Subject: STRUCTURE:DOOR ASSEMBLY:HINGE AND ATTACHMENTS
Recall Description: ENTRY DOORS MAY NOT MEET LONGITUDINAL LOAD REQUIREMENTS DUE TO OMISSION OF MUSHROOM CAP ON THE STRIKER PIN, REQUIRED BY FMVSS 206.
Consequence Summary: UNDER SEVERE CONDITIONS, SUCH AS EXTREME IMPACT TO THE MODULAR BOX OR A ROLLOVER, DOORS COULD SEPARATE FROM THE PIN AND OPEN; THIS WOULD ALLOW OCCUPANTS TO BE EXPELLED FROM AMBULANCE IF NOT SECURED BY SAFETY BELTS.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW STRIKER PINS THAT MEET FMVSS 206 REQUIREMENTS.

Subject: SUSPENSION:I-BEAM:SOLID:FRONT HANGER:BRACKET
Recall Description: A REQUIRED WELD IN THE AIR RIDE SUSPENSION FRAME ATTACHING AREA WAS OMITTED CAUSING SUSPENSION AND ADAPTOR CHANNELS TO BE OVERLOADED.
Consequence Summary: ADAPTOR CHANNELS AND SUSPENSION CROSS MEMBERS COULD CRACK AND FAIL WITH HANGER AND AXLE ASSEMBLY DETACHMENT; THIS COULD RESULT IN A VEHICLE CRASH AND/OR A CATASTROPHIC AXLE DETACHMENT.
Corrective Action: INSPECTION AND WELD REPAIR, IF NECESSARY, TO ATTACH THE BOGIE SUBFRAME CROSS MEMBERS TO THE BOGIE ADAPTOR CHANNEL.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT BELTS:LAP:REAR
Recall Description: OWNER'S MANUALS WERE PRINTED WITH REAR CENTER SEAT BELT INFORMATION OMITTED.
Consequence Summary: THIS WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 209.
Corrective Action: INSERT MISSING INFORMATION INTO OWNERS MANUAL.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT
Recall Description: THE RETRACTOR ASSEMBLY HAS A 'TONGUE' USED TO ENGAGE THE BREAST SHIELD OF THE CHILD RESTRAINT;  A STAMPING DIE USED ON THIS TONGUE COULD CAUSE THE PART TO FAIL AND COMPLETELY SEPARATE IN A CRASH.
Consequence Summary: CHILD USING THE SEAT WOULD NOT BE PROPERLY RESTRAINED IN A CRASH, AND COULD SUFFER INJURY;  ALSO, THE SEATS WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS213.
Corrective Action: INSTALL REPLACEMENT RETRACTOR ASSEMBLY WHICH WILL INCLUDE TONGUE THAT IS FREE OF THE STAMPING DIE THAT LED TO TONGUE FAILURE.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:TRAILER HITCHES AND ATTACHM
Recall Description: RETAINER SNAP RING THAT SECURES THE PINTLE HOOK LATCH PIN MAY NOT BE PROPERLY LOCATED AND SEATED.
Consequence Summary: PINTLE HOOK COULD BECOME DISENGAGED FROM THE LUNETTE EYERESULTING IN SEPARATION OF THE TRAILING UNIT FROM THE LEAD TRAILER. SEPARATIONCOULD RESULT IN A CRASH.
Corrective Action: ASSURE THAT SNAP RING IS PROPERLY INSTALLED BT REMOVING RING, CLEANING THE MACHINED GROOVE,  AND REINSTALLING SNAP RING.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL INJECTION:ELECTRICAL:LINE:HOSE
Recall Description: THE HOSE MATERIAL USED IN THE SHORT SECTION OF THE HIGH PRESSURE FUEL LINE HOSE, BETWEEN THE FUEL RAIL AND FUEL PRESSURE REGULATOR, IS SUBJECT TO HARDENING, AND COULD CAUSE FUEL LEAKS BETWEEN THE HOSE AND THE METAL PIPE FITTINGS.
Consequence Summary: FUEL LEAKS COULD IGNITE ON THE HOT EXHAUST SYSTEM, OR ANY OTHER SOURCE OF IGNITION, RESULTING IN AN ENGINE COMPARTMENT FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FUEL LINE HOSE WITH HOSES MADE OF IMPROVED MATERIAL.

Subject: STEERING:POWER:SHAFT SECTOR
Recall Description: THE UNIVERSAL JOINTS AT EACH END OF THE STEERING SHAFT ARE ATTACHED TO THE SHAFT WITH A KEY AND SET SCREW. THE SET SCREWS MAY LOOSEN AND ALLOW THE KEY TO FALL OUT OF PLACE.
Consequence Summary: IF THE KEY FALLS OUT, THE UNIVERSAL JOINT WOULD SPIN ON THE SHAFT, RESULTING IN LOSS OF STEERING AND A POSSIBLE CRASH.
Corrective Action: MODIFY STEERING LINKAGE TO PREVENT SET SCREW FROM LOOSENING AND KEY FROM COMING OUT OF KEY WAY.

Subject: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR
Recall Description: U-BOLTS THAT HOLD REAR AXLE TO THE FRAME MAY SEVER.
Consequence Summary: REAR AXLE COULD WORK FREE FROM ITS DESIGNED POSITION;  THIS COULD AFFECT DRIVER ABILITY TO CONTROL THE BUS AND COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE EXISTING U-BOLTS WITH IMPROVED U-BOLTS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:RESTRAINT:BELT ANCHOR AND ATTACHM
Recall Description: METAL FORMED ENDS OF SEAT BELT ANCHORAGE BAR MAY BE CRACKED.
Consequence Summary: SEAT BELT ANCHORAGES WOULD NOT SUSTAIN SEAT BELT LOADS INA CRASH, INCREASING THE RISK OF INJURY TO THE OCCUPANT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE TOP PLATE WELDMENT, INCLUDING SEAT BELT ANCHORAGE BAR, ON SEAT PEDESTALS.

Subject: STEERING:COLUMN
Recall Description: LOWER INTERMEDIATE STEERING SHAFT MAY SEPARATE AT THE RUBBER ISOLATED COUPLING OF THE SHAFT.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE INTERMEDIATE STEERING SHAFT WITH A SHAFT CONTAINING A RESTRAINED COUPLING.

Subject: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR
Recall Description: WELDED CONNECTION BETWEEN THE AXLE TRAILING ARM AND THE INNER TRANSVERSE AXLE BAR COULD FAIL.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD AFFECT OPERATOR'S ABILITY TO CONTROL THE VAN AND COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A REDESIGNED REAR AXLE AND REALIGN REAR WHEELS.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL SYSTEM OTHER PARTS
Recall Description: FILTERS MAY BE INCOMPLETELY ASSEMBLED WITH THE CRIMP OPERATION OMITTED; THE TWO HALVES ARE ONLY HELD TOGETHER BY SEALANT COMPOUND, ACTING AS AN ADHESIVE, AND WILL SEPARATE WHEN PRESSURE IS APPLIED.
Consequence Summary: FILTER SEPARATION WHEN PRESSURE IS APPLIED RESULTS IN SIGNIFICANT LEAKAGE OF FUEL, AND RISK OF FIRE NEAR A SOURCE OF IGNITION.
Corrective Action: REPLACE WITH FILTERS THAT HAVE BEEN INSPECTED FOR DEFECTS.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:SUN ROOF HINGES (8/82)
Recall Description: OPERATION OF SUNROOF IN "NON-STANDARD" MANNER MAY CAUSE MALE HINGE DISENGAGEMENT FROM THE ROOF HINGE RECEIVER.
Consequence Summary: THE SUNROOF GLASS COULD DETACH FROM THE ROOF AND RESULTIN INJURY TO OCCUPANTS OR PERSONS IN THE VICINITY, ESPECIALLY IF THIS OCCURS WHILE THE VEHICLE IS IN MOTION.
Corrective Action: REPLACE MALE HINGE WITH A MODIFIED VERSION TO INCREASE ROOF HINGE RECEIVER RETENTION ABILITY.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:SUN ROOF HINGES (8/82)
Recall Description: OPERATION OF SUNROOF IN "NON-STANDARD" MANNER MAY CAUSE MALE HINGE DISENGAGEMENT FROM THE ROOF HINGE RECEIVER.
Consequence Summary: THE SUNROOF GLASS COULD DETACH FROM THE ROOF AND RESULT IN INJURY TO OCCUPANTS OR PERSONS IN THE VICINITY, ESPECIALLY IF THIS OCCURS WHILE THE VEHICLE IS IN MOTION.
Corrective Action: REPLACE MALE HINGE WITH A MODIFIED VERSION TO INCREASE ROOF HINGE RECEIVER RETENTION ABILITY.

Subject: WHEELS:SINGLE:CAP:COVER:HUB
Recall Description: WHEELS MAY LOOSEN DUE TO USE OF INCORRECT CAP NUT, PREVENTING PROPER CONTACT WITH THE WHEEL AND EVENTUAL LOSS OF TORQUE.
Consequence Summary: WHEEL BOLT CIRCLE CAN CRACK, ALLOWING TIRE AND WHEEL TO SEPARATE FROM THE VEHICLE; THIS COULD AFFECT DRIVER CONTROL AND RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW WHEELS FOR DAMAGED WHEELS AND REPLACE CAP NUTS.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL SYSTEM OTHER PARTS
Recall Description: FRAME MOUNTED FUEL FILTER MAY CRACK FROM FLEXING AT THE FUEL INLET MOUNTING NUT AND ALLOW FUEL TO LEAK IN AREA OF EXHAUST PIPE.
Consequence Summary: HEAT FROM THE EXHAUST SYSTEM COULD IGNITE THE SPILLED FUEL AND RESULT IN A VEHICLE FIRE.
