Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW INTERMEDIATE FUEL FEED PIPE ASSEMBLY AND FUEL FILTER ASSEMBLY.

Subject: STEERING:POWER:SHAFT SECTOR
Recall Description: INTERFERENCE BETWEEN STEERING GEAR SECTOR SHAFT AND THE FRAME RAIL THROUGH HOLE CAN CAUSE SECTOR SHAFT WEAR AND CAN WEAKEN SHAFT CAUSE IT TO BREAK.
Consequence Summary: SHAFT FAILURE DURING VEHICLE OPERATION WOULD CAUSE LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL AND A CRASH WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: ENLARGE FRAME RAIL THROUGH HOLE TO PREVENT INTERFERENCE: REPLACE STEERING GEAR SECTOR SHAFT IF SCORED.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:WINDSHIELD WIPER LINKAGE:PIVOT:DRIV
Recall Description: A TOLERANCE MISMATCH IN THE CRANK ASSEMBLY OF THE BOSCH WINDSHIELD WIPER MOTOR COULD CAUSE INSTANTANEOUS SEPARATION OF THE CRANK FROM THE LINKAGE ASSEMBLY IN THE LEFT HAND CONTROL ARM ASSEMBLY; THIS WOULD MAKE THE SYSTEM INOPERABLE.
Consequence Summary: WIPER FAILURE DURING VEHICLE OPERATION COULD REDUCE DRIVER'S ABILITY TO SEE THE ROAD, AND CREATES A POTENTIAL FOR AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE LEFT HAND CONTROL ARM LINKAGE ASSEMBLY.

Subject: WHEELS:HUB
Recall Description: LOCK WASHER LOCATED UNDER THE NUT THAT SECURES THE FRONT HUB TO THE DRIVE SHAFT MAY HAVE HAD IMPROPER HEAT TREATMENT AND COULD CRACK.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CAUSE WHEEL BEARING FREEPLAY AND COULD RESULT IN BEARING DAMAGE, AND POSSIBLE LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL THROUGH WHEEL FAILURE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE LOCK WASHER ON EACH FRONT WHEEL AND REPAIR AREA AROUND LOCK WASHER AS NECESSARY.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:BELTS
Recall Description: FRONT SHOULDER BELT GUIDE LOOP ATTACHMENT FASTENER MAY PULL THROUGH DOOR MOUNTED ANCHOR PLATE.
Consequence Summary: SEAT BELT MAY NOT SUSTAIN LOADS REQUIRED BY FMVSS 210, AND IN A VEHICLE ACCIDENT, THE SEAT BELT MAY NOT PROPERLY RESTRAIN A PASSENGER, RESULTING IN INCREASED RISK OF GREATER INJURY TO AN OCCUPANT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FRONT SHOULDER BELT GUIDE LOOP ATTACHMENT NUTS AND INSTALL NEW GUIDE COVER.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:EMERGENCY EXIT LABEL
Recall Description: THE FRONT ENTRANCE DOOR OF THE COLLINS DIPLOMAT WAS INTENDED TO BE AN EMERGENCY EXIT, BUT IT IS NOT LABELED "EMERGENCY EXIT".
Consequence Summary: THE BUSES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 217.
Corrective Action: LABEL FRONT ENTRANCE DOOR "EMERGENCY EXIT".

Subject: BRAKES:AIR:DRUM AND SHOE SYSTEMS:LININGS
Recall Description: BRAKE SHOES MAY FAIL DUE TO THE USE OF UNDERSIZED RIVETS OR THE IMPROPER RIVETING IN ATTACHING THE LINING TO THE BRAKE SHOE TABLE.
Consequence Summary: LINING COULD CRACK, LOOSEN, CAUSING LOSS OF BRAKING POWER THAT COULD RESULT IN A VEHICLE CRASH WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: REPLACE DEFECTIVE RELINED BRAKES SHOES.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:ARM:PITMAN
Recall Description: THE UPPER AND LOWER PINCH BOLT ON THE STEERING PITMAN ARM AND THE LOWER PINCH BOLT CONNECTION ON SHEPHARD POWER GEARS WERE NOT TORQUED CORRECTLY.
Consequence Summary: PINCH BOLT COULD LOOSEN AND BREAK; THIS COULD CAUSE LOSS OF TRUCK STEERING CONTROL AND RESULT IN A CRASH.
Corrective Action: INSTALL ENGLISH HEX HEAD BOLTS AND FLAT WASHERS; TORQUE PINCH BOLTS TO SPECIFICATIONS.

Subject: STEERING:WHEEL AND COLUMN
Recall Description: IMPROPER TORQUING OF STEERING WHEEL COULD CAUSE THE STEERING COLUMN STEEL SHAFT TO WEAR ON THE WHEEL ALUMINUM HUB.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD EVENTUALLY ALLOW THE STEERING WHEEL TO BECOME DISENGAGED FROM THE SHAFT, WHICH COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF MOTORHOME CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ALUMINUM HUB AND PROPERLY TORQUE THE STEERING WHEEL.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:RESTRAINT:BELT WARNING SYSTEM:LIG
Recall Description: THE "FASTEN SEAT BELTS" WARNING LIGHTS MAY NOT WORK WHEN THE IGNITION IS SWITCHED TO THE "ON" POSITION DURING COLD AMBIENT TEMPERATURES.
Consequence Summary: OCCUPANTS WOULD NOT RECEIVE THIS WARNING TO USE SAFETY BELTS AND CARS WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 208.
Corrective Action: FORD WILL REPLACE INSTRUMENT CLUSTERS IN THE AFFECTED CARS.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC:INDICATOR:LEVER
Consequence Summary: INABILITY TO SEE GEAR SHIFT POSITION INDICATOR COULD PRESENT AN ACCIDENT HAZARD IF DRIVER IS NOT AWARE OF THE GEAR VEHICLE IS IN.
Corrective Action: SHORTEN INSTRUMENT PANEL TO MAKE GEAR POSTION INDICATOR VISIBLE TO THE DRIVER.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT
Recall Description: THE POLYPROPELENE FASTENERS (CANOE CLIP) USED TO ATTACH THE SEATS MAY CONTAIN HAIRLINE BREAKS OR WEAKNESSES THAT COULD CAUSE THE CLIP TO BREAK.
Consequence Summary: IF CLIPS BROKE DURING ORDINARY USAGE, CLIPS (OR BROKEN PIECES) COULD POSE A CHOKING RISK TO THE CHILD WHO ATTEMPTED TO SWALLOW THE CLIP OR PIECES OF A CLIP.
Corrective Action: REPLACEMENT CLIPS WILL BE SENT TO OWNERS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN
Recall Description: SAFETY BELTS (TYPE 1 LAP BELTS) FOR REAR FACING SEATS WERE NOT INSTALLED.
Consequence Summary: LACK OF RESTRAINTS COULD CONTRIBUTE TO OTHERWISE PREVENTABLE INJURY AND WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 209 AND 210.
Corrective Action: INSTALL SAFETY BELTS FOR REAR FACING SEATS.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:GLASS
Recall Description: WINDOW FILM DOES NOT MEET LIGHT REQUIREMENT OF NOT LESS THAN 70 PERCENT.
Consequence Summary: LIMOUSINES WILL NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 205.
Corrective Action: REMOVE WINDOW FILM TO ASSURE COMPLIANCE WITH STANDARD.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:EMERGENCY EXIT LABEL
Recall Description: THE FRONT ELECTRIC BI-FOLD DOORS ON THESE BUSES ARE IDENTIFIED AS AN "EMERGENCY EXIT". FMVSS 217 REQUIRES THAT DOORS IDENTIFIED AS EMERGENCY EXITS REQUIRE LESS THAN 20 POUNDS OF PRESSURE TO OPEN. THESE DOORS REQUIRE MORE THAN 25 POUNDS OF PRESSURE TO OPERATE MANUALLY.
Consequence Summary: THE VEHICLE IS IN NON-COMPLIANCE WITH FMVSS 217.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE "EMERGENCY EXIT" SIGNS WITH SIGNS THAT READ "FOR MANUAL OPERATION, PULL LEVER DOWN". SINCE THE DOORS ARE NOT IDENTIFIED AS AN EMERGENCY EXIT, THIS ELIMINATES THE NON-COMPLIANCE WITH FMVSS 217.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL LINES:HOSES:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: FRONT FUEL FEED HOSE ASSEMBLY COULD CRACK OR SEPARATE AT THE COUPLING ON THE ENGINE END OF THE HOSE ASSEMBLY, ALLOWING FUEL TO LEAK INTO THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT.
Consequence Summary: LEAKING FUEL IN THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT COULD RESULT IN A FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FRONT FUEL FEED HOSE ASSEMBLY.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL
Recall Description: THROTTLE LEVER MAY CONTACT THROTTLE BODY AIR INLET TUBE, WITH POTENTIAL FOR THROTTLE REMAINING OPEN FOLLOWING RELEASE OF THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL.
Consequence Summary: UNCONTROLLED ACCELERATION COULD CREATE LACK OF CONTROLAND CAUSE AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: MANUFACTURER WILL REPLACE AIR INLET TUBE WITH NEWLY DESIGNED REPLACEMENT.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:SPEED CONTROL
Recall Description: CRUISE CONTROL COMPUTER MALFUNCTION COULD OCCUR UPON SHUTTING OFF THE CONTROL AFTER CONTINUOUS USE FOLLOWED BY COLD AMBIENT TEMPERATURES.
Consequence Summary: THERMAL SHOCK TO THE CRUISE CONTROL COMPUTER COULD RESULT IN ENGINE RACING IF THE ENGINE IS RESTARTED WITH THE MAIN CONTROL SWITCH IN THE 'ON' POSITION.  THIS COULD CAUSE LOSS OF CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT IF THIS IS PERFORMED IN NORMAL TRAFFIC CONDITIONS.
Corrective Action: REPLACE COMPUTER WITH ONE OF IMPROVED DESIGN.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:FUSE
Recall Description: THE FUSE IN THE REAR WINDOW DEFROSTER CIRCUIT MAY BLOW DUE TO THE AMPERAGE LOAD EXCEEDING FUSE CAPACITY.
Consequence Summary: REAR STOP LAMPS, EXCEPT THE HIGH MOUNTED STOP LAMP, WOULD FAIL. THERE MAY NOT BE SUFFICIENT STOP SIGNAL WARNING TO THE FOLLOWING TRAFFIC WHICH MAY CAUSE AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL AN ADDITIONAL FUSED CIRCUIT TO HANDLE THE MAIN STOP LAMPS.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:ARM:PITMAN
Recall Description: CRACK MAY DEVELOP ON STEERING ARM THAT COULD PROGRESS AND REDUCE THE FATIGUE LIFE OF THE STEERING ARM.
Consequence Summary: STEERING ARM COULD FAIL WITHOUT WARNING RESULTING IN LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL AND POSSIBLY A CRASH.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A REDESIGNED STEERING ARM.

Subject: ENGINE COOLING SYSTEM:HOSES
Recall Description: THE SPRING CLAMP TANGS ON THE COOLANT BYPASS HOSE MAY CONTACT AND POSSIBLY DAMAGE THE ENGINE FUEL SUPPLY HOSE.
Consequence Summary: FUEL COULD LEAK FROM THE DAMAGED HOSE INTO THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT AND COULD RESULT IN A FIRE.
Corrective Action: ROTATE SPRING CLAMP TO PREVENT CONTACT WITH FUEL HOSE; REPLACE DAMAGED HOSES.

Subject: STRUCTURE:HOOD ASSEMBLY:LATCHES
Recall Description: INSUFFICIENT CLEARANCE COULD CAUSE THE SAFETY CATCH ON THE SECONDARY HOOD LATCH STRIKER TO BIND.
Consequence Summary: IF PRIMARY LATCH IS RELEASED OR IF HOOD IS NOT COMPLETELY CLOSED, HOOD COULD FLY OPEN WHILE VEHICLE IS IN MOTION; THIS WOULD BLOCK DRIVER'S VISION AND COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE HOOD LATCH STRIKER ASSEMBLY.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:SPEED CONTROL
Recall Description: ELECTRONICALLY CONTROLLED VALVES IN THE CRUISE CONTROL ACTUATOR MAY NOT FUNCTION PROPERLY DUE TO DIRT ENTERING THE VALVES.
Consequence Summary: CRUISE CONTROL WOULD NOT DISENGAGE UNDER NORMAL OPERATINGCONDITIONS WHICH COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE CRUISE CONTROL ACTUATOR AND INSTALL ADDITIONAL VACUUM DUMP VALVE.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK
Recall Description: DURING A REAR END COLLISION, THE REAR EXHAUST SYSTEM HEAT SHIELD, WHICH IS WELDED TO THE TAIL PIPE ASSEMBLY, MAY PUNCTURE THE FUEL TANK.
Consequence Summary: IN THE PRESENCE OF AN EXTERNAL SOURCE OF IGNITION, THIS COULD RESULT IN A FIRE.
Corrective Action: REMOVE REAR EXHAUST SYSTEM HEAT SHIELD FROM THE PIPE ASSEMBLY.

Subject: TIRES
Recall Description: TIRES MAY NOT MEET MINIMUM ENDURANCE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 109.
Consequence Summary: TIRES DO NOT COMPLY WITH REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 109.
Corrective Action: PROVIDE REPLACEMENT TIRES THAT COMPLY WITH STANDARD.

Subject: BRAKES:121 AIR SYSTEM
Recall Description: AN INCORRECT RATIO RELAY VALVE WAS INSTALLED IN THE BRAKE SYSTEM AND THE PRESSURE PROTECTION VALVE WAS INSTALLED INCORRECTLY.
Consequence Summary: INCORRECT INSTALLATION OF THE VALVES WOULD REDUCE THE AVAILABLE RESERVOIR CAPACITY BY ONE HALF, RESULTING IN LOSS OF NORMAL BRAKING FUNCTION AND COULD CAUSE APPLICATION OF THE SPRING BRAKES, WHICH COULD EFFECT THE OPERATION OF THE TRUCK AND RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE BRAKE RELAY VALVE AND RE-ORIENT THE PRESSURE PROTECTION VALVE.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:BATTERY:CABLE
Recall Description: BATTERY TO STARTER CABLES ARE LONGER THAN SPECIFIED; EXCESSIVE CABLE LENGTH COULD CONTACT ENGINE DAMPER PULLEY.
Consequence Summary: CABLE PROTECTIVE COVERING AND INSULATION COULD WEAR THROUGH AND CAUSE A DIRECT SHORT TO GROUND, RESULTING IN OVERHEATING OF THE CABLE INSULATION AND POSSIBLY A UNDERHOOD FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE BATTERY TO STARTER CABLE WITH CORRECT LENGTH CABLE.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT RETRACTORS
Recall Description: MISALIGNED REAR SEAT SAFETY BELT SHOULDER RETRACTOR ASSEMBLIES COULD CAUSE PENDULUM INTERFERENCE, CAUSING THE BELT TO REMAIN IN LOCKED POSITION OR TO TRAVEL FREELY WITHOUT LOCKING.
Consequence Summary: IN THE EVENT OF A PANIC STOP OR ACCIDENT, IF THE BELT RETRACTOR INERTIA LOCK DOES NOT ENGAGE, THE REAR SEAT OCCUPANT WOULD HAVE AN INCREASED LIKELIHOOD OF INJURY.
Corrective Action: REALIGN REAR SHOULDER BELT RETRACTOR ASSEMBLY.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:AIR BAG IMPACT
Recall Description: THE FORWARD SENSOR FOR THE AIR BAG MAY HAVE BEEN INCORRECTLY CONSTRUCTED WITH PART OF THE WIRING HARNESS TO THE SENSOR REVERSED.
Consequence Summary: THE REVERSAL OF THE WIRES COULD CAUSE DELAY IN THE DEPLOYMENT OF THE AIR BAG AND INCREASE THE SEVERITY OF THE OF INJURY TO AN UNBELTED DRIVER IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FORWARD DISCRIMINATING SENSOR AS NECESSARY.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT TRACKS AND ANCHORS
Recall Description: SEAT PEDESTALS FOR DRIVER AND PASSENGERS MAY HAVE A LARGER THAN SPECIFIED SLOT IN THE CENTER CHANNEL.
Consequence Summary: SEAT PEDESTAL MAY NOT MEET LOADING REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 210.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SEAT PEDESTALS WITH PEDESTALS HAVING PROPER SLOT SIZE.

Subject: STEERING:WHEEL AND COLUMN
Recall Description: NUT ATTACHING STEERING WHEEL MAY HAVE BEEN INSUFFICIENTLY TIGHTENED AND A NUT RETAINER MAY BE MISSING.
Consequence Summary: STEERING WHEEL COULD DISENGAGE FROM COLUMN WHICH COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REINSTALL STEERING WHEEL NUT AND RETAINER AND RE-TORQUE NUT.

Subject: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:LEAF SPRING ASSEMBLY
Recall Description: REAR WHEEL TIE ROD ASSEMBLY MAY FATIGUE AND COULD FRACTURE AT THE INBOARD BEARING DUE TO HIGH INNER JOINT ROCKING TORQUE.
Consequence Summary: FRACTURE IN THIS ASSEMBLY COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL AND A CRASH WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FAULTY TIE ROD ASSEMBLIES.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINKAGE:PEDAL
Recall Description: IMPROPERLY MACHINED BRAKE PEDAL TO PUSH ROD PIVOT BOLTS HAVE A TENDENCY TO WORK THEMSELVES LOOSE FROM THE RETAINING NUT, WHICH COULD LEAD TO BRAKE FAILURE.
Consequence Summary: IF THE NUT WORKED ITSELF LOOSE, PIVOT BOLT WOULD FALL OUT, LEAVING THE BRAKE PEDAL ASSEMBLY DETACHED FROM THE BRAKE BOOSTER REACTION ROD, WHICH WOULD DISABLE THE HYDRAULIC BRAKE SYSTEM AND LEAD TO AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE PIVOT BOLT AND NUT WITH UPGRADED BOLT AND NUT LOCK.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:RESTRAINT:BELT ANCHOR AND ATTACHM
Recall Description: UPPER ANCHORAGE OF TYPE 2 SAFETY BELT INSTALLED AT THE DRIVER'S SEATING POSITION IS NOT WITHIN THE SPECIFIED RANGE AS REQUIRED BY FMVSS 210.
Consequence Summary: BELTS MAY BE UNCOMFORTABLE AND OBSTRUCT VISION TO THE LEFT; BUSES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH STANDARD.
Corrective Action: INSTALL REINFORCING CHANNEL ASSURING THAT BELTS ARE WITHIN SPECIFIED RANGE.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: HIGH PRESSURE FLUID SUPPLY HOSE COULD RUPTURE CAUSING LOSS OF FLUID OF THE BRAKE POWER ASSIST SYSTEM.
Consequence Summary: LOSS OF FLUID COULD LEAD TO LOSS OF POWER ASSIST TO THE BRAKING SYSTEM, WHICH MAY RESULT IN LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT, AND THE EXPELLED FLUID FROM THE HOSE FAILURE COULD CAUSE AN ENGINE COMPARTMENT FIRE.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW POWER HYDRAULIC HOSE OF A DIFFERENT SPECIFICATION.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:SWITCH:BRAKE LIGHT
Recall Description: BRAKE ACCUMULATOR SWITCH WHICH CONTROLS HYDRAULIC FLUID FLOW TO AND FROM THE ENGINE DRIVEN PUMP, COULD LEAK, CAUSING LOSS OF FLUID IN THE POWER BRAKE ASSIST SYSTEM. THIS LEAK IS ALSO IN THE VICINITY OF ELECTRICAL WIRING.
Consequence Summary: THE LEAKING BRAKE ACCUMULATOR SWITCH COULD CAUSE ELECTRICAL POWER INTERRUPTION AND COULD CAUSE THE ASSIST FEATURE OF BRAKES NOT TO RECHARGE. ALSO, FLUID LOSS COULD LEAD TO SUDDEN LOSS OF POWER ASSISTANCE TOTHE BRAKING SYSTEM, WHICH COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE BRAKE ACCUMULATOR SWITCHES WITH REVISED SEALS.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:PIPE:FILLER:NECK
Recall Description: INSUFFICIENT INTERFERENCE FIT BETWEEN FUEL TANK FILLER PIPE AND GROMMET COULD RESULT IN AN INADEQUATE SEAL WHICH COULD ALLOW FUEL TO SEEP FROM THE JOINT.
Consequence Summary: IN THE PRESENCE OF AN IGNITION SOURCE, FUEL LEAKAGE COULD RESULT IN A FIRE.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A REVISED DESIGN GROMMET.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:EMERGENCY EXIT LABEL
Recall Description: THE REAR DOOR FAILED THE FMVSS 217 MAGNITUDE OF FORCE TEST. THE REAR DOOR RELEASE MECHANISM REQUIRES 35 POUNDS OF FORCE TO OPERATE. THIS IS GREATER THAN THE 20 POUNDS MAXIMUM ALLOWED BY THE FMVSS FOR DOORS LABELED 'EMERGENCY EXIT'. HOWEVER, THERE IS MORE UNOBSTRUCTED EXIT AREA THAN REQUIRED BY THE FMVSS, THEREFORE, THE REAR DOOR DOES NOT NEED TO BE LABELED AS AN EMERGENCY EXIT.
Consequence Summary: NONE. TO BRING THE VEHICLE INTO COMPLIANCE, THE WORDS  'IN EMERGENCY' WILL BE REMOVED FROM THE REAR DOOR LABEL.
Corrective Action: REMOVE WORDS 'IN EMERGENCY' FROM REAR DOOR LABEL.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT BUCKLES
Recall Description: UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS, FRONT SEAT CENTER, FOLD-DOWN ARM REST MAY CONTACT THE SAFETY BELT BUCKLE, CAUSING DAMAGE TO THE RELEASE BUTTON AND PREVENTING THE BELT TONGUE FROM LATCHING WHEN BUCKLING UP.
Consequence Summary: OCCUPANT WOULD NOT BE PROPERLY RESTRAINED AND COULD BE INJURED IN THE EVENT OF A SUDDEN STOP OR ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FRONT SEAT SAFETY BELT BUCKLES WITH SHORTER VERSION THAT WILL NOT CONTACT THE ARMRESTS. NOTE: OWNER NOTIFICATION DATE;  2/90 IS PREPARED IN DRAFT FORM.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL LINES:METALLIC
Recall Description: ON C AND K MODELS, FEED AND OR RETURN FUEL LINES CAN CONTACT THE AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION SHIFT LINKAGE CORDON SHAFT. IN ADDITION, ON K MODELS LINES MAY ALSO CONTACT FRONT PROPSHAFT.  IN EITHER CASE THE FUEL LINES COULD BE DAMAGED RESULTING IN A FUEL LEAK.
Consequence Summary: A HOLE COULD BE RUBBED THROUGH THESE FUEL LINES, ALLOWING FUEL LEAKAGE NEAR EXHAUST CROSSOVER PIPE; THIS COULD RESULT IN AN ENGINE COMPARTMENT FIRE THAT COULD SPREAD TO THE PASSENGER COMPARTMENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEWLY DESIGNED FUEL LINE ROUTING BRACKET TO PREVENT CONTACT AND, IF NECESSARY, REPLACE FUEL LINES.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL RETURN SPRING
Recall Description: THE THROTTLE RETURN SPRING MAY NOT AUTOMATICALLY RETURN THE THROTTLE LEVER TO THE IDLE POSTION IN THE EVENT THAT THE LINKAGE BECOMES DISCONNECTED.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CAUSE LOSS OF ACCELERATOR CONTROL IF THE THROTTLE LINKAGE FAILS IN THE FULL OPEN POSITION. THIS COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL AN IMPROVED THROTTLE RETURN KIT.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC SYSTEM
Recall Description: BOLTS USED FOR THE BRAKE STRUT SUPPORT DO NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS AND MAY BREAK.
Consequence Summary: THE FAILURE OF THE BOLTS MAY RESULT IN A DETERIORATION OF VEHICLE STEERING AND BRAKING WHICH COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE HEX NUT BOLTS WITH BOLTS THAT MEET SPECIFICATIONS.

Subject: ENGINE:PULLEY:CRANKSHAFT
Recall Description: MISMACHINING OF LOWER CRANKCASE HAS CAUSED THE OIL FILTER CASE TO BE POSITIONED INCORRECTLY.  THIS MISALIGNMENT STRESSES THE OIL AND WATER PUMPS AND COULD CAUSE ONE OR THE OTHER TO FAIL.
Consequence Summary: FAILURE OF THE OIL PUMP OR WATER PUMP DRIVES COULD CAUSE EXTENSIVE INTERNAL ENGINE DAMAGE AND FAILURE DUE TO LACK OF LUBRICATION OR COOLING WHICH COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL.
Corrective Action: CORRECT LOWER CRANKSHAFT MISMACHINING TO PREVENT ENGINE DAMAGE.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:TIRE RESERVE LOAD LABEL (GLOVE COMPARTME
Recall Description: TIRE INFLATION PRESSURE RECOMMENDED FOR REAR TIRE WILL NOT SUPPORT GROSS AXLE WEIGHT RATING; ALSO, WHEEL RIMS ARE NOT STAMPED DOT.
Consequence Summary: DURING HEAVY TOWING OR HAULING OF HEAVY LOADS, INFLATION OF REAR TIRES WOULD PRESENT A RISK OF TIRE FAILURE AND VEHICLES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 120.
Corrective Action: PROVIDE CORRECT TIRE INFLATION INFORMATION ON A NEW COMBINED CERTIFICATION - TIRE INFORMATION LABEL, AND STAMP WHEEL RIMS WITH DOT.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:TRAILER HITCHES AND ATTACHM
Recall Description: WELDS MAY BE OF POOR QUALITY, CRACKED OR MISSING FROM THE PINTLE HOOK ASSEMBLY TO THE REAR FRAME.
Consequence Summary: TRAILER COULD SEPARATE FROM THE TRUCK CREATING THE POTENTIAL FOR AN ACCIDENT OR CRASH.
Corrective Action: REWELD, REINFORCE, OR PROVIDE WELDING AS NECESSARY TO ASSURE PROPER ATTACHMENT OF THE PINTLE HOOK ASSEMBLY TO THE REAR FRAME.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL SEPARATOR (8/82)
Recall Description: THE DIESEL FUEL FILTER SEPARATOR IS LOCATED TOO CLOSE TO THE CHASSIS FRAME CROSS MEMBER WHICH COULD DEFORM AND DISLODGE THE BOWL OF THE SEPARATOR IN AN ACCIDENT.
Consequence Summary: FUEL SPILLAGE DURING AND AFTER A CRASH, IN EXCESS OF LIMIT ALLOWED BY FMVSS 301, COULD CAUSE A FIRE NEAR A SOURCE OF IGNITION.
Corrective Action: RELOCATE FUEL FILTER - SEPARATOR TO ELIMINATE INTERFERENCE WITH CROSSMEMBER IN ANY CRASH.

Subject: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:LEAF SPRING ASSEMBLY
Recall Description: THE 7/8 INCH SPRING EYE BOLTS WITHIN THE SPRING EYE BUSHING HANGER BRACKET OF THE REAR SUSPENSION MAY FAIL.
Consequence Summary: THE SPRING COULD FALL ONTO THE ROAD SURFACE, WITHOUT WARNING TO THE DRIVER, AND A VEHICLE CRASH COULD OCCUR DUE TO THE SUDDEN DRAG OF THE SPRING.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ALL 7/8 INCH DIAMETER SPRING EYE BOLTS WITH 1 INCH DIAMETER BOLTS.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL LINES:METALLIC
Recall Description: FUEL FEED AND RETURN LINE CONNECTORS HAVE INCORRECT LINE END FLARE CONFIGURATIONS.
Consequence Summary: LINE ENDS COULD CRACK CAUSING A FUEL LEAK THAT COULD RESULT IN AN ENGINE COMPARTMENT FIRE.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW FUEL LINES WITH CORRECT END FLARE CONFIGURATION.

Subject: STEERING:COLUMN COUPLING
Recall Description: STEERING COLUMNS CONTAIN AN INCORRECT AND POSSIBLY UNDER TORQUED COUPLING TO STEERING COLUMN CLAMPING BOLT.
Consequence Summary: LOW TORQUE ON CLAMPING BOLT COULD RESULT IN SEPARATION OF COUPLING FROM THE STEERING COLUMN OR WEAR ON THE SPLINES AND COULD CAUSE LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL WITH POTENTIAL FOR AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL GRADE EIGHT FASTENERS WITH PROPERLY TORQUED NUTS.

Subject: STEERING:POWER ASSIST
Recall Description: POWER STEERING PUMP BRACKET IS SUBJECT TO BREAKAGE DUE TO EXCESSIVE TENSION CAUSED BY A LACK OF CLEARANCE BETWEEN THE PUMP MOUNTING BRACKET AND SEALING FLANGE EDGE OF THE OIL PAN.
Consequence Summary: BRACKET BREAKAGE COULD ALLOW POWER STEERING PUMP TO LOOSEN AND DRIVE BELT TO SLIP, RESULTING IN THE NEED FOR UNEXPECTED INCREASED STEERING FORCE WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE POWER STEERING PUMP BRACKET.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT
Recall Description: CHILD SEATS CONTAIN SHIELD THAT MAY CAUSE THE SEAT TO FAIL TO CONFORM TO HEAD EXCURSION REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 213.
Consequence Summary: POTENTIAL FOR INJURY TO CHILD WOULD INCREASE IN THE EVENT OF A SUDDEN STOP OR AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: CONSUMER CAN REMOVE OPTIONAL SHIELD ATTACHMENT OR RETURN CAR SEAT FOR FULL REPLACEMENT.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AND BELT
Recall Description: CABLE PORTION OF SAFETY BELT ASSEMBLY (FEMALE RECEPTACLE MOUNTED INBOARD ON LEFT HAND SIDE, DRIVER'S SIDE, IN CREW CAB JUMP AREA) HAS BEEN TWISTED.
Consequence Summary: TWISTING CABLE REDUCES ITS HOLDING CAPACITY AND SAFETY BOLT COULD FAIL IN A CRASH, INCREASING THE POTENTIAL FOR INJURY TO OCCUPANT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SAFETY BELT ASSEMBLY.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:DRIVELINE:SHAFT CHAIN:PROPELLOR:DRIVE
Recall Description: THERE MAY BE PAINT IN THE FIXING FLANGE BETWEEN THE PROPELLER SHAFT AND DIFFERENTIAL GEAR WHICH COULD CAUSE THE FIXING (ATTACHING) BOLTS TO LOOSEN. THIS MAY RESULT IN THE SEPARATION OF THE PROPELLER SHAFT FROM  THE DIFFERENTIAL UNIT.
Consequence Summary: SEPARATION OF THE PROPELLER SHAFT MAY CAUSE LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL WHICH MAY RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: DISCONNECT THE PROPELLER SHAFT, REMOVE PAINT FROM THE FIXING FLANGE AREAS, RECONNECT THE PROPELLER SHAFT AND TORQUE BOLTS TO SPECIFICATIONS.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT
Recall Description: THESE SAFETY SEATS EXCEED THE POST IMPACT BUCKLE RELEASE FORCE REQUIREMENT OF 16 LBS. MAXIMUM DURING TESTING. NOT IN COMPLIANCE WITH FMVSS 213.W.
Consequence Summary: IN A TRAFFIC ACCIDENT, THIS COULD PREVENT THE ADULT OR PARENT FROM QUICKLY REMOVING THE CHILD FROM THE CAR SEAT, CREATING A FURTHER SAFETY HAZARD FOR THE CHILD.
Corrective Action: REPLACE HARNESS ASSEMBLIES WITH NEW VERSION THAT INCLUDES A MODIFIED LATCH TORQUE.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT
Recall Description: THE SHOULDER STRAPS AND ASSEMBLY DO NOT FIT A CHILD SNUGLY, LEADING TO THE POSSIBILITY THAT A CHILD COULD TRAVEL TOO FAR FORWARD IN A CRASH. THIS CAUSES THE CHILD SEAT TO FAIL THE HEAD AND KNEE EXCURSION REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 213.   CONSEQUENCE OF DEFECT:     THE CHILD SITTING ON THE AFFECTED CHILD SEAT MAY BE  SUBJECT TO LESS PROTECTION DUE TO THE SEAT TRAVEL MOVEMENT IN A CRASH.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW HARNESS PROVIDED BY KOLCRAFT.

Subject: TIRES:MARKINGS
Recall Description: BOTH SIDEWALLS OF TIRES HAVE INCORRECT MAXIMUM LOAD INFORMATION;  THIS SHOWS A GREATER LOAD CAPACITY THAN INTENDED.
Consequence Summary: TIRES MIGHT DEVELOP A SEPARATION THAT COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF INFLATING AIR WITH POTENTIAL FOR LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE AFFECTED TIRES AT NO CHARGE WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM THE DATE OF NOTIFICATION.

Subject: EMERGENCY PARKING BRAKE:MECHANICAL:RELEASE MECHANI
Recall Description: THE PARKING BRAKE RELEASE CABLE MAY BIND IF IT IS TOO CLOSE TO THE EXHAUST MANIFOLD.  ALSO, THE OIL HOSE MAY CONTACT THE BRAKE PUMP BRACKET AND EVENTUALLY CAUSE OIL TO LEAK FROM THE HYDRO-MAX SYSTEM.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CAUSE THE PARKING BRAKE TO BE INOPERATIVE, WHICH COULD ALLOW THE TRUCK TO ROLL AND COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE AND REROUTE CABLE TO PREVENT BINDING. ALSO INSPECT AND REPLACE DAMAGED HOSE.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT
Recall Description: THE RETAINING SCREWS OF THE HANDLE TO THE SHELL CAN LOOSEN, ALLOWING THE HANDLE TO SEPARATE FROM THE SHELL.
Consequence Summary: HANDLE SEPARATION FROM THE SHELL MAY CAUSE THE INFANT TO FALL FROM THE SEAT, WHICH COULD RESULT IN AN INJURY.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE ATTACHING SCREWS WITH NEW DESIGNED SCREWS.

Subject: TIRES:LINER
Recall Description: SOME TIRES MAY DEVELOP A SMALL CRACK IN THE T546 RADIAL TUBELESS DESIGN THAT COULD EVENTUALLY CAUSE A SIDEWALL BULGE.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN TIRE FAILURE WITH POTENTIAL FOR LOSS OF TRUCK CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE AFFECTED TIRES AT NO CHARGE WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM DATE OF NOTIFICATION.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES
Recall Description: THE TELEVISION MOUNTED IN THE FRONT OVERHEAD CABINET MAY BE INSECURELY MOUNTED, AND COULD VIBRATE LOOSE AND FALL.
Consequence Summary: FALLING TV COULD STRIKE THE DRIVER OR FRONT SEAT PASSENGER, OR COULD DISTRACT THE DRIVER'S ATTENTION, CREATING THE POTENTIAL FOR AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: ADD TWO RETAINING BRACKETS TO PREVENT THE TV FROM MOVING OUT OF ITS CABINET.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK
Recall Description: REAR IMPACT AT 30 MPH CAUSED STEEL MEMBER OF FLOOR STRUCTURE TO PUNCTURE TOP OF REAR FUEL TANK, IN VIOLATION OF FMVSS 301.
Consequence Summary: FUEL LEAKAGE COULD OCCUR FROM THIS PUNCTURE, CREATING A FIRE HAZARD IN THE PRESENCE OF AN IGNITION SOURCE.
Corrective Action: CUT CENTER FLOOR SUPPORT TUBE OFF AT FORWARD END TO PREVENT IT FROM PUNCTURING FUEL TANK IN A REAR IMPACT COLLISION.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:RESTRAINT:BELT ANCHOR AND ATTACHM
Recall Description: SAFETY BELT ANCHORAGES DID NOT MEET LOAD REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 222.
Consequence Summary: BUSES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 222; PASSENGERS IN THE AFFECTED REAR AREAS OF THE SCHOOL BUS MIGHT NOT BE SUFFICIENTLY RESTRAINED IN THE EVENT OF A SUDDEN IMPACT OR ACCIDENT, WHICH MIGHT RESULT IN MORE EXTENSIVE INJURY.
Corrective Action: ADD A .25 INCH TO 1.5 INCH STRAP TO TWO REARMOST SEATS.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:VALVE:FOOT CONTROL
Recall Description: HYDROGEN EMBRITTLEMENT OF SCREWS USED TO HOLD TOGETHER VALVE BODY CAUSES THE SCREWS TO BREAK OFF UNDER STRESS.
Consequence Summary: THE LOSS OF BRAKE VALVE INTEGRITY COULD CAUSE AN INCREASEIN STOPPING DISTANCE, OR LOSS OF BRAKING CONTROL IN AFFECTED TRAILERS. EITHERCONDITION COULD CAUSE AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: MANUFACTURER WILL REPLACE VALVES WITH DIFFERENT BODY SCREWS.

Subject: ENGINE
Recall Description: DUE TO AN INTERACTION OF THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT ENVIRONMENT AND MAINTENANCE OR SERVICE RELATED FACTORS, THERE IS A RISK OF  ENGINE COMPARTMENT FIRES.
Consequence Summary: AN ENGINE COMPARTMENT FIRE CAN SPREAD TO THE PASSENGERCOMPARTMENT AND INJURE OCCUPANTS.
Corrective Action: CORRECT OR INSTALL NEW ENGINE COMPONENTS TO PREVENT UNREASONABLE FIRE RISK.

Subject: ENGINE:GASKETS:VALVE COVER
Recall Description: THE ENGINE VALVE COVER GASKET MAY DISLOCATE AND ALLOW AN ENGINE OIL LEAK AT THE GASKET.
Consequence Summary: THE LEAKAGE OF OIL IN THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT COULD CAUSEA FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE GASKET COVER WITH REVISED COVER, AND RTV SEALANT WILL BE APPLIED IN PLACE OF A GASKET.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:DISC:CALIPER
Recall Description: HEAD OF REAR CALIPER FIXING BOLT COULD BREAK OFF, LEAVING ONLY BOLT SHANK IN PLACE.
Consequence Summary: THE BREAK IN THE REAR BRAKE CALIPER FIXING BOLT COULDRESULT IN AN INCREASE IN STOPPING DISTANCES, AND COULD CAUSE AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: MANUFACTURER WILL REPLACE DEFECTIVE BOLT.

Subject: SUSPENSION
Recall Description: CRACKING OF OUTER 'C' CHANNELS OF SUSPENSION DUE TO OVERLOADING IN THE HANGER AND AIR ATTACHMENT AREAS.
Consequence Summary: CRACKING OF THE 'C' CHANNEL COULD CAUSE THE CROSSMEMBERSIN THE SUSPENSION SUBASSEMBLY TO BREAK AWAY FROM THE OUTER FRAME CHANNELS OF THEASSEMBLY, CAUSING LOSS OF CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: MANUFACTURER WILL INSTALL MODIFICATION TO STRENGHTHEN SUSPENSION SUBASSEMBLY.

Subject: TIRES
Recall Description: TESTING SHOWS THAT TIRE MAY FAIL THROUGH LOSS OF AIR THROUGH SIDEWALLS, IN WHICH CASE THE TIRE WILL BULGE.
Consequence Summary: LOSS OF AIR THROUGH SIDEWALL COULD RESULT IN A LOSS OFCONTROL AND CAUSE AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: TIRES ARE RECALLED AND CREDIT GIVEN UPON CONFIRMATION.

Subject: TIRES:SIDEWALL
Recall Description: SEPARATION MAY DEVELOP IN THE LOWER SIDEWALL AREA.
Consequence Summary: IF SEPARATION IS NOT DISCOVERED, CONTINUED USE WILL CAUSETHE PLY CORDS AND TUBELESS LINER TO BREAK, CAUSING LOSS OF AIR, RESULTING INLOSS OF CONTROL, AND CAUSING AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ALL TIRES FOR CREDIT.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL
Recall Description: THROTTLE LEVER MAY CONTACT THROTTLE BODY AIR INLET TUBE, WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR THROTTLE REMAINING OPEN FOLLOWING RELEASE OF THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL FROM THE FULL-THROTTLE POSTION IN TRUCKS WITH 4.0 L ENGINES.
Consequence Summary: UNCONTROLLED ACCELERATION COULD CREATE LACK OF CONTROLAND CAUSE AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: MANUFACTURER WILL REPLACE AIR INLET TUBE WITH NEWLY DESIGNED REPLACEMENT WITH AN INCREASED THROTTLE LEVER-TO-INLET TUBE CLEARANCE.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL RETURN SPRING
Recall Description: THROTTLE RETURN SPRINGS MAY FAIL DURING NORMAL OPERATION WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Consequence Summary: IF BOTH THROTTLE RETURN SPRINGS FAIL THE ENGINE THROTTLENAT NOT RETURN TO THE IDLE POSTION WHEN THE THROTTLE PEDAL IS RELEASED. THIS MAYRESULT IN LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL, AND COULD CAUSE AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: MANUFACTURER WILL REPLACE THE THROTTLE RETURN SPRINGS.

Subject: LIGHTING:GENERAL OR UNKNOWN COMPONENT:INSTRUMENT L
Recall Description: WINDSHIELD WASHER-WIPER SYMBOL IS NOT ILLUMINATED.
Consequence Summary: VANS ARE NOT IN COMPLIANCE WITH FMVSS 101.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A RETRO-FIT WIPER-WASHER LAMP TO THE INSTRUMENT PANEL FOR ILLUMINATION.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:PEDALS AND LINKAGES
Recall Description: THE BRAKE PEDAL PUSH ROD MAY BEND IF IT IS ADJUSTED TO NEAR ITS MINIMUM LENGTH.
Consequence Summary: IF ROD IS BENT, FULL BRAKE APPLICATION PRESSURE WOULD NOTBE ACHIEVED OR LOSS OF BRAKES WOULD RESULT IF PUSH ROD FRACTURES. IN EITHER CASETHE FAILURE COULD CAUSE AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPAIR TO PREVENT BENDING OR FRACTURE OF BRAKE PEDAL PUSH RODS.

Subject: ENGINE COOLING SYSTEM:FAN
Recall Description: THE BLADE(S) MAY SEPARATE FROM THE ENGINE COOLING FAN ASSEMBLY.
Consequence Summary: BLADES SEPARATING FROM THE FAN ASSEMBLY COULD PRESENT ASAFETY HAZARD TO ANYONE WALKING IN THE VICINITY OF THE ENGINE.
Corrective Action: REMOVE AND REPLACE SUSPECT FAN ASSEMBLY.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN
Recall Description: VANS WERE PRODUCED WITHOUT PLASTIC COVER DESIGNED TO COVER OUTBOARD SEAT BACK PIVOT HINGE ALLOWING WEBBING OF FRONT PASSENGER-SIDE SAFETY BELTS TO BECOME ABRADED OR CUT DUE TO CONTACT WITH EXPOSED HINGE.
Consequence Summary: DAMAGE TO BELT WEBBING COULD WEAKEN BELTS TO POINT OFFAILURE INCREASING RISK OF INJURY IN AN ACCIDENT OR A SUDDEN STOP.
Corrective Action: INSTALL PLASTIC PIVOT COVER; REPLACE BELTS AS NECESSARY.

Subject: STRUCTURE:DOOR ASSEMBLY:HINGE AND ATTACHMENTS
Recall Description: A DOOR HINGE (UPPER OR LOWER) MAY BREAK WHILE OPENING OR CLOSING THE DOOR MAKING IT DIFFICULT TO REPOSITION AND CLOSE PROPERLY.
Consequence Summary: HINGE SEPARATION MAY REDUCE THE STRUCTURAL INTEGRITY OFTHE SIDE OF THE CAR AND INCREASE RISK OF INJURY IN CERTAIN TYPES OF ACCIDENTS.
Corrective Action: REPLACE DOOR HINGES ON BOTH DOORS.

Subject: TIRES
Recall Description: TIRES MAY NOT PASS STRENGTH TEST REQUIRED BY FMVSS 109.
Consequence Summary: TIRES WOULD BE SUSCEPTIBLE TO PREMATURE FAILURE IN CASEOF IMPACT AND CONDITION COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF AIR OR POSSIBLE BLOW-OUT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SUBJECT TIRES FREE OF CHARGE.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:TIRE RESERVE LOAD LABEL (GLOVE COMPARTME
Recall Description: POSSIBLE OVERLOADING OF REAR AXLE IF THE VEHICLE IS LOADED WITH 8 PEOPLE PLUS CARGO.
Consequence Summary: OVERLOADING OF THE REAR AXLE WILL RESULT IN DIFFICULTVEHICLE HANDLING, AND COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF CONTROL OF THE VEHICLE AND ANACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL CORRECTED PLACARD

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CERTIFICATION LABEL
Recall Description: COMPLIANCE LABEL DOES NOT AGREE WITH WEIGHT CAPACITY OF NEW REAR AXLE TIRES.
Consequence Summary: TRUCKS DO NOT COMPLY WITH CFR PART 567.
Corrective Action: AFFIX NEW COMPLIANCE LABEL WITH CORRECT INFORMATION IN SAME LOCATION.

Subject: LIGHTING:LAMP OR SOCKET:BRAKE LIGHTS
Recall Description: STOP LAMPS DO NOT COMPLY WITH PHOTOMETRIC REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 108.
Consequence Summary: NON-COMPLYING LAMPS DO NOT MEET REQUIREMENTS OF STANDARD.
Corrective Action: RETURN LAMPS FOR FULL REFUND OF PURCHASE PRICE.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:MASTER CYLINDER:PISTONS:CUPS:SPRI
Recall Description: INABILITY TO MAINTAIN PRESSURE IN THE SECONDARY SYSTEM OF THE MASTER CYLINDER (CONTROLS BRAKING OF REAR WHEELS) COULD INCREASE BRAKE PEDAL TRAVEL AND REDUCE BRAKE PERFORMANCE AT TEMPERATURES LESS THAN 40 DEGREES.
Consequence Summary: THIS WOULD CAUSE REDUCED BRAKING EFFECTIVENESS ANDINCREASED STOPPING DISTANCE THAT COULD RESULT IN A CRASH OR COLLISION.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW DESIGN MASTER CYLINDER INCORPORATING A REDESIGNED SEAL.

Subject: BRAKES:POWER ASSIST:PRIMARY:CONTROL VALVE
Recall Description: THE THROTTLE VALVE INSIDE THE HYDRAULIC BRAKE BOOSTER MAY DEFORM FROM BUILDUP OF HEAT AND PRESSURE AND CLOSE-OFF FLUID RETURN PORTS.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CAUSE EXCESSIVE PRESSURE BUILDUP IN THEBOOSTER CAUSING THE BRAKES TO SELF APPLY WITH A SEVERE UNEXPECTED STOP. THISCONDITION COULD ALSO RESULT IN LOSS OF POWER STEERING ASSIST. EITHER CONDITIONCOULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE BRAKE BOOSTER ASSEMBLY.

Subject: LIGHTING:GENERAL OR UNKNOWN COMPONENT:HEAD LIGHTS
Recall Description: HEADLAMPS HAVE NO PROVISION FOR MECHANICAL AIMING AS REQUIRED BY FMVSS 108. ALSO, LAMPS DO NOT CONTAIN D.O.T. SYMBOL WHICH CONFIRMS COMPLIANCE WITH FMVSS 108.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN HEADLAMPS NOT BEING PROPERLY AIMED,AFFECTING DRIVER VISIBILTY AND VEHICLES WOULD NOT CONFORM WITH FMVSS 108.
Corrective Action: REFUND PURCHASE PRICE OF THE HEADLAMPS.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:FITTINGS
Consequence Summary: PROLONGED CHAFING COULD EVENTUALLY CAUSE A LEAKING BRAKELINE RESULTING IN DIMINISHED BRAKING IN ONE BRAKE CIRCUIT WHICH WOULD INCREASETHE STOPPING DISTANCES AND RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: CURVE OR REPLACE RIGHT FRONT BRAKE LINE.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:BICYCLE CARRIER
Recall Description: THERE MAY BE IMPROPER FIT AND INSTALLATION OF THE BICYCLE RACK DUE TO BUMPER STOP MATERIAL THAT IS TOO SOFT AND LOWER STRAP BUCKLE THAT IS DIFFICULT TO OPERATE.
Consequence Summary: INSTALLATION MAY BE DIFFICULT AND RACK MOVEMENT ANDSEPARATION IS POSSIBLE CREATING A POTENTIAL ROAD HAZARD.
Corrective Action: RETURN RACK FOR CREDIT OR REFUND.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:MASTER CYLINDER:PISTONS:CUPS:SPRI
Recall Description: THE PRIMARY SIDE BRAKE CUP WITHIN THE MASTER CYLINDER MAY FAIL CAUSING LOSS OF BRAKE FLUID LINE PRESSURE IN ONE-HALF OF THE DUAL BRAKING SYSTEM.
Consequence Summary: THIS WOULD CAUSE REDUCED BRAKING EFFECTIVENESS ANDINCREASED STOPPING DISTANCES THAT COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE MASTER CYLINDER.

Subject: SUSPENSION:TANDEM AXLE:REAR:LEAF SPRING ASSEMBLY:H
Recall Description: A REQUIRED WELD JOINING A WALKING BEAM BUSHING SPACER TO THE AXLE HANGER BRACKET MAY HAVE BEEN OMITTED.
Consequence Summary: REAR AXLE COULD SEPARATE FROM THE REAR SUSPENSION,CAUSING LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL WHICH COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: MAKE NECESSARY WELDING CORRECTIONS.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:SPEED CONTROL
Recall Description: CRUISE CONTROL ACTUATOR MAY NOT RELEASE FROM ITS MOST RECENT SETTING DUE TO STICKING OF CLUTCH MECHANISM.
Consequence Summary: THIS CAN INCREASE STOPPING DISTANCES, WHICH COULD RESULTIN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE CRUISE CONTROL ACTUATOR.

Subject: HEATER:WATER:DEFROSTER:DEFOGGER:LINES:LINKAGE:COMB
Recall Description: DUE TO INSUFFICIENT CLEARANCE BETWEEN A BOLT THAT FIXES THE HEATER TO THE VEHICLE BODY AND A FUEL DELIVERY PIPE AND BETWEEN A REAR HEATER HOSE CLIP, USE UNDER SERVERE CONDITIONS COULD CAUSE PIPE RUPTURE AND FUEL LEAKAGE.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN A FIRE.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW LINES AND A CLIP.

Subject: LIGHTING:GENERAL OR UNKNOWN COMPONENT:HIGH MOUNTED
Recall Description: LAMP HOUSING OF CENTER HIGH MOUNTED STOP LAMP COULD BECOME DISTORTED AFTER PROLONGED ILLUMINATION, PARTICULARLY UNDER HIGH TEMPERATURES.
Corrective Action: REPLACE LAMP HOUSING WITH ONE OF HIGHER TEMPERATURE RESISTANT MATERIAL.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: THE FRONT AIR BRAKE HOSES CAN CONTACT THE INNER FENDER EXTENSIONS.
Consequence Summary: THIS INTERFERENCE CAN CHAFE THE BRAKE HOSES TO THE POINTOF RUPTURE, RESULTING IN LOSS OF FRONT BRAKES WITH POTENTIAL FOR AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: CUT OUT A PORTION OF INNER FENDER EXTENSIONS TO PREVENT INTERFERENCE. ALSO, REPLACE ANY DAMAGED FRONT BRAKE HOSES.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT
Recall Description: REMOVABLE PROTECTIVE FABRIC PAD THAT IS ATTACHED TO THE FRONT TRAY SHIELD WITH VELCRO TABS MAY HAVE EXPOSED URETHANE FOAM ON THE UNDERSIDE OF THE SHIELD PAD THAT A CHILD COULD PICK AT WITH HIS OR HER FINGERS.
Consequence Summary: A CHILD COULD PUT SMALL PIECES OF PAD IN HIS OR HER MOUTHOR NOSE CREATING A HEALTH HAZARD.
Corrective Action: REPLACE CURRENT PADS WITH PADS CONTAINING 2 BUTTON FASTENERS THAT CANNOT BE REMOVED BY A CHILD; ALSO, TWEED PADS WILL BE FROM FOAM THAT IS COVERED WITH A NON-WOVEN BACKING.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT BUCKLES
Recall Description: SAFETY BELT TONGUE MAY DISENGAGE FROM THE BUCKLE WHEN FORCES OF LESS THAN 5,000 POUNDS ARE EXERTED AGAINST THE CONNECTION FORMED BETWEEN THE TONGUE AND BUCKLE.
Consequence Summary: BELT FAILURE WOULD INCREASE THE RISK OF INJURY TO SEATOCCUPANT; ALSO TRUCKS AND BUSES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 209.
Corrective Action: REPLACE "BUCKLE SIDE" PART TO PREVENT BELT DISENGAGEMENT.

Subject: STRUCTURE:FRAME AND MEMBERS(GIVE SIDE/END)
Recall Description: SOME WELDS IN THE RIGHT REAR FRAME SUPPORT EXTENSION STRUCTURE MAY NOT HAVE BEEN COMPLETED.
Consequence Summary: UNDER EXTREME TOWING CONDITIONS, THIS COULD CAUSE THEHITCH ASSEMBLY TO COME LOOSE AND COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF CONTROL OF THE VEHICLEBEING TOWED, WHICH COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: COMPLETE WELDS TO PREVENT HITCH ASSEMBLY FROM LOOSENING.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: NON-DOT "PUSH-ON" TYPE HOSES WERE USED IN CERTAIN ACCESSORY NON-BRAKE AIR SYSTEMS, WITHOUT ISOLATION OF THAT SYSTEM BY A CHECK VALVE, PRESSURE PROTECTION VALVE, OR OTHER MEANS OF SYSTEM SEPARATION.
Consequence Summary: TRUCKS DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 106; THERE COULD BE ANUNCHECKED LOSS OF AIR PRESSURE IN THE BRAKES THAT COULD RESULT IN THE LOSS OFSERVICE BRAKES AND TRUCK CONTROL.
Corrective Action: INSTALL PRESSURE PROTECTION VALVE(S) IN THE AIR SYSTEM TO ISOLATE ALL ACCESSORY AIR LINES FROM THE BRAKE SYSTEM.

Subject: EQUIPMENT
Recall Description: CERTAIN BOLTS SUCH AS THE DRIVE SHAFT BOLTS, STEERING MOUNTING BOLTS, MOTOR MOUNT BOLTS, AND THE WHEEL CHAIR SUPPORT BOLTS MAY NOT MEET SAE SPECIFICATIONS.
Consequence Summary: BOLTS COULD BREAK OR FAIL AFFECTING THE SPECIFIC COMPONENT INVOLVED, RESULTING IN A POTENTIAL AN ACCIDENT AND/OR PERSONAL INJURY.
Corrective Action: REPLACE NON-SPECIFICATION BOLTS WITH BOLTS THAT MEET SAE SPECIFICATIONS.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CARRIER:SPARE TIRE
Recall Description: MOUNTING BRACKETS USED TO ATTACH THE SPARE TIRE CARRIER ASSEMBLY TO THE TRAILER FRAME MAY FAIL.
Consequence Summary: FAILURE OF THE MOUNTING BRACKET RESULTS IN THE SPARE TIREASSEMBLY SEPARATING FROM THE TRAILER AND CAUSING THE SPARE TIRE TO FALL OFF,CREATING A ROAD HAZARD WHICH MAY RESULT IN VEHICLE CRASH.
Corrective Action: REPLACE BRACKETS WITH MODIFIED BRACKETS.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: ROUTING OF THE FRONT BRAKE HOSE MAY ALLOW HOSE INTERFERENCE WITH THE WHEEL OPENING SPLASH GUARDS.
Consequence Summary: THIS INTERFERENCE MAY CAUSE ABRASION OF THE BRAKE HOSEAND EVENTUAL LOSS OF FRONT WHEEL BRAKING CAPABILITY WITH POTENTIAL FOR ANACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FRONT WHEEL OPENING SPLASH SHIELDS WITH REVISED SHIELDS THAT ELIMINATE INTEFERENCE; ALSO, REPLACE ANY DAMAGED FRONT BRAKE HOSES.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER LABELS
Recall Description: PROPER ALTERER'S LABELS CONTAINING INFORMATION REGARDING WEIGHTS AND VEHICLE CLASSIFICATION, MAY NOT HAVE BEEN INSTALLED.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH CFR PART 567.
Corrective Action: INSTALL ALTERER'S LABEL REFLECTING THE PROPER INFORMATION.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:TIRE RESERVE LOAD LABEL (GLOVE COMPARTME
Recall Description: NEW TIRE PLACARD SHOWING TIRE SIZE AND INFLATION PRESSURE FOR HIGHER FRONT AND REAR WEIGHT RATINGS, SEATING CAPACITY, AND REVISED CAPACITY WEIGHT MAY NOT HAVE BEEN INSTALLED.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLE WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 110.
Corrective Action: INSTALL PLACARD REFLECTING PROPER INFORMATION.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:TIRE RESERVE LOAD LABEL (GLOVE COMPARTME
Recall Description: TIRE RESERVE LOAD LABEL MAY NOT HAVE BEEN INSTALLED.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 110.
Corrective Action: INSTALL PROPER LABEL.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:TIRE RESERVE LOAD LABEL (GLOVE COMPARTME
Recall Description: TIRE RESERVE LOAD LABEL MAY NOT HAVE BEEN INSTALLED.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLE WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 110.
Corrective Action: INSTALL PROPER LABEL.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN
Recall Description: SAFETY BELTS AND SAFETY BELT ASSEMBLIES MAY NOT HAVE BEEN INSTALLED FOR THE TWO SEATING POSITIONS IN THE ADDITIONAL REAR FACING SEAT.
Consequence Summary: PASSENGERS IN THE REAR FACING SEAT WOULD BE SUBJECT TOINCREASED INJURY AND VEHICLES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 208.
Corrective Action: INSTALL APPROPRIATE SAFETY BELT IN REAR FACING SEAT.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:GLASS
Recall Description: HEAVILY TINTED WINDOWS MAY NOT BE IN COMPLIANCE WITH LIGHT TRANSMISSION REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 205.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 205.
Corrective Action: REMOVE OR LIGHTEN WINDOW TINTING TO ASSURE COMPLIANCE.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:GLASS:WINDOW:REAR-VIEW BACKLIGHT
Recall Description: WINDOW TINTING MAY NOT PERMIT ENOUGH LIGHT TO ALLOW PHOTOMETRIC PERFORMANCE OF THE CENTER HIGHMOUNTED STOP LAMP.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLE MAY NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 108.
Corrective Action: REMOVE WINDOW TINTING TO ASSURE COMPLIANCE.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES:ACCELERATOR:FLEXIBLE
Recall Description: ROUTING OF THROTTLE CABLE AND GEAR SHIFT CABLE ADJACENT TO THE TELMA RETARDER COULD ALLOW HEAT FROM THE RETARDER TO DAMAGE THE CABLE JACKETS.
Consequence Summary: THIS CAN CAUSE SLOW RETURN OR STICKING OF THE THROTTLEWHICH COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SUBJECT CABLES, AS NECESSARY, AND WRAP CABLES WITH A HEAT RESISTANT BLANKET.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:DRIVESHAFT
Recall Description: DRIVESHAFT COULD CONTACT THE FUEL TANK AND SCORE AND SCRAPE OUTER SURFACES OF THE TANK AT THE POINT OF CONTACT.
Consequence Summary: A SMALL LEAK COULD DEVELOP WHICH COULD , IN THE PRESENCEOF AN IGNITION SOURCE, RESULT IN A FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FUEL TANK AND/OR INSTALL PROTECTIVE DEVICE BETWEEN DRIVESHAFT AND THE TANK.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:SHOE AND DRUM SYSTEM:DRUM
Recall Description: FRONT AXLE ASSEMBLIES MAY CONTAIN CRACKED BRAKE DRUMS DUE TO IMPROPER FIT BETWEEN THE WHEEL HUBS AND THE BRAKE DRUMS.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CAUSE LOSS OF BUS BRAKING CONTROL AND RESULTIN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE DEFECTIVE BRAKE DRUMS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:FRONT BUCKET SEAT LATCH
Recall Description: WHEN USING FRONT SEATBACK RELEASE LEVERS TO TIP FRONT SEATBACK FORWARD TO GAIN ENTRY TO, OR EXIT FROM , THE REAR SEAT, IT IS POSSIBLE TO INSERT A FINGER INTO THE SEATBACK HINGE MECHANISM.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN THE FINGER BEING PINCHED ANDPOSSIBLY SERIOUSLY INJURED.
Corrective Action: REPAIR TO PREVENT CONDITION THAT WOULD PERMIT FINGER INJURY.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN
Recall Description: LIMOUSINE MAY NOT CONTAIN THE PROPER NUMBER OF SEAT BELTS WITH REGARD TO EACH DESIGNATED SEATING POSITION AS REQUIRED BY FMVSS 208.
Consequence Summary: SITTING IN AN UNBELTED SEAT WHILE RIDING WOULD SUBJECTTHE OCCUPANT TO INCREASED RISK OF INJURY IN AN ACCIDENT OR SUDDEN STOP.
Corrective Action: INSTALL ADDITIONAL SEAT BELTS IN ALL APPROPRIATE PLACES.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:RESTRAINT:BELT ANCHOR AND ATTACHM
Recall Description: SEAT BELT ANCHORAGES, SEAT DEFLECTION, AND KNEE PROTECTION REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 222 WERE NOT MET. ALSO, REAR EMERGENCY DOOR LABELING AND CERTIFICATION LABELING REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 217 WERE NOT MET.
Consequence Summary: BUSES ARE IN NONCOMPLIANCE WITH STANDARDS; THERE WOULD BEINCREASED RISK OF INJURY IN AN ACCDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL METAL STIFFENER AND SEAT BELT BRACKET AS WELL AS ADDITIONAL FOAM TO SEAT. ALSO, INSTALL NEW CERTIFICATION AND EMERGENCY DOOR OPERATING INSTRUCTION LABELS.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CERTIFICATION LABEL
Recall Description: THE ALTERER'S LABEL WAS NOT INSTALLED.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH PART 567.
Corrective Action: INSTALL CERTIFICATION LABEL.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER LABELS
Corrective Action: INSTALL CORRECT TIRE INFORMATION LABEL.

Subject: HEATER:WATER:DEFROSTER:DEFOGGER:HOSE:DUCT:AIR
Recall Description: HEATER HOSE MAY BE INCORRECTLY ROUTED.
Consequence Summary: HOSE COULD WEAR THROUGH AND LEAK WHICH COULD RESULT INAN UNDERHOOD FIRE.
Corrective Action: REROUTE AND SPLICE HOSE AS NECESSARY.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:OTHER PART
Recall Description: THE NATO SLAVE RECEPTACLE MAY BE INCORRECTLY INSTALLED WITH AN INSUFFICIENT CLEARANCE BETWEEN THE POSITIVE AND NEGATIVE SHELL.
Consequence Summary: AN ELECTRICAL SHORT COULD OCCUR THAT COULD RESULT IN ABATTERY MELTDOWN, VEHICLE FIRE AND POSSIBLE BATTERY EXPLOSION.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SLAVE RECEPTACLE AS NECCESSARY.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT TRACKS AND ANCHORS
Recall Description: RIGHT REAR AND LEFT REAR PASSENGER SEAT ANCHORAGES MAY NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 222.
Consequence Summary: BUSES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH REQUIREMENTS OF STANDARD.
Corrective Action: REPAIR TO ASSURE COMPLIANCE WITH STANDARD.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:RESTRAINT:BELT ANCHOR AND ATTACHM
Recall Description: THE CENTER SAFETY BELT ATTACHMENT HARDWARE BRACKETS FOR THE THIRD SEAT MAY NOT WITHSTAND THE SPECIFIED TENSILE LOAD.
Consequence Summary: VANS WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 210
Corrective Action: REPLACE SAFETY BELT ASSEMBLIES WITH BRACKETS.

Subject: STEERING:COLUMN COUPLING
Recall Description: INTERMEDIATE STEERING SHAFTS HAVE AN INADEQUATE LENGTH OF SPLINE ENGAGEMENT AND MAY EXHIBIT EXCESSIVE SIDE-TO-SIDE FREEPLAY MOVEMENTS.
Consequence Summary: EXCESSIVE WEAR ON SPLINES COULD CAUSE LOOSENESS IN THESTEERING WHEEL AND COULD RESULT IN STEERING SHAFT DISENGAGEMENT, LOSS OFSTEERING CONTROL, AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW DESIGN INTERMEDIATE STEERING SHAFT ASSEMBLY.

Subject: STRUCTURE:FRAME AND MEMBERS(GIVE SIDE/END)
Recall Description: VEHICLES MAY HAVE DISCREPANT WELDS IN THE LEFT REAR ROCKER PANEL WHICH CAN CAUSE DEFORMATION OF THE PANEL.
Consequence Summary: INCREASED DEFORMATION OF THE LEFT REAR ROCKER PANELCAN CAUSE THE LEFT REAR SEAT BELT ANCHORAGE NOT TO ACHIEVE THE LOAD REQUIREDBY FMVSS NO. 210.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A REINFORCEMENT KIT.

Subject: TIRES:SIDEWALL
Recall Description: SOME TIRES MAY DEVELOP A FLEX BREAK IN THE LOWER SIDEWALL PRIOR TO COMPLETING THE ENDURANCE COMPLIANCE TESTING / FMVSS 109.
Consequence Summary: TIRES DO NOT COMPLY WITH REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 109.
Corrective Action: PROVIDE REPLACEMENT TIRES THAT COMPLY WITH STANDARD.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:METALLIC
Recall Description: THE ROUTING OF THE THROTTLE KICKDOWN CABLE COULD ALLOW CHAFING TO OCCUR BETWEEN THE CABLE AND ANY ONE OF THREE STEEL BRAKE FLUID LINES NEAR THE VALVE BLOCK OF THE HYDRAULIC BRAKE UNIT.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CAUSE BRAKE FLUID LEAKAGE; THUS, THE BRAKECIRCUIT SUPPLIED BY THAT LINE WOULD BECOME INOPERATIVE AND RESULT IN DECREASEDBRAKING EFFECTIVENESS AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: CHANGE CABLE ROUTING AND INSTALL NEW ATTACHMENT BRACKET TO PREVENT CHAFING.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:BENCH:BACK REST
Recall Description: THE ADJUSTABLE SEAT BACK STRUCTURE AND TILT MECHANISM MAY NOT WITHSTAND REARWARD FORCE REQUIRED BY FMVSS 207.
Consequence Summary: BUSES ARE NOT IN COMPLIANCE WITH FMVSS 207; SEATBACKCOULD FAIL IN AN ACCIDENT INCREASING POTENTIAL FOR INJURY TO OCCUPANT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW SEAT BACK STRUCTURE AND TILT MECHANISM ASSEMBLY THAT COMPLIES WITH STANDARD.

Subject: STEERING:POWER:SHAFT PITMAN
Corrective Action: REPLACE PITMAN ARM AS NECCESSARY.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER LABELS
Recall Description: TIRE INFORMATION LABELS ON THE DOOR AND THE INFORMATION IN THE OWNERS MANUAL DO NOT APPLY TO THE FULL SIZE ORIGINAL EQUIPMENT TIRE AND WHEEL THAT WAS SUBSTITUTED FOR THE "SPACE-SAVER" EMERGENCY USE ONLY SPARE TIRE.
Corrective Action: INSTALL LABELS PROVIDED THAT REFER TO THE FULL-SIZE TIRES.

Subject: STEERING:COLUMN COUPLING
Recall Description: THE CLAMP LOAD MAY NOT FULLY ENGAGE ON THE MATING STEERING BOX SPLINES DUE TO MANUFACTURING TOLERANCES AND/OR THE PINCH BOLT MAY NOT BE PROPERLY TORQUED.
Consequence Summary: INADEQUATE TORQUE MAY RESULT IN SLIPPAGE AND POSSIBLESHAFT DISENGAGEMENT WITH LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL; THIS COULD RESULT IN ANACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE STEERING SHAFT.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:FITTINGS
Recall Description: A FATIGUE CRACK IN THE REAR BRAKE LINE ASSEMBLY COULD DEVELOP.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF BRAKE FLUID AND LOSS OF REARBRAKE OPERATION WHICH WOULD REDUCE STOPPING ABILITY AND INCREASE POTENTIAL FORAN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL REPLACEMENT REAR BRAKE LINE COMPONENTS.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:BATTERY:CABLE
Recall Description: POSITIVE BATTERY CABLE LEAD TO THE STARTER SOLENOID MAY SEPARATE FROM THE ROUTING CLAMP CUTTING THE INSULATION ON THE LEAD.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CAUSE A SHORT CIRCUIT IN THE ELECTRICAL SYSTEM THAT COULD RESULT IN THE ENGINE STOPPING AND THE LIGHTS GOING OUT WITHPOTENTIAL FOR AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: MODIFY BY INSTALLATING A RUBBER GROMMET IN THE BRACKET HOLE, REROUTING AND CLAMPING LEADS TO THE BRACKET WITH A NEW BAND.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES:ACCELERATOR:FLEXIBLE
Recall Description: THE ACCELERATOR CABLE CAN BECOME FRAYED AND BIND OR BREAK WITHIN ITS HOUSING.
Consequence Summary: THROTTLE WOULD NOT OPERATE PROPERLY WHICH COULD RESULT INLOSS OF ACCELERATOR CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A NEWLY DESIGNED ACCELERATOR CABLE.

Subject: LIGHTING:GENERAL OR UNKNOWN COMPONENT:HEAD LIGHTS
Recall Description: HEADLAMP KITS UTILIZE A H-4 BULB AND OTHER COMPONENTS THAT HAVE NOT BEEN CERTIFIED AS CONFORMING TO FMVSS 108.
Consequence Summary: KITS ARE IN NON-COMPLIANCE WITH FMVSS 108.
Corrective Action: PROVIDE A FULL REFUND OR CREDIT FOR ANY EURO HEADLAMP COMPONENT PURCHASED.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:DRIVELINE:DIFFERENTIAL:OTHER PARTS (8/
Recall Description: AN INCORRECT BOLT AND NUT ARRANGEMENT AND SIZE WAS USED TO INSTALL BOTH FRONT AND REAR DRIVE DRIVE SHAFT ASSEMBLIES AT THE DIFFERENTIAL PINION FLANGES.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CAUSE THE DRIVESHAFT TO LOOSEN, VIBRATE ANDMAY RESULT IN THE DRIVESHAFT DETACHING WITH POTENTIAL FOR LOSS OF CONTROL ANDAN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL CORRECT ATTACHING BOLTS AND TORQUE TO PROPER SPECIFICATIONS.

Subject: TIRES:MARKINGS
Recall Description: INFLATION INFORMATION MAY BE STAMPED ON THE TIRE TO READ "MAX LOAD 2,150 LBS AT 80 PSI COLD" WHEN IT SHOULD READ "MAX LOAD 2,150 LBS AT 20 PSI COLD"
Consequence Summary: TIRES DO NOT COMPLY WITH LABELING REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSSPART 119.
Corrective Action: RE-BRAND THE CORRECT STAMPING ON ALL AVAILABLE TIRES.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL PUMP
Recall Description: FUEL PUMPS MAY HAVE A LOOSE RACK FASTENER THAT COULD ALLOW THE BOLT TO COME OUT OF THE RACK.
Consequence Summary: THIS WOULD AFFECT OPERATOR CONTROL OF ENGINE SPEED ANDENGINE SHUTDOWN CAPABILITY WHICH COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: RETIGHTEN FASTENER TO SPECIFIED TORQUE AND USE SELF LOCKING NUT.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN
Recall Description: SEAT BELTS INSTALLED ON MIDDLE BUCKET SEATS DO NO MEET ANGLE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 210.
Consequence Summary: VANS WOULD BE IN NON-COMPLIANCE WITH STANDARD.
Corrective Action: REPLACE 6 INCH SEAT SLIDE WITH A 5 INCH SEAT SLIDE TO CORRECT SEAT BELT ANGLE.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:VALVE:FOOT CONTROL
Recall Description: INTERNAL COMPONENTS OF THE E-12 DUAL CIRCUIT AIR BRAKE VALVES MAY BE MISASSEMBLED SO THAT ONE OF THE TAPERED SNAP RINGS IS UPSIDE DOWN.
Consequence Summary: THE SNAP RING CAN COME OUT CAUSING THE VALVE TOMALFUNCTION AND APPLY THE TRUCK'S BRAKE SYSTEM WITHOUT WARNING; THIS COULDRESULT IN LOSS OF CONTROL AND A CRASH.
Corrective Action: REPLACE MISASSEMBLED VALVES.

Subject: STRUCTURE:FRAME:MEMBERS AND BODY:OTHER PARTS
Recall Description: A CRACK MAY DEVELOP IN THE REAR END CARRIER ARMS THAT ARE THE LOAD CARRYING MEMBERS ATTACHING THE TWO SECTIONS OF THE ARTICULATED BUS.
Corrective Action: INSTALL REINFORCEMENT BRACKETS TO PREVENT CRACKING OF THE CARRIER ARMS.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:VALVE:FOOT CONTROL
Consequence Summary: THE SNAP RING CAN COME OUT CAUSING THE VALVE TOMALFUNCTION AND APPLY THE TRUCK'S BRAKE SYSTEM WITHOUT WARNING; THIS COULDRESULT IN LOSS OF CONTROL AND A CRASH.
Corrective Action: REPLACE MISASSEMBLED VALVES.

Subject: STEERING:WHEEL:HANDLEBAR
Recall Description: BOLTS THAT SECURE HANDLEBARS TO THEIR HOLDERS CAN LOOSEN OR FRACTURE.
Consequence Summary: HANDLE BARS COULD SEPARATE FROM THE HOLDER RESULTING INLOSS OF DRIVER CONTROL WITH POTENTIAL FOR AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE HOLDER ASSEMBLY WITH REVISED HOLDER DESIGN THAT USES TWO BOLTS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT BELTS:LAP:FRONT
Recall Description: OCCUPANT RELEASE OF THE LAP BELT IN A CERTAIN MANNER COULD CAUSE THE BELT RETRACTOR TO LOCK AT THE RETRACTED AND STOWED POSITION.
Consequence Summary: SEAT BELTS MAY BE UNUSABLE OR OCCUPANTS MAY BEDISCOURAGED FROM USING BELTS, INCREASING THEIR POTENTIAL FOR INJURY IN ANACCIDENTAL OR SUDDEN STOP.
Corrective Action: REPLACE LAP BELT WITH A REDESIGNED BELT GUIDE.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: THE AIR LINES TO THE RIGHT REAR BRAKE CHAMBER CAN BE PINCHED BY THE AUXILIARY HEATER CABINET IF THE AIR IN THE REAR AIR SUSPENSION SYSTEM BLEEDS OUT WHEN A LEAK DEVELOPS OR THE ENGINE HAS NOT BEEN RUN FOR AN EXTENDED PERIOD OF TIME.
Consequence Summary: THIS WOULD AFFECT OPERATION OF BRAKES, CREATING APOTENTIAL FOR AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REROUTE AIR LINES TO RIGHT REAR BRAKE CHAMBER TO PROVIDE CLEARANCE WITH THE AUXILIARY HEATER CABINET.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC
Consequence Summary: THIS WOULD EVENTUALLY CAUSE FAILURE OF THE FRONTHYDRAULIC BRAKE SYSTEM, INCREASE STOPPING DISTANCE WHICH COULD RESULT IN ANACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: MODIFY FENDER SKIRT SPLASH SHIELD AND REPLACE BRAKE HOSE ON BOTH SIDES.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:TRACKS AND ANCHORS:FRONT SEAT:MAN
Recall Description: THE FORWARD OUTBOARD PEDESTAL OF THE SEAT TRACK OF DRIVER'S SEAT MAY BE SUSCEPTIBLE TO FATIGUE FRACTURE.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN A LIMITED DEGREE OF ROCKING MOTIONOF THE DRIVERS SEAT ASSEMBLY UPON ACCELERATION OR DECELERATION, WHICH COULDCAUSE AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A REINFORCEMENT ON ALL MODELS AND A NEW SEAT TRACK AS NECESSARY

Subject: LIGHTING:SWITCH:BUTTON:RING:HEAD LIGHTS
Recall Description: AN INCORRECT TRANSISTOR MAY CAUSE AUTOLAMP SYSTEM LIGHT SENSOR MODULE MALFUNCTION.
Consequence Summary: HEADLAMPS COULD TURN OFF WHILE VEHICLE IS BEING DRIVEN ORREMAIN ON AFTER VEHICLE IS PARKED. LOSS OF HEADLIGHTS WHILE DRIVING AT NIGHTCOULD BE HAZARDOUS TO THE DRIVER AND OTHER TRAFIFIC.
Corrective Action: REPLACE LIGHT SENSOR MODULES.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:GLASS:WINDSHIELD
Recall Description: SPECIAL PRIMER THAT PROMOTES THE BONDING OF A URETHANE ADHESIVE TO THE GLASS WAS NOT APPLIED TO THE WINDSHIELDS BEFORE INSTALLATION.
Consequence Summary: OMISSION OF THE PRIMER COULD CAUSE THE WINDSHIELD NOT TOBE PROPERLY ADHERED TO BODY, AND VEHICLE WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 212.
Corrective Action: REMOVE AND PROPERLY INSTALL WINDSHIELD USING SPECIAL PRIMER.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT TRACKS AND ANCHORS
Recall Description: FLOOR ANCHORAGE INSERT BOLTS FOR SECURING WHEELCHAIR ARE SUBJECT TO BREAK.
Consequence Summary: A BROKEN OR DAMAGED BOLT MAY NOT ADEQUATELY RESTRAIN AWHEELCHAIR AND PERSON DURING HARD BUS MANEUVER OR DURING A CRASH.
Corrective Action: FLOOR ANCHORAGE MOUNTING INSERT DESIGN WILL BE CHANGED.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL EMISSION CONTROL
Recall Description: EXCESSIVE FUEL VAPOR PRESSURE CAN OCCUR.
Consequence Summary: THIS CREATES FUEL ODORS AND AFTER PROLONGED CYCLINGCOULD CAUSE WEAKENING OF THE FUEL TANK STRUCTURE, WHICH COULD RESULT IN FUELTANK LEAKS. IF A SOURCE OF IGNITION IS PRESENT, A FIRE COULD RESULT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL REVISED PURGE SYSTEM COMPONENTS.

Subject: STRUCTURE:DOOR ASSEMBLY
Recall Description: REAR DOOR RELEASE MECHANISM DOES NOT OPEN BOTH DOORS SIMULTANEOUSLY; ALSO, EXIT OPERATING INSTRUCTIONS ARE NOT WITHIN 6 INCHES OF REAR EMERGENCY EXIT RELEASE MECHANISM.
Corrective Action: REPLACE REAR SEAT(S); REMOVE LATCH HOOK FOR LEFT REAR DOOR TO ALLOW FOR SIMULTANEOUS OPENING OF BOTH DOORS; INSTALL NEW DECALS 6 INCHES FROM RELEASE MECHANISM.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:RESTRAINT:BELT ANCHOR AND ATTACHM
Recall Description: SEAT BELTS DESIGNED FOR USE ON DRIVER'S SEATS WERE INSTALLED ON PASSENGER SEATS; THIS CAUSES THE STRAP CONNECTING THE BUCKLE TO THE FLOOR TO BE TWISTED.
Consequence Summary: STRESSES WITHIN THE BUCKLE RESULT IN FAILURE TO COMPLYWITH FMVSS 210.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL PUMP
Recall Description: FUEL PUMPS MAY HAVE A LOOSE RACK FASTENER THAT COULD ALLOW THE BOLT TO COME OUT OF THE RACK.
Consequence Summary: THIS WOULD AFFECT OPERATOR CONTROL OF ENGINE SPEED ANDENGINE SHUTOWN CAPABILITY, WHICH COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: RETIGHTEN FASTENER TO SPECIFIED TORQUE AND USE SELF LOCKING NUT.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CARRIER:SPARE TIRE
Recall Description: SPARE TIRE CARRIER MAY NOT BE PROPERLY ATTACHED TO THE REAR WALL DUE TO THE USE OF INCORRECT BRACKET.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW BRACKET AND HARDWARE.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:TRAILER HITCHES AND ATTACHM
Recall Description: SOME 'S' HOOKS MAY HAVE HAIRLINE CRACKS ON THE INSIDE RADIUS OF THE EYE END OF THE HOOK.
Corrective Action: REPLACE DEFECTIVE 'S' HOOKS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT TRACK ANCHORS AND SEATS:OTHE
Recall Description: THE REAR MODULAR SEAT FRAME HOLD-DOWN HOOKS MAY NOT MEET THE REQUIRED PULL FORCE AT THE REAR SET ANCHORAGE.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLES WOULD NOT CONFORM TO FMVSS 207.
Corrective Action: REPLACE REAR HOLD DOWN HOOKS AND PIVOT RIVETS WITH HEAT TREATED HARDWARE.

Subject: HEATER:WATER:DEFROSTER:DEFOGGER:HOSE
Recall Description: HEATER HOSE MAY BE INCORRECTLY ROUTED.
Consequence Summary: HOSE COULD WEAR THROUGH AND LEAK WHICH COULD RESULT INAN UNDERHOOD FIRE.
Corrective Action: REROUTE HOSE AS NECESSARY.

Subject: HEATER:WATER:DEFROSTER:DEFOGGER:HOSE
Recall Description: HEATER HOSE MAY BE INCORRECTLY ROUTED.
Corrective Action: REROUTE HOSE AS NECESSARY.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR:OVER:HYDRAULIC:DISC:LINES:HOSE:NON-META
Recall Description: AIR PIPING IS INSTALLED IN A WAY THAT COULD CAUSE FRONT BRAKE HOSES TO RUB AGAINST THE BRAKE CHAMBER.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD EVENTUALLY RESULT IN BRAKE HOSE FAILURE. INCREASING THE STOPPING DISTANCE, WHICH COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPAIR IN A MANNER TO PREVENT FRONT BRAKE HOSE FROM RUBBING AGAINST THE BRAKE CHAMBER.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:PIPE:FILLER:NECK
Recall Description: FUEL LEAKAGE EXCEEDS THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 301 IN A REAR BARRIER CRASH.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 301.
Corrective Action: INSTALL PROTECTIVE BUFFERS; RELOCATE FUEL PUMP AND FILER TO ASSURE COMPLIANCE.

Subject: HEATER:WATER:DEFROSTER:DEFOGGER:HOSE
Recall Description: HOSE COULD WEAR THROUGH AND LEAK.
Consequence Summary: LEAKAGE OF ANTI-FREEZE LIQUID COULD RESULT IN ANUNDERHOOD FIRE
Corrective Action: INSTALL A RETAINING BRACKET THAT WILL REROUTEHOSE AS NECESSARY.

Subject: TIRES:PLY
Recall Description: TIRES MAY DEVELOP A SEPARATION BETWEEN PLIES DURING SERVICE AS A RESULT OF LOWER ADHESION DUE TO PLY COAT STOCK THAT WAS OFF- SPECIFICATION.
Consequence Summary: LOSS OF AIR COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF STEERING CONTROLWITH POTENTIAL FOR A CRASH.
Corrective Action: TIRES WILL BE REPLACED AT NO COST TO CONSUMERS WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM DATE OF NOTIFICATION. Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES:ACCELERATOR:RIGID
Recall Description: THROTTLE LEVERS MAY HAVE BEEN BENT DURING ASSEMBLY.
Consequence Summary: THROTTLE MAY STICK AND NOT RETURN FULLY TO IDLEPOSITION.
Corrective Action: PLACE AFFECTED VEHICLES ON DELIVERY HOLD UNTIL REPAIRED.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:BELTS
Recall Description: THERE MAY BE ELECTRICAL INTERFERENCE BETWEEN PASSIVE BELT MOTOR AND ELECTRONIC CONTROL UNIT.
Consequence Summary: PASSIVE BELT SYSTEM MAY NOT OPERATE CORRECTLY AT ALLTIMES WHICH COULD CAUSE MORE SERIOUS INJURIES TO THE WEARER OF THE BELT.
Corrective Action: REPAIR PASSIVE BELT SYSTEM TO ASSURE PROPER OPERATION.

Subject: STEERING:COLUMN SHAFT UPPER
Recall Description: SPLINED SHAFT IN FIXED STEERING COLUMN IS TOO SHORT, CAUSING THE HUB OF THE STEERING WHEEL TO NOT FULLY SEAT IN THE TAPER.
Consequence Summary: IF THE RETAINING NUT IS IMPROPERLY TORQUED, STEERING WHEEL CAN COME LOOSE AND STEERING CONTROL WOULD BE LOST AND COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE STEERING COLUMN.

Subject: STEERING:GEAR BOX
Recall Description: STRESS CRACKS IN STEERING GEAR MOUNTING BRACKET RESULTING FROM METAL FATIGUE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE STEERING GEAR MOUNTING BRACKET AND ATTACHING HARDWARE.

Subject: WHEELS:HUB
Recall Description: NUTS THAT RETAIN THE WHEEL HUBS ON THE TANDEM DRIVE AXLES MAY NOT BE PROPERLY TORQUED ON THE LEFT HAND SIDE.
Consequence Summary: WHEEL COULD COME OFF WHILE TRUCK IS IN SERVICE; THISCOULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: PROPERLY TORQUE LEFT SIDE DRIVE AXLE SPINDLE JAM NUTS ON BOTH FORWARD AND REAR DRIVE AXLES; REPLACE ANY LOOSE WHEEL HUB NUTS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT BELTS:LAP:REAR
Recall Description: REAR SEAT LAP BELT MAY NOT RETURN TO FULLY RETRACTED POSITION AFTER USE.
Consequence Summary: CONSEQUENTLY, BELT COULD NOT BE RELEASED, DUE TOLOCKING CHARACTERISTICS OF AUTOMATIC LOCKING RETRACTOR SYSTEM.
Corrective Action: INSTALL BELT GUIDE, OR SHEATH, TO DECREASE RETRACTING RESISTANCE AND ALLOW FREE BELT MOVEMENT.

Subject: STEERING:COLUMN
Recall Description: ADJUSTABLE STEERING COLUMN YOKE END, THAT SECURES UNIVERSAL JOINT BEARING CUPS, MAY NOT BE OF THE CORRECT EXECUTION AND CAPS COULD COME LOOSE.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CAUSE LOSS OF STEERING, WHICH COULD RESULTIN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE COMPLETE STEERING SHAFT.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:ARM:PITMAN
Recall Description: STEERING ARM MAY EXPERIENCE FATIGUE FAILURE IN UNDERCUT AREA OF THE ARM.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL AND ANACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SUSPECT STEERING ARMS.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CERTIFICATION LABEL
Recall Description: TRUCKS MAY HAVE BEEN PRODUCED WITH INCORRECT OR MISSING
Consequence Summary: TRUCKS WOULD NOT CONFORM TO REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 120.
Corrective Action: INSTALL CORRECT CERTIFICATION LABEL.

Subject: STRUCTURE:DOOR ASSEMBLY
Recall Description: REAR EMERGENCY EXIT RELEASE MECHANISM EXCEEDS MAXIMUM FORCE REQUIREMENT; THERE ARE NO OPERATING INSTRUCTIONS FOR REAR DOOR; AND SIDE (DRIVER'S) DOOR IS NOT LABELED AS AN EMERGENCY EXIT.
Consequence Summary: BUSES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 217.
Corrective Action: INCREASE STRIKER BOLT HOLES IN DOOR; INSTALL LABELS FOR REAR DOOR AND DRIVER'S DOOR.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN
Recall Description: SEAT BELTS ARE MOUNTED IN SUCH A WAY THAT THERE IS INSUFFICIENT ADJUSTMENT TO ACCOMMODATE A 95TH PERCENTILE ADULT MALE.
Consequence Summary: BELTS ARE IN NONCOMPLIANCE WITH FMVSS 209.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SEAT BELTS WITH BELTS OF SUFFICIENT LENGTH TO COMPLY WITH FMVSS 209.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT
Recall Description: CHILD RESTRAINT FAILED POST IMPACT BUCKLE RELEASE FORCE TESTING.
Consequence Summary: BUCKLE TONGUE DEFORMED DURING TESTING.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW HARNESS WITH SPECIAL HEAT TREATED TONGUE.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:METALLIC
Recall Description: MISSING OR MISAPPLIED SUPPORT CLIP CREATES POTENTIAL FOR REAR BRAKE LINE FRACTURE DUE TO FATIGUING.
Consequence Summary: FRACTURE COULD RESULT IN DECREASED BRAKING PERFORMANCE.WHICH COULD CAUSE AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPAIR BRAKE CLIP, AS NECESSARY.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:BATTERY:OTHER PART
Recall Description: BATTERY BOX COVER MOUNTING BRACKET FAILURE COULD ALLOW COVER TO COME LOOSE.
Consequence Summary: COVER COULD DETACH FROM TRUCK AND CAUSE AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPAIR MOUNTING BRACKET WELD IN A MANNER TO PREVENT FAILURE.

Subject: EMERGENCY PARKING BRAKE:MECHANICAL:LEVER SETTLING
Recall Description: PARK BRAKE ACUATOR LEVER COULD FAIL AND BRAKE WOULD NOT ENGAGE WHEN THE GEAR SHIFT LEVER IS PUT IN THE "P" PARK POSITION.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLE COULD MOVE AFTER IT IS PARKED, CREATING POTENTIALFOR A CRASH AND INJURY.
Corrective Action: REPLACE PARK BRAKE ACTUATOR LEVER WITH LEVER OF HEAVIER DUTY DESIGN.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:WINDSHIELD WASHER HOSES
Recall Description: HEATER HOSE MAY BE INCORRECTLY ROUTED.
Consequence Summary: HOSE COULD WEAR THROUGH AND LEAK, WHICH COULD RESULT INAN UNDERHOOD FIRE.
Corrective Action: REROUTE HOSE AS NECESSARY.

Subject: AIR CONDITIONER:COMPRESSOR
Recall Description: DISCHARGE VALUE ASSEMBLY BOLT MAY FAIL AND JAM AGAINST A PISTON.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CRACK THE CYLINDER HEAD WITH A RESULTANTDISCHARGE OF HIGH PRESSURE GAS AND THE PROPELLING OF METAL FRAGMENTS THAT COULDINJURE PERSONS IN THE IMMEDIATE VICINITY.
Corrective Action: DISCONNECT AIR CONDITIONING COMPRESSORS UNTIL FASTENERS CAN BE REPLACED.

Subject: HEATER:WATER:DEFROSTER:DEFOGGER:HOSE
Recall Description: HEATER HOSE MAY BE INCORRECTLY ROUTED.
Consequence Summary: HOSE COULD WEAR THROUGH AND LEAK, WHICH COULD RESULT INAN UNDERHOOD FIRE.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A RETAINING BRACKET THAT WILL REROUTE HOSE AS NECESSARY.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:STARTER RELAY
Recall Description: THE NARTRON INSTRUMENT PANEL MOUNTED STARTER SWITCH MAY STICK WHEN STARTING TRUCK DUE TO OVERTORQUING OF RETAINING NUT.
Consequence Summary: RETURN SPRING WOULD NOT FUNCTION PROPERLY.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW IMPROVED DOUGLAS STARTER SWITCH AND HARNESS ASSEMBLY.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL PUMP
Recall Description: THE SCREW THAT CONNECTS THE RACK TO THE GOVERNOR LINKAGE INSIDE THE BOSCH FUEL INJECTION PUMP MAY HAVE INSUFFICIENT TORQUE ON THE RETAINING NUT.
Consequence Summary: NUT MAY WORK LOOSE AND SCREW FALL OUT, ALLOWING GOVERNORLINKAGE TO SEPARATE FROM THE RACK, RESULTING IN LOSS OF CONTROL OVER ENGINESPEED WITH POTENTIAL FOR A VEHICLE CRASH.
Corrective Action: RETORQUE SCREW FOR FUEL PUMP RACK TO GOVERNOR LINKAGE.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK:AUXILLARY SELECTOR AND SWITCH
Recall Description: INCORRECTLY INSTALLED FUEL LINE CONNECTORS HAVE FUEL SUPPLY AND RETURN LINES CROSSED.
Consequence Summary: FUEL COULD BE TRANSFERRED FROM ONE TANK TO THE OTHER,POSSIBLY RESULTING IN FUEL OVERFLOW AND SPILLAGE, IN PRESENCE OF AN IGNITIONSOURCE, A FIRE COULD OCCUR.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FUEL LINE ASSEMBLY.

Subject: HEATER:WATER:DEFROSTER:DEFOGGER:HOSE
Recall Description: HEATER HOSE MAY BE INCORRECTLY ROUTED.
Consequence Summary: HOSE COULD WEAR THROUGH AND LEAK WHICH COULD RESULT INAN UNDERHOOD FIRE.
Corrective Action: REROUTE AND REPAIR HOSE, AS NECESSARY.

Subject: HEATER:WATER:DEFROSTER:DEFOGGER:HOSE
Recall Description: HEATER HOSE MAY BE INCORRECTLY ROUTED.
Consequence Summary: HOSE COULD WEAR THROUGH AND LEAK WHICH COULD RESULT INAN UNDERHOOD FIRE.
Corrective Action: REROUTE AND REPAIR HOSE AS NECESSARY.

Subject: LIGHTING:GENERAL OR UNKNOWN COMPONENT:HEAD LIGHTS
Recall Description: REPLACEMENT HEADLAMPS WERE NOT APPROVED FOR HIGHWAY USE IN THE U. S. AND DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 108.
Consequence Summary: HEADLAMPS WOULD NOT PROVIDE PROPER ILLUMINATION ANDCOULD CAUSE GLARE TO ONCOMING TRAFFIC.
Corrective Action: REPLACE HEADLAMPS WITH ORIGINAL DOT CERTIFIED LAMPS.

Subject: TIRES
Recall Description: TIRES MAY BE SUBJECT TO AN AIR LOSS DUE TO A SMALL HOLE IN THE SIDEWALL OF THE TIRE. CONSEQUENCE OF DEFECT:  TIRE COULD HAVE A RAPID LOSS OF AIR IN SIDEWALL AREA.
Corrective Action: REPLACE DEFECTIVE TIRES WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM DATE OF NOTIFICATION. DOT IDENTIFICATION:  BFHLWPK079 - 119 INCLUSIVE.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL RETURN SPRING
Recall Description: THROTTLE RETURN SPRINGS MAY NOT BE PROPERLY INSTALLED.
Consequence Summary: THIS WOULD CAUSE THROTTLE LEVER TO NOT BE UNDERSUFFICIENT TENSION TO COMPLY WITH FMVSS 124.
Corrective Action: CORRECTLY LOCATE THROTTLE RETURN SPRINGS.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL RETURN SPRING
Recall Description: THROTTLE RETURN SPRING MAY BE INCORRECTLY LOCATED.
Consequence Summary: THIS WOULD CAUSE THROTTLE LEVER TO NOT BE UNDERSUFFICIENT TENSION TO COMPLY WITH FMVSS 124.
Corrective Action: CORRECTLY LOCATE THROTTLE RETURN SPRINGS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEATS
Recall Description: THE SEAT INSERT MATERIAL DOES NOT MEET THE FLAMMABILITY REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 302.
Consequence Summary: TRUCKS FAIL TO COMPLY WITH FMVSS 302.
Corrective Action: REMOVE AND REPLACE ALL SUSPECT SEAT UPHOLSTERY.

Subject: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT CONTROL ARM:LOWER
Recall Description: THE ALLOY A-ARMS MAY HAVE A MANUFACTURING CASTING DEFECT AND COULD CRACK AND BREAK AFTER MILEAGE ACCUMULATION.
Consequence Summary: A-ARM BREAKAGE COULD CAUSE LOSS OF CONTROL WHICH COULDRESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SUSPECT A-ARMS.

Subject: SUSPENSION:TWIN:I-BEAM:SOLID:FRONT:RADIUS ARM
Recall Description: DUE TO HIGH LOADS ON THE UPPER REAR RADIUS ROD, WHICH IS USED TO LOCATE THE CRIVE AXLE AND LIMIT VEHICLE ROLL DURING TURNING MANUEVERS, THE UPPER REAR RADIUS ROD MAY FAIL.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN INADEQUATE LOCATION OF THE AXLEWITH POSSIBLE INTERFERENCE BETWEEN MOVING PARTS, WHICH COULD CAUSE STABILITYPROBLEMS AND A POTENTIAL FOR AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SUSPECT RADIUS RODS WITH RODS OF A MORE HEAVY-DUTY DESIGN.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:DIFFERENTIAL:PROPORTIONAL VALVE
Recall Description: TRUCKS WILL EXPERIENCE REDUCED BRAKING AT LOW BRAKE APPLICATION PRESSURES WHEN OPERATING IN THE BOBTAIL MODE.
Consequence Summary: REDUCED BRAKING CREATES THE POTENTIAL FOR AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FRONT AXLE RATIO VALVES WITH STANDARD VALVING THAT DOES NOT REDUCE APPLICATION PRESSURE.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES
Recall Description: FURNACE PLYWOOD COVER WAS NOT INSTALLED.
Consequence Summary: WITHOUT COVER, ITEMS STORED UNDER THE SOFA COULD COMEINTO CONTACT WITH METAL FURNACE CASING; THIS CREATES A POTENTIAL FOR A FIRE IFSTORED ITEMS ARE COMBUSTIBLE AND FURNACE IS OPERATING.
Corrective Action: INSTALL FURNACE COVER.

Subject: STRUCTURE:FRAME:MEMBERS AND BODY:OTHER PARTS
Recall Description: STEPS MAY NOT BE PROPERLY WELDED.
Consequence Summary: STEP WELDING COULD FAIL AND RESULT IN INJURY TO USER.
Corrective Action: REPLACE STEPS.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING
Recall Description: WIRING HARNESS FOR THE HEADLAMPS MAY BREAK DUE TO THE STRESS CREATED BY THE HEADLAMP POP UP DEVICES.
Consequence Summary: BREAKAGE OF THE WIRING HARNESS CAUSES LOSS OFHEADLAMP ILLUMINATION WHICH COULD HAVE A POTENTIAL FOR AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: HEADLAMP WIRING HARNESS ROUTING WILL BE MODIFIED AND DAMAGED WIRES REPAIRED.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC:LEVER AND LINKA
Recall Description: THE SHIFT LEVER MAY NOT DROP INTO PARK DETENT WHEN PLACED IN THE PARK POSITION.
Consequence Summary: THE SHIFT LEVER MAY MOVE FROM PARK TO REVERSE ALLOWINGUNEXPECTED VEHICLE MOVEMENT AND A VEHICLE CRASH MAY OCCUR.
Corrective Action: ADJUST STEERING COLUMN AND SHIFT LINKAGE TO OBTAIN CLEARANCE BETWEEN THE SHIFT ROD LEVER AND THE DASH PANEL OPENING.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL LINES:METALLIC
Recall Description: FUEL LINE ROUTING COULD ALLOW THE LINE TO CONTACT THE ELECTRICAL CONNECTION ON THE STARTER SOLENOID.
Consequence Summary: SUCH CONTACT COULD RESULT IN A TRUCK FIRE.
Corrective Action: REROUTE FUEL LINE AND REPLACE LINE, IF NECESSARY.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL SYSTEM OTHER PARTS
Recall Description: FUEL PUMP BREATHER TUBE ROUTING MAY CAUSE AIR/FUEL MIXTURE TO BE IGNITED BY THE ARCING OF THE CONTACTS IN THE ELECTRICAL FUEL PUMP.
Consequence Summary: A FIRE MAY RESULT AT THE END OF THE BREATHER TUBE ANDMAY SPREAD TO ADJACENT AREAS.
Corrective Action: REPLACEMENT AND REROUTING OF THE FUEL PUMP BREATHER TUBE.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:EMERGENCY EXIT LABEL
Recall Description: STATIONARY REAR WINDOWS INSTEAD OF EMERGENCY EXIT TYPE WERE INSTALLED.  ALSO, DRIVERS DOOR AS AN EMERGENCY EXIT, WAS NOT PROPERLY IDENTIFIED AND LABELED.
Consequence Summary: BUSES DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 217.
Corrective Action: INSTALL EMERGENCY EXIT TYPE WINDOW IN REAR OF BUS.  INSTALL EMERGENCY EXIT LABELING FOR DRIVERS DOOR.

Subject: AIR CONDITIONER:ELECTRONIC CLIMATE CONTROL MODULE
Recall Description: THE ELECTRONIC AIR CONDITIONING CONTROL MAY NOT FUNCTION WHEN STARTING CAR THAT HAS BEEN PARKED FOR A FEW HOURS WITH IGNITION OFF.
Consequence Summary: WINDSHIELD MAY NOT DEFROST AND CAR WOULD NOT CONFORMWITH FMVSS 103.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ELECTRONIC COMFORT CONTROL ASSEMBLY.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:PEDALS:LINKAGES AND VALVES
Recall Description: THE REAR AXLE RELAY VALVES (ONE PER AXLE) MAY NOT MEET BRAKE RELEASE TIMING REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 121.
Consequence Summary: THE REAR AXLE BRAKES MAY NOT RELEASE IN THE TIMESSPECIFIED BY FMVSS 121.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE NONCOMPLYING RELAY VALVES.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:STOVE
Recall Description: CONTROL KNOBS FOR GAS COOKING RANGE BURNERS MAY BE INCORRECTLY LABELED AS TO BURNER LOCATION.
Consequence Summary: GAS FLOW FROM THE MISLABELED BURNER WOULD IGNITEUNEXPECTEDLY AND COULD CAUSE BODY INJURY AND/OR VEHICLE DAMAGE.
Corrective Action: INSTALL LABELS THAT CORRECTLY MATCH BURNER LOCATIONS.

Subject: LIGHTING:LAMP OR SOCKET:OTHER PART LIGHTING SYSTEM
Recall Description: THE BASE MARKING ON THE 9005 BULB WAS INCORRECTLY MARKED AS TYPE HB4 INSTEAD OF HB3.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 108.
Corrective Action: INSTALL CORRECTLY MARKED BULBS.

Subject: STEERING:UNKNOWN TYPE:GEAR BOX
Recall Description: THE STEERING GEAR MOUNTING BRACKET WELDS MAY CRACK UNDER CERTAIN STEERING LOAD CONDITIONS.
Consequence Summary: STEERING CONTROL WOULD BE ADVERSELY AFFECTED WITHPOTENTIAL FOR LOSS OF TRUCK CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE STEERING GEAR MOUNTING BRACKET WITH A REDESIGNED BRACKET.

Subject: SUSPENSION:I-BEAM:SOLID:FRONT HANGER:BRACKET
Recall Description: THERE MAY BE SPRING EYE CONTACT WITH THE SPRING BRACKET AND HIGH STRESS LEVELS IN THE BRACKET.
Consequence Summary: SPRING BRACKET FAILURE AND CONSEQUENT FRONT SPRINGDISLOCATION COULD RESULT IN IMPAIRED STEERING CONTROL IN A TURNING MANEUVER.
Corrective Action: CHASSIS WILL BE RETROFITTED WITH CURRENT PRODUCTION FRONT SPRING REAR BRACKETS TO ELIMINATE ANY INTERFERENCE.

Subject: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT
Recall Description: UNDER CERTAIN VEHICLE LOAD OR ROAD CONDITIONS, A SECTION OF THE FRONT SUSPENSION SUPPORT, AT LEVEL OF THE BEARING PIVOT, MAY CRACK OR BREAK.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN EVENTUAL LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL ANDCOULD CAUSE AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL REINFORCEMENTS ON THE SUSPENSION SUPPORT OF THE AXLES.

Subject: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:NON-POWER AXLE
Consequence Summary: IF FRACTURING OCCURS, CONTACT BETWEEN THE TIRE AND THESIDE OF THE WHEEL LINER COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF CONTROL OF THE TRAILER CAUSED BYUNANTICIPATED MOVEMENT OF THE CAMPING TRAILER.
Corrective Action: WELD NEW AXLE MOUNTING PLATES.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:SPEED CONTROL
Recall Description: CRUISE CONTROL SYSTEM IS SUSCEPTIBLE TO WATER CONTAMINATION AND, IF IT BECOMES WET WHILE IN USE, COULD CREATE A SHORT CIRCUIT.
Consequence Summary: MOTORCYCLE SPEED WOULD INCREASE AUTOMATICALLY WITHOUTANY ACTION ON THE PART OF THE DRIVER PRESENTING THE POTENTIAL FOR AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE CRUISE CONTROL MODULE.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:DISC:ROTOR:DISC HUB
Recall Description: THE HUB MAY SEPARATE FROM THE DISCS OF THE ROTORS.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN BRAKE FAILURE AND A VEHICLEACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ROTORS.

Subject: SUSPENSION:I-BEAM:SOLID:FRONT KING PIN
Recall Description: THE KING PIN THAT IS USED TO JOIN A TRAILER TO THE TRACTOR AT THE COUPLINGS MAY FRACTURE.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN TRAILER SEPARATION FROM THETRACTOR, WITH POTENTIAL TO INJURE PEOPLE IN ITS PATH AND TO CRASH INTO OTHERVEHICLES.
Corrective Action: REPLACE TRAILER MAIN BEAM (INCLUDING THE KING PIN).

Subject: FUEL:FUEL INJECTION:UNKNOWN TYPE:REGULATOR
Recall Description: DUE TO CRACKING OF A RUBBER DIAPHRAGM IN THE FUEL PRESSURE REGULATOR, LEAKAGE MAY OCCUR.
Consequence Summary: FUEL LEAKAGE CREATES A POTENTIAL FIRE HAZARD.
Corrective Action: REPLACE MODEL 4300VP REGULATOR WITH ONE 4303VP FILTER, ONE 4306VP FILTER, AND ONE 4309VP FILTER ELEMENTS. 4300VP BRAND NAMES:  POWERCRAFT, PARKER AND DIAL A PRESSURE.

Subject: STEERING:WHEEL AND COLUMN
Recall Description: LOOSE RETAINING NUT ON STEERING WHEEL COULD CAUSE THE STEERING WHEEL TO FEEL LOOSE.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD ADVERSELY AFFECT STEERING CONTROL WITHPOTENTIAL FOR AN ACCIDENT.
