Corrective Action: TORQUE RETAINING NUT TO SPECIFICATION AND APPLY LOCKTITE.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK:AUXILLARY
Recall Description: SHIELDS ON THE FRONTS OF THE MIDSHIP MOUNTED FUEL TANKS WERE OMITTED DURING ASSEMBLY.
Consequence Summary: TRUCKS WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH 30 MPH IMPACT TEST OFFMVSS NO. 301, FUEL SYSTEM INTEGRITY.
Corrective Action: INSTALL FUEL TANK SHIELDS.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:ARM:IDLER AND ATTACHMENT
Recall Description: PREMATURE WEAR IN THE IDLER ARM PIVOT BEARING AND OR BALL JOINT ATTACHMENTS COULD OCCUR.
Consequence Summary: THIS WEAR CAN RESULT IN LOOSENESS IN THE STEERING ANDERRATIC STEERING REPONSE, WHICH COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE IDLER ARM DESIGN WITH A ONE PIECE DRAG LINK.

Subject: STRUCTURE:DOOR ASSEMBLY:LATCHES AND LOCKS
Recall Description: THE LOCK CYLINDER OVERRIDE MECHANISM MAY FAIL AND PREVENT A PERSON ON THE INSIDE FROM USING THE TURN KNOB TO EXIT THE VEHICLE.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN A PERSON BEING TRAPPED INSIDETHE VEHICLE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE OUTSIDE LOCK CYLINDER ASSEMBLY TO ASSURE THAT DOOR CAN BE OPENED FROM INSIDE.

Subject: ENGINE:TURBO-CHARGER
Recall Description: MISROUTING OF TURBOCHARGER OIL FEED PIPE COULD ALLOW PIPE TO CONTACT THE POSITIVE BATTERY CABLE CONNECTING STUD ON THE STARTER MOTOR.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CAUSE AN ELECTRICAL GROUND THAT COULD RESULTIN AN ENGINE COMPARTMENT FIRE.
Corrective Action: REROUTE OIL FEED PIPE; ALSO INSTALL A NEWLY DESIGNED CLAMP AND BRACKET TO LOCATE PIPE AWAY FROM THE STARTER.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CERTIFICATION LABEL
Recall Description: TIRE SIZE DATA ON CERTIFICATION LABEL IS INCORRECT.
Consequence Summary: INCORRECT TIRE INFORMATION FAILS TO CONFORM TOFMVSS 120.
Corrective Action: AFFIX NEW CERTIFICATION LABEL WITH CORRECT INFORMATION.

Subject: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT CONTROL ARM:LOWER
Recall Description: FRONT LOWER SUSPENSION ARM FORKS COULD DEFORM AFTER SUBSTANTIAL IMPACTS, SUCH AS IN AN ACCIDENT.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN EVENTUAL COLLAPSE OF THE SUSPENSIONARM WITH IMPAIRED HANDLING, WHICH COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FOUR FRONT LOWER SUSPENSION ARM FORKS WITH FORKS OF A GREATER THICKNESS.

Subject: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT:BEARING WHEEL
Recall Description: FRONT WHEEL BEARING ADJUSTING NUT RETAINING KEYS MAY BE MISSING FROM FRONT AXLE ASSEMBLIES, ALLOWING THE NUT TO LOOSEN.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN DETACHMENT OF THE WHEEL AND HUBASSEMBLY FROM THE AXLE, LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL, AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL RETAINING KEYS IN FRONT WHEEL HUB ASSEMBLIES WHERE MISSING.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT
Recall Description: THE LOOP ON THE END OF THE SHOULDER STRAP IS ONLY GLUED TOGETHER, RATHER THAN GLUED AND SEWN.
Consequence Summary: IN THE EVENT THE CAR STOPS SUDDENLY OR IS IN ANACCIDENT, THE GLUED SHOULDER STRAP MAY FAIL AND CHILD WOULD NOT BE RESTRAINED.THIS COULD RESULT IN MORE SERIOUS INJURIES.
Corrective Action: SHOULDER STRAP LOOPS ARE TO BE SEWN TOGETHER AND NOT JUST GLUED.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:AXLE ASSEMBLY:SEAL:AXLE SHAFT
Recall Description: DUE TO IMPROPER SEATING, THERE COULD BE A CLEARANCE BETWEEN THE WEAR WASHER AND AXLE LUG, OR BETWEEN THE WEAR WASHER AND THE INNER RACE OF THE BEARING.
Consequence Summary: WHEN TRUCK IS LOADED, CONTACT BETWEEN HUB NUT AND HUBEND CAP COULD CAUSE NUT TO BECOME BACKED OFF AND RESULT IN THE WHEEL BECOMINGLOOSE CAUSING FAILURE OF THE BEARING AND/OR AXLE WHICH COULD RESULT IN ANACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: ADJUST BEARING CLEARANCE TO PREVENT HUB NUTS FROM BACKING OFF AND WHEEL BECOMING LOOSE.

Subject: EXHAUST SYSTEM:CATALYTIC CONVERTER SYSTEM
Recall Description: INADEQUATE HEAT SHIELD ABOVE CATALYTIC CONVERTER COULD OVERHEAT.
Consequence Summary: MATERIALS NEAR CATALYTIC CONVERTER, INCLUDING LINES FORAUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION FLUID, COULD IGNITE AND CAUSE AN UNDERBODY FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE HEAT SHIELD FOR CATALYTIC CONVERTER WITH A LARGER, IMPROVED HEAT SHIELD.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES
Recall Description: UNDER CERTAIN CIRCUMSTANCES, THE TV MONITORS MAY FALL FROM THEIR RECEPTACLES.
Consequence Summary: PASSENGERS SEATED IN CLOSE AREA OF THE TV MONITORRECEPTACLES COULD BE INJURED.
Corrective Action: SECURE RETAINING SCREWS AND THE DOOR LOCK MECHANISM.

Subject: HEATER:EXHAUST MANIFOLD:DEFROSTER:DEFOGGER
Recall Description: UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS, A REVERSE CURRENT MIGHT FLOW THROUGH A WIRE CABLE BETWEEN THE AIR RECIRCULATION SWITCH AND A MICROSWITCH.
Consequence Summary: HEATER FAN RESISTOR WOULD OVERHEAT AND SMOKE IN THEPASSENGER COMPARTMENT HEATING SYSTEM, CAUSING DISCOMFORT AND BREATHING HAZARDSTO THE DRIVER AND PASSENGERS.
Corrective Action: DISCONNECT ELECTRICAL WIRE CABLE AND SECURE BY TAPE AROUND CABLE HARNESS.

Subject: TIRES:SIDEWALL
Recall Description: TIRES MAY DEVELOP A FLEX BREAK IN THE LOWER SIDEWALL PRIOR TO COMPLETING THE REQUIRED FMVSS 109 ENDURANCE COMPLIANCE TESTING.
Consequence Summary: TIRES FAILED TO MEET REQUIREMENT OF FMVSS 109 FORENDURANCE TESTING.
Corrective Action: TIRES WILL BE REPLACED AT NO COST TO CONSUMER WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM DATE OF NOTIFICATION.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL SYSTEMS
Recall Description: THE COMPOSITION OF CERTAIN NON-GENUINE REPLACEMENT PREHEAT TUBES CAN CAUSE COMBUSTION.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN AN ENGINE COMPARTMENT FIRE.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A MODIFIED DESIGN PREHEAT TUBE.

Subject: TIRES:MARKINGS
Recall Description: FAILS TO MEET REQUIREMENT OF FMVSS 119, DOT SYMBOL NOT SHOWN.
Consequence Summary: TIRES WERE NOT CERTIFIED BY ORIGINAL MANUFACTURERS.  NODOT SYMBOL, AS REQUIRED BY FMVSS 119.
Corrective Action: TIRES TO BE RETURNED FREIGHT COLLECT.  MANUFACTURER WILL REIMBURSE FOR EXPENSES AND PURCHASE PRICE.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:REFRIGERATORS
Recall Description: SHORT CIRCUITS MAY OCCUR IN THE EYEBROW PANEL WHICH IS LOCATED IN THE FRONT OF THE REFRIGERATOR.
Consequence Summary: IF SHORT CIRCUITS OCCUR AND DEVELOP INTO A FIRE,OCCUPANTS OF THE RV OR TRAILER WOULD BE AT SERIOUS RISK.  THE SHORT CIRCUITSHAVE ONLY OCCURRED WHILE THE VEHICLE IS PARKED AND HOOKED UP TO ALTERNATINGCURRENT (AC).
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE ENTIRE PANEL, LIGHTS AND WIRING WITH AN ASSEMBLED UNIT CONTINUING THE ELECTRICAL MALE CONNECTOR COMPLETELY CONTAINED IN A FIRE RETARDANT PLASTIC SLEEVE.

Subject: BRAKES:LOW AIR PRESSURE WARNING DEVICES
Recall Description: SWITCHES MAY NOT ACTUATE THE SERVICE RESERVOIR LOW PRESSURE WARNING BUZZERS AND LIGHTS AT PRESSURES BELOW 60 POUNDS PER SQUARE INCH. CONSEQUENCE OF DEFECT:  DRIVER WOULD NOT BE WARNED OF AIR BRAKE SYSTEM LOW PRESSURE AND LOSS OF BRAKE COULD BE EXPERIENCED WITHOUT WARNING.
Corrective Action: REPLACE LOW PRESSURE SWITCHES.

Subject: BRAKES:MECHANICAL SERVICE:OTHER
Recall Description: IF FRONT WHEEL HITS A BUMP DURING HARD BRAKING, VIBRATION CAN OVERLOAD THE COMPRESSION BAR OF THE FRONT BRAKE ASSEMBLY.
Consequence Summary: A STRONG VIBRATION COULD CAUSE BREAKAGE OF THE FRONTWHEEL BRAKE COMPONENTS, LOSS OF FRONT BRAKE STOPPING ABILITY, WHICH COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW COMPRESSION BAR KIT.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT
Recall Description: THE SINGLE STRAP SLIDE THAT IS POSITIONED ON THE RIGHT AND LEFT SIDE OF THE UPPER HARNESS MAY SLIP.
Consequence Summary: SHOULD THE SLIPPAGE OCCUR THE SYSTEM WOULD FAIL TORESTRAIN THE CHILD.
Corrective Action: HARNESS WILL BE REPLACED WITH A DOUBLE SLIDE LOCKING SYSTEM.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:SPEED CONTROL
Recall Description: IF CRUISE CONTROL MAIN SWITCH IS IN THE ON POSITION WHEN ENGINE IS STARTED, SYSTEM CAN BE AFFECTED BY A SHORT DURATION VOLTAGE DROP CAUSED BY OPTIONAL HI-POWER (H340) RADIO.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CAUSE ERRATIC CRUISE CONTROL OPERATION, WHICHCOULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ELECTRONIC CONTROL MODULE.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:SPEED CONTROL
Recall Description: A SMALL NYLON BUSHING IN THE CRUISE CONTROL SERVO BAIL MAY SLIP OUT OF PLACE, CAUSING INTERMITTENT AND UNEXPECTED INCREASES IN ENGINE SPEED OR DIESELING (ENGINE RUN ON WITH IGNITION OFF).
Consequence Summary: SERVO ROD ASSEMBLY COULD CATCH ON ENGINE COMPONENTS ANDRESULT IN A STUCK THROTTLE WITH POTENTIAL FOR A VEHICLE CRASH.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A NEW BUSHING IN CRUISE CONTROL SERVO BAIL.

Subject: FURNACE:RECREATIONAL VEHICLE
Recall Description: A SECONDARY HEAT SHIELD COLLAR MAY HAVE BEEN OMITTED FROM THE FURNACE EXHAUST TUBE.
Consequence Summary: SURROUNDING MATERIALS MAY BECOME OVERHEATED AND COULDRESULT IN A VEHICLE FIRE.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A HEAT SHIELD.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL:PEDAL
Recall Description: THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL STOPPER MAY BE BENT WHEN EXCESSIVE DOWNWARD FORCE IS APPLIED AFTER PEDAL HAS CONTACTED THE STOPPER.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF ACCELERATOR CONTROL SHOULDPEDAL BE CAUGHT AND HELD DOWN BY BENT STOPPER, WHICH COULD CAUSE AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A SUPPORT TO PREVENT STOPPER FROM BENDING.

Subject: ENGINE:GASKETS
Recall Description: EXTERNAL CRACKS ABOVE THE NUMBER 3 CYLINDER (1984 MODELS) OR ROCKER ARM COVER GASKETS SPLITTING (1985 MODELS) COULD ALLOW OIL TO LEAK ONTO THE EXHAUST MANIFOLD.
Consequence Summary: ENGINE OIL LEAKING ONTO A HOT EXHAUST MANIFOLD COULDRESULT IN AN ENGINE COMPARTMENT FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE CRACKED CYLINDER HEADS (1984 MODELS); REPLACE ROCKER ARM COVER GASKETS (1985 MODELS).

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER LABELS
Recall Description: THE LABEL ON THE HAND THROTTLE WAS OMITTED.
Consequence Summary: TRUCKS WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 101.
Corrective Action: LABEL AND INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS WILL BE SENT TO OWNERS.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OWNERS MANUAL INFORMATION
Recall Description: INFORMATION REGARDING CHILD RESTRAINTS WAS OMITTED FROM THE OWNERS MANUAL.
Consequence Summary: THIS OMISSION RESULTS IN NONCOMPLIANCE WITH FMVSS 210.
Corrective Action: SEND MISSING PAGE TO OWNERS TO BE PLACED IN THEIR VEHICLE OWNERS MANUAL.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT TRACKS AND ANCHORS
Recall Description: THE REAR INBOARD SEAT ANCHORAGE BRACKET FOR THE FRONT SEATS MAY NOT WITHSTAND THE FORCE REQUIRED BY FMVSS 207.
Consequence Summary: BRACKET FAILURE COULD RESULT IN SEAT BECOMING LOOSE;VEHICLES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 207.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A REINFORCING PLATE TO REAR INBOARD SEAT ANCHORAGE BRACKET FOR EACH FRONT SEAT.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER LABELS
Recall Description: STEERING WHEEL HORN PADS DO NOT CONTAIN THE HORN SYMBOL DISPLAY AS REQUIRED BY FMVSS 101.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLES DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 101, CONTROLS ANDDISPLAYS.
Corrective Action: SEND NOTIFICATION POSTCARD TO OWNERS TO ASSIST ANY FUTURE OWNERS WHO MIGHT BE UNSURE OF HORN LOCATION.

Subject: STRUCTURE:BODY:GRAB BAR:STRAP MOUNTING ASSIST
Recall Description: CORROSION OF THE GRABHANDLE AT ITS MOUNTING SURFACE MAY LEAD TO CRACKING OR LOSS OF STRENGTH.
Consequence Summary: FAILURE OF GRABHANDLE DURING USE COULD RESULT INPERSONAL INJURY.
Corrective Action: REPLACE GRABHANDLE AND ITS FASTENER WITH IMPROVED GRABHANDLE; ALSO, INSTALL GASKET BETWEEN THE HANDLE AND AIR STARTER RESERVOIR.

Subject: STRUCTURE:FIFTH WHEEL ASSEMBLY
Recall Description: THE TURNTABLE PEDESTAL MAY DEVELOP FATIGUE CRACKS IN THE FRONT SUSPENSION SYSTEM.
Consequence Summary: FATIGUE CRACKING COULD LEAD TO FAILURE AND SEPARATIONOF THE FRONT AXLE AND SUSPENSION FROM THE FULL TRAILER.  A VEHICLE CRASH COULDOCCUR WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: REPLACEMENT OF THE 5TH WHEEL PEDESTAL WILL BE MADE AT NO COST TO THE CUSTOMER.

Subject: STRUCTURE:TONGUE DOLLY
Recall Description: THE TORQUE OF CONVERTER DOLLY IS  HELD UP BY A SUPPORT LEG WHICH UNLATCHES AND FOLDS UP BETWEEN THE FRONT OF THE A-FRAME WHEN UNIT IS IN OVER THE ROAD USE.  THIS LEG MAY FAIL TO SUPPORT THE UNIT WHEN IN THE PROCESS OF COUPLING OR UNCOUPLING JIFFLOX FROM THE TRACTOR/TRAILER.
Consequence Summary: FAILURE OF THE LEG ALLOWS THE TORQUE TO DROP ANDPOSSIBLY CAUSE INJURY TO THE PERSON WORKING WITH THE EQUIPMENT.
Corrective Action: NEW MODIFIED DROP LEG ASSEMBLY WILL BE FURNISHED TO EACH CUSTOMER.

Subject: STEERING:GEAR BOX
Recall Description: THE STEERING BEVEL GEAR ASSEMBLY MAY HAVE WATER CONTAMINATION WHICH COULD LEAD TO RUST/CORROSION.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CAUSE ERRATIC STEERING, WHICH COULD RESULT INAN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE STEERING BEVEL GEAR ASSEMBLY; COVER LIQUID GASKET MATERIAL WITH IMPROVED MATERIAL.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM
Recall Description: IMPROPER MOUNTING OF AN ELECTRICAL JUNCTION BOX COULD ALLOW MOUNTING SCREWS TO PROTRUDE THROUGH WALL AND INTO THE L P GAS TUBING ON THE BACK OF AN ADJACENT RANGE/OVER APPLIANCE.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN L P GAS ESCAPING DURING COOKING;IN THE PRESENCE OF AN IGNITION SOURCE, THERE COULD BE A FIRE OR AN EXPLOSION.
Corrective Action: REMOUNT ELECTRICAL JUNCTION BOX TO PREVENT SCREWS FROM PROTRUDING THROUGH COMPARTMENT WALL.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES
Recall Description: CLAMPING RING MAY BE UNDERSIZED AND THE CLAMP NUT MAY NOT FULLY ENGAGE THE THREADS OF THE CLAMP BOLT.
Consequence Summary: IF THE NUT DOES NOT FULLY ENGAGE THE BOLT THREADS, THETHREAD COULD BE STRIPPED WITH THE RESULT THAT THE MANHOLE COVER WOULD NOT BESECURELY ATTACHED TO THE COLLAR, FALL OFF, AND BECOME A ROAD HAZARD.
Corrective Action: INSPECT ALL CLAMPING RINGS AND IF DEFECTIVE REPLACE.  ALL RINGS NOT INSTALLED WILL BE RETRIEVED BY THE MANUFACTURER.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT RETRACTORS
Recall Description: SOME LAP SHOULDER BELT RETRACTORS WERE BUILT WITH CERTAIN OUT OF TOLERANCE COMPONENTS.
Consequence Summary: RETRACTORS MAY LOCK AT LOW BELT PULL OUT RATES, THISCOULD DISCOURAGE SEAT BELT USAGE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FRONT LAP SHOULDER BELT ASSEMBLIES, AS NECESSARY.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT TRACKS AND ANCHORS
Recall Description: THE FRONT SEAT FRAME ASSEMBLY MAY CONTAIN AN IMPROPER, MISSING AND/OR MISLOCATED WELD THAT COULD FRACTURE.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CAUSE UNEXPECTED SEAT MOVEMENT AND RESULT INPERSONAL INJURY AND/OR LOSS OF CONTROL OF THE CAR.
Corrective Action: REPLACE BOTH FRONT SEAT ASSEMBLIES.

Subject: STEERING:WHEEL AND COLUMN
Recall Description: STEERING WHEEL RETAINING NUTS MAY HAVE BEEN IMPROPERLY INSTALLED AND/OR TORQUED.
Corrective Action: RENEW AND RETORQUE STEERING WHEEL RETAINING NUTS.

Subject: BRAKES:CALIPER
Recall Description: DUE TO CONTACT BETWEEN THE BRAKE CALIPER OF THE INBOARD FRONT WHEEL AND THE FRONT STABILIZER BAR, THERE MAY BE INCREASED BRAKE PEDAL TRAVEL FOLLOWING LOW SPEED TURNING MANEUVERS.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CAUSE A REDUCTION IN BRAKE PERFORMANCETHAT COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL ACORN TYPE FRONT SUSPENSION STRUT NUTS TO ELIMINATE STABILIZER BAR TO BRAKE CALIPER CONTACT.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:EMERGENCY EXIT LABEL
Recall Description: EMERGENCY EXIT LABEL IS MISSING ON ENTRANCE DOOR AND/OR EXIT DOOR FOR USE AS EMERGENCY EXIT.  PUSH OUT WINDOW INSTRUCTION LABEL DOES NOT START WITH THE WORDS EMERGENCY EXIT.
Consequence Summary: BUSES ARE NOT IN COMPLIANCE WITH FMVSS 217.
Corrective Action: INSTALL MISSING LABELS AND REPLACE INCORRECT LABELS.

Subject: STEERING:COLUMN COUPLING
Recall Description: THERE MAY BE EXCESSIVE TORQUING OF THE LOWER STEERING COLUMN PINCH BOLTS.
Consequence Summary: BOLTS COULD FRACTURE, ADVERSELY AFFECTING STEERINGCONTROL WHICH COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SUSPECT PINCH BOLTS.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:ARM:PITMAN
Recall Description: CERTAIN STEERING GEAR PITMAN ARM PINCH BOLTS MAY BE DEFECTIVE; ALSO, TORQUING MAY HAVE BEEN ABOVE SPECIFICATION.
Consequence Summary: BOLTS COULD FAIL RESULTING IN LOSS OF STEERING CONTROLWITH POTENTIAL FOR AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE PITMAN ARM PINCH BOLTS.

Subject: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:SPRING:COIL AND ATTACH
Recall Description: IMPROPERLY HEAT TREATED REAR SUSPENSION KNUCKLES COULD EXPERIENCE HIGH MILEAGE FATIGUE CRACKS AND EVENTUAL FRACTURE.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN REAR SUSPENSION FAILURE AT THEAFFECTED WHEEL WITH AN ADVERSE AFFECT ON CONTROL OF THE CAR, WHICH COULDCAUSE AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE KNUCKLES THAT HAVE THE AFFECTED LOT CODES.

Subject: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:SPRING:COIL AND ATTACH
Recall Description: INCORRECTLY WELDED SUSPENSION BRACKETS TO THE AXLE HOUSING MAY CAUSE PREMATURE FAILURE OF THE HOLDING BRACKET WELD.
Consequence Summary: A FAILURE OF THE AXLE/BRACKET WELD MAY PERMIT THE AXLETO MOVE FROM ITS INTENDED POSITION ON THE VEHICLE AFFECTING VEHICLE CONTROL.THIS COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSPECT AND REPAIR OR REPLACE AXLES WHICH CONTAIN THE DEFECT. ALSO, AS A PRECAUTION FOR SAFE OPERATION, A TEMPORARY CONTAINMENT DEVICE WHICH WILL MAINTAIN SAFE VEHICLE CONTROL IN THE EVENT THAT AN AXLE BRACKET WELD FAILS.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:TRAILER HITCHES AND ATTACHM
Recall Description: THERE MAY BE BELOW SPECIFIED TORQUE ON THE TRAILER HITCH ATTACHING FASTENERS, ALLOWING THE TRAILER HITCH TO MOVE UNDER TOWING LOADS.
Consequence Summary: FASTENERS COULD FAIL; IF THIS OCCURS WHILE TRAILERIS BEING PULLED, HITCH AND TRAILER COULD SEPARATE AND A VEHICLE CRASH COULDOCCUR WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: CORRECT TORQUE IN TRAILER HITCH FASTENERS TO PREVENT TRAILER SEPARATION.

Subject: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT ATTACHING MECHANISMS
Recall Description: TORQUE ROD BOLTS ARE GRADE 2 INSTEAD OF GRADE 5, WHICH IS NOT TO SPECIFICATION, AND COULD FAIL.
Consequence Summary: BOLT FAILURE COULD ALLOW THE REAR AXLE TO SHIFT; THISCOULD ADVERSELY AFFECT TRUCK CONTROL AND COULD RESULT IN A CRASH.
Corrective Action: REPLACE TORQUE ROD BOLTS WITH BOLTS OF THE PROPER SPECIFICATION.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC SYSTEM
Recall Description: UNEQUAL BRAKING MAY OCCUR ON THE FRONT, DRIVE AND TAG AXLES.
Consequence Summary: THIS WOULD AFFECT BRAKING EFFECTIVENESS WITH UNNECESSARYSKIDDING DURING HARD BRAKING WITH POTENTIAL FOR AN ACCIDENT AND PERSONAL INJURY.
Corrective Action: REPAIR IN A MANNER THAT WILL BALANCE BRAKING AND PREVENT UNNECESSARY SKIDDING.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:TRAILER HITCHES AND ATTACHM
Recall Description: HAIRLINE CRACK ON THE INSIDE RADIUS OF THE EYE END OF THE S HOOK ON THE TRAILER CHAIN.
Consequence Summary: SHOULD THE S HOOK FAIL, THE SAFETY CHAIN WOULD NOT BECAPABLE OF RETAINING THE TRAILER SHOULD IT UNCOUPLE FROM THE TOWING VEHICLE.
Corrective Action: THE MANUFACTURER WILL REPLACE CRACKED HOOKS ON ASSEMBLIES AS REQUIRED.

Subject: HEATER:WATER:DEFROSTER:DEFOGGER:HOSE
Recall Description: HEATER HOSE MAY BE INCORRECTLY ROUTED.
Consequence Summary: HOSE COULD WEAR THROUGH AND LEAK WHICH COULD RESULT INAN UNDERHOOD FIRE.
Corrective Action: REROUTE AND SPLICE HOSE AS NECESSARY.

Subject: STRUCTURE:FRAME:MEMBERS AND BODY
Recall Description: THE ATTACHMENT MEANS FOR THE DIAGONAL BRACING OF THE LANDING GEAR SUPPORT STRUCTURE ARE INADEQUATE.
Consequence Summary: THERE WOULD BE A PROGRESSIVE REDUCTION IN THE RIDIGITYOF THE LANDING GEAR OVER TIME, WHICH COULD LEAD TO COLLAPSE OF THE GEAR ANDSERIOUS INJURY TO INDIVIDUALS WORKING ABOUT OR IN THE TRAILER.
Corrective Action: REINFORCE ATTACHMENT POINTS OF THE DIAGONAL BRACING.

Subject: AIR CONDITIONER:OTHER PART
Recall Description: MOUNTING FOR AIR CONDITIONER AUXILLIARY FUEL TANK MAY BE FAULTY.
Consequence Summary: FUEL TANK COULD SEPARATE FROM THE BUS WITH POTENTIAL FORA FIRE.
Corrective Action: MODIFY AIR CONDITIONER FUEL TANKS AND BRACKET TO PREVENT SEPARATION.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:IGNITION:SWITCH:NEUTRAL START
Recall Description: THE NEUTRAL BY PASS SWITCH WHICH ALLOWS THE NEUTRAL START SAFETY SWITCH TO BE OVERRIDDEN VIOLATES THE FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 102.
Consequence Summary: SHOULD THE NEUTRAL START SWITCH BE OVERRIDDEN AND THEBUS ENGINE STARTED WHILE IN GEAR, IT IS POSSIBLE FOR THE BUS TO MOVEUNEXPECTEDLY.  THIS COULD RESULT IN A VEHICLE ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: ON VEHICLES WITH AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION, THE SWITCH IS TO BE DISCONNECTED.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL SYSTEM OTHER PARTS
Recall Description: FUEL PUMP SHUTOFF SWITCH MAY BE INCORRECTLY MOUNTED AS TO ITS VERTICAL POSITION.
Consequence Summary: VANS WOULD NOT BE IN CONFORMANCE WITH FMVSS 301.
Corrective Action: REMOUNT FUEL PUMP SHUT OFF SWITCH IN THE PROPER VERTICAL POSITION.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:CAP:FILLER
Recall Description: A CRACK MAY DEVELOP ADJACENT TO THE FUEL TANK SEAM WELD ATTACHING THE TANK END CAP.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN A LEAK OR DRIPPING FROM THE FUELTANK WITH POTENTIAL FIRE HAZZARD.
Corrective Action: INSTALL LIMITER CUSHIONS ON THE TANK SUPPORT BRACKETS OR REPLACE TANK, IF NECESSARY.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL
Recall Description: THERE MAY BE INSUFFICIENT CLEARANCE BETWEEN A CLAMP ON A VACUUM HOSE AND THE THROTTLE LINKAGE.
Consequence Summary: ON RAPID APPLICATION OF FULL THROTTLE, LINKAGE COULD BINDAGAINST A CLAMP AND RESULT IN LOSS OF ACCELERATOR CONTROL, WHICH COULD CAUSE ANACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REROUTE VACUUM HOSE AND SHORTEN VACUUM PIPE.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT
Recall Description: PRE DYNAMIC TEST BUCKLE RELEASE FORCE IS LOWER THAN REQUIRED BY FMVSS 213 CHILD RESTRAINT SYSTEM.
Consequence Summary: FAILURE TO MEET REQUIREMENT OF FMVSS 213, MAY NOT RETAINCHILD IN SEAT IN THE EVENT OF A VEHICLE CRASH.
Corrective Action: OWNERS WILL BE INSTRUCTED TO RETURN SEATS TO THEIR DEALERS FOR A NEW SEAT OR A FULL REFUND.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:BATTERY:CABLE
Recall Description: THE POSITIVE BATTERY CABLE COULD DEVELOP A SHORT CIRCUIT DUE TO EXCESSIVE WEAR AND CHAFING IF ROUTED IN A CERTAIN POSITION.
Consequence Summary: IF THIS CONDITION EXISTS, THE CABLE MIGHT OVERHEAT,POSSIBLY TO A DEGREE WHICH MIGHT CAUSE A VEHICLE FIRE.
Corrective Action: THE POSITIVE BATTERY CABLE WILL BE REPLACED ON ALL SUBJECT VEHICLES.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:METALLIC
Recall Description: REAR AXLE BRAKE TUBE FLARE WAS INCORRECTLY MANUFACTURED, A SINGLE FLARE TYPE INSTEAD OF A DOUBLE FLARE TYPE WAS USED.
Consequence Summary: THE SINGLE FLARE MAY FAIL AFTER EXTENDED USE; THISFAILURE WOULD CAUSE THE REAR AXLE BRAKES TO BECOME INOPERATIVE, INCREASING STOPPING DISTANCE WHICH COULD CAUSE AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: THE DOUBLE FLARE TUBE WILL BE INSTALLED TO REPLACE THE SINGLE FLARE TUBE.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:SPEED CONTROL
Recall Description: WHEN USING THE CRUISE CONTROL THE ACCELERATOR CABLE TENSION MAY ALLOW THE CABLE TO SAG AND BECOME ENTANGLED WITH THE WATER PIPE BRACKET IMPEDING ITS RETURN TO IDLE POSITION.
Consequence Summary: FAILURE TO RETURN TO IDLE POSITION COULD LEAD TO ANACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: THE PRESENT ACCELERATOR CABLE BRACKET WILL BE REPLACED.

Subject: LIGHTING:SWITCH:MULTI-FUNCTION SWITCH:TURN SIGNAL
Recall Description: TURN SIGNAL SWITCH IN LEFT TURN MODE MAY NOT ALWAYS MAKE PROPER ELECTRICAL CONTACT.
Consequence Summary: THIS PROVIDES NO SIGNAL TO TRAFFIC, AND MAY CAUSE ANACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSPECT AND REPLACE SUSPECT TURN SIGNAL SWITCHES.

Subject: WHEELS:MULTIPLE:LUGS:NUTS:BOLTS
Recall Description: IMPROPER GRADE OF STEEL WAS USED AND WHEN HEAT TREATED STUDS FAILED TO MEET STRENGTH AND HARDNESS REQUIREMENTS.
Consequence Summary: THE SOFT STUD MAY FAIL TO RETAIN THE HUB AND WHEELASSEMBLY AND AN ACCIDENT MAY RESULT.
Corrective Action: THE STUDS WILL BE REPLACED WITH PROPERLY STRENGTHEN STUDS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AND BELT
Recall Description: INCORRECT FLOOR REINFORCEMENT WASHERS WERE USED TO INSTALL THE REAR SOFA SEAT BELT BAR.
Consequence Summary: WASHERS MAY NOT TOLERATE STRESS LOADS AS SET FORTH INSAE TEST PROCEDURES.
Corrective Action: REPLACE INCORRECT REINFORCEMENT WASHERS.

Subject: WHEELS:MULTIPLE:LUGS:NUTS:BOLTS
Recall Description: INSTALLED CAPSCREW HEAD COULD SEPARATE FROM THE BODY DUE TO HYDROGEN EMBRITTLEMENT DURING THE PLATING PROCESS.
Consequence Summary: BRAKE COULD BECOME LOOSE ON THE WHEEL CAUSING FAILUREOF THE BRAKES WHICH COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE BRAKE DRUM CAPSCREW AND PROPERLY TORQUE.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT
Recall Description: RESTRAINT SYSTEM FAILED TO MEET THE 70 DEGREE MAXIMUM BACK SUPPORT ANGLE REQUIREMENT OF FMVSS 213 DYNAMIC TESTS IN THE MOST RECLINED POSITION WHEN USED WITH A LAP BELT ONLY.
Consequence Summary: FAILURE TO MEET TEST REQUIREMENT MAY RESULT IN INJURYIN A CRASH.
Corrective Action: A CHANGE OF NEW INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS ISSUED. THE CHILD SEATS ARE NOT TO BE USED IN THE MOST RECLINED POSITION WITH LAP BELTS ONLY. WARNING LABEL WILL BE MAILED UPON REQUEST.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING
Recall Description: NYLON TIES THAT SUPPORT THE MAIN WIRING HARNESS TO THE CHASSIS COULD WEAR AND BREAK DUE TO EXCESSIVE VIBRATION. THUS, WIRING HARNESS COULD FALL ON ENGINE COMPONENTS AND SHORT CIRCUIT.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CAUSE LOSS OF ELECTRICAL SYSTEM WHICH COULDRESULT IN AN UNDERHOOD FIRE.
Corrective Action: INSTALL RETROFIT RIT OF PLASTIC-COATED METAL CLAMPS, LOOM FOR POSITIVE BATTERY CABLES AND RE-ROUTE WIRING.

Subject: LIGHTING:SWITCH:BUTTON:RING:TURN SIGNAL LIGHTS
Recall Description: UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS WHEN APPLYING TURN SIGNAL SWITCH AND TURNING STEERING WHEEL, A TURN SIGNAL COMPONENT COULD DRAG ACROSS THE FACE OF THE TURN SIGNAL DETENT PLATE.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESTRICT FREE MOVEMENT OF THE STEERING WHEEL,WHICH MAY RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE DEFECTIVE CANCELING PLATES AND REMOVE ANY DEBRIS PRESENT IN LOWER STEERING COLUMN SHAFT.

Subject: LIGHTING:SWITCH:BUTTON:RING:OTHER PART LIGHTING SY
Recall Description: UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS WHEN APPLYING TURN SIGNAL SWITCH AND TURNING STEERING WHEEL, A TURN SIGNAL COMPONENT COULD DRAG ACROSS THE FACE OF THE TURN SIGNAL DETENT PLATE.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESTRICT FREE MOVEMENT OF THE STEERING WHEELWHICH WOULD EFFECT STEERING CONTROL AND COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE DEFECTIVE CANCELING PLATES AND REMOVE ANY DEBRIS PRESENT IN LOWER STEERING COLUMN SHAFT.

Subject: SUSPENSION:TANDEM AXLE:REAR
Recall Description: IMPROPERLY ASSEMBLED AXLE SUSPENSION BRACKETS COULD CAUSE BRACKET SEPARATION FROM THE AXLE HOUSING.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN PARTIAL LOSS OF BUS CONTROL AND ACRASH WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: INSTALL AN AXLE STRAP OR REPLACE AXLE.

Subject: STEERING:POWER ASSIST:HOSE:FLUID
Recall Description: MOTORHOMES ARE SUBJECT TO ROAD AND ENGINE VIBRATIONS.
Consequence Summary: EXCESSIVE VIBRATION COULD FATIGUE POWER STEERING HOSECAUSING A LOSS OF POWER ASSIST TO THE STEERING FUNCTION.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A STABILIZING BRACKET FOR THE POWER STEERING HOSE.

Subject: STEERING:POWER:GEAR BOX
Recall Description: STEERING GEAR MOUNTING BOLTS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN TIGHTENED TO THE PROPER TORQUE VALUE AND COULD LOOSEN AND INTERFERE WITH THE PITMAN ARM ON STEERING GEAR.
Consequence Summary: THIS INTERFERENCE COULD RESULT IN THE LOSS OF STEERINGCONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: RETIGHTEN OR REPLACE MOUNTING BOLTS.

Subject: SUSPENSION:TANDEM AXLE:REAR
Recall Description: TRUCKS MAY HAVE INSUFFICIENT WELD MATERIAL ATTACHING REAR SUSPENSION BRACKET TO THE REAR AXLE HOUSING.
Consequence Summary: REAR SUSPENSION BRACKET COULD SEPARATE FROM THE AXLEAND RESULT IN A LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REWELD REAR SUSPENSION BRACKETS.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR:ANTILOCK SYSTEM
Recall Description: ONE OR BOTH ABS HYDRAULIC UNIT MOUNTING BOLTS MAY NOT BE PROPERLY SEATED AND COULD LOOSEN.
Consequence Summary: THIS CONDITION COULD LEAD TO SEPARATION OF THE ABSHYDRAULIC UNIT FROM THE MOUNTING BRACKET AND RESULT IN LOSS OF BRAKE FUNCTIONAND A CRASH WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: REPLACE BOTH ABS HYDRAULIC UNIT MOUNTING BOLTS.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR:ANTILOCK SYSTEM
Recall Description: LEFT FRONT BRAKE PIPE MAY CONTACT THE CRUISE CONTROL SERVO BRACKET.
Consequence Summary: BRAKE LINE COULD WEAR THROUGH CAUSING LOSS OF BRAKEFLUID AND PARTIAL LOSS OF BRAKING CAPABILITY; THIS COULD RESULT IN A VEHICLECRASH.
Corrective Action: REPLACE LEFT FRONT BRAKE PIPE ASSEMBLY.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: CLOSE PROXIMITY OF CERTAIN HOSES TO HIGH HEAT EMITTED FROM THE CATALYTIC CONVERTER WOULD CAUSE THE HOSE TO DETERIORATE.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN A SUDDEN LOSS OF POWER, CREATINGTHE POSSIBILITY OF A REAR END CRASH.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A HEAT SHIELD OVER THE CATALYTIC CONVERTER TO PROTECT THE HOSES FROM HEAT DETERIORATION.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL LINES:METALLIC
Recall Description: PROCESS USED FOR CONNECTING THE GAS LINES WAS SUBSTANDARD.
Consequence Summary: A GAS LEAK COULD DEVELOP CREATING A FIRE POTENTIAL.
Corrective Action: INSTALL STANDARD GAS LINE COMPRESSION FITTINGS.

Subject: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT CONTROL ARM:LOWER
Recall Description: FRONT SUSPENSION CROSSMEMBER MAY CORRODE AND FAIL AT LOWER CONTROL ARM REAR PIVOT MOUNTS IF OPERATED WHERE SALT IS USED TO AID IN SNOW REMOVAL.
Consequence Summary: CONTROL ARM COULD DETACH FROM THE CROSSMEMBER, ADVERSELYAFFECTING DIRECTIONAL STABILITY, WHICH COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL ATTACHMENT REINFORCEMENT BRACKETS TO PREVENT CONTROL ARM DETACHMENT AS A RESULT OF CORROSION WEAKENING.

Subject: TIRES:EMERGENCY SPARE TIRE
Recall Description: SPARE TIRE CARRIER MAY FAIL IN SERVICE ALLOWING THE TIRE AND WHEEL ASSEMBLY TO DROP ONTO THE GROUND.
Consequence Summary: THIS WOULD CREATE A SAFETY HAZARD AND/OR ROADOBSTRUCTION.
Corrective Action: REPAIR TO PREVENT TIRE CARRIER FAILURE.

Subject: ENGINE:FLYWHEEL
Recall Description: A CRACK MAY REDUCE STRUCTURAL STRENGTH OF THE FLYWHEEL.
Consequence Summary: FLYWHEEL FAILURE COULD CAUSE PERSONAL INJURY TOOCCUPANTS AND/OR LOSS OF TRUCK CONTRL AND RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REMOVE AND REPLACE ALL SUSPECT FLYWHEELS.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL RETURN SPRING
Recall Description: THROTTLE RETURN SPRINGS ARE SUBJECT TO FATIGUE AND COULD FAIL.
Consequence Summary: FAILURE OF BOTH SPRINGS CAUSES LOSS OF TRUCK CONTROL ANDCOULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THROTTLE RETURN SPRINGS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT RETRACTORS
Recall Description: THE LEFT SIDE, REAR SEAT BELT RETRACTOR ASSEMBLY MAY BE IMPROPERLY SECURED AND COULD PULL FREE OF ITS MOUNTING LOCATION.
Consequence Summary: OCCUPANT, THOUGH STILL RESTRAINED BY THE LAP PORTION OFTHE BELT, WOULD NOT HAVE UPPER BODY PROTECTION.
Corrective Action: REINSTALL THE RETRACTOR ATTACHMENT BOLT.

Subject: LIGHTING:SWITCH:MULTI-FUNCTION SWITCH:TURN SIGNAL
Recall Description: UNDER CERTAIN DRIVING CONDITIONS, MICRO SWITCH CONNECTED TO BRAKE PEDAL MAY FAIL CAUSING THE BRAKE LIGHT NOT TO PROVIDE CORRECT BRAKING SIGNALS.
Consequence Summary: LAMPS WOULD EITHER REMAIN CONTINUOUSLY ILLUMINATED ORFAIL TO ILLUMINATE AND FAILING TO WARN OTHER DRIVERS THAT THE VEHICLE WASSTOPPING, WHICH COULD CAUSE AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL AN IMPROVED STOP LAMP SWITCH AND MODIFY WIRING, AS APPROPRIATE.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:ARM:PITMAN
Recall Description: THE RETAINER THAT SECURES THE PITMAN ARM TO THE STEERING GEAR OUTPUT SHAFT MAY HAVE INSUFFICIENT TORQUE AND COULD WORK LOOSE.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CAUSE THE PITMAN ARM TO SEPARATE FROM THESTEERING GEAR AND RESULT IN LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: RETORQUE PITMAN ARM RETAINER.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC:LEVER AND LINKA
Recall Description: THE RETAINER THAT SECURES THE AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION CONTROL ROD LINKAGE TO THE STEERING COLUMN LOWER SHIFT LEVER MAY LOOSEN AND COULD DISENGAGE.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN SEPARATION OF CONTROL ROD FROMLOWER SHIFT LEVER.  ALSO, SHIFT INDICATOR MAY NOT REFLECT GEAR THE TRANSMISSIONIS IN CREATING AN ACCIDENT POTENTIAL.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A TRANSMISSION LINKAGE RETAINER.

Subject: LIGHTING:LIGHT AND COMMUNICATIONS:REFLECTIVE DEVIC
Recall Description: THE CONTOURED SIDE CLEARANCE LAMP ASSEMBLY DID NOT HAVE THE REQUIRED REFLEX REFLECTOR MOLDED INTO THE LAMP LENS.
Consequence Summary: TRAILERS WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 108.
Corrective Action: INSTALL SELF ADHESIVE MOUNTED REFLEX REFLECTORS.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING
Recall Description: DUE TO CONTACT OF THE METAL SLIDE OF THE LOWER DRAWER IN THE BEDROOM CLOSET WITH A 110-VOLT WIRE FROM THE ELECTRICAL CONVERTER, INSULATION MAY BE STRIPPED FROM THE WIRE.
Consequence Summary: A SHORT COULD DEVELOP AND RESULT IN A FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPAIR TO ELIMINATE CONTACT WITH WIRE FROM ELECTRICAL CONVERTER.

Subject: STRUCTURE:DOOR ASSEMBLY
Recall Description: THE ENTRANCE DOOR EMERGENCY RELEASE MECHANISM MAY EXCEED THE 20 LB. FORCE ALLOWED BY FMVSS 217.
Consequence Summary: BUSES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH STANDARD.
Corrective Action: REPAIR RELEASE CABLE MECHANISM TO COMPLY WITH STANDARD.

Subject: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:NON-POWER AXLE:SPINDLE
Recall Description: FRACTURE OF THE SPINDLE END AND SEPARATION OF THE DUAL WHEELS FROM THE VEHICLE.
Consequence Summary: WHEEL SEPARATION WOULD NOT AFFECT THE CONTROL ORSTABILITY OF THE TRACTOR/TRAILER SINCE OTHER AXLES WOULD SUPPORT THE VEHICLE.THE SEPARATION WOULD CONSTITUTE A HAZARD TO OTHER ROADWAY USERS, BYSTANDERSAND ADJACENT PROPERTY.
Corrective Action: INSPECT AND REPLACE AXLE WHERE NECESSARY.

Subject: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR
Recall Description: AN INCORRECT NUMBER OF BOLTS WAS USED TO FASTEN THE REAR AXLE TO THE FRAME RAILS.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD ALLOW THE SPRING HANGER TO BECOME DETACHEDFROM THE RAILS AND CAUSE THE REAR AXLE TO SEPARATE FROM THE MOTORHOME, CAUSINGLOSS OF CONTROL WHICH MAY RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL THE CORRECT NUMBER OF FASTENING BOLTS.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:BATTERY:OTHER PART
Recall Description: BATTERY CABLES AND WIRE LOOMS CAN RUB AGAINST FRONT ROADSIDE MUD FLAP BRACKET, AND/OR ONE OF THE BATTERY CABLE CLAMP BOLTS.
Consequence Summary: THIS CREATES THE POTENTIAL FOR ELECTRICAL SHORTS AND AFIRE HAZARD.
Corrective Action: MODIFY MUD FLAP BRACKET AND/OR CABLE CLAMP BOLT TO AVOID INTERFERENCE WITH BATTERY CABLES.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:BATTERY:OTHER PART
Recall Description: INSULATION ON A BATTERY CABLE CAN CHAFE, SHORTING THE CONDUCTOR TO GROUND.
Consequence Summary: THIS CREATES A POTENTIAL FIRE HAZARD.
Corrective Action: REPAIR OR REPLACE CONDUCTOR.

Subject: EMERGENCY PARKING BRAKE:OTHER PART
Recall Description: PARKING BRAKE MECHANISM COMPONENT MAY DISENGAGE.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF PARKING BRAKE FUNCTION;ALSO, LOOSE COMPONENT COULD JAM IN THE PARKING BRAKE ASSEMBLY.
Corrective Action: REPLACE PARKING BRAKE ASSEMBLY.

Subject: LPG LINES
Recall Description: RUBBER GASOLINE HOSE USED TO ACCOMMODATE RELOCATION OF THE FUEL TANK IS SUBJECT TO DETERIORATION OVER TIME.
Consequence Summary: A LEAK IN A DETERIORATED RUBBER LINE COULD SPRAY GASOLINEUNDERNEATH THE CHASSIS AND RESULT IN AN UNDERCARRIAGE FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE RUBBER GASOLINE LINE WITH NYLON LINE.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:SPEED CONTROL
Recall Description: SPEED CONTROL LEVER RETURN SPRING MAY FAIL.
Consequence Summary: FAILURE OF THE SPEED CONTROL LEVER RETURN SPRING COULDCAUSE LOSS OF CONTROL OF THE ENGINE SPEED, WHICH COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACEMENT OF THE SPEED CONTROL LEVER RETURN SPRING.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:AIR SUPPLY:RESERVOIR:WET:DRY
Recall Description: TOTAL CAPACITY OF AIR BRAKE RESERVOIR MAY BE SLIGHTLY LESS THAN REQUIRED BY FMVSS 121.
Consequence Summary: TRUCKS WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH STANDARD.
Corrective Action: REPAIR TO ASSURE CORRECT TOTAL CAPACITY OF AIR BRAKE RESERVOIRS.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:OTHER PART
Recall Description: TRAILER WIRING HARNESS CONNECTOR COULD CAUSE INTERMITTENT OR TOTAL FAILURE OF TRAILER BRAKE LIGHTS OR ALL OF THE TRAILER LIGHTS.
Consequence Summary: THIS WOULD AFFECT OTHER DRIVERS ABILITY TO SEE THETRAILER AND COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE TRAILER WIRING HARNESS CONNECTOR.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:BELTS
Recall Description: FRONT SEAT BELT LATCH PLATES MAY NOT ENGAGE THE BUCKLE ASSEMBLIES.
Consequence Summary: IN EVENT OF AN ACCIDENT, UNBELTED OR IMPROPERLY BELTEDOCCUPANTS ARE MORE AT RISK TO INJURY THAN IF BELTS ARE PROPERLY BUCKLED.
Corrective Action: REPLACE IMPROPERLY FUNCTIONING BUCKLE ASSEMBLIES.

Subject: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT CONTROL ARM UPPER:BAL
Recall Description: THE UPPER BALL JOINT CASINGS ALL OUTSIDE THE CERTIFIED DESIGN HARDNESS.
Consequence Summary: PREMATURE WEAR OF THE CASING AND LOOSENING OR SEPARATIONOF THE BALL FROM THE CASING CAN RESULT IN LOSS OF VEHICLE STEERING CONTROL.THIS COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: THE BALL JOINTS WILL BE REPLACED AT NO COST TO THE CONSUMER.

Subject: TIRES
Recall Description: TIRES ARE SUBJECT TO PROBLEMS IN SHOULDER AREA DUE TO INSUFFICIENT TREAD TO CARCASS ADHESION WHEN SUBJECT TIRE WAS LOADED OVER THE MAXIMUM CARRYING CAPACITY FOR THE INFLATION PRESSURE UTILIZED.
Consequence Summary: THE CARCASS MAY LOSSEN AND COME OFF TIRE WITH THEPOSSIBILITY OF LOSS OF INFLATING AIR.
Corrective Action: TIRES WILL BE REPLACED AT NO COST TO THE CONSUMER WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM DATE OF NOTIFICATION.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER LABELS
Recall Description: THE PUSH OUT WINDOW EXITS ARE MARKED EXIT, NOT EMERGENCY EXIT AS REQUIRED BY FMVSS 217.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLE WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 217.
Corrective Action: INSTALL REPLACEMENT LABELS ON INSIDE LOWER PORTION ON ALL EMERGENCY EXIT WINDOWS.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL
Recall Description: THE ENGINES ARE SUBJECT TO THROTTLE VALVE ICING UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS.
Consequence Summary: THIS MAY CAUSE THE THROTTLE VALVE TO STICK AND NOT ALLOWTHE ENGINE RPM TO RETURN TO IDLE WHICH COULD CAUSE AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A HEATED ADAPTER PLATE.

Subject: STEERING:POWER ASSIST:HOSE:FLUID
Recall Description: AN INCORRECT HIGH PRESSURE POWER STEERING HOSE MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED.
Consequence Summary: UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS, HOSE COULD FAIL RESULTING INLOSS OF POWER STEERING ASSIST AND POSSIBLY AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE INCORRECT POWER STEERING HOSES.

Subject: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:SPRING:COIL AND ATTACH
Recall Description: DOWELS MAY HAVE BEEN OMITTED DURING SPRING CAP INSTALLATION; THIS WOULD PUT SHEAR LOAD ON THE FOUR (4) SPRING CAP BOLTS.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN LOOSENING AND FAILURE OF THE BOLTSWITH POSSIBLE LOSS OF CONTROL AND ACCIDENT POTENTIAL.
Corrective Action: INSTALL THE MISSING DOWELS TO PREVENT MOVEMENT BETWEEN THE SPRING CAP AND AXLE HOUSING.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT
Recall Description: A CAR SEAT FOAM PIECE WHICH IS ATTACHED TO THE PLASTIC SEAT SHELL LOCATED UNDER THE SEAT COVER DOES NOT MEET THE FLAMMABILITY REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 302.
Consequence Summary: THE FOAM PIECE FAILS TO MEET FULLY THE REQUIREMENT OFSTANDARD 302.
Corrective Action: A FOAM PIECE WHICH MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 302 WILL BE FORWARDED TO EACH CONSUMER.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS
Recall Description: HYDROGEN EMBRITTLEMENT OF THE SCREWS USED TO HOLD TOGETHER SECTIONS OF THE VALVE BODY.  THIS CONDITION CAUSES THE HEADS OF THE SCREWS TO BREAK OFF UNDER STRESS.
Consequence Summary: THE LOSS OF THE SCREW HEADS ALLOWS THE VALVE TO COMEAPART AND CAUSES LOSS OF BRAKING ABILITY, WHICH COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: SCREWS WILL BE REPLACED WITH A PHOSPHATE AND OIL TREATED SCREW RATHER THAN AN ELECTRO DEPOSITED PLATING.  THE DRIVE HEADS WILL BE CHANGED FROM SQUARE DRIVE TO A TORX HEAD SCREW.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES:ACCELERATOR:FLEXIBLE
Recall Description: UNDER CERTAIN OPERATING AND CLIMATIC CONDITIONS, WATER CAN ENTER THE ACCELERATOR CABLE HOUSING AND FREEZE.
Consequence Summary: THROTTLE WOULD NOT CLOSE COMPLETELY WHEN DRIVERS FOOTIS REMOVED FROM THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ACCELERATOR CABLE WITH A NEW CABLE THAT IS DESIGNED TO PREVENT WATER INTRUSION.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL
Recall Description: THROTTLE BLADE ICING MAY OCCUR DURING EXTENDED HIGHWAY DRIVING AT TEMPERATURES BELOW 10 DEGREES F.
Consequence Summary: ICE FORMATION CAN PREVENT THROTTLE BLADE FROM CLOSINGTO THE IDLE POSTION WHEN THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL IS RELEASED, CREATING APOTENTIAL FOR LOSS OF CONTROL, WHICH COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL ANCHOR PLATE UNDER BASE OF THROTTLE; HEATED ENGINE COOLANT WILL BE FLOWED THROUGH AN ADAPTER PLATE TO ELIMINATE ICE FORMATION ON THE THROTTLE BLADE.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:STANDARD:MANUAL
Recall Description: DUE TO THE DESIGN OF THE TRANSMISSION CASE DIPSTICK AND THE FLUID LEVEL CHECKING METHOD, THERE MAY BE INSUFFICIENT LUBRICATION OF THE 4 WHEEL DRIVE EXTENSION HOUSING BEARING.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CAUSE BEARING SEIZURE AND POSSIBLE REAR WHEELLOCKUP, WHICH COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL MODIFIED DIPSTICK AND INSERT INFORMATION IN OWNERS MANUAL ON THE CORRECT FLUID LEVEL CHECKING PROCEDURES.

Subject: STEERING:WHEEL AND COLUMN
Recall Description: DUE TO THE SUBSTITUTION OF A SPACER FOR A RETAINER ON THE STEERING WHEEL ASSEMBLY, THE SPACER COULD BREAK ALLOWING THE STEERING WHEEL TO SEPARATE FROM THE MOUNTING HUB.
Consequence Summary: SEPARATION OF THE STEERING WHEEL WHILE THE TRUCK ISMOVING, STEERING CONTROL WOULD BE LOST AND A CRASH COULD RESULT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL RETAINER IN PLACE OF SPACER.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:OTHER
Recall Description: REAR AXLE BRAKE TUBES (EITHER SIDE) CAN FATIGUE CAUSING A LOSS OF FLUID IN THE REAR BRAKE SYSTEM.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN REDUCED BRAKING CAPABILITY WITHPOTENTIAL FOR AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW BRAKE PIPE ASSEMBLIES WITH REDESIGNED MOUNTING BRACKETS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT BELTS:LAP:REAR
Recall Description: SEAT TETHER BELT 11.0 INCHES LONG WAS INSTALLED INSTEAD OF THE 8.5 INCHES LONG BELT REQUIRED FOR THIS CHASSIS.
Consequence Summary: INCORRECT LENGTH BELT MAY NOT PROPERLY RESTRAIN OCCUPANTAND WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 210.
Corrective Action: INSTALL CORRECT 8.5 INCH SEAT TETHER BELT.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:OTHER
Recall Description: CURVED SPRING WASHERS OR ECCENTRIC WASHERS MAY HAVE BEEN OMITTED FROM SOME OF THE REAR BRAKE SIDE PLATE ASSEMBLIES.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN DECREASED BRAKING PERFORMANCEWHICH COULD REDUCE STOPPING DISTANCE AND INCREASE THE POTENTIAL FOR AN  ACIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SIDECAR REAR BRAKE BACKING PLATE ASSEMBLY.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:PEDAL
Recall Description: THE COTTER PIN THAT HOLDS IN PLACE THE HINGE PIN, WHICH CONNECTS THE BRAKE TREADLE (PEDAL) TO THE FLOOR MOUNTING PLATE, MAY HAVE BEEN OMITTED.
Consequence Summary: THE HINGE PIN COULD WORK ITSELF OUT OF THE HINGE,ALLOWING THE BRAKE TREADLE TO SEPARATE FROM THE FLOOR MOUNTING; DRIVER WOULDNOT BE ABLE TO APPLY THE BRAKES WITH THE FOOT VALVE, RESULTING IN A POTENTIALFOR AN ACCIDENT
Corrective Action: REPLACE ANY MISSING COTTER PIN AT THE BRAKE TREADLE HINGE PIN.

Subject: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:LEAF SPRING:U-BOLT
Recall Description: AN INCORRECT 3/4 INCH BOLT WAS INSTALLED ON RT/RS 450 SUSPENSION.
Consequence Summary: THIS BOLT MAY BREAK, CAUSING DISENGAGEMENT OF THE BEAM CONNECTION OF REAR SUSPENSION, RESULTING IN LOSS OF CONTROL, WHICH COULD  RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: RETROFIT CHASSIS WITH 1 INCH BOLTS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AND BELT
Recall Description: WHEN SEAT BELTS ARE NOT BEING WORN, ABRADING OF THE WEBBING MAY OCCUR AT THE D-RING.
Consequence Summary: SEAT BELT MAY NOT PROPERLY RESTRAIN OCCUPANT IN CASEOF AN ACCIDENT WHICH COULD RESULT IN MORE SERIOUS INJURIES.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SEAT BELT WEBBING.

Subject: STEERING:WHEEL AND COLUMN
Recall Description: DUE TO THE SUBSTITUTION OF A SPACER FOR A RETAINER ON THE STEERING WHEEL ASSEMBLY, THE SPACER COULD BREAK ALLOWING THE STEERING WHEEL TO SEPARATE FROM THE MOUNTING HUB.
Consequence Summary: SEPARATION OF THE STEERING WHEEL WHILE THE TRUCK ISMOVING, STEERING CONTROL WOULD BE LOST AND A CRASH COULD RESULT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL RETAINER IN PLACE OF SPACER.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: THE OPTIONAL RIDE SYSTEM COMPONENT CAN ABRADE THE FLEXIBLE BRAKE HOSE THAT IS ROUTED FROM THE DIFFERENTIAL HOUSING TO THE CROSSMEMBER TO THE REAR OF THE REAR AXLE.
Consequence Summary: ABRASION MAY CAUSE HOSE TO LOSE BRAKE FLUID AND THE REARWHEEL BRAKES TO BECOME INOPERABLE, INCREASING STOPPING DISTANCE WHICH MAY RESULTIN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: RELOCATE FLEXIBLE BRAKE HOSE AND REPLACE INCORRECT FASTENERS.

Subject: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:SWAY BAR
Recall Description: THE BOLTS, WASHERS, AND NUTS USED TO INSTALL THE OPTIONAL REAR SWAY BAR ARE INCORRECT.
Consequence Summary: FASTENERS MAY SEPARATE AND ALLOW REAR SWAY BAR TO FALLTO THE ROAD SURFACE, CAUSING A ROAD HAZARD WHICH MAY RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE INCORRECT FASTENERS.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:PEDAL
Recall Description: INCORRECT INSTALLATION OF A CIRCLIP HOLDING THE BRAKE PEDAL PIVOT SHAFT COULD ALLOW THE CIRCLIP TO DISENGAGE AND THE PIVOT SHAFT TO MOVE ENOUGH FOR THE BRAKE PEDAL TO MOVE FROM ITS DESIGNED POSITION.
Consequence Summary: ALTHOUGH FULL BRAKING ACTION CAN STILL BE OBTAINED,DRIVER ALARM FROM THE INCORRECTLY POSITIONED PEDAL COULD RESULT IN ANINAPPROPRIATE ACTION BY THE DRIVER WHICH COULD CAUSE AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPAIR CIRCLIP INSTALLATION TO PREVENT ITS DISENGAGEMENT.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT TRACK ANCHORS AND SEATS
Recall Description: DRIVERS SEAT FRAME MAY EXPERIENCE FATIGUE FAILURE AT ONE (FRONT/OUTBOARD) OF ITS FOUR ATTACHMENTS.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN SOME FORWARD, BACKWARD OR LATERALMOVEMENT OF SEAT, CREATING A POTENTIAL FOR LOSS OF CONTROL OF THE VEHICLEWHICH COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT
Corrective Action: REPLACE DRIVERS SEAT FRAME WITH A STRENGHTENED VERSION; ALSO, REINFORCE POWER ADJUSTER FRONT CROSSMEMBER TO INCREASE RIGIDITY OF SEAT ATTACHMENT SYSTEM.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SHOULDER BELTS
Recall Description: DRIVERS SEAT AND/OR SHOULDER BELT LOCKING MECHANISM MAY NOT OPERATE.
Consequence Summary: IN A CRASH, AFFECTED BELTS WOULD NOT LOCK, THEREBYINCREASING THE POSSIBILITY OF INJURY TO THE SEAT OCCUPANT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A NEW DRIVERS SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:OTHER
Recall Description: BOLTS THAT ATTACH THE FRONT AXLE TRACK BAR BRACKET TO THE FRONT CROSSMEMBER MAY LOOSEN, ALLOWING THE FRONT WHEELS TO OSCILLATE WITH FRONT END SHIMMY.
Consequence Summary: SEVERE SHIMMY COULD DAMAGE STEERING LINKAGE OR STEERINGGEAR, WHICH COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL REDESIGNED FRONT AXLE TRACK BAR TO CROSSMEMBER BRACKET AND IF NECESSARY, REPLACE CERTAIN STEERING COMPONENTS.

Subject: TIRES
Recall Description: TIRES FAIL TO MEET REQUIREMENTS FOR THE A-TEMPERATURE GRADE.
Consequence Summary: FAILURE TO MEET GRADE A-TEMPERATURE REQUIREMENTS.
Corrective Action: REPLACE WITH NEW TIRE AT NO COST TO CONSUMER.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC SYSTEM
Recall Description: TAG AXLE HYDRA VAC BRAKE BOOSTER MOUNTING BRACKET MAY CRACK AND FAIL.
Consequence Summary: SHOULD THE MOUNTING BRACKET BREAK A LOSS OF POWER ASSISTWOULD OCCUR IN THE TAG AXLE BRAKING SYSTEM.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A REINFORCEMENT PLATE TO THE BOOSTER MOUNTING BRACKET.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL SYSTEMS
Recall Description: FUEL INJECTION SEALS MAY HARDEN, DUE TO HIGH TEMPERATURE AND ALCOHOL IN SOME FUELS, AND ALLOW FUEL TO ESCAPE INTO THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT.
Consequence Summary: FUEL DRIPPING ONTO HOT ENGINE COMPONENTS COULD CAUSE ANENGINE COMPARTMENT FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ENGINES FUEL INJECTOR SEALS WITH IMPROVED SEALS PLUS IMPROVEMENTS DESIGNED TO BETTER INSULATE THE ENGINE AGAINST FIRE RISK.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL:PEDAL
Recall Description: ACCELERATOR PEDALS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN PROPERLY ATTACHED TO THE FLOOR PAN DURING ASSEMBLY.
Consequence Summary: UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS, PEDAL MAY BECOME STUCK AND NOTFULLY RETURN TO THE IDLE POSITION WHEN THE DRIVER REMOVES HIS FOOT FROM THEPEDAL CAUSING LOSS OF CONTROL, WHICH COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: COMPLETELY SEAT LUGS IN THE RECESSES OF THE FLOOR PAN TO ASSURE PROPER ATTACHMENT OF THE GAS PEDAL.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT RETRACTORS
Recall Description: RETRACTOR HOUSING ON SEAT BELT MAY INTERFERE WITH THE SEAT CUSHION.
Consequence Summary: IF SEAT BELT RETRACTOR FAILED TO LOCK IN AN EMERGENCY,DRIVER MAY NOT BE RETAINED AND PERSONAL INJURY MAY RESULT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A SPACER TO ELIMINATE ANY INTERFERENCE BETWEEN THE SEAT CUSHION AND THE SEAT BELT RETRACTOR HOUSING.

Subject: STEERING:WHEEL AND COLUMN
Recall Description: DUE TO THE SUBSTITUTION OF A SPACER FOR A RETAINER ON THE STEERING WHEEL ASSEMBLY, SPACER COULD BREAK ALLOWING THE STEERING WHEEL TO SEPARATE FROM THE MOUNTING HUB.
Consequence Summary: IF STEERING WHEEL SEPARATED WHILE THE TRUCK WAS MOVING,STEERING CONTROL WOULD BE LOST AND A CRASH COULD RESULT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL RETAINER IN PLACE OF THE SPACER.

Subject: SUSPENSION:AXLE UNKNOWN:NON-POWER:AXLE ASSEMBLY
Recall Description: DUE TO METAL FATIGUE, CRACKING AND BREAKING OF THE FRONT AXLE BEAM CENTER COULD OCCUR.
Consequence Summary: SHOULD FATIGUE CRACK IN THE BEAM COMPLETELY BREAK ORRUPTURE DURING NORMAL OPERATION IT COULD LEAD TO LOSS OF CONTROL AND THEPOSSIBILITY OF VEHICLE CRASH.
Corrective Action: THE AXLE BEAM CENTERS WILL BE REPLACED ON ALL INVOLVED VEHICLES.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC:COOLING UNIT AN
Recall Description: THERE MAY BE INTERFERENCE OF THE TRANSMISSION CROSS SILL WITH THE TRANSMISSION OIL COOLER LINE.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN CHAFFING OF THE TRANSMISSION OILCOOLER LINE.
Corrective Action: ROTATE ELBOW FITTING TO PREVENT INTERFERENCE.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:WINDSHIELD WIPER ARM
Recall Description: WHILE IN OPERATION AT SPEEDS ABOVE 35 MPH, THE WIPER ARM WILL LIFT OFF THE SURFACE OF THE WINDSHIELD.
Consequence Summary: DRIVER VISIBILTY WOULD BE ADVERSELY AFFECTED, WHICHCOULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW WINDSHIELD WIPER ARM ASSEMBLY.

Subject: EXHAUST SYSTEM:PIPE:EXHAUST
Recall Description: EXHAUST HEAT SHIELD WAS NOT INSTALLED IN PRODUCTION.
Consequence Summary: THE LACK OF THIS SHIELD CAN ALLOW FALLING REFUSE TO CAUSEA VEHICLE FIRE.
Corrective Action: INSTALL AN EXHAUST PIPE HEAT SHIELD.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL LINES:METALLIC
Recall Description: ROUTING OF FUEL LINE COULD ALLOW IT TO CONTACT THE ELECTRICIAL CONNECTION ON THE STARTER SOLENOID.
Consequence Summary: SUCH CONTACT COULD RESULT IN A TRUCK FIRE.
Corrective Action: REROUTE FUEL LINE AND SECURE AWAY FROM STARTER SOLENOID.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AND BELT
Recall Description: BOLTS MAY BE MISSING FROM THE UPPER MOUNTING BRACKET OF THE 3 POINT SEAT BELT.
Consequence Summary: AN OCCUPANT WOULD NOT BE PROPERLY RESTRAINED IN ANEMERGENCY AND TRUCKS WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 210.
Corrective Action: INSTALL MISSING BOLTS.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:FUSE AND RECEPTICLE:CIRCUIT BREA
Recall Description: THE MONITOR PANEL, TV ANTENNA BOOSTER, FURNACE AND RADIO CIRCUITS MAY HAVE BEEN IMPROPERLY FUSED AT THE CONVERTER AND BATTERY.
Consequence Summary: THERE WOULD NOT BE PROPER PROTECTION FOR THE CIRCUITWIRES WHICH COULD BECOME SHORTED OUT AND PRESENT A FIRE HAZARD.
Corrective Action: REPAIR WIRE CONNECTIONS AND INSURE PROPER FUSING.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL RETURN SPRING
Recall Description: CABLES USED FOR THROTTLE CONTROL ARE SUBJECT TO FAILING IN SERVICE DUE TO VIBRATIONAL FATIGUE BETWEEN THE CABLE END SLEEVE AND HUB.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CAUSE THE CABLE NOT ALLOWING THE THROTTLE TORETURN TO THE IDLE POSTION, WHICH COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SUSPECT THROTTLE CABLES WITH THROTTLE RODS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT TRACK ANCHORS AND SEATS
Recall Description: WITH BOTH PASSENGER SEAT BELTS IN USE, IN THE EVENT A HIGH SPEED COLLISION, THE MIDDLE SEAT BELT ANCHOR NUT AND BOLT MAY PULL THROUGH THE SHEET METAL FLOOR.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 210.
Corrective Action: INSTALL MID ANCHOR REINFORCEMENT TO COMPLY WITH PULL TEST REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 210.

Subject: EMERGENCY PARKING BRAKE
Recall Description: DUE TO IMPROPERLY ASSEMBLED PARKING BRAKE HYDRAULIC SYSTEM, IN COLD WEATHER HIGH OIL BACK PRESSURE MAY OCCUR; WHEN ENGINE IS STARTED PARTIAL OR FULL RELEASE OF PARKING BRAKE MAY AUTOMATICALLY OCCUR.
Consequence Summary: IF THIS OCCURS WHEN VEHICLE IS PARKED ON AN INCLINE,VEHICLE COULD ROLL DOWN THE INCLINE AND RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT OR PERSONALINJURY.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A NEW HYDRAULIC HOSE AND FITTINGS TO ELIMINATE THE BACK PRESSURE FROM THE SIGNAL PORT WHICH WOULD PRECLUDE ANY FALSE SIGNAL TO THE PARKING BRAKE.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AND BELT
Recall Description: THE ADJUSTABLE LENGTH TETHER BELT INSTALLED BETWEEN THE DRIVERS SEAT BELT ATTACHMENT ON SEAT FRAME AND ANCHORAGE ATTACHMENT POINT FAILED TO MEET REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 207.
Consequence Summary: TETHER BELT LENGTH FAILED TO MEET REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS207.  THIS COULD RESULT IN THE UNLATCHING OF THE SEAT ADJUSTMENT MECHANISM.
Corrective Action: THE TETHER BELT WILL BE ADJUSTED TO THE PROPER LENGTH ON AFFECTED VEHICLES.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:TRAILER HITCHES AND ATTACHM
Recall Description: WELDS THAT ATTACH TUBE AND CHAIN BRACKET TO CROSSMEMBER ASSEMBLY WERE POROUS AND INADEQUATE IN SIZE.
Consequence Summary: FAILURE OF WELDS COULD LEAD TO SUDDEN SEPARATION OF THETRAILER FROM THE TOWING VEHICLE.
Corrective Action: HITCHES ARE TO BE RETURNED FOR REPLACEMENT OF CROSSMEMBERS AT NO COST TO THE CONSUMER.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:PIPE:FILLER:NECK
Recall Description: SEAL BETWEEN FUEL FILL TUBE AND FUEL TANK MAY ALLOW A SLOW GASOLINE LEAK.
Consequence Summary: IN THE PRESENCE OF AN IGNITION SOURCE THIS COULD RESULTIN A FIRE.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A REDESIGNED FILL TUBE WITH A LONGER TUBE LENGTH, TO BE INSERTED FARTHER INTO THE TANK, WHICH WILL ASSURE A POSITIVE SEAL BETWEEN TUBE AND FUEL TANK.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER LABELS
Recall Description: INFLATION PRESSURE RECOMMENDED FOR REAR WHEELS WILL NOT SUPPORT REAR GAWR.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 120.
Corrective Action: SEND NOTIFICATION LETTER WITH A REVISED TIRE PLACARD INDICATING APPROPRIATE TIRE INFLATION PRESSURES.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL PUMP
Recall Description: THE DIAPHRAGM MATERIAL OF THE MECHANICAL FUEL PUMPS MAY DETERIORATE AND ALLOW THE DIAPHRAGM TO RUPTURE.
Consequence Summary: FUEL PUMPED THROUGH THE RUPTURED DIAPHRAGM AND OUT OFTHE VENT OPENING COULD RESULT IN A FIRE.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW MECHANICAL FUEL PUMPS WITH IMPROVED DIAPHRAGM MATERIAL AND REVISE WIRING FOR ELECTRIC FUEL PUMP CIRCUITS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AND BELT
Recall Description: WEBBING ON THE BUCKLE PORTION OF THE REAR LAP/SHOULDER BELTS MAY BE TOO LONG.
Consequence Summary: IN THE EVENT OF A SEVERE VEHICLE CRASH, THE EFFECTIVENESSOF THE LAP/SHOULDER BELT MAY BE REDUCED.
Corrective Action: REPLACE REAR INBOARD SEAT BELTS WITH BELTS OF THE PROPER LENGTH.

Subject: LIGHTING:SWITCH:BUTTON:RING:BRAKE LIGHTS
Recall Description: PLASTIC PIN AND/OR ADJUSTABLE STOP BOLT WHICH ACTIVATE FRONT/REAR BRAKE LIGHT SWITCHES COULD CAUSE SWITCH FAILURE.
Consequence Summary: BRAKE LIGHT WOULD NOT FUNCTION; THUS, A CRASH INVOLVINGANOTHER VEHICLE COULD OCCUR.
Corrective Action: MODIFY FRONT HAND BRAKE LEVER; PLACE A CAP ON REAR BRAKE STOP BOLT; AND REPLACE FRONT AND REAR BRAKE LIGHT SWITCHES WITH NEWER SWITCH.

Subject: LIGHTING:GENERAL OR UNKNOWN COMPONENT:SIDE MARKER
Recall Description: FRONT SIDE MARKER LAMPS WERE UNINTENTIONALLY EQUIPPED WITH CLEAR BULBS, INSTEAD OF AMBER COLORED BULBS AS SPECIFIED IN FMVSS 108.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH STANDARD.
Corrective Action: REPLACE CLEAR BULBS WITH AMBER COLORED BULBS.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:EMERGENCY EXIT LABEL
Recall Description: ADDITIONAL LABELING OF EMERGENCY EXIT INSTRUCTIONS IS NEEDED TO COMPLY WITH FMVSS 217 REQUIREMENTS.
Consequence Summary: BUSES DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 217.
Corrective Action: INSTALL ADDITIONAL EMERGENCY EXIT LABELING.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:PIPE:FILLER:NECK
Recall Description: FUEL RETURN LINES COULD FRACTURE AND ALLOW FUEL TO LEAK IN THE AREA OF THE FUEL TANK.
Consequence Summary: IN PRESENCE OF AN IGNITION SOURCE, THIS CONDITION COULDRESULT IN A FIRE.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW FUEL RETURN PIPE ASSEMBLY.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK
Recall Description: A FUEL TANK LEAK COULD OCCUR DUE TO SMALL CREASES ON THE TANK UNDERSIDE CRACKING DURING PRESSURE CYCLING WHICH OCCURS DURING NORMAL OPERATION.
Consequence Summary: IN PRESENCE OF AN IGNITION SOURCE, THIS CONDITION COULDRESULT IN A FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FUEL TANK.

Subject: TIRES:TREAD
Recall Description: TREAD SEPARATION FROM BODY OF TIRE.
Consequence Summary: IF TREAD SEPARATION OCCURS IT COULD RESULT IN RAPID LOSSOF INFLATING AIR AND POSSIBLE VEHICLE CRASH.
Corrective Action: TIRES WILL BE RECALLED AND MONEY REFUNDED.

Subject: FUEL:CARBURETOR:PROPANE/GAS
Recall Description: CONTAMINATION OF PROPANE GAS ATTACKS RUBBER COMPONENTS.
Consequence Summary: CAUSES DETERIORATION IN THE RUBBER COMPONENTS IN THEVAPORIZATION SYSTEM OF PROPANE POWERED VEHICLES AND COULD ALLOW LIQUID PROPANETO FLOW THROUGH CARBURETOR AND BE RELEASED THROUGH THE AIR FILTER RESULTING INTHE POSSIBILITY OF A FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE LOCKOFF VALVE ON ALL VEHICLES USING THE AFFECTED PRODUCT.  ALSO, INSPECT HIGH PRESSURE HOSE, CONVERTER AND LOW PRESSURE HOSE CONNECTING THE CONVERTER TO THE CARBURETOR; IF DAMAGE IS FOUND REPLACE THE ABOVE COMPONENTS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:BELTS
Recall Description: AUTOMATIC PASSIVE RESTRAINT SYSTEM MAY NOT OPERATE DUE TO A PAYOUT MOTOR DEFECT IN THE SAFETY BELT RETRACTOR ASSEMBLY.
Consequence Summary: AUTOMATIC OPERATION OF PASSIVE RESTRAINT SYSTEM WOULDBECOME INTERMITTENT OR COMPLETELY INOPERATIVE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY.

Subject: STEERING:WHEEL AND COLUMN
Recall Description: STEERING WHEEL/SHAFT DESIGNED TO USE SURFACE FRICTION MAY LOOSE THIS FRICTION IF GREASE OR OIL IS PRESENT ON THE CONESHAPED SURFACE OF THE STEERING SHAFT.
Consequence Summary: IF THE ABOVE CONDITION IS PRESENT AND THE STEERING WHEELNUT IS TORQUED LOWER THAN SPECIFIED, BREAK OF THE FRICTION LOCK COULD RESULT INLOOSENING AND SEPARATION OF THE STEERING WHEEL.
Corrective Action: REMOVE THE STEERING WHEEL OF VEHICLES AND CLEAN FRICTION SURFACE AND INSTALL A SPRING RETAINER, REPLACE THE STEERING WHEEL NUT WITH A SELF LOCKING NUT.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL FILTER LINE
Recall Description: FUEL FILTER MAY NOT MEET THE SPECIFICATION CONCERNING LEAKAGE CRITERIA DUE TO LOW TEMPERATURE DURING THE GLUING PROCESS.
Consequence Summary: FUEL FILTER MAY LEAK CREATING A POTENTIAL FIRE HAZARD.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FUEL FILTER.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL EMISSION CONTROL:CANISTER
Recall Description: DUE TO CLOSE PROXIMITY OF FUEL EMISSION CANISTER TO THE CATALYTIC CONVERTER, VAPOR RELEASED FROM THE FUEL TANK MAY NOT BE CONSUMED AT THE ENGINE IN AN IDLE SITUATION.
Consequence Summary: A FIRE COULD OCCUR IF FUMES ARE CONCENTRATEDSUFFICIENTLY.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A NEW CANISTER SYSTEM POSITIONED FORWARD UNDER THE STEPWELL OF THE ENTRY DOOR.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:OTHER PART
Recall Description: THE MILITARY NATO SLAVE RECEPTACLE IS NOT WATERPROOF AND WHEN SUBMERGED IN WATER A CURRENT PATH IS CREATED.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN A DIRECT ELECTRICAL SHORT CIRCUITAND THE POTENTIAL FIRE HAZARD OF THE NATO SLAVE RECEPTACLE.
Corrective Action: DISCONNECT NATO SLAVE RECEPTACLE TO PREVENT FIRE HAZARD.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: AIR BRAKE HOSES FAILED WATER ABSORPTION AND TENSILE STRENGTH TEST OF FMVSS 106.
Consequence Summary: TRAILERS DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 106.
Corrective Action: REPLACE DEFECTIVE BRAKE HOSE ASSSEMBLY.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:ATTACHMENTS
Recall Description: FUEL RESERVOIR SHIELDS, THAT PROTECT THE RESERVOIR FROM CONTACT BY THE TRANSFER CASE IN CERTAIN FRONTAL IMPACTS, WERE NOT INSTALLED.
Consequence Summary: FUEL SPILLAGE IN EXCESS OF THAT PERMITTED BY FMVSS 301COULD OCCUR.
Corrective Action: INSTALL FUEL RESERVOIR PROTECTIVE SHIELDS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT BELTS:LAP:FRONT
Recall Description: SEAT BELT LATCH STALK (COATED WIRE CABLE BETWEEN THE SEAT BELT LATCH AND VEHICLE FLOOR ON THE INBOARD SIDE OF THE FRONT SEATS) CAN BECOME DAMAGED AND COULD BREAK AFTER EXTENSIVE BENDING.
Consequence Summary: BREAKAGE OF THE LATCH STALK WOULD PREVENT THE SEAT BELTFROM RESTRAINING THE OCCUPANT IN THE EVENT OF A SUDDEN STOP OR CRASH.
Corrective Action: INSTALL REPLACEMENT COMPONENTS.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:WINDSHIELD WIPER
Recall Description: UNDER HIGH AMBIENT TEMPERATURES FRONT WINDSHIELD WIPER CONTACT UNIT COULD LOOSEN AND BECOME DISLODGED.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN WINDSHIELD WIPER FAILURE AND WOULDAFFECT DRIVER VISIBILITY.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A CONTACT UNIT HOLDER THAT WOULD PREVENT LOOSENING.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:UNKNOWN TYPE
Recall Description: THERE MAY BE STRUCTURAL INTEGRITY PROBLEMS WITH THE SHIFTER FORKS USED IN THE TRANSMISSIONS.
Consequence Summary: SHIFTER FORKS MIGHT FRACTURE, CAUSING THE TRANSMISSION TOMALFUNCTION, AND POSSIBLY CAUSE THE REAR WHEEL TO LOCK UP; THIS COULD RESULT INAN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE SHIFTER FORKS IN THE TRANSMISSION.

Subject: ENGINE COOLING SYSTEM:FAN
Recall Description: ENGINE COOLING FAN IS SUBJECT TO HIGH STRESS AND POTENTIAL FATIGUE PROBLEMS.
Consequence Summary: FAN FAILURE COULD RESULT IN PARTS BEING PROPELLED OUTSIDEOF THE FAN SHROUD, WHICH COULD INJURE THE PERSON STANDING NEAR THE ENGINECOMPARTMENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FAN WITH AN ALTERNATE FAN.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:TRAILER HITCHES AND ATTACHM
Recall Description: WELDS THAT ATTACHED TUBE AND CHAIN BRACKET TO CROSSMEMBER ASSEMBLY WERE POROUS AND INADEQUATE IN SIZE.
Consequence Summary: FAILURE OF WELDS COULD LEAD TO SUDDEN SEPARATION OF THETRAILER FROM THE TOWING VEHICLE.
Corrective Action: HITCHES ARE TO BE RETURNED FOR REPLACEMENT OF CROSSMEMBERS AT NO COST TO CONSUMER.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT BELTS:LAP:FRONT
Recall Description: MOVABLE PART OF SEAT IS NOT STRONG ENOUGH TO SUPPORT THE SEAT BELT.
Consequence Summary: SEAT BELT MAY NOT PROPERLY RESTRAIN DRIVER.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A TETHER STRAP.

Subject: EMERGENCY PARKING BRAKE:MECHANICAL:LINKAGES AND CA
Recall Description: THE PARKING BRAKE CABLE MAY BE DISCONNECTED FROM THE LEFT REAR BRAKE CALIPER.
Consequence Summary: PARKING BRAKE CANNOT BE PROPERLY APPLIED AND VEHICLEWILL NOT MEET THE GRADE HOLDING REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 105.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A RETAINER ON LEFT REAR CALIPER IF CABLE IS NOT ALREADY RETAINED WITH A COTTER PIN AND ADJUST PARKING BRAKE SYSTEM.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:OTHER PART
Recall Description: GROUNDING OF THE AC POWER SOURCE MAY BE DEFECTIVE (OR THERE MAY BE NO ELECTRICAL GROUNDING AT THE AC POWER SOURCE).
Consequence Summary: ANYONE COMING INTO PHYSICAL CONTACT WITH THE TRUCK WHILEIT IS CONNECTED TO A NON GROUND AC POWER SOURCE MAY RECEIVE AN ELECTRICAL SHOCKSUFFICIENT TO CAUSE PERSONAL INJURY OR DEATH.
Corrective Action: REWIRE ENGINE BLOCK HEATER TO ASSURE PROPER GROUNDING.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:AIR SUPPLY:GAUGE:AIR PRESSURE
Recall Description: USE OF THE AIR HORN CAN CAUSE THE AIR PRESSURE TO DROP BELOW 85 PSI.
Consequence Summary: IF AIR PRESSURE DROPS BELOW 85 PSI WHILE THE VEHICLE ISBEING DRIVEN THE REAR BRAKE SPRING CHAMBERS WILL START TO APPLY CAUSING THEREAR BRAKE DRUMS TO OVERHEAT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL PRESSURE PROTECTION VALVES IN ALL AIR HORN CIRCUITS.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:HARNESS:UNDER DASH
Recall Description: WIRING HARNESS MAY CHAFE AGAINST SHARP EDGES UNDER THE DASHBOARD AND AGAINST A SUPPORT UNDER THE REAR SEAT (1988 MODELS ONLY).
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD CAUSE A SHORT CIRCUIT; THE RESULTING HEATBUILDUP COULD CAUSE SMOKE OR A FIRE IN THE PASSENGER COMPARTMENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL RUBBER PROTECTIVE STRIPS TO SHARP EDGES AND COMPLETELY ENCASE WIRE HARNESS IN A PROTECTIVE PLASTIC TUBE.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:LIFT:WRECKER
Recall Description: THE L BAR LATCH WAS OF LESSER STRENGTH THAN SPECIFIED.
Consequence Summary: DUE TO THIS CONDITION A FATIGUE FRACTURE OF THE LATCHCOULD OCCUR WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.  IF A VEHICLE WAS BEING TOWED IT COULD BEDROPPED AND RESULT IN A VEHICLE CRASH.
Corrective Action: ALL LATCHES WILL BE REPLACED ON AFFECTED WHEEL LIFT UNITS.

Subject: STRUCTURE:TONGUE DOLLY
Recall Description: CRACKS MAY OCCUR IN THE MATERIAL OF THE TONGUE MOUNT WHERE THREE ONE INCH HOLES ARE LOCATED TO ACCOMMODATE RUBBER GROMMETS.
Consequence Summary: TONGUE MOUNT COULD FAIL AND RESULT IN TRAILER SEPARATION.
Corrective Action: REALIGN, REINFORCE, AND WELD FRACTURED PART.

Subject: SUSPENSION:TANDEM AXLE:REAR:SUPPORT BAR:CROSS TUBE
Recall Description: AXLE SYSTEM IS SUBJECT TO CRACKING OF CROSS TUBES AND TRAILING ARMS, AS WELL AS FAILURE OF MOUNTING BOLTS.
Consequence Summary: FAILURE OF THE TAG AXLE WILL REDUCE THE LOAD CARRYINGCAPABILITY OF THESE BUSES.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW AXLE SYSTEM.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:PEDAL
Recall Description: FASTENERS THAT RETAIN THE BRAKE PEDAL TO THE PIVOT TUBE MAY NOT HAVE BEEN PROPERLY TORQUED.
Consequence Summary: BRAKE PEDALS COULD DETACH FROM THE PIVOT TUBE WHILE TRUCKIS IN OPERATION WHICH COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REINSTALL BRAKE PEDAL CLAMP FASTENERS WITH LOCTITE AND TORQUE PROPERLY.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:OTHER
Recall Description: NUTS THAT RETAIN THE STEERING AND TIE ROD ARMS MAY CRACK WHILE TIGHTENING, DUE TO A DEEP BAR DEFECT.
Consequence Summary: STEERING CAPABILITIES COULD BE ADVERSELY AFFECTED.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE STEERING LEVER NUTS.  IF NUTS ARE CRACKED, MOUNTING STUDS WILL ALSO BE REPLACED.

Subject: STRUCTURE:DOOR:EMERGENCY:ROOF
Consequence Summary: EMERGENCY DOOR WOULD BECOME NON OPERATIONAL IF C CLIPSCAME LOOSE AND FELL OFF.
Corrective Action: INSTALL C CLIPS OF THE PROPER SIZE.

Subject: ENGINE:MOUNTS
Recall Description: CERTAIN ENGINE SUPPORT CASTINGS WERE PRODUCED WITH FAULTY METALLURGY AND COULD FAIL.
Consequence Summary: FAILURE OF ONE OR BOTH BRACKETS COULD CAUSE DISLOCATIONOF ENGINE AND TRANSMISSION ASSEMBLY, WHICH COULD RESULT IN TRUCK DISABLEMENT,POSSIBLE LOSS OF ACCELERATOR CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE REAR ENGINE SUPPORTS AS NECESSARY.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT
Recall Description: A FOREIGN OBJECT OR SUBSTANCE CAN CAUSE THE WHITE LOCK LEVER TO BE STUCK IN THE DOWN POSITION AT THE TIME THE CHEST SHIELD IS UNBUCKLED TO REMOVE THE CHILD.
Consequence Summary: SHOULDER BELT COULD RETRACT TOO FAR MAKING IT DIFFICULTTO REMOVE THE CHILD.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A BELT BUTTON WHICH ACTS AS A STOP, LIMITING THE RETRACTION OF THE SHOULDER BELT.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL LINES:HOSES:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: FUEL FEED HOSE COULD LEAK AT THE COUPLING ON THE ENGINE END OF THE HOSE ASSEMBLY.
Consequence Summary: FUEL LEAKAGE INTO THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT COULD RESULT INAN ENGINE COMPARTMENT FIRE THAT COULD SPREAD TO THE PASSENGER COMPARTMENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW FUEL FEED HOSE ASSEMBLY.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL SYSTEM OTHER PARTS
Recall Description: THERE MAY BE INSUFFICIENT WELD WHERE THE STEP IS WELDED TO THE FUEL TANK.
Consequence Summary: WELD CRACKS COULD EVENTUALLY CAUSE STEPS TO DISENGAGEAND POSSIBLY INJURE PERSONS ENTERING OR LEAVING THE TRUCK.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FUEL TANK STEPS WITH CRACKS; MODIFY OTHERS TO PREVENT STEP FROM SEPARATING FROM THE TANK.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:ATTACHMENTS
Recall Description: PLASTIC ROLLOVER VALVE MOUNTING PLATE MAY NOT BE PROPERLY SEALED TO THE PLASTIC FUEL TANK.
Consequence Summary: FUEL OR VAPOR COULD LEAK, WHICH COULD RESULT IN A VEHICLEFIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FUEL TANK.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT BUCKLES
Recall Description: SEAT BELT BUCKLES MAY NOT PROPERLY LATCH ALLOWING THE LATCH PLATE TO BE REMOVED FROM THE BUCKLE WITHOUT PRESSING THE RELEASE BUTTON.
Consequence Summary: IN EVENT OF A SUDDEN STOP OR COLLISION, SEAT BELT COULDRELEASE, INCREASING THE RISK OF INJURY TO OCCUPANTS.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SEAT BELT BUCKLES.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:DRIVESHAFT
Recall Description: FRONT DRIVESHAFT FLANGE BOLTS MAY LOOSEN.
Consequence Summary: THIS CAN RESULT IN SEPARATION OF THE DRIVESHAFT FROM THETRANSMISSION AND DAMAGE TO THE GEAR SELECTOR.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE DRIVESHAFT FLANGE BOLTS AND NUTS; MODIFY THE JOINT BETWEEN THE DRIVESHAFT AND TRANSMISSION.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:ARM:PITMAN
Recall Description: STEERING ARM MAY FAIL IF USED ON EATON EFA12F4 FROM AXLE IN CONJUNCTION WITH ROSS HFB70 POWER STEERING GEAR.
Consequence Summary: A FAILED STEERING GEAR ARM COULD LEAD TO LOSS OF VEHICLECONTROL AND VEHICLE CRASH.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A NONADJUSTABLE 1500 PSI POWER STEERING PUMP PRESSURE RELIEF VALVE TO LIMIT STEERING ARM FORCES.  REPLACE STEERING ARM WITH A DESIGN CAPABLE OF WITHSTANDING HIGHER FORCES.  ADJUST MAXIMUM POPPET VALVE SETTINGS TO 500 PSI AND ADJUST AXLE STOPS.

Subject: LIGHTING:LAMP OR SOCKET:TURN SIGNAL LIGHTS
Recall Description: INSTALLATION OF TWO OPTIONAL REAR SIDE TURN SIGNAL LIGHTS INCREASED THE BULB LOAD ON THE COMBINATION TURN/HAZARD FLASHER FROM 8 TO 10 BULBS, WHEN OPERATED IN THE HAZARD MODE.
Consequence Summary: FLASHER DID NOT MEET THE HAZARD FLASHER PERFORMANCE TESTREQUIREMENTS SPECIFIED IN FMVSS 108.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A COMBINATION TURN/HAZARD FLASHER THAT COMPLIES WITH THIS STANDARD.

Subject: STEERING:POWER ASSIST:BELT
Recall Description: THE V BELT PULLEY, WHICH DRIVES THE HYDRAULIC PUMP PROVIDING POWER ASSIST FOR STEERING AND HYDRAULIC BRAKES, CAN FAIL.
Consequence Summary: LOSS OF POWER ASSIST TO THE STEERING AND POWER ASSIST TOHYDRAULIC BRAKES CAN RESULT IN A VEHICLE CRASH WITHOUT WARNING.
Corrective Action: INSTALL DIFFERENT PULLEY AND REINFORCE POWER STEERING PUMP MOUNTING.

Subject: STEERING:POWER:SHAFT SECTOR
Recall Description: STEERING DRIVE SHAFT WAS NOT PROPERLY ASSEMBLED TO THE STEERING GEAR UNIT.
Consequence Summary: THIS MISASSEMBLAGE DOES NOT ALLOW PROPER ENGAGEMENT OFTHESE STEERING COMPONENTS.
Corrective Action: REPAIR MISASSEMBLAGE OF STEERING COMPONENTS AND PROPERLY TORQUE STEERING FASTENERS.

Subject: WHEELS:HUB
Recall Description: ONE OR MORE OF THE FOUR BRAKE DISC MOUNTING BOLTS COULD LOOSEN AND CONTACT THE BRAKE CALIPER BRACKET WITH SEVERE FRONT BRAKE USAGE.
Consequence Summary: WHEEL HUB COULD CRACK AND BRAKE DISC MAY SEPARATE FROMTHE HUB, RESULTING IN LOSS OF FRONT BRAKING.
Corrective Action: INSTALL AN IMPROVED FRONT WHEEL HUB.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:WINDSHIELD WIPER LINKAGE:PIVOT:DRIV
Recall Description: WINDSHIELD FRAME METAL MAY CRACK AT THE WIPER ARM PIVOT MOUNTINGS DUE TO METAL STRESS DURING WIPER OPERATION.
Consequence Summary: THIS CAN CAUSE DISLOCATION AND BINDING OF THE WIPERSYSTEM LINKAGE WHICH, IN INCLEMENT WEATHER, COULD AFFECT DRIVER VISIBILITY ANDRESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: RETROFIT WITH A WINDSHIELD FRAME REINFORCEMENT AT THE WIPER PIVOT LOCATIONS AND REDESIGNED LINKAGE COMPONENTS TO REDUCE STRESS AT THE PIVOT MOUNTINGS.

Subject: SUSPENSION:TANDEM AXLE:REAR
Recall Description: THE UNDERSIZED WELD ON THE REAR SUSPENSION BRACKETRY ATTACHMENT CAN CAUSE BRACKET FAILURE.
Consequence Summary: BRACKET FAILURE CAN ALLOW THE SPRING ASSEMBLY TO BERELEASED ONTO THE ROADWAY, POSSIBLY RESULTING IN LOSS OF CONTROL AND ANACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ANY HOUSINGS THAT HAVE SINGLE PASS (UNDERSIZED) WELDS ON THE BRACKETRY ATTACHMENT.

Subject: WHEELS:OTHER
Recall Description: FASTENERS THAT HOLD THE REAR WHEEL TO THE HUB AND DRUM ASSEMBLY MAY BE IMPROPERLY TORQUED.
Consequence Summary: AN UNDERTORQUED FASTENER WILL LOOSEN UP AND CAN RESULT INWHEEL SEPARATION, LOSS OF CONTROL, AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: PROPERLY TORQUE REAR WHEEL SPACE FASTENERS.

Subject: LPG LINES
Recall Description: LEAK IN LP GAS SERVICE LINE CAUSED BY LINE CONTACTING REAR SUSPENSION SYSTEM WHICH RESULTS IN LINE RUPTURE.
Consequence Summary: A RUPTURED LINE WOULD RELEASE LP GAS TO THE ATMOSPHERECREATING THE POSSIBILITY OF AN EXPLOSION AND/OR FIRE AND POTENTIAL PERSONALINJURY TO ANY OCCUPANT OR PERSON IN CLOSE PROXIMITY OF THE MOTORHOME.
Corrective Action: THE LP GAS SERVICE LINE WILL BE RELOCATED TO PRECLUDE CONTACT WITH THE REAR SUSPENSION SYSTEM.

Subject: TIRES
Recall Description: INCORRECT CURE PROCEDURE DURING MANUFACTURING PROCESS.
Consequence Summary: THIS CONDITION COULD CAUSE TIRE TO DEVELOP A RAPID LOSSOF AIR IN THE SHOULDER AREA OF THE TIRE.
Corrective Action: TIRE WILL BE REPLACED AT NO COST TO THE CONSUMER WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM DATE OF NOTIFICATION.

Subject: EXHAUST SYSTEM:MUFFLER:RESONATOR
Recall Description: HEAT SHIELD WAS INSTALLED ON LOWER SIDE OF MUFFLER INSTEAD OF THE UPPER SIDE.
Consequence Summary: THE HEAT SHIELD ASSISTS IN DISSIPATION OF HEAT FROM THEUPPER PORTION OF THE MUFFLER.  WITHOUT THE HEAT SHIELD, THE MUFFLER MIGHTCONTACT THE TRUNK OF THE CAR, DAMAGING THE CONTENTS.
Corrective Action: A HEAT SHIELD WILL BE INSTALLED ON THE UPPER PORTION OF THE MUFFLER.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:LINES AND FITTINGS
Recall Description: IN ADDING AN AIR TRACTOR PACKAGE TO THE STANDARD AIR OVER HYDRAULIC BRAKE SYSTEM A MIX OF PIPE FITTINGS WAS MADE WHICH WERE INCOMPATIBLE WITH THE PIPE THREADS ON THE VEHICLES AIR BRAKE SYSTEM.
Consequence Summary: THIS CONDITION COULD RESULT IN AIR LEAKS IN THE BRAKESYSTEM AND REDUCE THE BRAKING ABILITY.
Corrective Action: INSTALL CORRECT FITTINGS AS NECESSARY.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT RETRACTORS
Recall Description: THE SEAT CUSHION MAY INTERFERE WITH THE SEAT BELT RETRACTOR MECHANISM KEEPING IT FROM LOCKING.
Consequence Summary: SEAT BELT WOULD BE INEFFECTIVE AND WOULD NOT RESTRAINOCCUPANT IN EVENT OF A SUDDEN STOP OR ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A SPACER BEHIND THE BELT ASSEMBLY MOUNT.

Subject: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT CONTROL ARM:LOWER:SHA
Recall Description: BOLTS USED IN THE ATTACHMENTS OF THE FRONT SUSPENSION SYSTEM CONTROL ARMS MAY BE DEFECTIVE.
Consequence Summary: IF MORE THAN ONE OF THE THREE BOLTS SHOULD FAIL, LOWERFRONT CONTROL ARM COULD COME LOOSE LEADING TO LOSS OF DIRECTIONAL CONTROL OF AFRONT WHEEL.
Corrective Action: REPLACE BOLTS WITH PROPER SPECIFICATION BOLTS.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM
Recall Description: RESONATORS USED IN MANUFACTURING OF VIGIL II LIGHTBARS MAY CAUSE UNPREDICTABLE OPERATION.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF TURN SIGNALS, HAZARD WARNINGLIGHTS, HIGH BEAM INDICATOR, OR LOW AIR WARNING SIGNAL.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SUSPECT LIGHT BARS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AND BELT
Recall Description: SEAT TETHER BELTS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN ADJUSTED DURING ASSEMBLY.
Consequence Summary: DURING AN IMPACT, DRIVER AND/OR RIDER CAN MOVE FORWARDAND POSSIBLY STRIKE THE WINDSHIELD, EVEN WHEN WEARING A SEAT BELT.
Corrective Action: ADJUST SEAT TETHER BELT IF NECESSARY.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT TRACK ANCHORS AND SEATS
Recall Description: WIRING FOR THE POWER LUMBAR SEAT SYSTEM WAS ROUTED DIRECTLY BENEATH THE SEAT CUSHION SPRINGS AND MAY BE ABRADED BY THE SPRINGS.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN A SHORT CIRCUIT WHICH MAY CREATESUFFICIENT HEAT TO START A FIRE IN THE SEAT CUSHION PAD AND/OR TRIM COVER.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A FUSE WITHIN THE POWER LUMBAR ELECTRICAL CIRCUIT.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:GLASS:WINDOW:REAR-VIEW BACKLIGHT
Recall Description: SLIDING REAR WINDOW MAY CONTAIN GLAZING PANELS WHICH DO NOT MEET REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 205.
Consequence Summary: A FRACTURED WINDOW MAY CONTAIN FRAGMENTS THAT ARE LARGERTHAN THE 425 GRAMS ALLOWED.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SUSPECT WINDOW PANELS.

Subject: STRUCTURE:FRAME:MEMBERS AND BODY:OTHER PARTS
Recall Description: CYLINDER ROD AND ROD JOINTS ARE WELDED, THESE WELDS ARE SUBJECT TO BRITTLE FATIGUE FRACTURE CAUSED BY RAPID COOLING ALSO THE WELD AREA IS CONTAMINATED BY CHROME PLATING.
Consequence Summary: FAILURE OF THE WELDS ALLOWS THE DUMP BODY TO FALL OR THECONTAINER OF REFUSE WILL DROP.
Corrective Action: REPLACE HYDRAULIC CYLINDER WITH NEW CYLINDER.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:POWER ASSIST:BOOSTER
Recall Description: BRAKE BOOSTERS HAVE BEEN IMPROPERLY ASSEMBLED WITH THE TWO HALVES OF THE BOOSTER UNIT INSUFFICIENTLY CONNECTED.
Consequence Summary: BRAKE BOOSTER HALVES COULD SEPARATE UNDER HEAVY BRAKEAPPLICATION AND BRAKING POWER WOULD SUDDENLY DIMINISH WHICH COULD RESULT IN ANACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE BRAKE BOOSTERS AS NECESSARY.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL SYSTEM OTHER PARTS
Recall Description: FUEL ROLLOVER VALVE ASSEMBLY MAY NOT HAVE BEEN INSTALLED.
Consequence Summary: IN EVENT OF AN ACCIDENT IN WHICH VEHICLE BECOMES INVERTEDMISSING VALVE COULD ALLOW FUEL SPILLAGE IN EXCESS OF AMOUNT ALLOWED BY FMVSS 301WHICH COULD RESULT IN A FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FUEL SENDER AND PUMP ASSEMBLY.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT BELTS:LAP:FRONT
Recall Description: AN INCORRECT SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY WAS INSTALLED IN THE DRIVER AND PASSENGER SEATS.
Consequence Summary: MOTORHOMES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 208.
Corrective Action: INSTALL TYPE 2 SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES.

Subject: LIGHTING:FLASHER:TURN SIGNAL
Recall Description: FAILS TO MEET DURABILITY AND FLASH RATE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 108.
Consequence Summary: FAILURE TO PROPERLY SIGNAL DIRECTION OF VEHICLE TOTRAFFIC.  THIS COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REFUND PURCHASE PRICE UPON RETURN OF FLASHER TO THE MANUFACTURER.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT BELTS:LAP:FRONT
Recall Description: SEAT BELT WEBBING MAY CHAFE AS THE SEAT SLIDES BACK AND FORTH.
Consequence Summary: OVER TIME BELT COULD WEAR THROUGH RENDERING ITINEFFECTIVE.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A SPACER FOR ADDITIONAL CLEARANCE BETWEEN THE SEAT BELT AND SEAT FRAME.  REPLACE CHAFED SEAT BELTS AS NECESSARY.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:PEDALS:LINKAGES AND VALVES
Recall Description: AN INCORRECT FRONT AXLE BRAKE VALVE MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED.
Consequence Summary: BRAKING ABILITY OF THE VEHICLE WITHOUT A TRAILER COULDBE REDUCED WHICH COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE LQ4 VALVE WITH A QR1 QUICK RELEASE VALVE.

Subject: LIGHTING:SWITCH:BUTTON:RING:TURN SIGNAL LIGHTS
Recall Description: TURN SIGNAL DOES NOT CANCEL WITH ROTATION OF STEERING WHEEL.
Consequence Summary: THIS CONDITION CAUSES THE VEHICLE TO FAIL TO MEET THEREQUIREMENT OF FMVSS NO. 108.
Corrective Action: A NEW TURN SIGNAL SWITCH DESIGNED TO OPERATE AS REQUIRED BY FMVSS NO. 108 WILL BE INSTALLED.

Subject: STEERING:GEAR BOX
Recall Description: AN INTERNAL FAILURE OF THE STEERING GEAR RESULTING IN EITHER A LOCK UP OR SEPARATION OF THE STEERING MECHANISM.
Consequence Summary: IF EITHER OF THE ABOVE FAILURES OCCUR, IT CAN RESULT INA LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING AND POSSIBLY A VEHICLE CRASH.
Corrective Action: THE SUSPECT STEERING GEAR WILL BE REMOVED AND REPLACED WITH A NEW OR REBUILT GEAR.

Subject: AIR CONDITIONER:OTHER PART
Recall Description: THE HEATER/AIR CONDITIONER BLOWER MOTOR SPEED CONTROL RESISTORS CAN UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS OVERHEAT AND STALL.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN LOW AIR FLOW ACROSS THE RESISTORNETWORK AND HIGH AMPERAGE, ALLOWING THE AIR DUCT TO REACH ELEVATED TEMPERATURESWITH THE POSSIBILITY OF A FIRE.
