Corrective Action: INSTALL A THERMO CUTOFF DEVICE IN THE HEATER/AIR CONDITIONER SYSTEM AND/OR REPLACE THE BLOWER MOTOR SWITCH.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: MELTING OF THE AIR BRAKE LINES CAN OCCUR WHERE THE AIR LINES ROUTE UNDER THE LEFT HAND FRAME RAIL NEAR THE EXHAUST PIPE.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN PARTIAL OR TOTAL LOSS OF SERVICEBRAKES WITHOUT WARNING, WHICH COULD LEAD TO A VEHICLE CRASH.
Corrective Action: REROUTE AIR LINE HARNESS AWAY FROM THE EXHAUST SYSTEM; REPLACE HARNESS IF HEAT DETERIORATION HAS OCCURED.

Subject: TIRES:BEAD
Recall Description: TIRES WERE BUILT WITHOUT THE SPECIFIED BEAD FLIPPER.
Consequence Summary: THE OMISSION OF THE BEAD FLIPPER MAKES THE TIRESUSCEPTIBLE TO CHAFING IN THE RIM FLANGE AREA THIS COULD LEAD TO LOSS OFINFLATING AIR.  THE LOSS OF AIR COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL WITHPOSSIBLE VEHICLE CRASH.
Corrective Action: REPLACE TIRE WITH NEW ONE WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM DATE OF NOTIFICATION.

Subject: BRAKES:FLUID:HYDRAULIC (FLUID CONTAMINATION/WRONG
Recall Description: CONTAMINANTS IN THE HYDRAULIC BRAKE FLUID MAY CAUSE A DECREASE IN THE BRAKE FLUID PRESSURE PRODUCED BY THE MASTER CYLINDER WHEN THE BRAKE PEDAL IS DEPRESSED.
Consequence Summary: A DECREASE IN STOPPING CAPABILITY CAN OCCUR WITHOUTWARNING.
Corrective Action: REMOVE ANY CONTAMINATED BRAKE FLUID AND REPLACE.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEATS
Recall Description: THE DRIVER AND/OR PASSENGER SEATBACKS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN FULLY ATTACHED TO THE SEAT BASE RECLINING ARMS (ATTACHING BRACKETS).
Consequence Summary: THERE MAY BE LOOSENESS OF, OR NOISE IN, THE SEATBACK;ALSO, DURING A SEVERE REAR IMPACT, SEATBACK MIGHT NOT SUPPORT THE OCCUPANT.
Corrective Action: MANUALLY SEAT THE SEATBACK ON THE BASE.

Subject: ENGINE COOLING SYSTEM:HOSES
Recall Description: EXTREME OPERATING CONDITIONS COULD CAUSE PREMATURE DETERIORATION OF THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT HEATER HOSES OR ENGINE BYPASS HOSES.
Consequence Summary: ENGINE COOLANT COULD DISCHARGE ONTO THE ENGINE AND ITSEXHAUST MANIFOLD CREATING THE POTENTIAL FOR A FIRE DUE TO THE HIGH ENGINEEXHAUST MANIFOLD TEMPERATURES.
Corrective Action: REPLACE HOSES AND RADIATOR CAPS; INSTALL HIGH HEAT RESISTANCE ALUMINIZED STAINLESS STEEL MUFFLERS.

Subject: STRUCTURE:FRAME:MEMBERS AND BODY:OTHER PARTS
Recall Description: LUGGAGE RACK ABOVE THE SEATS PROTRUDES INTO THE UPPER LIMIT OF THE HEAD IMPACT ZONE.
Consequence Summary: BUSES DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 222.
Corrective Action: REPOSITION LUGGAGE RACK.

Subject: TIRES
Recall Description: THE TIRE MAY LOSE AIR BECAUSE A CURING PRESS INDENTIFICATION TIN WAS BENT AND CREATED A VOID THROUGH THE SIDEWALL AND LINER STOCK.
Consequence Summary: LOSS OF AIR MIGHT RESULT IN LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL WITHTHE POTENTIAL FOR A CRASH.
Corrective Action: REPLACE TIRE WITH NEW TIRE WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM DATE OF NOTIFICATION.

Subject: ENGINE:GASKETS:VALVE COVER
Recall Description: PLASTIC PRODUCTION ENGINE VALVE ROCKER COVER MAY LEAK OIL DUE TO WARPING OR IMPROPER SEALING.
Consequence Summary: OIL COULD IGNITE AND CREATE AN ENGINE COMPARTMENT FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ENGINE VALVE ROCKER COVER.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:OTHER
Recall Description: STEERING ARMS USED ON FRONT AXLES CONTAIN DIMENSIONAL INCONSISTENCIES.
Consequence Summary: STEERING ARMS COULD EVENTUALLY DEVELOP FATIGUE CRACKS.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SUSPECT FRONT STEERING ARMS.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:JACKS
Recall Description: DUE TO A DESIGN DEFECT IN THE THREAD PROFILE OF THE CAR JACK, WHEN THE WAGON IS RAISED, THE JACK MAY BE UNABLE TO SUSTAIN THE VEHICLE.
Consequence Summary: JACK COULD LOWER ITSELF WITH POTENTIAL TO CAUSE PERSONALINJURY.
Corrective Action: REPLACE JACK.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT RETRACTORS
Recall Description: FRONT PASSENGER SEAT LAP BELT RETRACTOR, WHICH INCORPORATES A CHILD SEAT BELT LOCKING FEATURE, MAY MALFUNCTION.
Consequence Summary: SEAT BELT LOCK WOULD EXTRACT AND CHILD SEAT MAY MOVE OUTOF ITS RESTRAINED POSITION.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FRONT PASSENGER SEAT LAP RETRACTOR WITH A REDESIGNED RETRACTOR.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC
Recall Description: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSIONS EXPERIENCED ENDURANCE FAILURES OF PARK MECHANISM COMPONENTS DURING SEVERE TESTING.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLES WOULD BE SUBJECT TO TRANSMISSION FAILURES.
Corrective Action: RETROFIT TRANSMISSION.

Subject: STRUCTURE:DOOR ASSEMBLY
Recall Description: AIR OPEN/SPRING CLOSED TYPE EXIT DOOR MAY BE INCORRECTLY WIRED.
Consequence Summary: DRIVER CAN DRIVE OFF WITH EXIT DOOR NOT CLOSED AND LOCKEDWHICH COULD RESULT IN A PASSENGER FALLING OUT OF THE EXIT DOOR WHILE THE BUS ISMOVING.
Corrective Action: CORRECT DOOR WIRING AND READJUST DOORS.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: SOME AIR BRAKE HOSE ASSEMBLIES MAY NOT COMPLY WITH BURST STRENGTH REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 106.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLES DO NOT COMPLY WITH STANDARD.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SUSPECT HOSE ASSEMBLIES.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:ARM:PITMAN
Recall Description: SOME OF THE NUTS/BOLTS USED TO FASTEN THE STEERING PITMAN ARM MAY LOOSEN.
Consequence Summary: THIS WOULD ALLOW THE PITMAN ARM TO COME OFF THE STEERINGGEAR SECTOR SHAFT AND RESULT IN IMMEDIATE LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL AND A VEHICLECRASH COULD OCCUR.
Corrective Action: RETORQUE NUTS/BOLTS WHERE NECESSARY.

Subject: STEERING:POWER ASSIST:PUMP
Recall Description: POWER STEERING PUMPS MAY HAVE A RIDGE INSIDE THE ALUMINUM HOUSING WHICH COULD DETACH ITSELF FROM THE HOUSING AND BECOME WEDGED INSIDE THE RELIEF VALVE, KEEPING IT OPEN.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN SUDDEN LOSS OF ASSISTANCE TO THESTEERING WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE POWER STEERING PUMP.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:AUXILLIARY GENERATOR
Recall Description: THE GROUNDING LUG ATTACHED TO THE METAL CASE OF THE 120VAC/12VDC POWER CONVERTER DOES NOT HAVE REQUIRED GROUNDING CONDUCTOR CONNECTED TO THE CHASSIS GROUND SYSTEM.
Consequence Summary: AN ELECTRICAL SHOCK HAZARD MAY EXIST IF AN INSULATIONFAILURE OF A CONDUCTOR INSIDE THE CONVERTER SHOULD OCCUR.
Corrective Action: INSTALL CONVERTER CASE GROUND CONDUCTOR.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL
Recall Description: DUE TO AN INCORRECT CAB SUPPORT LEG, THROTTLE ROD WHEN SEPARATED, COULD CAUSE THROTTLE LINKAGE TO LOCK IN THE FULL THROTTLE POSITION.
Consequence Summary: IF THROTTLE LOCKED IN FULL THROTTLE POSITION WHILE THETRUCK IS MOVING, LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A RESTRICTOR PLATE TO THE CAB LEG.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL
Recall Description: BRACKETS USED TO ATTACH CRUISE CONTROL TO THE FUEL PUMP MAY BEND AND/OR DEFLECT.
Consequence Summary: THROTTLE LINKAGE COULD BIND AND NOT CONFORM TO THROTTLERETURN TIMING OF FMVSS 124.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SUSPECT BRACKETRY WITH A REINFORCED PART.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:LINK:DRAG:CONNECTION
Recall Description: STEERING DRAGLINK NUTS MAY NOT BE PROPERLY TORQUED.
Consequence Summary: DRAGLINK COULD LOOSEN AND CAUSE ERRATIC STEERING WHICHCOULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: RETORQUE DRAGLINK.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:GLASS:WINDSHIELD
Recall Description: THERE MAY BE POOR BOND ADHESION BETWEEN WINDSHIELD GLASS AND MOUNTING.
Consequence Summary: WINDSHIELD COULD SEPARATE DURING A 30 MPH FRONTAL BARRIERTEST REQUIRED BY FMVSS 212.  SUCH SEPARATION DURING AN ACCIDENT COULD RESULT INAN UNBELTED OCCUPANT BEING EJECTED AND INJURIED.
Corrective Action: REINSTALL WINDSHIELD ASSURING PROPER ADHESION.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING
Recall Description: ELECTRICAL CIRCUIT THAT CONTROLS CURRENT TO BRAKE PUMP MOTOR RELAY, HEATER AND AIR CONDITIONING BLOWER MOTOR, TURN SIGNALS, AND A ELECTRONIC MESSAGE CENTER MAY OVERHEAT DUE TO INABILITY OF IGNITION CIRCUIT WIRING CONNECTIONS TO DISSIPATE HEAT GENERATED BY ELECTRICAL LOADS.
Consequence Summary: BRAKE PUMP MOTOR WILL NOT OPERATE, SUBSTANTIALLY REDUCINGBRAKING CAPABILITY; BRAKE WARNING LIGHT WILL COME ON.
Corrective Action: REPLACE IGNITION SWITCH AND MODIFY SWITCH WIRING.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:TRAILER HITCHES AND ATTACHM
Recall Description: PINTLE BODY CHEMISTRY AND HEAT TREAT PROBLEM WHICH RESULTS IN DECREASED PINTLE HORN STRENGTH.
Consequence Summary: WITH THE DECREASED STRENGTH IN THE PINTLE HOOK HORN ITCOULD ALLOW SEPARATION OF THE TRACTOR AND TRAILER.
Corrective Action: THE PINTLE HOOK WILL BE REPLACED WITH A NEW PROPERLY HEAT TREATED AND CORRECT MATERIAL.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL PUMP
Recall Description: UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS, MECHANICAL FUEL PUMPS MAY DEVELOP FUEL LEAKAGE AT CRIMPED SEAM BETWEEN THE TWO FUEL PUMP HALVES.
Consequence Summary: FUEL LEAKAGE IN THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT CREATES APOSSIBILITY OF A FIRE.
Corrective Action: INSTALL AN IMPROVED FUEL PUMP ASSEMBLY.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL SYSTEM OTHER PARTS
Recall Description: CORROSION COULD OCCUR BETWEEN THE FUEL FILTER AND ITS RETAINING BRACKET.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN PERFORATION OF THE FILTER CASINGAND FUEL LEAKAGE WITH POTENTIAL FOR A FIRE.
Corrective Action: INSTALL MODIFIED FUEL FILTER BRACKET.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:HARNESS:FRONT:UNDERHOOD
Recall Description: NYLON SHIELDED WIRING HARNESS, LOCATED IN THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT, IS SUSCEPTIBLE TO HEAT DAMAGE AND MELTING OF THE NYLON MATERIAL IN 100 DEGREE PLUS WEATHER.
Consequence Summary: MELTED NYLON SHIELD COULD DRIP ONTO THE EXHAUST MANIFOLDAND RESULT IN AN UNDERHOOD FIRE.
Corrective Action: WRAP WIRING HARNESS WITH HEAT RESISTANT FIBERGLASS TAPE.

Subject: SUSPENSION:TANDEM AXLE:REAR:V-BOLT AND ATTACHMENTS
Recall Description: AXLE SEAT USED ON REAR AXLE MAY BE TOO HARD (BRITTLE) AND COULD CRACK.
Consequence Summary: THE AFFECTED AXLE WOULD BE LOOSE, AFFECTING STEERING ANDDIRECTIONAL CONTROL, WHICH COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL AND ANACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SUSPECT AXLE SEAT.

Subject: WHEELS:CAP:COVER:HUB
Recall Description: DECORATIVE REAR AXLE COVERS, WHICH ARE HELD IN PLACE BY WHEEL RIM LUG NUTS, DO NOT ALLOW THE LUG NUTS TO RETAIN THE PROPER TORQUE.
Consequence Summary: LUG NUTS COULD LOOSEN, ALLOWING THE WHEEL TO SEPARATEFROM THE HUB, WHICH COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE DECORATIVE AXLE COVERS WITH COVERS WHICH HAVE BEEN CORRECTLY MANUFACTURED.

Subject: STRUCTURE:BODY:GRAB BAR:STRAP MOUNTING ASSIST
Recall Description: THE OUTER STAINLESS STEEL SKIN ON THE MUFFLER COULD REACH TEMPERATURES OVER 400 DEGREES.
Consequence Summary: PERSONS USING THE MUFFLER MOUNTED GRAB HANDLES FORSUPPORT TO ENTER OR EXIT THE CAB COULD RECEIVE SEVERE HAND OR ARM BURNS.
Corrective Action: ADD HEAT SHIELDS TO THE STAINLESS STEEL WRAPPED MUFFLERS IN QUESTION.

Subject: BRAKES:CALIPER
Recall Description: FRONT BRAKE CALIPER IS SUBJECT TO LOOSEN.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN FRONT WHEEL SEIZURE WITH POTENTIALFOR AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE UPPER BOLT ON THE BRAKE CALIPER; ALSO INSTALL A WASHER AND COTTER PIN TO FURTHER RESTRAIN MOVEMENT.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: TWISTED COMPONENTS COULD ALLOW THE LEFT FRONT BRAKE HOSE TO CONTACT THE FENDER LINING/RAIL AREA; OVER TIME THE BRAKE HOSE COULD WEAR THROUGH.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN A LOSS OF BRAKE FLUID AND A PARTIALLOSS OF BRAKING CAPABILITY WHICH COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSPECT LEFT FRONT BRAKE HOSE FOR PROPER INSTALLATION AND REPLACE, AS NECESSARY.

Subject: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT CONTROL ARM:LOWER
Recall Description: LEFT HAND LOWER CONTROL ARM CAN CRACK AND COULD EVENTUALLY CAUSE THE LOWER BALL JOINT TO SEPARATE FROM THE CONTROL ARM.
Consequence Summary: LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL CAN OCCUR WHICH COULD RESULT INA CRASH WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: REPAIR OR REPLACE LOWER LEFT CONTROL ARM.

Subject: STRUCTURE:FIFTH WHEEL ASSEMBLY
Recall Description: POSSIBLE OMISSION OF KINGPIN BRACES AND FINAL WELDING.
Consequence Summary: WITH THE ABOVE DEFECT THE 5TH WHEEL KINGPIN ASSEMBLYCOULD COLLAPSE UNEXPECTEDLY AND CAUSE DAMAGE TO BOTH THE TOW VEHICLE AS WELL ASTHE 5TH WHEEL.
Corrective Action: INSPECTION AND REPLACEMENT OF KINGPIN ASSEMBLY.

Subject: WHEELS:LUGS:NUTS:BOLTS
Recall Description: LEFT WHEEL COULD COME OFF THE AXLE, WHILE THE TRAILER IS BEING TOWED, DUE TO WHEEL LUG BOLTS LOOSENING.
Consequence Summary: WHEEL SEPARATION COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ORIGINAL EQUIPMENT LUG BOLTS WITH LOC TITE LUG BOLTS.

Subject: BRAKES:POWER ASSIST:PRIMARY:BOOSTER
Recall Description: BRAKE BOOSTER VACUUM RESERVOIR CANISTERS MAY DEVELOP LEAKS DUE TO BUMPER IMPACT.
Consequence Summary: THIS WOULD RESULT IN LOSS OF POWER BRAKE ASSIST AND ANINCREASE IN STOPPING DISTANCE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE BRAKE BOOSTER VACUUM CANNISTERS WITH NEW TYPE CANNISTERS; ALSO, INSTALL A RESTRICTION ORIFICE TO ENSURE SUFFICIENT VACUUM IN EVENT CANNISTER LEAKAGE OCCURS.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL SYSTEMS
Recall Description: FUEL LEAKAGE MAY OCCUR IN LOW AMBIENT TEMPERATURE OPERATION AT CONNECTIONS OF AN ENGINE COMPARTMENT FUEL SUPPLY HOSE TO THE PRESSURE REGULATOR AND TO THE FUEL RAIL.
Consequence Summary: IN THE PRESENCE OF AN IGNITION SOURCE, FUEL LEAKAGE COULDRESULT IN A FIRE.
Corrective Action: RELOCATE PRESSURE REGULATOR; REPLACE FUEL SUPPLY WITH FORMED HOSE WITH REVISED ROUTING CONFIGURATION TO ENSURE SEALING INTEGRITY.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY
Recall Description: FUEL TANKS MAY BE CONSTRUCTED OF IMPROPER MATERIAL.
Consequence Summary: FUEL COULD LEAK AT THE TANK SEAM WHICH, IN PRESENCE OFAN IGNITION SOURCE, COULD RESULT IN A FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SUSPECT FUEL TANKS.

Subject: STRUCTURE:DOOR ASSEMBLY:LATCHES AND LOCKS
Recall Description: EMERGENCY EXIT UNLATCHING FORCES EXCEED THE 20 LBS. MAXIMUM ALLOWED.
Consequence Summary: BUSES DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 217.
Corrective Action: MAKE ADJUSTMENT TO REDUCE UNLATCHING FORCES BELOW 20 LBS.

Subject: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR
Recall Description: REAR AXLE MUST BE RERATED FROM ITS PRESENT 21,200 LBS. GAWR TO 20,000 LBS. AS THE MAXIMUM LOAD CARRYING CAPACITY OF THE AXLE TO COMPLY WITH FMVSS 121.
Consequence Summary: TRUCKS DO NOT COMPLY WITH STANDARD.
Corrective Action: RERATE REAR AXLE TO 20,000 GAWR.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC:LEVER AND LINKA
Recall Description: TRANSMISSION SHIFT CABLES MAY NOT MEET FORDS PULL OUT LOAD SPECIFICATIONS FOR THE SWIVEL TUBE PORTION OF THE CABLE, WHICH COULD ALLOW THE SWIVEL TUBE TO SEPARATE FROM THE SHIFT CABLE ASSEMBLY.
Consequence Summary: OPERATOR WOULD NOT BE ABLE TO SHIFT FROM ONE OF THEDRIVE GEARS INTO PARK POSITION.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SHIFT CABLE.

Subject: STEERING:GEAR BOX
Recall Description: COMPRESSION OF FRONT SPRINGS COULD INTERFERE WITH THE 90 DEGREE CROSSOVER FITTINGS ON THE BOTTOM OF THE GEARS.
Consequence Summary: IF ONE OF THE FITTINGS BREAK, THE HYDRAULIC FLUID ISLOST, RESULTING IN LOSS OF POWER STEERING AND POSSIBLY A CRASH.
Corrective Action: REPLACE CENTER PORT STEERING GEAR CYLINDER HEADS WITH NEW SIDE PORT CYLINDER HEADS.  ALSO, INSTALL THICKER BUMPER STOPS TO ELIMINATE SPRING TO GEAR CONTACT.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:BATTERY:CABLE
Recall Description: MISROUTED BATTERY CABLES COULD COME IN CONTACT WITH HOT OIL COOLER LINES OR SHARP OBJECTS AND DAMAGE THE INSULATION.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN AN ELECTRICAL SHORT AND POSSIBLY AFIRE.
Corrective Action: REROUTE AND REPLACE BATTERY CABLES AS NECESSARY.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:CAP:FILLER
Recall Description: TRUCKS ARE SUBJECT TO PRESSURIZATION OF THE FUEL TANK UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS.
Consequence Summary: REMOVAL OF FUEL FILLER CAP COULD RESULT IN SPILLAGE ORSPEWING OF FUEL FROM THE TANK WITH POTENTIAL FOR FIRE OR EXPLOSION.
Corrective Action: REPLACE CAP FOR THE FUEL FILLER LINE.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL:PEDAL
Recall Description: ELECTRONIC THROTTLE SENSORS MAY FAIL TO RETURN TO IDLE DUE TO THROTTLE PEDAL STOP BEING INCORRECTLY MANUFACTURED OF ALUMINUM INSTEAD OF STEEL.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF TRUCK CONTROL AND ANACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ALUMINUM THROTTLE PEDAL STOPS WITH A STEEL VERSION, ALSO, REPLACE THROTTLE POTENTIOMETER IF IT HAS BEEN OVERLOADED.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:TIE ROD:END
Recall Description: RIGHT SIDE TIE ROD STEERING ARM ON FRONT STEERING AXLE MAY HAVE MISSED THE HEAT TREATMENT OPERATIONS.
Consequence Summary: TIE ROD STEERING ARM COULD FAIL, AFFECTING STEERINGCONTROL WHICH COULD RESULT IN A CRASH WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: REPLACE RIGHT TIE ROD STEERING ARM.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:HARNESS:REAR COMPARTMENT
Recall Description: REAR LAMP WIRING HARNESS MAY CONTAIN OPEN OR INTERMITTENT CIRCUITS AFFECTING BACK UP LAMP OR LICENSE PLATE LAMP OPERATION.
Consequence Summary: LAMPS WOULD FLASH OR BE INOPERATIVE; CARS WOULD NOTCOMPLY WITH FMVSS 108.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW WIRING HARNESS.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:PIPE:FILLER:NECK
Recall Description: FUEL FILLER NECK MAY HAVE BEEN INCOMPLETELY WELDED, ALLOWING FUEL TO LEAK FROM THE NECK ASSEMBLY.
Consequence Summary: IN THE EVENT OF A COLLISION IMPACT, FUEL SPILLAGE INEXCESS OF AMOUNT ALLOWED BY FMVSS 301 COULD RESULT IN A FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FUEL FILLER NECK ASSEMBLY.

Subject: ENGINE COOLING SYSTEM:FAN
Recall Description: FAN BLADE MAY CRACK AND SEPARATE WHERE THE BLADE OVERLAPS THE SPIDER.
Consequence Summary: SEPARATED FAN BLADE COULD RESULT IN BODILY INJURY TOPERSONS NEAR BY AND ALSO COULD DAMAGE THE ENGINE, RADIATOR, ETC.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A NEW ALL STEEL FAN.

Subject: AIR CONDITIONER:COMPRESSOR
Recall Description: THE CYLINDER HEAD ON THE COMPRESSOR COULD CRACK OR BREAK.
Consequence Summary: SHOULD THE CYLINDER HEAD CRACK OR BREAK IT COULD RESULTIN AN EXPLOSION CAUSING BODILY INJURY TO PERSONS IN THE IMMEDIATE VICINITY.
Corrective Action: THE CYLINDER HEAD AND HEAD SPRING WILL BE REPLACED.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER LABELS
Recall Description: DECALS WARNING NOT TO USE ETHER OR STARTING FLUIDS MAY HAVE BEEN OMITTED FROM THE AIR CLEANER AND/OR INSTRUMENT PANEL.
Consequence Summary: INJECTION OF THESE FLUIDS INTO THE AIR INTAKE SYSTEMCOULD POSSIBLY BE IGNITED BY THE HEATING COILS AND AN EXPLOSION MAY OCCUR.
Corrective Action: INSTALL WARNING LABELS.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT
Recall Description: FAILED HEAD EXCURSION AND HIC REQUIREMENT OF DYNAMIC SLED TESTS, FMVSS NO. 213 FOR CHILD RESTRAINT SYSTEM.
Consequence Summary: THE EXCESSIVE HEAD MOVEMENTS MAY ALLOW CHILD TO CONTACTOBJECTS INSIDE THE VEHICLE AND CAUSE PERSONAL INJURY.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE BOOSTER SEAT WITH A NEW CHILD RESTRAINT SYSTEM.

Subject: SUSPENSION:TANDEM AXLE:REAR:AIR SUSPENSION SYSTEM
Recall Description: LOWER MOUNTING BRACKET FOR AIR BAG HELPER SPRINGS ARE SUBJECT TO FLATTENING AND DEFORMING AND COULD SHIFT.
Consequence Summary: SHIFTING BRACKET MAY PINCH A REAR BRAKE LINE, CRIMPINGAND BREAKING THE LINE; THIS COULD RESULT IN BRAKE FAILURE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE BRACKET, BOLTS AND BRAKE LINE.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:OTHER PART
Recall Description: VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH TRAILER TOW PACKAGE HAVE A TRAILER TAILLIGHT RELAY ASSEMBLY THAT CONTAINS WIRES OF SMALLER GAUGE THAN THE FUSE LINK WHICH PROTECTS THE CIRCUIT.
Consequence Summary: SHOULD A SHORT CIRCUIT OCCUR IN THE WIRING WITHIN THERELAY OR IF WATER INTRUSION OCCURS THE SMALLER GAUGE WIRE IN THE RELAY WILLFUNCTION AS A FUSE LINK AND OVERHEAT.  THE POSSIBILITY EXISTS FOR A FIRE IF THEWIRES ARE EXPOSED TO COMBUSTIBLE MATERIALS.
Corrective Action: INSTALLATION OF A RELAY WITH WIRES OF GAUGE ADEQUATE TO PROTECT THE CIRCUIT.

Subject: ENGINE:GASKETS
Recall Description: THE ENGINE OIL COOLER GASKET MAY FAIL AND ALLOW OIL TO LEAK INTO THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT.
Consequence Summary: DURING HIGH TEMPERATURE ENGINE OPERATION, LOSS OFLUBRICANT MAY OCCUR RAPIDLY AND LEAD TO ENGINE DAMAGE OR FIRE RESULTING FROM THELUBRICATING OIL SPRAYED FROM THE GASKET RUPTURE ONTO THE HOT EXHAUST SYSTEM.
Corrective Action: INSTALLATION OF A NEW TYPE GASKET WITH A STEEL CORE.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES
Recall Description: FAILURE OF THE BACKREST MOUNTING ARMS DUE TO IMPROPER HEAT TREATMENT.
Consequence Summary: BACKREST MAY BREAK FROM WEIGHT OF PASSENGER DURINGACCELERATION, POSSIBLY INJURING PASSENGER.
Corrective Action: CUSTOMERS WILL BE REQUESTED TO RETURN BACKREST AND RECEIVE A REFUND FOR THE FULL PURCHASE PRICE.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:CAP:FILLER
Recall Description: LARGER REPLACEMENT FUEL TANK IS SUBJECT TO EXCESSIVE HEAT BUILDUP INSIDE THE TANK THAT CAN INCREASE FUEL TEMPERATURE AND TANK PRESSURE.
Consequence Summary: TANK PRESSURE COULD RESULT IN SPILLAGE OR SPEWING OFFUEL FROM THE FUEL FILL LINE WITH POTENTIAL FOR FIRE OR EXPLOSION.
Corrective Action: INSTALL REPLACEMENT CAP FOR FUEL FILL LINE AND AFFIX WARNING LABEL.

Subject: LIGHTING:FLASHER:TURN SIGNAL
Recall Description: FAILURE TO MEET DURABILITY FLASH RATE AND CURRENT REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 108.
Consequence Summary: FAILURE TO PROPERLY SIGNAL DIRECTION OF VEHICLE TOTRAFFIC.  THIS COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REFUND OF PURCHASE PRICE UPON RETURN OF FLASHERS TO THE MANUFACTURER.

Subject: STRUCTURE:FRAME:MEMBERS AND BODY:OTHER PARTS
Recall Description: THE WELDED GUSSETT SUPPORTING THE LOWER FUEL TANK STEP IS OF INSUFFICIENT STRENGTH.
Consequence Summary: STEPS COULD BREAK AWAY AND POSSIBLY CAUSE INJURY TO USER.
Corrective Action: INSTALL AN END PLATE THAT WILL TIE TOGETHER UPPER AND LOWER STEPS ADDING SUFFICIENT STRENGTH TO SUPPORT THE LOWER STEP.

Subject: WHEELS:HUB
Recall Description: REAR WHEEL HUB DAMPER MAY SLIP OUT OF POSITION AND BECOME DAMAGED DURING HARD ACCELERATION, ALLOWING EXCESSIVE MOVEMENT BETWEEN THE HUB COUPLING AND THE REAR WHEEL HUB.
Consequence Summary: DAMPER COULD DETERIORATE COMPLETELY AND REAR WHEEL HUBOR TRANSMISSION GEARS MAY BREAK, WHICH COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF CONTROL AND ANACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE DAMPER, IF DAMAGED; REMOVE OIL ON REAR HUB AND SPROCKET CARRIER; AND INSTALL SPACERS IN SPROCKET CARRIER TO KEEP REAR HUB DAMPER FROM DEFORMING.

Subject: HEATER:WATER:DEFROSTER:DEFOGGER:HEATER CORE:WATER
Recall Description: COOLING SYSTEM PRESSURES DURING OVERHEATED ENGINE OPERATION MAY EXCEED THE STRENGTH CAPABILITY OF CERTAIN COMPONENTS DUE TO INADEQUATE VENTING CAPACITY OF THE SYSTEM PRESSURE CAP.
Consequence Summary: THE BUILDUP OF PRESSURE MAY CAUSE HEATER CORE TO RUPTUREAND DISCHARGE HOT COOLANT AND STEAM IN THE PROXIMITY OF THE DRIVERS LEGS.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ALL COOLANT SYSTEM PRESSURE CAPS WITH ONE HAVING ADEQUATE VENTING CAPACITY.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:DRIVELINE:BRACKET:SUPPORT:CENTER SHAFT
Recall Description: CLAMP PLATES USED BETWEEN THE DRIVE SHAFT AND CARRIER YOKES MAY CRACK AND COULD BREAK DUE TO IMPROPER HEAT TREATMENT.
Consequence Summary: IF CLAMP PLATE BREAKS, YOKE WOULD FLY OFF AT DETACHEDPOINT AND COULD INJURY ANYONE STRUCK BY FLYING FRAGMENTS.  ALSO, THE DETACHEDINNER SHAFT COULD INTERFERE WITH THE BRAKE SYSTEM AIR SUPPLY HOSES AND TRACTORTIRES, WHICH COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF TRUCK CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW CLAMPING PLATES AND CAPSCREWS IN ALL LOCATIONS AS NEEDED.

Subject: STRUCTURE:FIFTH WHEEL ASSEMBLY
Recall Description: TOO MUCH DISTANCE BETWEEN BOLTS SECURING THE 5TH WHEEL MOUNTING ANGLES TO THE FRAME SIDE RAIL PLACES STRESS ON MOUNTING FASTENERS.
Consequence Summary: FASTENERS COULD WORK LOOSE, CAUSING MOUNTING ANGLES TOFAIL AND RESULT IN SEPARATION OF THE 5TH WHEEL FROM THE TRUCK.
Corrective Action: INSTALL ADDITIONAL FASTENERS AS REQUIRED.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC:LEVER AND LINKA
Recall Description: TRANSMISSION LINKAGE WAS ADJUSTED IMPROPERLY DURING PRODUCTION.
Consequence Summary: IF THIS CONDITION EXISTS, THERE IS A POTENTIAL THAT THETRANSMISSION PARKING PAWL MAY NOT FULLY ENGAGE THE PARKING GEAR WHEN THETRANSMISSION SELECTOR LEVER IS PLACED IN PARK.
Corrective Action: INSPECT ALL VEHICLES AND ADJUST TRANSMISSION LINKAGE PROPERLY.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:FUSE AND RECEPTICLE:CIRCUIT BREA
Recall Description: THE 25 AMP AUTOMATIC RESET CIRCUIT BREAKER COULD FAIL IN THE CLOSED POSITION.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD JEOPARDIZE THE CIRCUITRY TO BE PROTECTED BYTHE CIRCUIT BREAKER AND COULD RESULT IN AN ELECTRICAL FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE CIRCUIT BREAKER.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:PIPE:FILLER:NECK
Recall Description: FUEL FILLER NECK COULD BE POSITIONED OR INSTALLED IN A WAY THAT ALLOWS FUEL TO ENTER THE PASSENGER COMPARTMENT UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS.
Consequence Summary: FUEL ODOR WOULD BE PRESENT AND IN PRESENCE OF AN IGNITIONSOURCE, COULD RESULT IN A FIRE.
Corrective Action: REMOVE FUEL FILLER NECK AND RELOCATE BELOW FLOORLINE OF BUS.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL:PEDAL
Recall Description: EXCESSIVE ACCELERATOR CABLE FRICTION MAY RESTRICT THE CABLES FREE MOVEMENT BETWEEN THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL AND THE THROTTLE BODY.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD PREVENT THROTTLE FROM RETURNING TO CLOSED(IDLE) POSITION WHEN ACCELERATOR PEDAL IS RELEASED; THUS, ENGINE SPEED WOULDNOT DECREASE, AND LOSS OF ACCELERATOR CONTROL COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ACCELERATOR CABLE.

Subject: LIGHTING:LAMP OR SOCKET:BRAKE LIGHTS
Recall Description: REAR WHEEL ANTILOCK BRAKE (RWAL) FEATURE COULD BECOME DISABLED BY AN ELECTRICAL MALFUNCTION.
Consequence Summary: BRAKE WARNING INDICATOR LAMP ON INSTRUMENT PANEL WILLNOT LIGHT TO INFORM THE DRIVER OF RWAL DISABLEMENT AND THUS NOT COMPLY WITHFMVSS 105.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A JUMPER WIRE HARNESS BETWEEN THE TRANSMISSION CONNECTION AND ENGINE WIRE HARNESS.

Subject: LIGHTING:LAMP OR SOCKET:EMERGENCY FLASH HAZARD WAR
Recall Description: DUE TO INCREASED BULB LOAD ON THE FLASHER, WHEN OPERATED IN HAZARD MODE, FLASHER DID NOT MEET PERFORMANCE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 108.
Consequence Summary: BUSES DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 108.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A COMBINATION TURN HAZARD FLASHER THAT COMPLIES WITH STANDARD.

Subject: STEERING:POWER ASSIST:PUMP
Recall Description: INSUFFICIENT CLEARANCE BETWEEN THE POWER STEERING PUMP PRESSURE HOSE ASSEMBLY AND THE TRANSMISSION GOVERNOR/SPEED SENSOR CONNECTOR COULD CAUSE ABRASION OF THE HOSE.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN A FLUID LEAK, WITH THE POTENTIAL FORAN UNDERHOOD FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE POWER STEERING PUMP PRESSURE HOSE.

Subject: STEERING:POWER:GEAR BOX
Recall Description: AN INCORRECT MACHINED PISTON BALL RACE IN THE STEERING GEAR CREATED AN OUT OF TOLERANCE CONDITION.
Consequence Summary: THIS CONDITION COULD CAUSE WEAR IN THE STEERING GEARLEADING TO INCREASED EFFORT AND COULD RESULT IN STEERING GEAR SEIZURE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE STEERING GEAR.

Subject: TIRES:OTHER
Recall Description: DUE TO IMPROPER MOUNTING PROCESS, SEMPERIT TIRES 20570R14 MOUNTED ON ALLOY WHEEL SIZE 6J X 14 COULD EXPERIENCE TINY CRACKS IN THE BEAD AREA.
Consequence Summary: TIRES COULD LOSE AIR, CREATING POTENTIAL FOR LOSS OFVEHICLE CONTROL.
Corrective Action: REPLACE TIRES AS NECESSARY.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:BATTERY:OTHER PART
Recall Description: THE BATTERY MAY INTERFERE WITH THE HOOD INNER PANEL AT THE FRONT THREE CELL VENT CAP OF THE BATTERY.
Consequence Summary: SUCH INTERFERENCE MAY DISLODGE CAP AND ALLOW HYDROGENGAS TO ESCAPE AND CAUSE A FIRE HAZARD.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THREE CELL CAP WITH INDIVIDUAL BATTERY CELL CAPS.

Subject: TIRES
Recall Description: TIRES FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE ECD 30 HIGH SPEED TEST FOR THE S-SPEED LEVEL.
Consequence Summary: TIRES MAY DEVELOP BELT EDGE SEPARATION AND BUBBLE IN THEUPPER SIDEWALL NEAR THE TREAD.  THIS COULD CAUSE RAPID AIR LOSS AND VEHICLECRASH.
Corrective Action: TIRES WILL BE REPLACED AT NO COST TO THE CONSUMER WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM DATE OF NOTIFICATION.

Subject: WHEELS:LUGS:NUTS:BOLTS
Recall Description: MACHINING ERROR IN LOCATING WHEEL STUD HOLES MAY PREVENT FULL SEATING OF BRAKE DRUM TO SHAFT FLANGE.
Consequence Summary: WHEEL STUDS COULD LOOSEN, ALLOWING WHEEL TO SEPARATEFROM THE TRUCK.
Corrective Action: REPLACE AXLE SHAFTS AS NECESSARY.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:VALVE:FOOT CONTROL
Recall Description: A PRESSURE PROTECTION VALVE WAS OMITTED IN FRONT AIR BRAKE PLUMBING THAT IS REQUIRED BY FMVSS 121.
Consequence Summary: IF A LEAK DEVELOPS IN THE AIR BRAKE PLUMBING, AIR INFRONT BRAKES WOULD NOT BE PROTECTED.
Corrective Action: INSTALL PRESSURE PROTECTION VALVE.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:HARNESS:FRONT:UNDERHOOD
Recall Description: TURN INDICATOR AND HEADLIGHT WIRING HARNESS CAN COME IN CONTACT WITH THE STEERING POST.
Consequence Summary: WHEN STEERING POST TURNS, IT CAN RUB THROUGH INSULATIONCAUSING ELECTRICAL SHORTS.
Corrective Action: REPAIR DAMAGED WIRES AND REROUTE WIRING HARNESS TO AVOID CONTACT WITH STEERING POST.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:CAP:FILLER
Recall Description: PRESSURE RELIEF VALVE IN FUEL CAP MAY STICK DURING THE TURN TO VENT FUNCTION, CAUSING THE VALVE TO REMAIN OPEN.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN FUEL SPILLAGE DURING AND AFTER ACOLLISION AND POSSIBLY A FIRE.  VEHICLES WOULD NOT BE IN COMPLIANCE WITH FMVSS301.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW FUEL CAP.

Subject: LIGHTING:SWITCH:BUTTON:RING:HEAD LIGHTS
Recall Description: THERE MAY BE AN INTERMITTENT HEADLIGHTS STALK SWITCH MALFUNCTION.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN SUDDEN HEADLIGHTS FAILURE WITHOUTPRIOR WARNING WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE HEADLIGHT SWITCH, IF NECESSARY, AND MODIFY HEADLIGHT SWITCH WIRING HARNESS.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: FRONT HYDRAULIC BRAKE FLUID HOSE MAY CONTACT SPEEDOMETER CABLE DURING NORMAL VERTICAL MOVEMENT OF THE FRONT SUSPENSION.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD WEAR THE BRAKE HOSE AND CAUSE BRAKE FLUIDLEAKAGE, THIS COULD RESULT IN REDUCED BRAKING EFFECTIVENESS, AND LEAD TO ANACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A SPEEDOMETER CABLE HOLDER TO PREVENT CONTACT WITH THE BRAKE FLUID HOSE; REPLACE BRAKE HOSE IF NECESSARY.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL FILTER LINE
Recall Description: IN LINE FUEL FILTER LEAKAGE AT THE SEAM (CRIMPED AREA) OF THE FILTER.
Consequence Summary: THIS IS A POTENTIAL SAFETY RISK DUE TO GASOLINE LEAKAGEWHICH MAY RESULT IN A FIRE.
Corrective Action: THE FILTER WILL BE REPLACED WITH NEW TYPE FUEL FILTER.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT BUCKLES
Recall Description: THE BUCKLE ASSEMBLY COULD HAVE A LARGE PAWL TO BASE CLEARANCE WHICH MAY NOT ALLOW THE PROPER ENGAGEMENT OF THE CONNECTOR.
Consequence Summary: THE PAWL TO BASE CLEARANCE PRECLUDES THE INABILITY TOENGAGE THE SEAT BELT CONNECTOR.
Corrective Action: INSPECT AND REPLACE ALL BUCKLE ASSEMBLIES FOUND WITH IMPROPER CLEARANCE.

Subject: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:LEAF SPRING:U-BOLT
Recall Description: INCORRECT BOLTS MAY HAVE BEEN USED TO ATTACH THE REAR SUSPENSION TO THE CROSSMEMBER.
Consequence Summary: BOLTS MAY NOT PROPERLY RETAIN REAR SUSPENSION CROSSMEMBER
Corrective Action: INSTALL CORRECT BOLTS.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR:ANTILOCK SYSTEM
Recall Description: LOW TORQUE OF THE BRAKE HYDRAULIC UNIT MOUNTING BOLTS COULD CAUSE INCREASED BRAKE PEDAL TRAVEL AND/OR POOR PEDAL FEEL IF ATTACHMENT LOOSENS.
Consequence Summary: THIS CONDITION COULD LEAD TO SEPARATION OF BRAKEHYDRAULIC UNIT FROM ITS MOUNTING BRACKET AND RESULT IN LOSS OF BRAKE FUNCTIONAND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE HYDRAULIC UNIT MOUNTING BOLTS.

Subject: STRUCTURE:HOOD ASSEMBLY:LATCHES
Recall Description: THE SECONDARY HOOD LATCH MAY NOT PROPERLY ENGAGE.
Consequence Summary: IF PRIMARY LATCH DISENGAGES, HOOD COULD UNEXPECTEDLYOPEN.  IF CAR WAS IN MOTION, HOOD COULD CONTACT THE WINDSHIELD, REDUCE THEDRIVERS FORWARD VISION AREA, AND COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SECONDARY LATCH WITH A NEW LATCH.

Subject: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT CONTROL ARM:LOWER:BAL
Recall Description: LOWER CONTROL ARM TO BALL JOINT ATTACHMENT CAN BECOME LOOSE.  ALSO, CERTAIN CARS COULD HAVE TIE ROD BALL STUD NUTS THAT WERE NOT PROPERLY TORQUED AND COULD LOOSEN.
Consequence Summary: CONTINUED OPERATION OF CAR WITH EITHER CONDITION COULDRESULT IN SEPARATION OF THAT JOINT AND POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL AND ANACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE BOTH LOWER CONTROL ARMS; ALSO, CHECK TIE ROD BALL STUD NUT TORQUE.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT BUCKLES
Recall Description: THE BUCKLE ASSEMBLY COULD HAVE A LARGE PAWL TO BASE CLEARANCE WHICH MAY NOT ALLOW THE PROPER ENGAGEMENT OF THE CONNECTOR.
Consequence Summary: THE PAWL TO BASE CLEARANCE PRECLUDES THE INABILITY TOENGAGE THE SEAT BELT CONNECTOR.
Corrective Action: INSPECT AND REPLACE ALL BUCKLE ASSEMBLIES FOUND WITH IMPROPER CLEARANCE.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT BUCKLES
Recall Description: THE BUCKLE ASSEMBLY COULD HAVE A LARGE PAWL TO BASE CLEARANCE WHICH MAY NOT ALLOW THE PROPER ENGAGEMENT OF THE CONNECTOR.
Consequence Summary: THE PAWL TO BASE CLEARANCE PRECLUDES THE INABILITY TOENGAGE THE SEAT BELT CONNECTOR.
Corrective Action: INSPECT AND REPLACE ALL BUCKLE ASSEMBLIES FOUND WITH IMPROPER CLEARANCE.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT BUCKLES
Recall Description: THE BUCKLE ASSEMBLY COULD HAVE A LARGE PAWL TO BASE CLEARANCE WHICH MAY NOT ALLOW THE PROPER ENGAGEMENT OF THE CONNECTOR.
Consequence Summary: THE PAWL TO BASE CLEARANCE PRECLUDES THE INABILITY TOENGAGE THE SEAT BELT CONNECTOR.
Corrective Action: INSPECT AND REPLACE ALL BUCKLE ASSEMBLIES FOUND WITH IMPROPER CLEARANCE.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT BUCKLES
Recall Description: THE BUCKLE ASSEMBLY COULD HAVE A LARGE PAWL TO BASE CLEARANCE WHICH MAY NOT ALLOW THE PROPER ENGAGEMENT OF THE CONNECTOR.
Consequence Summary: THE PAWL TO BASE CLEARANCE PRECLUDES THE INABILITY TOENGAGE THE SEAT BELT CONNECTOR.
Corrective Action: INSPECT AND REPLACE ALL BUCKLE ASSEMBLIES FOUND WITH IMPROPER CLEARANCE.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR:DISC SYSTEM:CALIPER
Recall Description: GUIDE PIN ON REAR DISC BRAKE CALIPER SUPPORT COULD HAVE LOOSENED DURING TRANSPORT AND WOULD NO LONGER HOLD THE CALIPER IN CORRECT POSITION.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN BRAKE DRAG, PREMATURE BRAKE PADWEAR AND PARTIAL LOSS OF BRAKING POWER WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL BRAKE CALIPER GUIDE PIN KIT.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:SPEED CONTROL
Recall Description: MICRO PROCESSOR IN CONTROL UNITS OF CRUISE CONTROL SYSTEM CAN BE AFFECTED BY A SHORT DURATION VOLTAGE DROP.
Consequence Summary: A VOLTAGE DROP WITH THE CRUISE CONTROL SWITCH IN ONPOSITION COULD CAUSE ERRATIC CRUISE CONTROL OPERATION.
Corrective Action: REPLACE CRUISE CONTROL UNIT.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:BELTS
Recall Description: THE DRIVE SPRING THAT DRIVES THE AUTOMATIC BELT MAY BREAK.
Consequence Summary: THIS WOULD PREVENT FULL FORWARD MOVEMENT OF THE SEAT BELTANCHORAGE FROM THE LOCK POSITION WHEN THE DOOR IS OPENED.
Corrective Action: REPLACE AUTOMATIC SHOULDER BELT.

Subject: TIRES:TREAD
Recall Description: TREAD SEPARATION DUE TO HIGH INFLATION PRESSURE WHEN USED AT SLOW SPEED AND NOT REDUCED FOR HIGHWAY SERVICE.
Consequence Summary: IF INFLATION PRESSURE IS NOT REDUCED FROM LOW SPEEDOPERATION WHEN IN HIGHWAY SERVICE TREAD SEPARATION WILL OCCUR, CAUSING COMPLETETIRE FAILURE.
Corrective Action: REPLACEMENT TIRES WILL BE INSTALLED AT NO COST WITHIN 90 DAYS FROM RECEIPT OF NOTIFICATION.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:CLUTCH ASSEMBLY:OTHER PARTS
Recall Description: THE CLUTCH MOUNTING HOLES WERE NOT DRILLED DEEP ENOUGH TO SECURE THE CLUTCH TO THE FLYWHEEL.
Consequence Summary: THIS INADEQUATE DEPTH OF MOUNTING HOLES ALLOWS THEATTACHING CAPSCREWS TO BOTTOM OUT AND NOT COMPRESS THE LOCKWASHER OR SECURE THECLUTCH TO THE FLYWHEEL.  THIS COULD RESULT IN THE CLUTCH SEPARATING FROM THEFLYWHEEL WHILE THE ENGINE IS OPERATING.
Corrective Action: RETAP ATTACHING HOLES TO PROPER DEPTH TO ADEQUATELY SECURE THE CLUTCH TO THE FLYWHEEL.

Subject: BRAKES:DRUMS
Recall Description: ORIGINAL SPECIFIED REAR BRAKE DRUMS ARE INADEQUATE IN STRENGTH FOR BRAKE LOADS BEING IMPOSED ON THESE DRUMS.
Consequence Summary: THIS INCREASED DUTY CYCLE HAS CAUSED PREMATURE COMPONENTFAILURE OF THE BRAKE DRUMS DUE TO CRACKING AND BREAKING.  THIS COULD RESULT INA RISK TO TRAFFIC SAFETY.
Corrective Action: REPLACEMENT OF REAR BRAKE DRUMS, REAR SPRING BRAKE CHAMBERS AND THE FRONT SERVICE CHAMBERS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT TRACK ANCHORS AND SEATS:OTHE
Recall Description: DRIVERS SEAT ADJUSTER MECHANISM MAY SEPARATE AT ITS FRONT ATTACHMENT DUE TO FATIGUE FAILURE OF THE ADJUSTER BRACKET.
Consequence Summary: FAILURE OF BOTH FRONT ATTACHMENTS MAY ALLOW SIGNIFICANTREARWARD MOVEMENT OF THE SEAT BACK.
Corrective Action: REPLACE DRIVERS SEAT ADJUSTER BRACKET WITH A STRONGER VERSION.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:TRACKS AND ANCHORS:FRONT SEAT:POW
Recall Description: A SERVICE REPLACEMENT DRIVERS SEAT CUSHION (MANUAL SEAT TYPE) MAY CONTAIN WRONG CUSHION WITH A BRACE THAT COULD INTERFERE WITH POWER SEAT ADJUSTER MECHANISM AND CAUSE STRESS ON THE FRAME.
Consequence Summary: SEAT FRAME COULD FRACTURE AND RESULT IN SIGNIFICANTREARWARD MOVEMENT OF THE SEAT BACK.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FRAME WITH PROPER POWER SEAT FRAME.

Subject: STEERING:POWER ASSIST:HOSE:FLUID
Recall Description: VIBRATION AND HIGH UNDERHOOD TEMPERATURES COULD CAUSE POWER STEERING SUPPLY HOSE AT THE CONNECTOR CLAMP SEAL TO DEVELOP A FLUID LEAK.
Consequence Summary: IF THE FLUID CONTACTS THE HOT EXHAUST MANIFOLD, IT MAYCAUSE SMOKE AND POSSIBLY AN UNDERHOOD FIRE.
Corrective Action: INSTALL AN IMPROVED POWER STEERING SUPPLY HOSE ASSEMBLY.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:EMERGENCY EXIT LABEL
Recall Description: NO EMERGENCY EXIT REFERRAL LABELS AS REQUIRED BY FMVSS NO. 217.
Consequence Summary: FAILS TO MEET REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 217, EMERGENCYEXIT LABELING.
Corrective Action: INSTALL EMERGENCY EXIT LABEL AS REQUIRED.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:EMERGENCY EXIT LABEL
Recall Description: FAILED TO MEET REQUIREMENTS FOR EMERGENCY EXIT LABELS FMVSS NO. 217.
Consequence Summary: DO NOT MEET REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 217 LABELING.
Corrective Action: REPLACE INCORRECT LABELS AND ADD NEW LABELS AS REQUIRED.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:JACKS
Recall Description: IMPROPER JACK FURNISHED WITH VEHICLES.
Consequence Summary: THE JACK MAY NOT REACH FAR ENOUGH INTO THE JACKETSPROVIDED ON BOTH SIDED OF THE VEHICLE.  IF THE IMPROPER JACK IS USED, IT COULDSLIP AND POSSIBLY INJURE A PERSON STANDING TOO CLOSE TO THE VEHICLE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE JACK WITH THE PROPER TYPE FOR VEHICLE.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:SPEED CONTROL VACUUM LINES
Recall Description: THE BALL CHAIN BETWEEN THE CRUISE CONTROL VACUUM REGULATOR AND THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL ARM MAY CATCH ON THE VACUUM REGULATOR ATTACHMENT CLIP.
Consequence Summary: IF THE CHAIN GETS CAUGHT THE THROTTLE COULD BE PREVENTEDFROM RETURNING TO FULLY CLOSED POSITION WHEN THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL IS RELEASED.
Corrective Action: A PLASTIC CAP WILL BE INSTALLED OVER THE VACUUM REGULATOR CLIP TO COVER THE OPENINGS.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK
Recall Description: FUEL TANK LOCATED TOO CLOSE TO DRIVE SHAFT, SO THAT UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS, THE TANKS MATING FLANGE MAY BE STRUCK BY THE UNIVERSAL JOINT ON DRIVE SHAFT.
Consequence Summary: CONTACT OF THE UNIVERSAL JOINT WITH THE FUEL TANK COULDEVENTUALLY CAUSE TANK TO LEAK FUEL, WHICH MIGHT BECOME A FIRE HAZARD.
Corrective Action: REPLACE WITH NEWLY DESIGNED TANK TO PRECLUDE INTERFERENCE WITH UNIVERSAL JOINT OF THE DRIVE SHAFT.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT BELT INSTRUCTIONS
Recall Description: OMISSION OF INFORMATION SPECIFIED BY FMVSS 210 FROM OWNER MANUAL.
Consequence Summary: FAILS TO MEET REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 210 REGARDING CHILDRESTRAINT SYSTEMS.
Corrective Action: ADHESIVE BACKED INSERTS WILL BE FURNISHED WITH THE CORRECT INFORMATION.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT TRACK ANCHORS AND SEATS:OTHE
Recall Description: THE PEDESTAL SEAT MOUNTING CHANNEL WAS OMITTED OR FAILURE TO PROPERLY ATTACH A SEAT MOUNTING CHANNEL.
Consequence Summary: THE MOUNTING CHANNEL IS NECESSARY TO SECURE THE SEAT BASEPEDESTAL.  IN THIS CONDITION A SUDDEN CHANGE IN THE VELOCITY OF THE VEHICLE SUCHAS AN ACCIDENT THE SEAT COULD SEPARATE FROM THE FLOOR OF THE VEHICLE, POSSIBLYRESULTING IN PERSONAL INJURY TO THE OCCUPANTS.
Corrective Action: REQUIRES INSTALLING SEAT MOUNTING CHANNELS AS REQUIRED TO SECURE THE SEATS.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:TIE ROD:END
Recall Description: TIE ROD END TAPERED STUD TO THE TIE ROD STEERING ARMS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN TIGHTENED TO SPECIFIED TORQUE.
Consequence Summary: THE TIE ROD END NUTS COULD LOOSEN, SHEAR OFF THE LOCKINGCOTTER PIN AND ALLOW THE TIE ROD TO SEPARATE FROM THE TIE ROD STEERING ARM.THIS COULD CAUSE VEHICLE TO CRASH WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: INSPECT VEHICLES AND TIGHTEN MOUNTING TIE ROD END NUTS TO PROPER TORQUE.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC:LEVER AND LINKA
Recall Description: THE AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION SHIFT LEVER BUTTON MECHANISM MAY WEAR TO THE POINT THAT THE BUTTON ON THE SHIFT LEVER NO LONGER NEEDS TO BE DEPRESSED TO SHIFT GEARS.
Consequence Summary: A LEVER WITH THIS CONDITION COULD BE INADVERTENTLY BUMPEDOR MOVED FROM DRIVE TO REVERSE BY THE DRIVER OR A PASSENGER WHILE THE VEHICLEIS BEING DRIVEN.  A SUDDEN UNEXPECTED SHIFTING COULD CAUSE LOSS OF VEHICLECONTROL AND A VEHICLE CRASH.
Corrective Action: A NEWLY DESIGNED TRANSMISSION SHIFT LEVER WILL BE INSTALLED ON ALL VEHICLES.

Subject: TIRES:BELT
Recall Description: SEPARATION IN THE SHOULDER AREA DUE TO LOST ADHESION BETWEEN TREAD AND BELTS CAUSED BY TRAPPED AIR.
Consequence Summary: TIRES MAY DEVELOP A SEPARATION IN THE SHOULDER AREA AS ARESULT OF LOST ADHESION BETWEEN TREAD AND BELTS DUE TO TRAPPED AIR IN THESHOULDER AREA.
Corrective Action: REPLACE TIRES WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM DATE OF NOTIFICATION AT NO COST TO CONSUMER.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SHOULDER BELTS
Recall Description: THE FRONT SHOULDER BELT GUIDE LOOP ATTACHED TO THE UPPER REAR CORNER OF THE DOOR MAY INTERFERE WITH THE GARNISH MOLDING.
Consequence Summary: THIS INTERFERENCE COULD LIMIT THE ROTATION OF THE GUIDELOOP.  IF THIS CONDITION EXISTS AND VEHICLE IS INVOLVED IN A CRASH IT COULD BEPOSSIBLE FOR THE SHOULDER BELT WELDING TO BE CUT BY THE GUIDE.  LOSS OF THESHOULDER BELT FUNCTION DURING A VEHICLE CRASH COULD INCREASE THE RISK OFINJURIES TO OCCUPANTS.
Corrective Action: A NEWLY DESIGNED GUIDE LOOP NUT AND SPACER WILL BE INSTALLED TO ELIMINATE THE POTENTIAL FOR INTERFERENCE CONDITIONS.

Subject: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT CONTROL ARM:LOWER
Recall Description: FRONT SUSPENSION LOWER CONTROL ARM BRACKET COULD DEVELOP METAL CRACKS.
Consequence Summary: THESE CRACKS MAY RESULT IN DISENGAGEMENT OF THE LOWERCONTROL ARM.  IF THIS OCCURS WHILE VEHICLE IS IN MOTION, IT COULD RESULT INLOSS OF STEERING CONTROL AND A VEHICLE CRASH COULD OCCUR WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: INSPECT ALL VEHICLES AND REPLACE ENGINE CRADLE ASSEMBLY ON ALL SUSPECT VEHICLES.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:WINDSHIELD WIPER LINKAGE:PIVOT:DRIV
Recall Description: THE WINDSHIELD WIPER DRIVE LINKAGE COULD LOCKUP AND CAUSE WIPERS TO STOP.
Consequence Summary: THIS CONDITION COULD IMPAIR THE DRIVERS VISION AND AVEHICLE CRASH MAY RESULT.
Corrective Action: THE WINDSHIELD WIPER DRIVE LINKAGE WILL BE REPLACED ON ALL VEHICLES.

Subject: ENGINE:OTHER PARTS
Recall Description: THE POSITIVE CRANKCASE VENTILATION VALVE MAY PROVIDE INADEQUATE AIR FLOW UNDER LOW ENGINE LOAD CONDITIONS.
Consequence Summary: THIS CONDITION CAN ALLOW WATER/OIL MIXTURE TO BUILD UPIN THE HOSE FROM THE OIL SEPARATOR TO THE AIR INLET DUCT.  AFTER THE ENGINE ISSTOPPED, THIS WATER/OIL MIXTURE CAN, UNDER COLD WEATHER CONDITIONS, FREEZE ANDCOMPLETELY BLOCK THE OIL SEPARATOR AIR DUCT HOSE.  THIS BLOCKAGE WILL RESULT ININCREASED PRESSURE WITHIN THE CRANKCASE.  THIS CAN CAUSE OIL LEAKS, IF ASUFFICIENT QUANTITY OF OIL CAME IN CONTACT WITH THE HOT EXHAUST SYSTEM AN ENGINECOMPARTMENT FIRE COULD RESULT WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: THE PCV VALVE WILL BE REPLACED WITH A NEW VALVE.

Subject: ENGINE:OTHER PARTS
Recall Description: THE POSITIVE CRANKCASE VENTILATION VALVE MAY PROVIDE INADEQUATE AIR FLOW UNDER LOW ENGINE LOAD CONDITIONS.
Consequence Summary: THIS CONDITION CAN ALLOW WATER/OIL MIXTURE TO BUILD UPIN THE HOSE FROM THE OIL SEPARATOR TO THE AIR INLET DUCT.  AFTER THE ENGINE ISSTOPPED, THIS WATER/OIL MIXTURE CAN, UNDER COLD WEATHER CONDITIONS, FREEZE ANDCOMPLETELY BLOCK THE OIL SEPARATOR AIR DUCT HOSE.  THIS BLOCKAGE WILL RESULT ININCREASED PRESSURE WITHIN THE CRANKCASE.  THIS CAN CAUSE OIL LEAKS.  IF ASUFFICIENT QUANTITY OF OIL CAME IN CONTACT WITH THE HOT EXHAUST SYSTEM AN ENGINECOMPARTMENT FIRE COULD RESULT WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: THE PCV VALVE WILL BE REPLACED WITH A NEW VALVE.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK
Recall Description: PERFORATION OF THE FUEL TANK OR ATTACHED FUEL FEED PIPE DUE TO CORROSION OF THE TANK OR FUEL FEED PIPE MATERIALS.
Consequence Summary: THIS CONDITION COULD ALLOW FUEL TO LEAK FROM THE FUELTANK AND ULTIMATELY RESULT IN A FIRE WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.  SUCH A FIRE COULDSPREAD TO THE PASSENGER COMPARTMENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE GAS TANK WITH NEW CORROSION RESISTANT TANK.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:RESTRAINT:BELT ANCHOR AND ATTACHM
Recall Description: SEAT BELT MOUNTING BOLTS ON THE INBOARD SIDE OF RIDERS SEAT MAY HAVE BEEN UNDERTORQUED.
Consequence Summary: BOLTS MAY LOOSEN AND EVENTUALLY SEPARATION OF THE BELTASSEMBLY FOR THE MOUNTING BRACKET COULD OCCUR.  IN AN SUDDEN PANIC STOP THEPASSENGER WOULD NOT BE RESTRAINT AND POSSIBLE INJURY WOULD RESULT.
Corrective Action: INSPECT BOLTS AND PROPERLY TORQUE.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:UNKNOWN TYPE:LEVER AND LI
Recall Description: AN INTERFERENCE BETWEEN THE TRANSMISSION SHIFT CABLE AND THE BELLCRANK CLIP IN THE STEERING COLUMN CAN RESULT IN DISENGAGEMENT OF THE TRANSMISSION CABLE.
Consequence Summary: THIS CONDITION COULD ALLOW THE TRANSMISSION TO BE IN AGEAR OTHER THAN THAT DISPLAYED BY THE SHIFT INDICATOR.  THE VEHICLE COULD MOVEIN AN UNEXPECTED DIRECTION AND CAUSE A VEHICLE CRASH WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: A NEWLY DESIGNED BELLCRANK CLIP WILL BE INSTALLED.

Subject: STEERING:POWER:SHAFT LOWER WORM
Recall Description: THE STEERING SHAFT SPLINE ENGAGEMENT IS ONLY .52, THE RECOMMENDED ENGAGEMENT IS 2 INCHES.
Consequence Summary: UNDER IMPACTS SUCH AS ROAD POTHOLES, IT COULD RESULT INSHAFT DISENGAGEMENT.  THE DRIVER WOULD IMMEDIATELY LOSE STEERING CONTROLWITHOUT WARNING AND VEHICLE CRASH COULD OCCUR.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SHAFTS THAT MEASURE UNDER THE MINIMUM ENGAGEMENT DIMENSIONS WITH A LONGER SHAFT.

Subject: LIGHTING:SWITCH:BUTTON:RING:BRAKE LIGHTS
Recall Description: THE STOP LAMP SWITCH MAY HAVE A LOOSE ELECTRICAL CONTACT. THE LOOSE CONTACT CAN OVERHEAT AND MELT THE SURROUNDING PLASTIC CAUSING THE CONTACT TO STICK OPEN.
Consequence Summary: AN OPEN CONTACT WOULD RENDER THE BRAKE LIGHTS INOPERATIVEWHEN THE BRAKE PEDAL IS DEPRESSED.  ALSO, THE TRANSMISSION CLUTCH CONTROL ANDCRUISE CONTROL CONTACTS WOULD REMAIN CLOSED.  THIS CONDITION WOULD RESULT INCRUISE RESUME UPON BRAKE PEDAL RELEASE IF THE CRUISE CONTROL IS IN THE ONPOSITION.  EITHER AN UNEXPECTED CRUISE RESUME OR INOPERATIVE BRAKE LIGHTS COULDRESULT IN A VEHICLE CRASH WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: THE ROTARY SOPLAMP SWITCH WILL BE REPLACED ON ALL INVOLVED VEHICLES.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL PUMP
Recall Description: IN LINE FUEL FILTER LOCATED BETWEEN THE FUEL TANK AND FUEL PUMP COULD SEEP FUEL AT THE SEAM OF THE PLASTIC CASING.
Consequence Summary: SHOULD SEEPAGE OCCUR, LEAKING FUEL CAN CAUSE A RISK OFFIRE IN THE PRESENCE OF AN IGNITION SOURCE.
Corrective Action: THE IN LINE FUEL FILTER WILL BE REPLACED WITH A STRAIGHT FUEL HOSE.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:PIPE:FILLER:NECK
Recall Description: PERFORATION OF THE FUEL TANK OR THE ATTACHED FUEL FEED PIPE DUE TO CORROSION OF THE TANK OR FUEL FEED PIPE MATERIALS.
Consequence Summary: THIS CONDITION COULD ALLOW FUEL TO LEAK FROM THE FUELTANK AND ULTIMATELY RESULT IN A FIRE WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.  SUCH A FIRE COULDSPREAD TO THE PASSENGER COMPARTMENT.
Corrective Action: THE FUEL TANK WILL BE REPLACED ON ALL INVOLVED VEHICLES.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC:INDICATOR:LEVER
Recall Description: A CLIP ON THE SHIFTER MECHANISM INSIDE THE CONSOLE MAY BECOME DISLODGED PREVENTING INDICATION OF THE CORRECT GEAR SELECTION UNDER CONDITIONS OF DARKNESS.
Consequence Summary: THE CLIP COULD ALSO BIND PART OF THE SHIFTER MECHANISMIN A WAY WHICH WOULD PREVENT GEAR DETENTS FROM OPERATING THIS COULD CAUSEUNDESIRED GEAR POSITION.  THIS COULD CAUSE VEHICLE CRASH WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: THE CLIP WILL BE REPLACED TO PRECLUDE THE CONDITION FROM OCCURING.

Subject: STRUCTURE:HOOD ASSEMBLY:LATCHES
Recall Description: SECONDARY HOOD LATCH ASSEMBLY MAY NOT HAVE BEEN PROPERLY ADJUSTED RESULTING IN LATCH BECOMING BENT.
Consequence Summary: A BENT SECONDARY HOOD LATCH COULD CAUSE THE PRIMARYLATCH TO MALFUNCTION.  IF THIS OCCURED THE HOOD COULD UNEXPECTEDLY OPEN.  IFTHIS HAPPENED WHILE VEHICLE IS IN MOTION REDUCTION OF FORWARD VISIBILITY COULDCAUSE A VEHICLE CRASH WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: INSPECT AND REPLACE SECONDARY HOOD LATCH ASSEMBLIES AS REQUIRED.

Subject: TIRES
Recall Description: TIRES EXHIBIT A FLAT TO CONCAVE TREAD PROFILE AND ON OFF SPEC DISTRIBUTION OF TREAD RUBBER ON THE SHOULDER AREA.
Consequence Summary: THE OFF SPEC RUBBER DISTRIUTION MAY RESULT IN CRACKINGAT THE DECOUPLING (OFF SHOULDER GROOVE, WHICH MIGHT LEAD TO BELT EDGESEPARATION).
Corrective Action: REPLACE TIRES AT NO COST TO CONSUMERS WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM DATE OF NOTIFICATION.

Subject: TIRES
Recall Description: TIRES FAIL TO MEET THE REQUIREMENTS SPECIFIED IN REGULATION 575.104 DURING SURVEILLANCE TESTING FOR GRADE A TEMPERATURE.
Consequence Summary: TIRES DO NOT COMPLY WITH REGULATION REQUIREMENT OFCFR 575.104 TIRE GRADING.
Corrective Action: TIRES WILL BE REPLACED AT NO CHARGE TO CONSUMER WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM NOTIFICATION.

Subject: TIRES:PLY
Recall Description: TIRES FAILED TO MEET THE MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS FOR ENDURANCE OF FMVSS NO. 109.
Consequence Summary: THE FAILURE TO MEET REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS COULD RESULTIN PLY SEPARATION AND LOSS OF AIR OR POSSIBLY BLOWOUT CAUSING A VEHICLE CRASH.
Corrective Action: TIRES WILL BE REPLACED AT NO COST TO CONSUMER WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM DATE OF NOTIFICATION.

Subject: WHEELS:LUGS:NUTS:BOLTS
Recall Description: WHEEL LUG NUTS WERE NOT PROPERLY TORQUED TO SPECIFICATIONS.
Consequence Summary: WHEEL LUG NUTS COULD LOOSEN AND/OR COME OFF THE WHEELSTUDS.  THIS COULD EVENTUALLY RESULT IN WHEEL SEPARATING FROM THE VEHICLE.LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL AND A VEHICLE CRASH COULD OCCUR.
Corrective Action: INSPECTION OF VEHICLE AND ASSURE PROPER TORQUE REPLACES ANY MISSING LUG NUT OR LOOSE STUD.

Subject: TIRES
Recall Description: TIRES FAIL TO MEET REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 119 FOR HIGH SPEED ENDURANCE TEST.
Consequence Summary: THE FAILURE TO MEET REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 119 COULDRESULT IN PLY SEPARATION, AND LOSS OF INFLATING AIR.
Corrective Action: TIRES WILL BE REPLACED AT NO COST TO THE CONSUMER WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM DATE OF NOTIFICATION.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT RETRACTORS
Recall Description: A NYLON PIVOT PIN IN THE SEAT BELT RETRACTOR LOCK MECHANISM MAY BE TOO LARGE IN DIAMETER.
Consequence Summary: THE NYLON MATERIAL SWELLS IN THE PRESENCE OF ATMOSPHEREHUMIDITY AND CAN RESTRICT MOVEMENT OF A LOCKING PAWL WHICH ACTIVATES THE BELTLOCKING MECHANISM.
Corrective Action: INSPECTION OF ALL VEHICLES AND REPLACE ANY SUSPECT BELT ASSEMBLY.

Subject: ENGINE:PULLEY:CRANKSHAFT
Recall Description: THE FRONT CRANKSHAFT PULLEY ISOLATOR ASSEMBLY MAY FAIL DUE TO SEPARATION OF THE PULLEY FROM THE HUB.
Consequence Summary: IF THIS CONDITION EXISTS, AND IF AN ISOLATOR FAILS DURINGSERVICING WITH ENGINE RUNNING THE POTENTIAL FOR RISK OF PERSONAL INJURY TO APERSON WORKING ON ENGINE AND OTHERS IN THE VICINITY.
Corrective Action: INSPECT AND REPLACE CRANKSHAFT PULLEY ASSEMBLY.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL LINES:HOSES:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: THE FUEL FEED OR FUEL RETURN HOSE AT THE ENGINE MAY RUB AGAINST A SHIFT LEVER ON THE 5 SPEED TRANSAXLE.
Consequence Summary: IN TIME A HOLE COULD BE RUBBED THROUGH THE HOSE AND FUELLEAK INTO THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT.  THIS COULD REUSLT IN AN UNDERHOOD FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE FUEL FEED AND RETURN HOSE/PIPE ASSEMBLIES.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES:ACCELERATOR:FLEXIBLE
Recall Description: THE OIL DIPSTICK TUBE ATTACHING BRACKET MAY HAVE BEEN BENT DURING PRODUCTION OR SCHEDULED MAINTENANCE, REDUCING THE CLEARANCE BETWEEN THE DIPSTICK RING AND THE THROTTLE BELLCRANK LEVER.
Consequence Summary: THIS REDUCED CLEARANCE MAY INHIBIT THE RETURN OF THETHROTTLE TO A FULLY CLOSED IDLE POSITION, WHEN THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL ISRELEASED.
Corrective Action: REQUIRES THE CUTTING OFF THE OUTBOARD END OF THE THROTTLE BELLCRANK LEVER TO PROVIDE NECESSARY CLEARANCE.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:AXLE ASSEMBLY:SHAFT AXLE
Recall Description: A DESIGN CHANGE TO FACILITATE CHANGEOVER IN REAR AXLE SHAFT FLANGES INADVERTENTLY PRODUCED THE POSSIBILITY FOR INTERFERENCE BETWEEN THE FLANGE AND DISC BRAKE ROTOR.
Consequence Summary: THE INTERFERENCE COULD PREVENT PROPER SEATING OF THEROTOR.  ALSO AN IMPROPERLY SEATED ROTOR COULD IN TIME RESULT IN A REDUCTION INTHE CLAMPING FORCES OF THE WHEEL STUDS, POSSIBLY LEADING TO FRACTURED STUDSAND REAR WHEEL SEPARATION.
Corrective Action: INSPECTION OF VEHICLES AND WHERE NECESSARY REPLACE REAR AXLE SHAFTS AND REAR BRAKE ROTORS.

Subject: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:TORSION BAR
Recall Description: TWO TORSION SPRINGS ATTACHED TO REAR SUSPENSION CONTROL ARMS MAY FRACTURE AND RUB AGAINST A REAR TIRE.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN SUDDEN LOSS OF TIRE INFLATIONPRESSURE WITH POTENTIAL FOR AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL TORSION SPRING SEATS TO RESTRICT THE SPRINGS FROM CONTACTING THE TIRE IF THEY SHOULD FRACTURE.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:ALTERNATOR:REGULATOR:STARTER:OTH
Recall Description: INSUFFICIENT CLEARANCE BETWEEN THE RELOCATED ALTERNATOR WIRING AND THE SOLENOID HOSE ALTERNATOR WIRING STAY BRACKET CAN CAUSE WIRE CHAFFING AND AN ELECTRICAL SHORT.
Consequence Summary: AN ELECTRICAL SHORT COULD RESULT IN SMOKE AND POSSIBLYAN ENGINE COMPARTMENT FIRE.
Corrective Action: MODIFY BY REMOVING THE SOLENOID HOSE/ALTERNATOR STAY BRACKET.

Subject: STRUCTURE:FRAME:MEMBERS AND BODY:OTHER PARTS
Recall Description: THE IRREGULAR SURFACE ON THE CYLINDER PISTON ON WHICH A STROKE LIMITING SPACER MUST EXERT FORCE, WHICH CAUSES THE SPACER TO FAIL AND CYLINDER OVERSTROKE TWO INCHES.
Consequence Summary: THE FAILED SPACER CLOGS THE HYDRAULIC OIL FILTER,DAMAGES HYDRAULIC PUMP CAUSING HOIST ARM TO BEND AND MAKING IT IMPOSSIBLE FORTHE OPERATOR TO LOWER THE DUMP BODY.
Corrective Action: VEHICLES WILL BE INSPECTED AND REPLACEMENTS OF HOISTS FOUND TO CONTAIN THE DEFECTIVE CYLINDERS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT RETRACTORS
Recall Description: AUTOMATIC RETRACTOR FOR SEAT BELTS FOR DUAL FACING REAR SEATS MAY BE INSTALLED IN AN IMPROPER LOCATION.
Consequence Summary: SEAT BELT COULD BIND BETWEEN SEAT CUSHION AND SEAT BACKCAUSING THE RETRACTOR TO BE SLUGGISH OR UNABLE TO TAKE UP EXCESS BELT SLACK.
Corrective Action: REMOVE AND PROPERLY INSTALL THE RIGHT AUXILIARY SEAT BELTS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AND BELT
Recall Description: DRIVER AND RIGHT FRONT PASSENGER INBOARD SEAT BELTS MAY BE IMPROPERLY ANCHORED DUE TO LOOSE NUTS THAT COULD BACK OFF.
Consequence Summary: BELT ANCHOR COULD DISENGAGE THE STUD; AN UNATTACHED BELTASSEMBLY WOULD NOT WITHSTAND AN IMPACT LOAD.
Corrective Action: INBOARD SEAT BELT ANCHORAGES WILL BE CORRECTED TO PREVENT LOOSENING.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:GLASS:WINDOW:DOOR AND SIDE
Recall Description: GLASS THAT HAS NOT BEEN TEMPERED WAS USED FOR PASSENGER WINDOWS.
Consequence Summary: GLASS CAN BREAK IN SUCH A MANNER THAT DOES NOT COMPLYWITH FMVSS 205.
Corrective Action: REPLACE NONCOMPLYING GLASS.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES
Recall Description: SOME DEADMAN PEDALS WERE ASSEMBLED WITH INCORRECT BOLTS WHICH COULD CAUSE A MALFUNCTION WITHOUT ANYONE STEPPING ON THE PEDAL.
Consequence Summary: IF MALFUNCTION OCCURS WHILE OPERATOR IS AT PLATFORMCONTROL, SUDDEN STOPPING OF MOTION AND THEN SUDDEN CONTINUATION OF MOVEMENTCOULD ENDANGER OCCUPANTS ON THE PLATFORM.
Corrective Action: REPLACE INCORRECT BOLTS.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL
Recall Description: TWO ATTACHMENT SCREWS FOR THE THROTTLE POSITION SENSORS COULD LOOSEN AND BACK OUT.
Consequence Summary: IF BOTH SCREWS COME OUT, SENSORS COULD DISENGAGE FROMTHE THROTTLE SHAFT, PREVENTING RETURN OF THE THROTTLE FROM MID POSITION.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ATTACHMENT SCREWS WITH SCREWS WITH PRE APPLIED ADHESIVE THAT WILL BE TIGHTENED TO A HIGHER TORQUE SPECIFICATION.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL RETURN SPRING
Recall Description: THROTTLE RETURN SPRINGS MAY FAIL DURING NORMAL OPERATION WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Consequence Summary: IF BOTH SPRINGS FAIL, ENGINE THROTTLE MAY NOT RETURN TOIDLE POSITION WHEN THROTTLE FOOT PEDAL IS RELEASED; THIS COULD RESULT IN A LOSSOF VEHICLE CONTROL AND A CRASH.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THROTTLE RETURN SPRINGS.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL:CAM:FAST IDLE
Recall Description: IDLE CONTROL UNIT MAY MALFUNCTION AND CAUSE IDLE STABLIZER VALVE TO BECOME ACTIVATED OUTSIDE ITS NORMAL OPERATING RANGE.
Consequence Summary: IDLE RPM MAY BECOME ERRATIC AND IN SOME INSTANCES,INCREASE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE IDLE CONTROL UNIT.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL:PEDAL
Recall Description: AT AMBIENT TEMPERATURES BELOW 0 DEGREE F, FROST MAY ACCUMULATE WITHIN THE THROTTLE BODY UNDER EXTENDED CONSTANT SPEED OPERATION.
Consequence Summary: FROST ACCUMULATION ON THE THROTTLE VALVE MAY PREVENT THEVALVE FROM RETURNING SMOOTHLY.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A NEW TYPE THERMOSTAT DESIGNED TO RAISE THE COOLANT TEMPERATURE AND WARM THE THROTTLE BODY TO A LEVEL ABOVE FREEZING.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:LINK:DRAG:CONNECTION
Recall Description: PITMAN ARM PINCH BOLTS MAY BE OVERTIGHTENED OR MISSING.
Consequence Summary: PITMAN ARM COULD SEPARATE FROM THE STEERING GEAR CAUSINGLOSS OF STEERING CONTROL AND A VEHICLE CRASH COULD RESULT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE PITMAN ARM PINCH BOLT.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL LINES:HOSES:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: IMPROPER ROUTING OF THE FUEL HOSE COULD CAUSE SOME FUEL HOSES TO HAVE INADEQUATE CLEARANCE TO THE EGR PIPE.
Consequence Summary: HEAT FROM THE EGR COULD CAUSE THE HOSE TO CRACK ANDRESULT IN FUEL LEAKAGE.
Corrective Action: REROUTE FUEL HOSE TO ENSURE PROPER CLEARANCE AND REPLACE HOSE, IF NECESSARY.

Subject: TIRES:BELT
Recall Description: TIRES FAIL TO MEET REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTORS VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD 109, FOR ENDURANCE TESTS.
Consequence Summary: THE FAILURE TO MEET REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 109 COULDRESULT IN PLY SEPARATION, LOSS OF AIR OR POSSIBLY BLOWOUT CAUSING A VEHICLECRASH.
Corrective Action: TIRES WILL BE REPLACED AT NO COST TO THE CUSTOMER WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM DATE OF NOTIFICATION.

Subject: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT ATTACHING MECHANISMS:
Recall Description: CERTAIN FRONT SUSPENSION LOWER SPRING PAN FIXINGS MAY FAIL DUE TO STRESS CORROSION.
Consequence Summary: THIS MAY ALLOW THE CARS FRONT SUSPENSION TO SETTLE ONTOTHE BUMP STOP ON ONE SIDE.
Corrective Action: INSTALL REVISED SPECIFICATION FRONT SUSPENSION SPRING PAN FIXINGS.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:PIPE:FILLER:NECK
Recall Description: FUEL TANK LOWER FILLER PIPE MAY CONTAIN SMALL HOLES AT SOME SPOT WELDS USED TO ATTACH A MOUNTING BRACKET.
Consequence Summary: FUEL COULD LEAK FROM THE PIPE DURING REFUELING ORTURNING AND SPILL FUEL IN EXCESS OF AMOUNT PRESCRIBED BY FMVSS 301.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FUEL TANK LOWER FILLER PIPE.

Subject: SUSPENSION
Recall Description: STEERING/SUSPENSION SYSTEMS MAY NOT ADEQUATELY CONTROL STEERING TYPE WOBBLE ALLOWING THE FRONT END TO SHIMMY.
Consequence Summary: SEVERE SHIMMY COULD DAMAGE VEHICLE FRAME OR STEERINGGEAR CREATING POTENTIAL FOR LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL.
Corrective Action: MODIFY AND/OR REPLACE FRONT SUSPENSION AND STEERING COMPONENTS, TIRES, AND FRAMES.

Subject: WHEELS:DISC:SPIDER
Recall Description: MISSING WELD THAT ATTACHES WHEEL CENTER TO THE RIM COULD ALLOW WHEEL CENTER TO SEPARATE FROM THE RIM.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN PARTIAL LOSS OF STEERING CONTROLAND BRAKES, LOSS OF TIRE AIR PRESSURE, AND SUDDEN CHANGE IN VEHICLE DIRECTION,WHICH COULD RESULT IN CRASH WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: REPLACE WHEELS WITH MISSING WELDS.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CAMPER:SLIDE-IN (9/82)
Recall Description: MISSING LOADING INFORMATION AS REQUIRED BY FMVSS 126.
Consequence Summary: FAILS TO MEET REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 126 FOR TRUCK CAMPERLOADING.
Corrective Action: FURNISH OWNERS WITH CORRECT LOADING INFORMATION.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:LINK:DRAG:CONNECTION
Recall Description: STEERING DRAG LINK MAY BE TOO CLOSE TO THE LEFT FRONT SPRING BRACKET.
Consequence Summary: DRAG LINK CAN LOOSEN AND ROTATE SUFFICIENTLY TO CATCHAND HANG UP ON THE SPRING BRACKET AND COULD RESULT IN A VEHICLE CRASH WITHOUTPRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: INSTALL FOUR HARDENED WASHERS BETWEEN STEERING GEAR AND FRONT SPRING BRACKET.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES:ACCELERATOR:RIGID
Recall Description: ACCELERATOR CONTROL MAY STICK IN A DEPRESSED POSITION WHEN OUTSIDE TEMPERATURES ARE AT OR BELOW FREEZING.
Consequence Summary: ENGINE CONTINUED TO RUN AT GREATER THAN IDLE SPEED WHENOPERATOR REMOVES PRESSURE FROM ACCELERATOR PEDAL, WHICH COULD RESULT IN LOSS OFCONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REROUTE OR REPLACE ACCELERATOR CABLE WITH A NEW CABLE.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:TIE ROD:END
Recall Description: STEERING SYSTEM LEFT TIE ROD END MAY DEVELOP A FATIGUE CRACK IN THE TREADED PART OF THE ROD DUE TO IMPROPER HEAT TREATMENT.
Consequence Summary: COMPLETE SEPARATION OF THE TIE ROD END RESULTS IN LOSSOF STEERING CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT COULD OCCUR.
Corrective Action: REPLACE LEFT TIE ROD ENDS WITH NEW PROPERLY HARDENED ENDS.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK
Recall Description: FUEL TANKS MAY HAVE BEEN DAMAGED DURING TANK MANUFACTURE.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN FUEL LEAKAGE WITH THE POTENTIAL FORA FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FUEL TANKS AS NECESSARY.

Subject: SUSPENSION:TANDEM AXLE:REAR:TORQUE ARM
Recall Description: THE TORQUE RODS MAY HAVE INSUFFICIENT WELD PENTERATION.
Consequence Summary: IF THE WELD FAILS IT WILL ALLOW THE REAR AXLES TO MOVEOUT OF POSITION RESULTING IN VEHICLE INSTABILITY AND LOSS OF CONTROL.
Corrective Action: A NEW COMPLETE UPPER TORQUE ROD SYSTEM OF NEW TYPE WITH 4 RODS PER SUSPENSION WILL BE INSTALLED TO REPLACE THE PRESENT SYSTEM.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:BATTERY:CABLE
Recall Description: UNDER HEAVY DEMAND ON THE ENGINE AND TRANSMISSION, THE TRANSMISSION COOLER LINE TEMPERATURE CAN EXCEED THE TEMPERATURE RATING OF BOTH THE PLASTIC CONDUIT AND INSULATION FOR THE BATTERY CABLE.
Consequence Summary: A DIRECT SHORT COULD OCCUR BETWEEN THE UNPROTECTEDBATTERY CABLE WIRE AND METAL TRANSMISSION COOLER LINE CREATING THE POSSIBILITYOF AN ENGINE COMPARTMENT FIRE.
Corrective Action: REMOVE THE BATTERY CABLE FROM THE TRANSMISSION LINE AND REFASTEN IT TO ANOTHER SECURE LOCATION.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT
Recall Description: CRACKS DEVELOP IN THE PLASTIC SHELL WHERE THE FRAME OF THE CAR SEAT IS RIVETED TO THE SHELL.
Consequence Summary: THE CRACKS IN THE LOWER REAR OF THE SHELL COULD IN ANACCIDENT EXTEND COMPLETELY ACROSS THE SHELL OF THE CAR SEAT.  THIS COULD RESULTIN THE AUTO SEAT BELT SEPARATING FROM THE CHILD RESTRAINT.
Corrective Action: A BRACE ASSEMBLY REPAIR KIT WILL BE INSTALLED TO PRECLUDE SEPARATION OF CAR SEAT FROM BELTED POSITION.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:POWER ASSIST:VACUUM SYSTEM
Recall Description: HYDRAULIC OVER VACCUM CONTROL VALVES USED TO TAP INTO THE TRUCKS ORIGINAL HYDRAULIC BRAKE SYSTEM MAY LEAK.
Consequence Summary: THIS LEAKING OF VALVES COULD CAUSE LOSS OF HYDRAULICFLUID FROM THE MASTER CYLINDER AND IF SIGNIFICANT AMOUNT, COULD RESULT IN LOSSOF BRAKING CAPACITY.
Corrective Action: REPLACE PRESENT VALVES WITH VALVES WITH PROPER O RING.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT BELT INSTRUCTIONS
Recall Description: OWNERS MANUAL DID NOT INCLUDE INSTRUCTIONS ON PROPER USAGE OF REAR SEAT SAFETY BELT SYSTEMS.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLES DO NOT CONFORM TO FMVSS 209.
Corrective Action: FURNISH OWNERS WITH UPDATED OWNERS MANUALS THAT CONTAIN THE OMITTED INSTRUCTIONS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT BELT INSTRUCTIONS
Recall Description: OWNERS MANUAL DID NOT INCLUDE STATEMENT ON CHILD RESTRAINT SYSTEMS.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLES DO NOT CONFORM TO FMVSS 210.
Corrective Action: FURNISH OWNERS WITH UPDATED OWNERS MANUALS THAT CONTAIN THE OMITTED INSTRUCTIONS.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:CLUTCH ASSEMBLY:LEVEL:RELEASE:THROW:OU
Recall Description: THE C SHAPED CLUTCH RELEASE LEVER MAY HAVE BEEN WEAKENED DUE TO CASTING IMPERFECTIONS.
Consequence Summary: CLUTCH LEVER MAY FAIL RESULTING IN LOSS OF CLUTCHCONTROL WHICH COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE C SHAPED CLUTCH RELEASE LEVER.

Subject: LIGHTING:SWITCH:BUTTON:RING:HEAD LIGHTS
Recall Description: THE HEADLAMP SWITCH IS NOT IDENTIFIED AS REQUIRED BY FMVSS/101.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLES DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 101.
Corrective Action: PROVIDE A DECAL TO BE PLACED ON INSTRUMENT PANEL ADJACENT TO THE HEADLAMP SWITCH.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:MASTER CYLINDER
Recall Description: MASTER CYLINDER MAY HAVE BEEN MISASSEMBLED CAUSING A BLOCKED HYDRAULIC FLUID OUTLET PORT AND RESTRICTED FLUID FLOW.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN INCREASED BRAKE PEDAL TRAVEL ANDPARTIAL LOSS OF BRAKING CAPABILITY.
Corrective Action: REPLACE MASTER BRAKE CYLINDER.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL LINES:HOSES:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: RUBBER HOSES CONNECTING FUEL TANK TO EVAPORATIVE EMISSION CONTROL SYSTEM FUEL SEPARATOR ARE INCORRECTLY INSTALLED.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD ALLOW FUEL TO BE PUMPED ONTO THE FUEL TANK.ALSO, MOTORCYCLES WILL NOT COMPLY TO APPLICABLE CALIFORNIA EVAPORATIVE EMISSIONCONTROL STANDARDS.
Corrective Action: RECONNECT HOSES TO PROPER LOCATIONS AND INSTALL CORRECT VACUUM HOSE ROUTING DIAGRAMS.

Subject: LIGHTING:SWITCH:BUTTON:RING:HEAD LIGHTS
Recall Description: UNDER EXTENDED HEADLAMP USAGE, CIRCUITRY IN THE HEADLAMP SWITCH PANEL MIGHT EXPERIENCE INCREASED RESISTANCE AND EXCESSIVE HEAT BUILDUP.
Consequence Summary: HEADLIGHTS WOULD CYCLE ON AND OFF.  SUDDEN LOSS OFHEADLIGHTS UNDER SEVERE WEATHER OR NIGHTIMER DRIVING CONDITIONS COULD RESULTIN A VEHICLE CRASH.
Corrective Action: REPLACE HEADLIGHT SWITCH WITH MODIFIED SWITCH.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL SYSTEM OTHER PARTS
Recall Description: THE ELECTRONIC FUEL CONTROL BYPASS VALVE ON THE FUEL PUMP MAY MALFUNCTION WHEN IN THE BYPASS MODE.
Consequence Summary: IF THE ABOVE CONDITION EXISTS, THE ENGINE COULDACCELERATE TO FULL THROTTLE UNEXPECTEDLY IF CRUISE CONTROL OR POWER TAKE OFFFUNCTION IS ACTIVATED.
Corrective Action: THE ELECTRONIC FUEL CONTROL BYPASS VALVE HAS BEEN REDESIGNED TO PREVENT LOSS OF THROTTLE CONTROL WITH THE PACE SYSEMS WHEN OPERATING IN CRUISE CONTROL.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CAMPER:SLIDE-IN (9/82)
Recall Description: FAILS TO MEET FMVSS 126 TRUCK CAMPER LOADING.
Consequence Summary: FAILURE TO MEET REQUIRED LABELS WITH PROPER LOADINGINSTRUCTIONS OF FMVSS 126.
Corrective Action: FURNISH PROPER LABELS FOR INSTALLATION ON CAMPER.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK
Recall Description: UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS, MOTORHOMES ARE SUBJECT TO PRESSURIZATION OF THE FUEL TANK.
Consequence Summary: REMOVAL OF THE FUEL TANK CAP MAY RESULT IN IMMEDIATESPILLAGE OR SPEWING OF FUEL WITH A POTENTIAL FIRE OR EXPLOSION HAZARD.
Corrective Action: INSTALL REPLACEMENT FUEL FILL CAP.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:ATTACHMENTS
Recall Description: RESISTANCE WELDS WHICH FORM THE ATTACHMENT OF THE FUEL TANK HANGER TO THE FLOOR PAN ARE NOT FIRM WELDS.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN FUEL TANK SEPARATION.
Corrective Action: FUEL TANK HANGER WILL BE MIG WELDED TO THE FLOOR PAN.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: BRAKE HOSE WHICH DIRECTS OIL FROM THE HYDRO MAX BRAKE UNIT TO A STEEL TUBE CONNECTED TO THE SUPPLY PART ON THE PARK BRAKE RELAY VALVE MAY CONTAIN DEFECTS AND LEAK OIL FROM THE BOOSTER SYSTEM.
Consequence Summary: REDUCTION IN HYDRAULIC BOOST PRESSURE AND EVENTUALOPERATION OF THE BACK UP BRAKE SYSTEM AND/OR MANUAL BRAKES ONLY.
Corrective Action: A NEW IMPROVED HOSE WILL BE INSTALLED IN PLACE OF THE DEFECTIVE ONE.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:SHOE AND DRUM SYSTEM:SHOES
Recall Description: VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH REAR BRAKE DRUMS TRANSPORTED BY TRAIN MAY EXPERIENCE SEPARATION OF THE BRAKE SHOE FROM THE WHEEL BRAKE CYLINDER PISTON.
Consequence Summary: SHOULD SEPARATION OCCUR, REPEATED BRAKE OPERATION MAYDAMAGE THE WHEEL BRAKE CYLINDER DUST BOOT, ALLOWING WATER OR DUST INTRUSION ANDSUBSEQUENT PISTON CONTAMINATION.
Corrective Action: ALL VEHICLES WILL BE INSPECTED AND IF NO SEPARATION IS FOUND GREASE WILL BE APPLIED TO THE COMPONENT INTERFACE TO LOWER FRICTION AND AVOID SUBSEQUENT RELATIVE MOTION.  IF SEPARATION IS FOUND THE WHEEL BRAKE CYLINDER DUST BOOT WILL BE REPLACED.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:HARNESS:UNDER DASH
Recall Description: ROUTING OF THE HEADLIGHT AND CLEARANCE LIGHT CIRCUITS THROUGH A SINGLE 20 AMP FUSE AND/OR BREAKER WHICH IS NOT ADQUATE FOR THE LOAD CREATED BY BOTH CIRCUITS.
Consequence Summary: THIS OVERLOAD CONDITION COULD CAUSE LOSS OF HEADLIGHTSWHILE DRIVING AT NIGHT.  THIS WOULD OCCUR WITHOUT WARNING AND COULD RESULT IN AVEHICLE CRASH.
Corrective Action: INSTALLATION OF AN ADDITIONAL 20 AMP BREAKER AND ROUTE HEADLAMP CIRCUIT ONLY THROUGH THAT BREAKER.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL FILTER LINE
Recall Description: FUEL LINE ASSEMBLY IS A FLEX FITTING DESIGN THAT TRANSFERS FUEL TO THE FUEL INJECTION PUMP FROM THE FUEL FILTERS.  THE FLANGE ON THE FUEL LINE MAY CRACK.
Consequence Summary: A CRACKED FLANGE WOULD ALLOW DIESEL FUEL TO SPRAY FROMTHE FILTER HOSE UNTIL ENGINE SHUTS DOWN DUE TO LACK OF FUEL.  THERE IS ALSO APOTENTIAL OF ENGINE COMPARTMENT FIRE.
Corrective Action: A NEW IMPROVED DESIGNED HOSE WILL BE INSTALLED TO REPLACE THE OLD HOSE.

Subject: LIGHTING:SWITCH:BUTTON:RING:HEAD LIGHTS
Recall Description: HEADLIGHT SWITCH CONTAINS COMPONENTS WHICH MAY COME LOOSE UPON OPERATION AND CAUSE SHORT CIRCUITS IN THE SWITCH.
Consequence Summary: IF THIS OCCURS, THE HEADLAMPS WILL NOT FUNCTION, ANDCHARRING OF THE INSULATION OF CERTAIN WIRES TO THE SWITCH MAY RESULT.
Corrective Action: ALL AFFECTED VEHICLES WILL HAVE THE HEADLIGHT SWITCH REPLACED.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC:INDICATOR:LEVER
Recall Description: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION MAY CONTAIN A PARK SPRAG ROD ASSEMBLY THAT MAY STICK IN THE TOOTH BUTT UNENGAGED POSITION.
Consequence Summary: THIS CONDITION COULD ALLOW THE VEHICLE TO ROLL WITH THEGEAR SHIFT LEVER IN PARK POSITION.
Corrective Action: ALL INVOLVED VEHICLES WILL HAVE THE PARK SPRAG ROD ASSEMBLIES REPLACED.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK
Recall Description: THE SOLDERED JOINT WHERE INLET PIPE ATTACHES TO THE FUEL TANK MAY BE CRACKED.
Consequence Summary: FUEL MAY SEEP THROUGH THE JOINT AND POSE A FIRE HAZARD.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FUEL TANK IF THERE IS SEEPAGE OR CRACK.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:RESTRAINT:BELT ANCHOR AND ATTACHM
Recall Description: FASTENER THAT CONNECTS THE HARNESS BELT D RING TO THE B PILLAR MAY NOT BE LONG ENOUGH TO PROVIDE FULL THREAD ENGAGEMENT WITH THE ANCHORAGE WELD NUT.
Consequence Summary: SEAT BELTS COULD FAIL AND NOT ADEQUATELY PROTECT THEOCCUPANT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE MOUNTING HARDWARE WITH HEX SHOULDER BOLT AND .55 INCH SPACER.

Subject: SUSPENSION:MOTORCYCLE REAR
Recall Description: LOWER PART OF SPRING/DAMPER UNIT EYELET, WHICH ATTACHES TO THE REAR DRIVE UNIT, COULD CRACK.
Consequence Summary: IN EXTREME CASES, SPRING DAMPER COULD DETACH FROM REARDRIVE ALLOWING REAR OF MOTORCYCLE TO DROP ONTO REAR TIRE, CAUSING DRAG ON TIREAND UNSTABLE HANDLING.
Corrective Action: REPLACE EYELET WITH A STRENGTHENED ONE.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:DRIVELINE:SHAFT CHAIN:PROPELLOR:DRIVE
Recall Description: SOME OF BOLTS FASTENING REAR DRIVESHAFT ON REAR AXLE FLANGE MAY LOOSEN CAUSING DRIVESHAFT DISASSEMBLY.
Consequence Summary: DRIVESHAFT COULD BREAK AWAY WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING ANDRESULT IN A CRASH OR INJURY FROM LOOSENED DRIVESHAFT OR BOLTS.
Corrective Action: REPLACE BOLTS ON REAR AXLE.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:ARM:PITMAN
Recall Description: THE PITMAN ARM TO DRAG LINK ANGLE IS OUT OF PHASE.
Consequence Summary: UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS, STEERING LINKAGE COULD GO INTOA TOGGLE CONDITION RESULTING IN A SLOW WHEEL RETURN AND IMPAIRED STEERINGCONTROL, CREATING THE POTENTIAL FOR A VEHICLE CRASH WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: REPLACE MISMARKED PITMAN ARM.

Subject: STRUCTURE:FIFTH WHEEL ASSEMBLY
Recall Description: THE BRACKET PIN COTTER KEY ON THE CONNECTION BETWEEN THE FIFTH WHEEL AND THE MOUNTING BRACKET ON TRUCK FRAME WAS REPLACED WITH A HITCH PIN CLIP.  THIS CLIP WAS FOUND TO BE OF INADEQUATE METAL HARDNESS.
Consequence Summary: INADEQUATE METAL HARDNESS COULD RESULT IN HITCH PIN CLIPFAILURE AND POSSIBLE RESULT IN SEPARATION OF THE TRACTOR FROM TRAILER.
Corrective Action: THE HITCH PIN CLIP WILL BE REPLACED WITH AN IMPROVED CLINCH PIN.

Subject: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:NON-POWER AXLE:BEARING
Recall Description: TRUCKS MAY HAVE BEEN EQUIPPED WITH INCORRECT REAR INNER WHEEL BEARINGS WHICH COULD DAMAGE THE BEARING AXLE SPINDLE.
Consequence Summary: PREMATURE FAILURE OF SPINDLE MAY OCCUR, WHICH COULDRESULT IN WHEEL AND TIRE SEPARATION FROM THE VEHICLE; STEERING CONTROL MAY BELOST AND A CRASH COULD RESULT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE REAR BEARINGS AND AXLE SPINDLE AS NECESSARY.

Subject: SUSPENSION:TANDEM AXLE:REAR:TORQUE ARM
Recall Description: THE TORQUE RODS MAY NOT HAVE SUFFICIENT PENETRATION AT THE DOG LEG WELDS.
Consequence Summary: IF THE WELD FAILS IT WILL ALLOW THE REAR AXLE TO MOVEOUT OF POSITION RESULTING IN VEHICLE INSTABILITY AND LOSS OF CONTROL. ANYTIMEDIRECTIONAL CONTROL IS LOST WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING, THERE IS A POTENTIAL FORVEHICLE CRASH.
Corrective Action: A CHANGE IN MANUFACTUING PROCESSES WILL ELIMINATE THE WELD ON THE DOG LEG TUBE.  THE TUBE WILL BE MANUFACTURED BY FORMING A CONTINUOUS SECTION.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: LEFT HAND FRONT HYDRAULIC BRAKE HOSE CONTACTS SPEEDOMETER CABLE HOUSING.
Consequence Summary: THIS CONTACT COULD EVENTUALLY WEAR THE HOSE ENOUGH TOCAUSE LEAKAGE.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A GUIDE TO ROUTE THE SPEEDOMETER CABLE HOUSING AWAY FROM THE BRAKE HOSE.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK
Recall Description: FUEL TANK FIXING BAND RETENTION IS NOT SUFFICIENT, ALLOWING THE BAND TO RUB AGAINST THE FUEL TANK BY VEHICLE VIBRATIONS.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD WEAR A HOLE IN THE FUEL TANK WHICH COULDRESULT IN FUEL LEAKAGE.
Corrective Action: REPAIR FUEL FIXING BAND BY INSTALLING A RUBBER SHEET.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:VALVE:HAND CONTROL
Recall Description: ABNORMAL ACTION OF TWISTING THE VALVE KNOBS CAN CAUSE INTERFERENCE WITH NORMAL VALVE OPERATION.
Consequence Summary: THE ABOVE INTERFERENCE PROHIBITS THE PISTON IN THE VALVEFROM PERFORMING ITS AUTOMATIC FUNCTION IN CASE OF EITHER A LOSS OF AIR PRESSUREIN THE TRAILER SYSTEM OR A TRAILER BREAK AWAY AND PREVENTS THE VALVE FROM BEINGOPERATED MANUALLY.
Corrective Action: MANUFACTURER WILL FURNISH NEW REPLACEMENT AND REIMBURSE FOR INSTALLATION UP TO $22.50.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT RETRACTORS
Recall Description: REAR SEAT BELT SHOULDER RETRACTOR ASSEMBLY MAY NOT LOCK WHEN SUBJECTED TO THE ACCELERATION REQUIRED BY FMVSS NO. 209.
Consequence Summary: THIS INCREASES LIKELIHOOD OF INJURY TO SEAT OCCUPANT.VEHICLES DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS NO. 209.
Corrective Action: REPLACE REAR SEAT SHOULDER BELT RETRACTOR ASSEMBLY, AS NECESSARY.

Subject: ENGINE:OTHER PARTS
Recall Description: DUE TO AN INTERACTION OF THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT ENVIRONMENT AND MAINTENANCE OR SERVICE RELATED FACTORS, THERE IS AN UNREASONABLE RISK OF CONNECTING ROD FAILURE AND ENGINE COMPARTMENT FIRES.
Consequence Summary: AN ENGINE COMPARTMENT FIRE CAN SPREAD TO THE PASSENGERCOMPARTMENT AND INJURE OCCUPANTS.
Corrective Action: CORRECT OR INSTALL NEW ENGINE COMPONENTS TO PREVENT UNREASONABLE FIRE RISK.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:PIPE:FILLER:NECK
Recall Description: THE FUEL FEED AND/OR RETURN HOSE/PIPE ASSEMBLIES COULD CRACK OR SEPARATE, ALLOWING FUEL TO LEAK INTO THE UNDERHOOD AREA.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN AN UNDERHOOD FIRE, WITHOUT PRIORWARNING, AND CAUSE INJURY TO OCCUPANTS.
Corrective Action: REPLACE BOTH FUEL FEED AND RETURN HOSE/PIPE ASSEMBLIES.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:BELTS
Recall Description: SEAT BELT RETRACTOR PAWL MAY NOT MEET HARDENING SPECIFICATIONS CONTAINED IN VOLKSWAGENS DESIGN STANDARD.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLES DO NOT MEET VOLKSWAGENS DESIGN STANDARD.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FRONT PASSIVE RESTRAINT SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY AS NECESSARY.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:KNUCKLE:SPINDLE:ARM
Recall Description: COTTER PINS IN THE UPPER AND LOWER BALL JOINTS MAY HAVE BEEN IMPROPERLY CRIMPED ALLOWING THE COTTER PIN TO COME OUT OF THE STUD.
Consequence Summary: BALL JOINT NUT COULD LOOSEN CAUSING SEPARATION OF THEBALL JOINT FROM THE STEERING KNUCKLE; THIS COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF STEERINGCONTROL AND A VEHICLE CRASH WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: REPLACE IMPROPERLY CRIMPED OR MISSING BALL JOINT STUD NUT COTTER PINS; ALSO, REPLACE STEERING KNUCKLE ASSEMBLIES, AS NECESSARY.

Subject: TIRES
Recall Description: TIRES FAIL TO MEET FMVSS NO. 109 REQUIREMENTS.  TIRES POSSESS LOCALIZED POROSITY.
Consequence Summary: THE POROSITY CONDITION MAY LEAD TO SEPARATION WITHIN THETREAD COMPONENTS.  A LOSS OF AIR COULD RESULT WITH POSSIBLE LOSS OF VEHICLECONTROL.
Corrective Action: REPLACE TIRES WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM DATE OF NOTIFICATION AT NO COST TO THE CONSUMER.

Subject: TIRES
Recall Description: TIRES FAIL TO MEET REQUIREMENTS OF THE ENDURANCE TESTS OF FMVSS NO. 109.
Consequence Summary: TIRES COULD DEVELOP SEPARATION IN THE SIDEWALL.  A LOSSOF AIR COULD OCCUR, CREATING A POTENTIAL FOR LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL.
Corrective Action: REPLACE TIRES WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM DATE OF NOTIFICATION AT NO COST TO THE CONSUMER.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:DISC:PADS AND SHOES
Recall Description: VEHICLE MAY FAIL TO CONFORM TO THE BRAKE FADE AND RECOVERY PORTION OF FMVSS 105.
Consequence Summary: THERE MAY BE A LOSS OF BRAKING EFFICIENCY DURINGREPEATED HARD APPLICATION OF BRAKES WHICH COULD RESULT IN A CRASH WITHOUT PRIORWARNING.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FRONT BRAKE PADS WITH NEWLY DESIGNED SEMI METALLIC BRAKE PADS.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:OTHER
Recall Description: CROSS STEERING LEVERS MAY BE IMPROPERLY HEAT TREATED AND SUBJECT TO FAIL DURING NORMAL OPERATION.
Consequence Summary: SUCH FAILURE COULD CAUSE LOSS OF TRUCK CONTROL WITHOUTPRIOR WARNING AND RESULT IN A CRASH.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW, PROPERLY HEAT TREATED STEERING LEVER.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:GLASS:WINDOW:TAILGATE AND BACK DOOR
Recall Description: THE KEY OPERATED TAILGATE WINDOW WILL CONTINUE TO CLOSE IF THE SPRING LOADED KEY DOES NOT RETURN TO OFF POSITION WHEN RELEASED.
Consequence Summary: WINDOW COULD CLOSE ON A CHILD OR OTHERS RESULTING INPERSONAL INJURY.
Corrective Action: OWNERS SHOULD NOT LEAVE KEY IN TAILGATE OF UNATTENDED VEHICLE.  REPAIR MECHANISM TO ASSURE PROPER KEY RETURN OPERATION.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:IGNITION:SWITCH
Recall Description: FAULT IN THE IGNITION SWITCH CAN INTERRUPT POWER SUPPLY TO VARIOUS ELECTRICAL SYSTEMS AND COMPONENTS.
