Consequence Summary: ELECTRICAL SYSTEMS, INCLUDING HEADLAMPS AND WINDSHIELDWIPERS, MAY BECOME INOPERATIVE, RESULTING IN REDUCED VISIBILITY WHICH COULDRESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE IGNITION SWITCH AND ATTACHED ELECTRICAL SUBHARNESS. ALSO, LUBRICATE IGNITION LOCK MECHANISM.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:LINK:DRAG:CONNECTION
Recall Description: SLOT IN STEERING DRAG LINK TO ALLOW FOR CLAMPING OF THE BALL JOINT MAY NOT BE FULLY CLOSED BY THE BALL JOINT THREAD.
Consequence Summary: WATER MAY ENTER THE DRAG LINK AND RESULT IN CORROSIONWHICH LOWERS STRENGTH OF DRAG LINK MAKING IT SUBJECT TO FRACTURE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE DRAG LINK IF OPENING EXIST; ALSO, THREADED STUD OF BALL JOINT HAS BEEN EXTENDED FOR COMPLETE CLOSURE OF THE SLOT.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:ELECTRIC EQUIPMENT:RADIO:TAPE DECK ETC.
Recall Description: POSSIBLE LOOSE CONNECTION IN THE PRINTED CIRCUIT BOARD COULD SEPARATE AND CAUSE AN ELECTRICAL ARC.
Consequence Summary: IF THE CIRCUIT BREAKER FAILS TO TRIP, THE ARCING MAYCONTINUE WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR A FIRE.
Corrective Action: NEW IMPROVED CONVERTER WILL REPLACE THE OLD ONE.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:SPEED CONTROL
Recall Description: CERTAIN VEHICLES MAY NOT BE MARKED WITH LETTERS RES TO IDENTIFY THE RESUME FUNCTION AS REQUIRED BY FMVSS 101.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLES DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 101.
Corrective Action: REPLACE PART OF CRUISE SWITCH PORTION.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL INJECTION:IDLE SPEED CONTROL UNIT
Recall Description: ELECTRONIC FUEL INJECTION CONTROL UNIT MAY CAUSE IDLE SPEED TO INCREASE BY ABOUT 550 RPM WHILE CAR IS STOPPED IN GEAR.
Consequence Summary: HIGHER THAN NORMAL IDLE COULD CREATE POTENTIAL FOR LOSSOF VEHICLE CONTROL.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ELECTRONIC FUEL INJECTION CONTROL UNIT.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:LINES AND FITTINGS
Recall Description: THE RESERVOIR LINE FROM THE SPRING BRAKE CONTROL VALVE WAS CONNECTED TO THE FRONT BRAKE RESERVOIR INSTEAD OF THE REAR RESERVOIR.
Consequence Summary: THIS PLUMBING ERROR AFFECTS THE MANNER IN WHICH THE AIRBRAKES WORK TO STOP THE BUS.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW AIR BRAKE TUBING TO CORRECT PLUMBING ERROR.

Subject: TIRES
Recall Description: TIRE FAILED TO MEET MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 109 HIGH SPEED TEST.
Consequence Summary: FAILURE TO MEET FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARDNO. 109.
Corrective Action: TIRES WILL BE REPLACED AT NO COST TO CONSUMER WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM DATE OF NOTIFICATION.

Subject: TIRES
Recall Description: TIRES FAIL TO MEET THE REQUIREMENT OF THE ENDURANCE TEST OF FMVSS NO. 109.
Consequence Summary: TIRES COULD DEVELOP A SEPARATION IN THE SIDEWALL.  ALOSS OF AIR COULD OCCUR, CREATING A POTENTIAL FOR A LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL.
Corrective Action: REPLACE TIRES AT NO COST TO CONSUMER WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM DATE OF NOTIFICATION.

Subject: VENTILATION:FRESH AIR:HEATER:DEFROSTER:DEFOGGER:FA
Recall Description: TOILET VENT FAN MOTOR MAY OVERHEAT, WITHOUT TRIPPING THE CIRCUIT BREAKER, DUE TO INJESTION OF A FOREIGN OBJECT INTO THE BLADES OR A LOCKED ROTOR CONDITION.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN A VEHICLE FIRE WITHOUT WARNING.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A TEMPERATURE SENSOR CONTROL SWITCH.

Subject: BRAKES:FLUID:HYDRAULIC (FLUID CONTAMINATION/WRONG
Recall Description: BRAKE FLUID FAILS TO MEET REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 116.
Consequence Summary: EXCEEDED VISCOSITY LIMIT OF 1500 C.ST. AT -40 F.
Corrective Action: REPLACE WITH BRAKE FLUID THAT COMPLIES WITH FMVSS NO. 116.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OWNERS MANUAL INFORMATION
Recall Description: OWNERS MANUAL INFORMATION REQUIRED BY FMVSS 210, SECTIONS 6A AND 6B WAS OMITTED FROM THE MANUAL.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLES MANUAL INFORMATION DOES NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS210.
Corrective Action: UPGRADE EXISTING MANUALS BY INSERTING ADHESIVE BACKED CORRECTION PAGES.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL INJECTION:IDLE SPEED CONTROL UNIT
Recall Description: MALFUNCTIONS OF INTERNAL COMPONENTS OF IDLE CONTROL UNIT COULD CAUSE IDLE STABILIZER VALVE TO BECOME ACTIVATED OUTSIDE ITS NORMAL OPERATING RANGE.
Consequence Summary: IDLE RPM MAY BECOME ERRATIC AND, IN SOMEINSTANCES,INCREASE.
Corrective Action: INSTALL LATEST SPECIFICATION IDLE CONTROL UNIT.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:ELECTRIC POWER ACCESSORIES:WINDOWS
Recall Description: WATER OR SNOW DRIPPING ONTO DRIVERS SIDE WINDOW SWITCH ASSEMBLIES MAY CAUSE AN ELECTRICAL SHORT AND SWITCHES TO OVERHEAT.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN A FIRE IN THE DOOR PANEL AREA.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEWLY DESIGNED WINDOW SWITCHES.  (1984 MODELS WILL RECEIVE NEW CONNECTORS ALSO).

Subject: EXHAUST/CRANKCASE EMISSION CONTROL:CHECK VALVE
Recall Description: INTERNAL CORROSION OF PULSAIR CHECK VALVE ASSEMBLY COULD PERMIT EXHAUST GAS TO MELT THE PLASTIC SHUT OFF VALVE AND DRAW VALVE PIECES INTO THE AIR CLEANER AND THROTTLE BODY.
Consequence Summary: IF VALVE PIECES LODGE AGAINST THROTTLE PLATE, ENGINE MAYNOT RETURN TO IDLE RESULTING IN LOSS ACCELERATOR CONTROL AND POSSIBLY A CRASH.
Corrective Action: REPLACE PULSAIR CHECK VALVE AND SHUT OFF VALVE WITH NEWLY DESIGNED VALVES.

Subject: LIGHTING:SWITCH:BUTTON:RING:HEAD LIGHTS
Recall Description: UNEXPECTED LOSS OF TAIL LAMP AND SIDE MARKER LAMP FUNCTION MAY OCCUR, REDUCING OTHER DRIVERS ABILITY TO SEE THE VEHICLE.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD LEAD TO A VEHICLE CRASH WITHOUT PRIOR WARNINGIN CONDITIONS OF POOR VISIBILITY, SEVERE WEATHER OR NIGHTTIME.
Corrective Action: REPLACE HEADLIGHT SWITCH PANEL.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC:LEVER AND LINKA
Recall Description: MANUAL VALVE LINK IN THE TRANSMISSION MAY HAVE BEEN IMPROPERLY FORMED.
Consequence Summary: THE VALVE LINK COULD SEPARATE RESULTING IN A GEARSELECTION DIFFERENT FROM WHAT THE DRIVER SELECTS.  ALSO, CAR COULD BE STARTEDWITH TRANSMISSION IN GEAR ALLOWING VEHICLE TO MOVE IN AN UNANTICIPATEDDIRECTION.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE MANUAL VALVE DETENT LEVER LINK.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:ARM:PITMAN
Recall Description: ON RIGHT HAND STEERING ARM, KEYWAY MAY BE IN THE WRONG LOCATION CAUSING A TOGGLE CONDITION TO OCCUR UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN SLOW STEERING RETURN WITHOUT PRIORWARNING WHICH WOULD AFFECT STEERING CONTROL AND CREATE THE POTENTIAL FOR ACRASH.
Corrective Action: REPLACE INCORRECT STEERING ARM.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:HARNESS:FRONT:UNDERHOOD
Recall Description: ENGINE COMPARTMENT WIRING HARNESS FUSIBLE LINK WIRES MAY BE TRAPPED UNDER THE SPEED CONTROL SERVO BRACKET.
Consequence Summary: TRAPPED WIRES MAY EVENTUALLY CAUSE A HIGH RESISTANCEELECTRICAL SHORT THAT CAN RESULT IN AN UNDERHOOD FIRE.
Corrective Action: FREE ANY TRAPPED WIRING; THEN SECURE WIRING WITH A TIE STRAP TO KEEP AWAY FROM SPEED CONTROL BRACKET.

Subject: STRUCTURE:SHIELDS:PROTECTORS:LINES:TUBING
Recall Description: A SHIELD AND SUPPORT LOCATED UNDER OPERATORS PLATFORM MAY CONTACT LEFT FRONT TIRE DURING TIGHT RIGHTHAND TURNS.
Consequence Summary: IF OPERATED IN REVERSE WITH WHEEL TURNED TIGHTLY RIGHT,THE TIP OF METAL SUPPORT MAY DAMAGE INSIDE SIDE WALL OF LEFT FRONT TIRE.
Corrective Action: REMOVE INTERFERING SUPPROT AND INSTALL NEW SUPPORT THAT CANNOT CONTACT THE TIRE.

Subject: WHEELS
Recall Description: UNDER HEAVY LOAD CONDITIONS, THE REAR TIRE SIDEWALLS MAY CHAFE AGAINST THE WHEEL HOUSING.
Consequence Summary: PROLONGED CHAFING CAN CAUSE PREMATURE TIRE WEAR ANDCOULD RESULT IN SUDDEN LOSS OF AIR.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A DIFFERENT TYPE SPORT WHEELS OR INSTALL STANDARD WHEELS.

Subject: STRUCTURE:FRAME:MEMBERS AND BODY
Recall Description: FASTENERS USED TO SUPPORT THE SIDE SKIRT ASSEMBLY MAY FAIL.
Consequence Summary: SIDE SKIRT ASSEMBLY MAY SEPARATE FROM TRUCK.
Corrective Action: INSTALL TWO SUPPORTING ANGLES TO PREVENT SKIRT ASSEMBLY SEPARATION.

Subject: BRAKES:CALIPER
Recall Description: IN AREAS OF HEAVY USAGE, ROAD SALT MAY ACCUMULATE AT SURFACES OF COMPONENTS OF FRONT BRAKE CALIPERS.
Consequence Summary: THIS WOULD EVENTUALLY CAUSE DISC PAD LINER CORROSIONTHAT WOULD PREVENT FREE MOVEMENT OF DISC PADS RESULTING IN INEFFECTIVE BRAKINGOF THE FRONT BRAKES.
Corrective Action: REPAIR FRONT BRAKE CALIPERS TO PREVENT ROAD SALT ACCUMULATION.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL RETURN SPRING
Recall Description: THE THROTTLE LEVER IS NOT UNDER SUFFICIENT TENSION.
Consequence Summary: TRUCKS DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 124.
Corrective Action: RELOCATE THROTTLE RETURN SPRING ANCHOR AND/OR THE SPRING ANCHOR WILL BE REPLACED.

Subject: TIRES
Recall Description: TIRES FAILED TO MEET REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 109 HIGH SPEED TEST.
Consequence Summary: FAILED TO MEET FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO.109.
Corrective Action: TIRES WILL BE REPLACED AT NO COST TO CONSUMER WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM DATE OF NOTIFICATION.

Subject: BRAKES:CALIPER
Recall Description: CERTAIN REAR BRAKE CALIPERS COULD BIND AND CONSEQUENTLY OVERHEAT.
Consequence Summary: OVERHEATED CALIPERS COULD CAUSE BRAKE PEDAL TO FEELSPONGY AND COULD RESULT IN ONE BRAKE CIRCUIT BECOMING INOPERATIVE.  BRAKINGABILITY WOULD BE AFFECTED.
Corrective Action: REQUIRES INSPECTION OF BRAKE CALIPERS AND REPLACEMENT OF CALIPERS AS NECESSARY.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK
Recall Description: REPEATED TOPPING OFF OF FUEL TANK DURING REFUELING REDUCES THE EXPANSION SPACE WITHIN THE TANK ALLOWING VAPORS TO ESCAPE FROM THE CHARCOAL FILTER TO OUTSIDE RATHER THAN BEING INDUCTED INTO THE ENGINE.
Consequence Summary: ESCAPING VAPORS COULD IGNITE BY HEAT EMITTED BY THEEXHAUST SYSTEM.
Corrective Action: INSTALL REDESIGNED FILLER NECK AND A NEW VENT VALVE AND HOSE FOR CHARCOAL FILTER.  ALSO, STOP REFUELING WHEN PUMP NOZZLE SHUTS OFF.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:HARNESS:REAR COMPARTMENT
Recall Description: CERTAIN COMPONENTS WERE INCORRECTLY ASSEMBLED; SUCH AS THE HEAT RESISTANT COVER ON THE WIRING HARNESS, LOCATED ABOVE THE EXHAUST SYSTEM AND THE MUFFLERS REAR HEAT SHIELD AND REAR HANGER.
Consequence Summary: A FIRE CAN DEVELOP UNDER MOTORHOME FLOOR WHEN ENGINE ISWORKING HARD IN WARM TEMPERATURES.
Corrective Action: REPLACE COVERING, ADD A HEAT SHIELD, AND REPOSITION MUFFLER HANGER.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK
Recall Description: VEHICLES ARE SUBJECT TO EXCESSIVE UNDERBODY TEMPERATURES AND FUEL SYSTEM PRESSURES.
Consequence Summary: THIS CREATES POTENTIAL FOR FUEL EXPULSION FROM THE FUELFILLER PIPE WHICH, IN THE PRESENCE OF AN IGNITION SOURCE, COULD RESULT IN AFIRE.
Corrective Action: INSTALL AN ADDITIONAL VENTING SYSTEM TO MAIN FUEL TANK TO VENT THE SUPPLEMENTAL PRESSURE.

Subject: TIRES:PLY
Recall Description: TIRES FAILED TO MEET REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 109 FOR ENDURANCE TESTS.
Consequence Summary: THE FAILURE TO MEET REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 109 COULDRESULT IN PLY SEPARATION, LOSS OF AIR, OR POSSIBLY BLOWOUT CAUSING A VEHICLECRASH.
Corrective Action: TIRES WILL BE REPLACED AT NO COST TO CUSTOMERS WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM DATE OF NOTIFICATION.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:LINK:DRAG:CONNECTION
Recall Description: STEERING DRAG LINKS ARE 1/2 INCH TOO LONG AND COULD CONTACT THE FRONT AXLE.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN STEERING AND CONTROL DIFFICULTY.
Corrective Action: REPLACE DRAG LINK TUBE WITH ONE THAT IS 1/2 INCH SHORTER TO ELIMINATE INTERFERENCE.

Subject: FUEL:CARBURETOR:UNKNOWN TYPE:CHOKE
Recall Description: MISUSE OF CARBURETOR CHOKE COULD CAUSE EXCESSIVE EXHAUST SYSTEM HEAT.
Consequence Summary: EXCESSIVE HEAT CAN RESULT IN HEAT DAMAGE TO CAR EXTERIORAND INTERIOR MATERIALS WHICH COULD CAUSE A FIRE.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A KIT WHICH WILL REDUCE EXHAUST SYSTEM TEMPERATURES TO AN ACCEPTABLE LEVEL.  OWNERS MAY CONTACT MASERATI AT 1-877.696.2737.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL
Recall Description: INCORRECT THROTTLE INNER CABLE MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED.
Consequence Summary: THIS CABLE COULD STICK INSIDE ITS HOUSING RESULTING IN ALOSS OF THROTTLE CONTROL.
Corrective Action: INSTALL CORRECT CABLE.

Subject: ENGINE COOLING SYSTEM:FAN
Recall Description: ENGINE VISCOUS FAN DRIVE MOUNTING STUDS LOCATED IN FAN SPACER MAY NOT BE OF SPECIFIED HARDNESS, NOR HAVE SPECIFIED THREAD LOCKING MATERIAL.
Consequence Summary: FAN COULD WORK LOOSE DURING ENGINE OPERATION ANDSEPARATE WHICH COULD RESULT IN PERSONAL INJURY TO PERSONS NEAR ENGINECOMPARTMENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE MOUNTING STUDS IN FAN SPACER.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES:ACCELERATOR:RIGID
Recall Description: FLOOR MAT COULD INTERFERE WITH RELEASE OF ACCELERATOR PEDAL DUE TO IMPROPER SHAPE OF MAT.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF ACCELERATOR CONTROL ANDCREATE POTENTIAL FOR AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REMOVE PRESENT MAT AND REPLACE WITH NEW IMPROVED MAT.

Subject: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:LEAF SPRING HANGER:BRA
Recall Description: WELD WHICH ATTACHES THE SUPPORT BRACKET TO THE REAR AXLE OF THE REAR SUSPENSION COULD CRACK AND BREAK.
Consequence Summary: THIS WOULD ALLOW THE HANGER TO BREAK OFF, POSSIBLYCAUSING AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A REINFORCEMENT KIT TO PREVENT HANGER FROM BREAKING OFF.

Subject: SUSPENSION:AXLE UNKNOWN NON-POWER
Recall Description: WELD CRACKS AND AXLE FRACTURES COULD OCCUR DUE TO INCOMPATIBILITY OF NEWAY RC-122 SUSPENSION AND ROCKWELL AXLES.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLE HANDLING WILL BE IMPAIRED.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW AXLES AND SUSPENSION.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:VALVE:FOOT CONTROL
Recall Description: FOOT CONTROLLED BRAKE VALVE MAY MALFUNCTION BY ALLOWING AIR PRESSURE TO BYPASS CONTROL PISTON O RING.
Consequence Summary: THESE CONDITIONS COULD CAUSE OVERLY AGGRESSIVE TRUCKBRAKING DURING NORMAL BRAKE APPLICATIONS CREATING THE POTENTIAL FOR A VEHICLECRASH.
Corrective Action: REPAIR SO AS TO PREVENT BRAKE VALVE MALFUNCTION.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR:DRUM AND SHOE SYSTEMS:CHAMBER:BRAKE
Recall Description: INCORRECT SIZE AIR BRAKE ACTUATOR CHAMBERS WERE INSTALLED ON THE DRIVE AXLES.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN INCREASED STOPPING DISTANCE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE DRIVE AXLE BRAKE CHAMBERS WITH CORRECT SIZE CHAMBERS.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER LABELS
Recall Description: MASTER CYLINDER RESERVOIR WAS NOT EQUIPPED WITH A WARNING STATEMENT LABEL AS REQUIRED BY FMVSS 105.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLES WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 105.
Corrective Action: AFFIX WARNING LABEL TO MASTER CYLINDER STATING CLEAN FILLER CAP BEFORE REMOVING.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL EMISSION CONTROL:LINES:VAPOR VENT
Recall Description: VEHICLES ARE SUBJECT TO EXCESSIVE UNDERHOOD TEMPERATURES AND FUEL SYSTEM PRESSURES IN SEVERE DUTY APPLICATIONS.
Consequence Summary: THIS CREATES POTENTIAL FOR FUEL EXPULSION FROM THE FUELFILLER PIPE WHICH IN THE PRESENCE OF AN IGNITION SOURCE, COULD RESULT IN AFIRE.
Corrective Action: INSTALL MODIFICATION KITS TO MINIMIZE POSSIBILITY OF FUEL EXPULSION AND TO SHIELD UNDERBODY COMPONENTS FROM EXHAUST SYSTEM HEAT.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:GAUGE:FUEL
Recall Description: SEALS OF LOWER FUEL TANK GAUGE COULD FAIL CAUSING GAS TO LEAK INTO LOWER FUEL TANK CAVITY AND POSSIBLY INTO PASSENGER COMPARTMENT.
Consequence Summary: IGNITION OF GAS VAPORS WHICH MIGHT BE PRESENT COULDCAUSE A FIRE OR EXPLOSION.
Corrective Action: REPLACE LOWER FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY TO UPGRADE FUEL SYSTEM TO CURRENT SPECIFICATIONS.

Subject: WHEELS:OTHER
Recall Description: REAR TIRES MAY RUB ON THE REAR LEAF SPRINGS.  ALSO, REAR WHEELS MAY BE DEFECTIVE.
Consequence Summary: CONTINUED DRIVING COULD RESULT IN REAR TIRES BLOWING OUTWITHOUT WARNING; DRIVER COULD LOSE CONTROL AND A CRASH COULD OCCUR.
Corrective Action: REPLACE TIRES AND WHEELS, AS NECESSARY.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC SYSTEM
Recall Description: TRUCKS WERE BUILT WITH INCORRECT REAR BRAKE ASSEMBLIES.     CONSEQUENCE OF DEFECT: A TENDENCY FOR REAR BRAKE LOCKUP WOULD EXIST PARTICULARLY DURING HEAVY BRAKE APPLICAION WITH A LIGHTLY LOADED TRUCK. ALSO, INCREASED STOPPING DISTANCE WOULD BE REQUIRED IF THE BRAKE MODULATION (PUMPING THE BRAKES) IS USED TO CONTROL THE VEHICLE DURING A HARD BRAKE STOP.
Corrective Action: REPLACE REAR BRAKE ASSEMBLIES.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:TRAILER HITCHES AND ATTACHM
Recall Description: INADEQUATE SUPPORT OF THE BALL HITCH AT ITS ATTACHMENT ONTO THE MOUNTING.
Consequence Summary: SHOULD THE MOUNTING PLATE FRACTURE IT WOULD RESULT INSEPARATION OF THE BALL FROM ITS MOUNTING.
Corrective Action: INSPECT AND REPLACE BALL HITCHES AS NECESSARY.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL LINES:METALLIC
Recall Description: SPRING LOCK FUEL LINE COUPLING MAY NOT BE PROPERLY ENGAGED.
Consequence Summary: COUPLING COULD DISENGAGE DUE TO FUEL PRESSURE,VIBRATION, AND ENGINE MOVEMENTS; THIS WOULD CAUSE LOSS OF FUEL WHICH, INPRESENCE OF AN IGNITION SOURCE, CREATES A FIRE RISK.
Corrective Action: INSTALL RETAINER CLIPS OVER THE COUPLINGS TO PREVENT COUPLING SEPARATION AND FUEL LEAKAGE.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT BUCKLES
Recall Description: MISMATCH OF MALE AND FEMALE REAR SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES.
Consequence Summary: THE SEAT BELTS CAN NOT BE BUCKLED AND PASSENGERS AREUNABLE TO USE THE RESTRAINT SYSTEM.
Corrective Action: INSPECT AND REPLACE ALL MISMATCHED BELT ASSEMBLIES.

Subject: SUSPENSION:TANDEM AXLE:REAR:TORQUE ARM
Recall Description: THE TANDEM SUSPENSION CURVED TORQUE RODS MAY FAIL AT A POINT WHERE THE TWO PIECE CENTER TUBE IS WELDED TOGETHER.
Consequence Summary: A BROKEN TORQUE ROD WOULD AFFECT THE HANDLING AND THESTABILITY OF THE VEHICLE.
Corrective Action: INSPECT AND MAKE NECESSARY REPAIRS TO PRECLUDE ROD SEPARATION AT THE WELD POINT.

Subject: WHEELS:LUGS:NUTS:BOLTS
Recall Description: WHEEL LUG NUT CONE ANGLES DO NOT MATCH LUG NUT SEATING ANGLES.
Consequence Summary: NUTS COULD LOOSEN IN SERVICE CREATING POTENTIAL FORWHEELS TO SEPARATE FROM TRUCK.
Corrective Action: REPAIR TO PREVENT LOOSENING OF LUG NUTS.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: RIGHT AND LEFT HAND BRAKE HOSE MAY CONTACT THE WHEEL OR TIRE IN A FULL TURN.
Consequence Summary: IF THE HOSE MAKES CONTACT WITH THE WHEEL OR TIRE IT WILLEVENTUALLY WEAR THE HOSE TO A POINT OF RUPTURE, RESULTING IN A LOSS OF THEFRONT BRAKES.  LOSS OF FRONT BRAKES WOULD INCREASE THE STOPPING DISTANCE WHENMINIMUM TIME IS REQUIRED AND COULD RESULT IN A VEHICLE CRASH.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW REPOSITIONING BRACKETS FOR THE FRONT BRAKE HOSES.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:FUSE
Recall Description: AN IN LINE FUSIBLE LINK MAY MELT DOWN AND CAUSE A FIRE.
Consequence Summary: THE IN LINE FUSIBLE LINK LOCATED IN THE AREA OF THEPLASTIC WINDSHIELD WASHER BOTTLE BRACKET MAY, UNDER A HIGH RESISTANCE LOAD,MELT DOWN AND IGNITE THE WASHER BOTTLE BRACKET RESULTING IN AN ENGINECOMPARTMENT FIRE.
Corrective Action: THE WINDSHIELD WASHER BOTTLE BRACKET WILL BE REPLACED.

Subject: LIGHTING:FLASHER:HAZARD WARNING (1/84)
Recall Description: FAILURE TO MEET STARTING TIME, VOLTAGE DROP AND DURABILITY REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 108.
Consequence Summary: FAILURE TO PROPERLY SIGNAL DIRECTION OF VEHICLE TOTRAFFIC.  THIS COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REFUND BY IMPORTER UPON RETURN OF FLASHERS.

Manufacturer: Mitsubishi Fuso Truck of America, Inc.
Subject: POWER TRAIN:CLUTCH ASSEMBLY:PEDAL
Recall Description: IMPROPER MACHINING OF THE CLUTCH MASTER CYLINDER LOCATED ON CLUTCH PEDAL SUPPORT.
Consequence Summary: IMPROPERLY MACHINED CYLINDERS COULD CAUSE THE CLUTCH TORELEASE IMPROPERLY WHEN THE CLUTCH PEDAL IS DEPRESSED.  IF THIS HAPPENS, IT MAYBE DIFFICULT TO TOTALLY RELEASE CLUTCH AND SHIFT TRANSMISSION OUT OF GEAR.
Corrective Action: REPLACE CLUTCH AS REQUIRED.

Subject: WHEELS
Recall Description: DUAL REAR WHEELS MAY HAVE PIN HOLE LEAKS AND CRACKS AROUND THE VALVE STEM HOLE THAT HAD BEEN WELDED.
Consequence Summary: DRIVING WITH THE INNER DUAL REAR WHEEL FLAT COULD CAUSEA BLOWOUT, AND POSSIBLE WHEEL BEARING OR AXLE FAILURE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE DEFECTIVE WHEELS.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL INJECTION:OTHER PARTS
Recall Description: FUEL RAILS MAY BE BENT SO THAT NO. 5 INJECTOR CUPS ARE OUT OF DESIGN POSITION.
Consequence Summary: BENT FUEL RAIL COULD CAUSE A FUEL LEAK, WHICH INPRESENCE OF AN IGNITION SOURCE COULD RESULT IN AN ENGINE FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FUEL RAIL ASSEMBLIES AS NECESSARY.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR LINES AND FITTINGS
Recall Description: ROUTING OF AIR SUPPLY LINES CLOSE TO THE EXHAUST MANIFOLD PIPE SUBJECT THE LINES TO DEFORMATION AND POSSIBLE RUPTURE FROM THE RADIANT HEAT OF THE PIPE.
Consequence Summary: RUPTURE OF AIR PRESSURE LINES COULD CAUSE LOW AIRPRESSURE AND PARK BRAKE WARNING LIGHTS TO COME ON; IT WILL AUTOMATICALLY APPLYPARK/EMERGENCY BRAKE AND DEFLATE FRONT SUSPENSION AIR BAGS.
Corrective Action: REPLACE DAMAGED AIR LINES AND INSTALL A PROTECTIVE HEAT SHIELD OR REPOSITION AIR LINES AWAY FROM EXHAUST PIPE.

Subject: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR
Recall Description: IMPROPER WELDS WHERE STEERABLE DRIVE END MOUNTING FLANGE IS ATTACHED TO THE TUBULAR PORTION OF THE HOUSING.
Consequence Summary: FAILURE OF WELDS COULD RESULT IN AXLE END SEPARATINGFROM THE HOUSING RESULTING IN POSSIBLE VEHICLE CRASH AND DAMAGE TO VEHICLE.
Corrective Action: REPLACEMENT OF ALL DEFECTIVE AXLE HOUSINGS.

Subject: WHEELS:OTHER
Recall Description: CRACKS IN FRONT AND REAR WHEELS COULD DEVELOP AND CONTINUE THROUGH WHEEL SPOKES.
Consequence Summary: HUB AND RIM COULD SEPARATE CREATING HANDLING PROBLEMSWHICH COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF CONTROL.
Corrective Action: REPLACE WHEELS WITH DIFFERENT TESTED WHEELS.

Subject: BRAKES:FLUID:HYDRAULIC (FLUID CONTAMINATION/WRONG
Recall Description: FLUID FAILED TO COMPLY WITH THE EVAPORATION REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 116.
Consequence Summary: FAILED THE EVAPORATION REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 116.
Corrective Action: BRAKE FLUID WILL BE REPLACED AT NO COST TO CONSUMER.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:SPEED CONTROL:LINKAGES(12:83)
Recall Description: CRUISE CONTROL CABLE LOCK MECHANISM MAY SELF DISENGAGE CAUSING ERRATIC OPERATION OR THROTTLE NOT RETURNING TO IDLE.
Consequence Summary: ENGINE SPEED WOULD NOT DECREASE; LOSS OF ACCELERATORCONTROL COULD RESULT IN A CRASH WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A CLAMP AROUND THE LOCK TAB OF CRUISE CONTROL.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:TIE ROD:END
Recall Description: ONE OR BOTH OF OUTER TIE ROD NUTS MAY BE LOOSE AND NOT CRIMPED.
Consequence Summary: LOSS OF ONE OR BOTH NUTS COULD LEAD TO TIE RODDISENGAGING FROM STEERING KNUCKLE RESULTING IN POSSIBLE LOSS OF STEERINGCONTROL AND POSSIBLY A CRASH.
Corrective Action: REPLACE TIE ROD AND KNUCKLE AND SET TOE-IN.

Subject: STRUCTURE:DOOR ASSEMBLY:LATCHES AND LOCKS
Recall Description: TRUCKS MAY HAVE CRACKED OR BROKEN DOOR STRIKER NUTS, WHICH DO NOT CONFORM TO FMVSS 206.
Consequence Summary: IN A COLLISION, CRACKED OR BROKEN STRIKER NUT COULDALLOW DOOR TO OPEN UNEXPECTEDLY AND POSSIBLY CAUSE INJURY TO OCCUPANTS.
Corrective Action: REPLACE EXISTING DOOR STRIKER NUTS.

Subject: STRUCTURE:FRAME:MEMBERS AND BODY:OTHER PARTS
Recall Description: SMALL CRACKS MAY DEVELOP IN THE BODY PILLAR AROUND THE DOOR STRIKER BOLT HOLE.
Consequence Summary: CRACKS WOULD INCREASE LEADING TO DIFFICULTY IN CLOSINGTHE DOOR AND MIGHT ALLOW DOOR TO COME OPEN DURING A CRASH, INCREASINGLIKELIHOOD OF INJURY TO OCCUPANTS.
Corrective Action: INSTALL INNER AND OUTER REINFORCEMENT PLATE ON BOTH LEFT AND RIGHT BODY PILLARS.

Subject: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT SHOCK ABSORBER
Recall Description: INCORRECT FRONT SHOCK ABSORBER UPPER AND LOWER NUTS COULD LOOSEN.
Consequence Summary: SHOCK ABSORBER COULD DETACH AND COME IN CONTACT WITHFRONT BRAKE HOSE; THIS CONTACT COULD RESULT IN A LEAK IN THE HOSE AND LOSS OFFRONT BRAKES.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FREE SPINNING NUTS WITH TORQUE NUTS.

Subject: TIRES
Recall Description: FAILURE TO MEET REQUIREMENT OF FMVSS NO. 119, ENDURANCE TEST.
Consequence Summary: TIRES FAILED TO MEET FMVSS NO. 119.
Corrective Action: REPLACE WITH NEW TIRE AT NO COST TO CUSTOMER WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM NOTIFICATION.

Subject: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:VALVE:AIR BRAKE SYSTEM
Recall Description: OVERLOADED REAR SUSPENSION MAY AFFECT BRAKING ABILITY.
Consequence Summary: IMPAIRED BRAKING ABILITY COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE BRAKE PROPORTIONING VALVE.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL:SOLENOID:VALVES
Recall Description: A SMALL AMOUNT OF COOLANT SEEPAGE MAY OCCUR, AND EVENTUALLY RESIDUE MAY ACCUMULATE ON THE THROTTLE VALVE.
Consequence Summary: RESIDUE MAY CAUSE THROTTLE VALVE RETURN-TO-IDLE SPEED TOBE SLOWER THAN NORMAL WHEN ACCELERATOR PEDAL IS RELEASED.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THROTTLE BODY ASSEMBLY.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR:DRUM AND SHOE SYSTEMS:CHAMBER:BRAKE
Recall Description: SEVERE BRAKE CHATTER MAY CAUSE THE BRAKE CHAMBER MOUNTING BRACKETS ON EITHER SIDE TO DEVELOP CRACKS IN THE WELD AREA WHERE THE S CAM SHAFT TUBE ATTACHES TO THE CHAMBER SUPPORT SECTION.
Consequence Summary: BRACKETS CAN BREAK, RESULTING IN LOSS OF BRAKING ABILITYAT THAT FRONT WHEEL, AND POSSIBLY RESTRICTED STEERING, WHICH COULD LEAD TO AVEHICLE CRASH WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: AS NECESSARY, INSTALL NEW REINFORCED FRONT BRAKE CHAMBER MOUNTING BRACKETS AND INSTALL A FRONT BRAKE LIMITING VALVE ON VEHICLES WITHOUT ONE.

Subject: LIGHTING:FLASHER:HAZARD WARNING (1/84)
Recall Description: THE HAZARD FLASHER UNIT, WHEN USED IN PLACE OF THE TURN SIGNAL FLASH UNIT, DOES NOT PROVIDE LAMP OUTAGE INDICATION AS REQUIRED BY FMVSS 108.
Consequence Summary: DRIVER WOULD NOT REALIZE TURN SIGNAL LAMP HAS BURNEDOUT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE HAZARD FLASHER UNIT WITH A NEW TURN SIGNAL FLASHER WHICH COMPLIES WITH FMVSS 108.

Subject: LIGHTING:GENERAL OR UNKNOWN COMPONENT:TURN SIGNAL
Recall Description: REFLECTOR PORTION OF FRONT TURN SIGNAL LENS ASSEMBLY DOES NOT MEET PHOTOMETRIC REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 108.
Consequence Summary: IMPROPERLY REFLECTED LIGHT COULD CONCEIVABLY RESULT INANOTHER VEHICLE OPERATOR FAILING TO SEE TURN SIGNAL, WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR ANACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE LEFT AND RIGHT FRONT TURN SIGNAL LENS WITH COMPLIANT MATERIAL.

Subject: WHEELS:HUB
Recall Description: IRON PARTICLES INSIDE THE WHEEL HUBS COULD CREATE FRICTION CAUSING THE BEARING TO OVERHEAT.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN PREMATURE BEARING FAILURE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE HUBS AND BEARINGS.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:SHOE AND DRUM SYSTEM:DRUM
Recall Description: REAR BRAKE DRUMS MAY HEAT UP DUE TO A LACK OF BRAKING BY THE FRONT AXLE DISC BRAKES.
Consequence Summary: DRUMS COULD CRACK AND BREAK RESULTING IN TRUCKS NOTSTOPPING PROPERLY.
Corrective Action: INSTALL 30 IN. REAR BRAKE CHAMBERS AND 30 IN. FRONT BRAKE CHAMBERS.

Subject: LIGHTING:FLASHER:HAZARD WARNING (1/84)
Recall Description: A RELAY IN THE FLASHING CIRCUIT COULD FAIL.
Consequence Summary: RED WARNING LIGHTS WOULD NOT FLASH, BUT WOULD BE ONCONSTANTLY.
Corrective Action: REPLACE DEFECTIVE FLASHER UNITS WITH NEW UNITS WITH RELIABLE RELAYS.

Subject: SUSPENSION:I-BEAM:SOLID:FRONT HANGER:BRACKET
Recall Description: FRAME BRACKET WHICH SUPPORTS THE REAR OF THE FRONT AXLE SUSPENSION SPRING MAY FAIL.
Consequence Summary: SUSPENSION AND AXLE COULD SEPARATE FROM VEHICLE WHICHCOULD RESULT IN LOSS OF CONTROL.
Corrective Action: REPLACE STANDARD BRACKET WITH BRACKET INTENDED FOR OFF HIGHWAY SEVERE SERVICE.

Subject: STRUCTURE:BODY ROOF
Recall Description: BUS BODIES MAY NOT MEET THE 60 PERCENT JOINT EFFICIENCY REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 221 DUE TO INSUFFICIENT BONDING OF THE ADHESIVE IN THE JOINT.
Consequence Summary: ROOF PANEL JOINTS COULD DETACH IN A SEVERE CRASH OR BUSROLLOVER.
Corrective Action: REPAIR JOINTS BY INSTALLING A SUFFICIENT NUMBER OF FASTENERS TO MECHANICALLY BRING JOINTS INTO COMPLIANCE.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL EMISSION CONTROL:LINES:VAPOR VENT
Recall Description: EXPULSION OF FUEL DUE TO OVERPRESSURIZATION.
Consequence Summary: FUEL OR FUEL VAPORS IN THE PRESENCE OF AN IGNITIONSOURCE CAN CAUSE A FIRE.
Corrective Action: MODIFICATION OF THE BASE FUEL VENTING AND EMISSION CONTROL SYSTEM TO REDUCE OPERATING TEMPERATURES AND FUEL SYSTEM PRESSURES.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:PEDALS:LINKAGES AND VALVES
Recall Description: THE BRAKE INTERLOCK SHUTTLE VALVE ASSEMBLY COULD UNDER A HEAVY SERVICE BRAKE APPLICATION FRACTURE OR FRAGMENT THE INTERNAL SHUTTLE PISTON.
Consequence Summary: THE FRACTURE OR FRAGMENTION OF THE INTERLOCK SHUTTLEVALVE PISTON COULD RESULT IN PARTIAL OR COMPLETE LOSS OF REAR BRAKING.  AREDUCTION IN BRAKING ABILITY COULD RESULT IN A VEHICLE CRASH WITHOUT PRIORWARNING.
Corrective Action: NEW IMPROVED BRAKE INTERLOCK SHUTTLE ASSEMBLY WILL BE INSTALLED.

Subject: LIGHTING:FLASHER:TURN SIGNAL
Recall Description: FAILURE TO MEET REQUIREMENTS OF PHOTOMETRIC TESTS OF FMVSS NO. 108.
Consequence Summary: FAILURE TO PROPERLY SIGNAL DIRECTION OF VEHICLE TOTRAFFIC.  THIS COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REFUND PURCHASE COST FOR RETURNED LAMPS.

Subject: BRAKES:FLUID:HYDRAULIC (FLUID CONTAMINATION/WRONG
Recall Description: FLUID FAILED TO COMPLY WITH VISCOSITY TEST OF FMVSS NO. 116.
Consequence Summary: FAILED KINEMATIC VISCOSITY TEST REQUIRED BY FMVSS NO.116.
Corrective Action: BRAKE FLUID WILL BE REPLACED AT NO CHARGE BY WARWICK LAB.

Subject: ENGINE:GASKETS:VALVE COVER
Recall Description: VALVE COVER GASKET MAY LEAK OIL.
Consequence Summary: OIL MAY DRIP ON EXHAUST MANIFOLD AND IF ENGINE ISOPERATED UNDER SEVERE CONDITION OR OPERATED AT CONTINUOUSLY HIGH SPEEDS.  THEMANIFOLD MAY BECOME HOT ENOUGH TO IGNITE THE OIL.  THIS COULD RESULT IN ANENGINE COMPARTMENT FIRE.
Corrective Action: THE VALVE COVER GASKET WILL BE REPLACED WITH A NEW GASKET REDESIGNED TO CORRECT THE OIL LEAK.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:SPEED CONTROL:LINKAGES(12:83)
Recall Description: HIGH VOLTAGE PULSES CAN CAUSE THE MICROPROCESSOR IN THE CRUISE CONTROL TO PULL THE THROTTLE AND CAUSE SELF ENGAGEMENT.
Consequence Summary: SELF ENGAGEMENT COULD HAPPEN WHILE IN TRAFFIC ANDPOSSIBLE CAUSE AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALLATION OF 22K RESISTOR IN SERIES WITH THE WIRE TO THE COIL.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:ATTACHMENTS
Recall Description: FUEL LEAK AT THE TOP OF THE FRONT FUEL TANK IN THE AREA OF THE VAPOR VALVE GROMMET.  GROMMET MAY SPLIT DUE TO COMPRESSIVE LOAD WHEN INSTALLED IN THE FUEL TANK.
Consequence Summary: FUEL MAY LEAK FROM VAPOR VALVE AND BECOME THE SOURCE OFFUEL FOR A FIRE.
Corrective Action: INSTALLATION OF A NEWLY DESIGNED VAPOR VALVE GROMMET.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL:PEDAL
Recall Description: DRIVERS FLOORMAT MISPOSITIONED SUCH AS TO INTERFERE WITH ACCELERATOR PEDAL.
Consequence Summary: FLOORMAT MAY RESTRICT RETURN OF ACCELERATOR PEDAL TO THEIDLE POSITION.
Corrective Action: FLOORMAT WILL BE REPLACED WITH A REDESIGNED MAT TO ELIMINATE THE INTERFERENCE.

Subject: SUSPENSION:I-BEAM:SOLID:FRONT KING PIN
Recall Description: INADEQUATE REINFORCEMENT FOR KING PIN.
Consequence Summary: KING PIN COULD SEPARATE FROM TRAILER, FREEING THETRAILER TO TRAVEL UNSTEERED AND UNGUIDED, A HAZARD TO OTHER VEHICLES ANDPERSONS IN ITS PATH.
Corrective Action: REINFORCEMENT OF THE KING PIN SUPPORT STRUCTURE AND CHECK ALL EXISTING WELDS.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:AIR SUPPLY:RESERVOIR:WET:DRY
Recall Description: MINIMUM AIR RESERVOIR VOLUME CAPACITY IS LESS THAN REQUIRED BY FMVSS NO. 121.
Consequence Summary: FAILURE TO MEET REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 121.
Corrective Action: RETROFIT ADDITIONAL RESERVOIR CAPACITY TO ENSURE FULL COMPLIANCE WITH FMVSS NO. 121.

Subject: LIGHTING:LAMP OR SOCKET:BRAKE LIGHTS
Recall Description: CRUISE CONTROL MAY FAIL TO DISENGAGE IN A NORMAL MANNER UPON APPLICATION OF THE BRAKES, AND THE REAR BRAKE LAMPS MAY FAIL DUE TO MALFUNCTION OF BRAKE LAMP MICROSWITCH ASSEMBLY.
Consequence Summary: POSSIBLE  LOSS OF STOP LAMPS AND FAILURE OF CRUISECONTROL TO DISENGAGE IN THE NORMAL MANNER MAY RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A MODIFIED MICROSWITCH IN ALL VEHICLES.

Subject: STEERING:COLUMN
Recall Description: MISALIGNMENT BETWEEN THE STEERING COLUMN ASSEMBLY AND THE GEAR BOX.
Consequence Summary: EXCESSIVE MISALIGNMENT CAN LEAD TO STEERING FAILURE ANDLOSS OF STEERING CONTROL.
Corrective Action: REQUIRES REMOVING OLD STEERING COLUMN AND REPLACING WITH NEW DESIGNED COLUMN.

Subject: LIGHTING:FUSE:BRAKE LIGHTS
Recall Description: IN CASE OF ELECTRICAL FAILURE WHICH BLOWS FUSE NO. 9, THE REAR BRAKE LIGHTS WILL NOT OPERATE.
Consequence Summary: TOUCHING THE BRAKE PEDAL TO DISENGAGE THE CRUISE CONTROLWOULD NOT FUNCTION AS INTENDED.
Corrective Action: USE TWO FUSES IN COMBINATION SO THAT IN CASE OF A FUSE FAILURE, THE CRUISE CONTROL SYSTEM WILL NOT OPERATE.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:FUSE AND RECEPTICLE:CIRCUIT BREA
Recall Description: THE HEADLAMP CIRCUIT BREAKER MAY OVERHEAT AT LOW BEAM CAUSING AN INTERMITTENT HEADLAMP CIRCUIT.
Consequence Summary: HEADLAMP AND FOGLAMPS WOULD GO OUT SUDDENLY REDUCINGDRIVER VISIBILITY, WHICH COULD RESULT IN A VEHICLE CRASH.
Corrective Action: REVISE FOGLAMP CIRCUIT TO PREVENT OVERHEATING OF HEADLAMP CIRCUIT.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AND BELT
Recall Description: FASTENERS USED TO ASSEMBLE THE D RING ANCHORAGE FOR THE SHOULDER HARNESS MAY NOT PROVIDE SUFFICIENT STRENGTH TO MEET SPECIFIED LOAD REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 210.
Consequence Summary: TRUCKS DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 210.
Corrective Action: REPLACE MONOBOLT FASTENERS WITH HIGH CLAMP 1/4 IN BLIND RIVETS.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: HOSE FAILS TO COMPLY TO CRUSH TEST FOR FMVSS NO. 106.
Consequence Summary: HOSE BECOMES OVAL AND MAY RESTRICT FLOW OF VACUUM ONVACUUM ASSISTED HYDRAULIC BRAKE SYSTEM.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ALL HOSE WITH NEW IMPROVED HOSE.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: MAIN HYDRAULIC PRESSURE HOSE MAY NOT WITHSTAND EXCESSIVELY HIGH EXHAUST TEMPERATURES.
Consequence Summary: HOSE COULD LEAK AND RESULT IN A FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE DEFECTIVE HOSES WITH HIGH TEMPERATURE HOSE ASSEMBLIES AND HEAT SHIELDS, AS NECESSARY.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:FUSE AND RECEPTICLE:CIRCUIT BREA
Recall Description: INCORRECT CIRCUIT BREAKER CAN BECOME OVERLOADED AND TRIP, AND NOT RESET FOR 40-60 SECONDS.
Consequence Summary: BUS WOULD LOSE TURN SIGNALS, TAIL LIGHTS, STOP LIGHTS,HEADLIGHTS, AND/OR WINDSHIELD WIPERS.
Corrective Action: REPLACE 50 AMP BREAKER WITH 105 AMP BREAKER.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK
Recall Description: FUEL TANKS MAY CRACK IN SERVICE DUE TO FATIGUE OF MATERIAL AROUND WELD.
Consequence Summary: FUEL WOULD SEEP FROM TANK CREATING THE POTENTIAL FOR AFIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ORIGINAL TANK WITH A NEW TANK.

Subject: LIGHTING:LAMP OR SOCKET:EMERGENCY FLASH HAZARD WAR
Recall Description: FAILURE TO MEET DURABILITY FLASH RATE AND CURRENT REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 108.
Consequence Summary: FAILURE TO PROPERLY SIGNAL DIRECTION OF VEHICLE TOTRAFFIC.  THIS COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACEMENT OF FLASHERS WITHOUT CHARGE TO CUSTOMERS.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:PIPE:FILLER:NECK
Recall Description: THERE MAY BE HOLES IN THE GASOLINE FUEL FILLER NECK IN THE WELD SEAM WHICH CONVERTS THE FORD FILLER NECK WITH A 90 DEGREE BEND INTO A STRAIGHT TUBE.
Consequence Summary: SUCH HOLES COULD ALLOW FUEL TO LEAK CREATING THEPOTENTIAL FOR A FIRE.
Corrective Action: PRESSURE TEST FILLER NECKS TO ASSURE THAT NO POTENTIAL LEAKS EXISTS IN THIS PART.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC:LEVER AND LINKA
Recall Description: UNINTENDED ACCELERATION MAY OCCUR, FOR EXAMPLE, WHEN SHIFTING FROM THE PARK POSITION.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN A VEHICLE ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A SHIFT INTERLOCK SYSTEM WHICH PREVENTS THE TRANSMISSION SHIFT LEVER FROM BEING MOVED FROM THE PARK POSITION UNLESS THE BRAKE PEDAL IS DEPRESSED.

Subject: TIRES:OTHER
Recall Description: PROTRUSION OF THE TIRE FLAP AND INNER TUBE MATERIAL THROUGH THE SLOTTED VALVE OPENING IN THE METAL RIM ON WHICH TIRE MAY BE MOUNTED.
Consequence Summary: ABRASION OF THE FLAP AND TUBE CAN RESULT IN LOSS OF AIRPRESSURE FROM THE TIRE AND INNER TUBE ASSEMBLY.
Corrective Action: FLAPS AND TUBES WILL BE REPLACED AT NO CHARGE TO CUSTOMER.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL LINES FITTINGS AND PUMP
Recall Description: THE OPEN DESIGN GUIDE SLEEVE FOR THE PLUNGER IN THE ENGINE INJECTION PUMP MAY CONTAIN A STEEL BURR THAT CAN LODGE BETWEEN THE GUIDE SLEEVE AND THE PLUNGER CAUSING AN INCREASE IN STRESS AT A NOTCH IN THE SLEEVE AND RESULTING IN CRACKING OF THE SLEEVE.
Consequence Summary: THE CRACKED GUIDE SLEEVE MAY BIND THE FUEL CONTROL RACK,RESULTING IN A LOSS OF ENGINE SPEED CONTROL.
Corrective Action: THE INJECTION PUMPS WILL BE REPLACED ON ALL ENGINES.

Subject: STRUCTURE:BODY ROOF
Recall Description: OPENING THE ROOF HATCH PAST 90 DEGREES CAN DISENGAGE THE HINGE PIN RETAINER RING ALLOWING THE HINGE PINS TO WORK OUT.
Consequence Summary: ROOF HATCH COULD SEPARATE FROM THE BUS AND INJUREINDIVIDUALS IN THE VICINITY.
Corrective Action: INSTALL TWO HINGE PINS TO PREVENT ROOF HATCH SEPARATION.

Subject: LIGHTING:FLASHER:TURN SIGNAL
Recall Description: FAILURE TO MEET DURABILITY, FLASH RATE AND CURRENT REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 108.
Consequence Summary: FAILURE TO PROPERLY SIGNAL DIRECTION OF VEHICLE TOTRAFFIC.  THIS COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACEMENT OR REFUND OF PURCHASE PRICE UPON RETURN OF FLASHERS.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: FRONT BRAKE HOSE, ROUTED FROM THE BODY BRAKE TUBING TO THE FRONT AXLE CONNECTOR, MAY BE TWISTED.
Consequence Summary: TWISTED HOSE CAN LOOP UPON ITSELF AND ALLOW ABRASIVECONTACT DURING NORMAL SUSPENSION TRAVEL; THIS CAN RESULT IN HOSE FAIILURE ANDPARTIAL LOSS OF BRAKING CAPABILITY.
Corrective Action: REROUTE HOSE TO ELIMINATE ANY CONTACT POTENTIAL.

Subject: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:NON-POWER AXLE:AXLE AS
Recall Description: THE REAR AXLE SHAFTS MAY CONTAIN BRAKE DRUM/WHEEL STUDS THAT ARE NOT CENTERED WITH THE DRUM PILOT DIAMETER.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD PREVENT FULL SEATING OF THE DRUM TO THE SHAFTFLANGE, WHICH MAY RESULT IN WHEEL STUD NUT LOOSENING.
Corrective Action: REPLACE AXLE SHAFTS AS NECESSARY.

Subject: WHEELS:RIM BASE
Recall Description: SPACERS DO NOT MEET MANUFACTURERS SPECIFICATION, MATERIAL USED .109 THICK IN PLACE OF .156 THICK MATERIAL.
Consequence Summary: THE THINNER MATERIAL CAN DEFORM UNDER NORMAL CLAMPINGLOAD, WHICH COULD ALLOW THE RIM TO ROTATE RELATIVE TO THE WHEEL.  THIS ROTATIONCOULD CAUSE THE VALVE STEM TO PINCH AND POSSIBLY BREAK, RESULTING IN A FLATTIRE AND DAMAGE THE WHEEL.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SPACERS AND WHEEL ASSEMBLY IF ANY INDICATION OF DAMAGE.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:ANTI-SKID SYSTEM
Recall Description: THE ANTI LOCK BRAKE SYSTEM (ABS) PRESSURE/WARNING SWITCH MAY EXHIBIT BRAKE FLUID SEEPAGE WHICH EVENTUALLY CAN LEAD TO LOSS OF THE BRAKE SYSTEM HYDRAULIC PUMP MOTOR.  ADDITIONALLY, THE HYDRAULIC PUMP MOTOR AND ABS ELECTRICAL RELAYS MAY HAVE BEEN EXPOSED TO WATER CONTAMINATION DURING VEHICLE ASSEMBLY.  THIS CONDITION CAN CAUSE LOSS OF THE HYDRAULIC PUMP MOTOR AND/OR LOSS OF THE ABS FUNCTION.
Consequence Summary: LOSS OF THE HYDRAULIC PUMP MOTOR WOULD RESULT IN A TOTALLOSS OF REAR BRAKES AS WELL AS POWER ASSIST TO THE FRONT BRAKES.  THE RED BRAKEWARNING LIGHT WOULD ILLUMINATE AND STAY ON.  IF THIS WARNING IS NOT HEEDED, ALOSS OF REAR BRAKES AT A TIME WHEN MINIMUM STOPPING DISTANCE IS REQUIRED COULDRESULT IN A VEHICLE CRASH.  AN INOPERATIVE ABS ELECTRICAL RELAY COULD CAUSELOSS OF THE ABS FUNCTION, BUT NORMAL POWER ASSISTED BRAKING WOULD BE RETAINED.THE AMBER ANTI LOCK WARNING LIGHT WOULD ILLUMINATE AND STAY ON.
Corrective Action: THE ABS AND HYDRAULIC PUMP MOTOR ELECTRICAL RELAYS AND 30 AMP FUSES WILL BE REPLACED.  IN ADDITION, THE HYDRAULIC PUMP MOTOR ASSEMBLY AND PRESSURE/WARNING SWITCH WILL BE INSPECTED AND, IF REQUIRED, REPLACED.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:PIPE:FILLER:NECK
Recall Description: INCORRECT FUEL FILLER NECK ATTACHMENT SCREWS WERE USED TO ATTACH THE NECK TO THE REAR QUARTER PANELS.
Consequence Summary: THIS CONDITION COULD CAUSE A RATTLE BETWEEN THE FUELFILLER PIPE AND THE SURROUNDING BODY STRUCTURE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE INCORRECT SCREWS WITH NEW BOLT/WASHER ASSEMBLIES.

Subject: STRUCTURE:BODY:TILT CAB (8/82)
Recall Description: BUCKLING OF THE TILT CYLINDERS MAY OCCUR WHILE LOWERING THE VEHICLES CAB DUE TO IMPROPER USE OF THE CAB TILT SYSTEM.
Consequence Summary: CAB MAY DROP TO ITS LOWERED POSITION.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE 1 1/2 IN. DIAMETER TILT CYLINDERS ON ALL 104 IN. CABS WITH 2 IN. DIAMETER CYLINDERS.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK
Recall Description: IN A FRONT END COLLISION, DUAL FUEL TANKS MAY SLIDE ON THE SUPPORT BRACKETS ALLOWING THE FUEL CROSSOVER PIPE END FITTINGS TO CONTACT A PIPE SUPPORT AND PROTECTION GUARD.
Consequence Summary: THIS CONTACT MAY BREAK OR CRACK THE FITTINGS, RESULTINGIN A FUEL LEAK.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW FUEL LINE GUARD, FASTENERS AND, IF NECESSARY, A FITTING.

Subject: LIGHTING:GENERAL OR UNKNOWN COMPONENT:OTHER PART L
Recall Description: THE FLASHING MODE OF THE DECELERATION LIGHT SYSTEM IS NOT IN COMPLIANCE WITH FMVSS 108.
Consequence Summary: FLASHING DECELERATION LIGHTS MAY BE CONFUSING TO OTHERDRIVERS; BUSES DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 108.
Corrective Action: MODIFY DECELERATION LIGHTS TO REMOVE THE FLASHING MODE.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:HARNESS:FRONT:UNDERHOOD
Recall Description: WIRING HARNESSES LOCATED TO THE REAR OF THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT COULD CHAFE AND SHORT CIRCUIT.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN AN ENGINE COMPARTMENT FIRE.
Corrective Action: INSTALL PROTECTIVE INSULATED TAPE.

Subject: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:VALVE:FOOT CONTROL
Recall Description: SINGLE CHECK AIR SYSTEM VALVE MAY MALFUNCTION DUE TO CORROSION.
Consequence Summary: AIR COULD TRANSFER BETWEEN CIRCUITS OF DUAL AIR BRAKESYSTEM IN EVENT OF FAILURE OF ONE OR THE OTHER CIRCUIT, WHICH COULD CAUSEDEPLETION OF THE ENTIRE AIR SYSTEM.
Corrective Action: REPLACE CHECK VALVES, AS NECESSARY.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:TRACKS AND ANCHORS:REAR SEAT
Recall Description: SEAT BRACKETS WHICH ANCHOR REARWARD PASSENGER SEATS MAY NOT ENGAGE PROPERLY.
Consequence Summary: SEAT COULD BREAK LOOSE DURING ACCELERATION AND CAUSEINJURY TO THE SEAT OCCUPANT.
Corrective Action: ASSURE THAT SEAT BRACKETS ARE PROPERLY ENGAGED.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC:OTHER PARTS
Recall Description: PIN IN SHIFT LOCKING PAWL MAY NOT BE PROPERLY WELDED TO THE PAWL.
Consequence Summary: IF PIN SEPARATES FROM PAWL, DRIVER WOULD BE ABLE TO MOVETHE SHIFT LEVER DURING DRIVING INTO ANY POSITION WITHOUT PRESSING SAFETYRELEASE BUTTON.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SHIFT LOCKING PAWL.

Subject: SUSPENSION:AXLE UNKNOWN NON-POWER
Recall Description: WELD CRACKS AND AXLE FRACTURES COULD OCCUR DUE TO INCOMPATIBILITY OF NEWAY RC 122 SUSPENSION AND ROCKWELL AXLES.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLE HANDLING WILL BE IMPAIRED.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW AXLES AND SPRING SUSPENSIONS.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES:ACCELERATOR:RIGID
Recall Description: FLOOR MAT COULD BECOME MISPOSITIONED AND INTERFERE WITH ACCELERATOR PEDAL.
Consequence Summary: THROTTLE MAY NOT RETURN TO THE CLOSED IDLE POSITIONCAUSING LOSS OF ACCELERATOR CONTROL WHICH COULD RESULT IN A VEHICLE CRASHWITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FLOOR MATS WITH NEWLY DESIGNED MATS THAT ARE LONGER AND HAVE IMPROVED RETENTION.

Subject: TIRES
Recall Description: TIRES FAILED TO PASS ENDURANCE TEST REQUIRED BY FMVSS 109.  TIRES MAY DEVELOP SEPARATION BETWEEN THE CARCASS AND BELTS.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLE VIBRATION AND SUDDEN LOSS OF AIR CAN RESULT IN AVEHICLE CRASH WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: REPLACEMENT OF TIRES AT NO COST TO THE CONSUMER WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM DATE OF NOTIFICATION.

Subject: TIRES:SIDEWALL
Recall Description: A HOLE APPROXIMATELY .040 INCHES IN DIAMETER PROTRUDING PARTIALLY THROUGH THE MID SIDEWALL AREA OF THE TIRE.  THIS WAS CAUSED BY A DRILL BIT PROTRUDING FROM THE MOLD AT THE MOLD VENT LOCATION.
Consequence Summary: THIS CONDITION WOULD RESULT IN GRADUAL AIR LOSS CAUSINGUNDERINFLATION OR SIDEWALL CARCASS SEPARATION.  SUDDEN LOSS OF AIR COULD CAUSEVEHICLE CRASH WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: REPLACEMENT OF TIRES AT NO COST TO THE CONSUMER WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM DATE OF NOTIFICATION.

Subject: WHEELS:HUB
Recall Description: THE MALLEABLE IRON REAR HUBS MAY EXHIBIT CRACKS.  ALSO, THE FRONT AXLE HUBS MAY HAVE NOT BEEN PROPERLY HEAT TREATED.
Consequence Summary: AXLE HUBS MAY CRACK STARTING AT POINT WHERE WHEEL STUDSHAVE BEEN PRESSED INTO THE HUB.
Corrective Action: REPLACE AXLE HUB, AS NECESSARY.

Subject: SUSPENSION:I-BEAM:SOLID:FRONT KING PIN
Recall Description: THE TAPERED KING PIN MAY HAVE BEEN BROKEN SHORTLY AFTER ASSEMBLY INTO THE AXLE.
Consequence Summary: KING PIN COULD WORK LOOSE, CAUSING ERRATIC STEERINGWHICH COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF CONTROL AND A CRASH.
Corrective Action: REPAIR TO CORRECT BROKEN KING PIN CONDITION.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL PUMP
Recall Description: VEHICLE MAY EXPERIENCE PERFORATION OF THE FUEL PUMP DIAPHRAGM.  EXCESSIVE ALCOHOL CONTENT IN THE FUEL PROMOTES DEGRADATION OF THE DIAPHRAGM COATING RESULTING IN RADIAL CRACKING OF THE DIAPHRAGM.
Consequence Summary: A PERFORATED DIAPHRAGM CAN ALLOW FUEL TO LEAK FROM THEFUEL PUMP INTO THE UNDERHOOD AREA.  THIS COULD ULTIMATELY RESULT IN ANUNDERHOOD FIRE WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.  SUCH A FIRE COULD SPREAD TO THEPASSENGER COMPARTMENT.
Corrective Action: A FUEL VENTALATION HOSE KIT WILL BE INSTALLED TO PREVENT FUEL FROM ESCAPING INTO THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT IF THE FUEL PUMP DIAPHRAGM LEAKS AND THEREBY REDUCE THE POSSIBILITY OF AN UNDERHOOD FIRE.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL PUMP
Recall Description: VEHICLES MAY EXPERIENCE PERFORATION OF THE FUEL PUMP DIAPHRAGM.  EXCESSIVE ALCOHOL CONTENT IN THE FUEL PROMOTES DEGRADATION OF THE DIAPHRAGM COATING RESULTING IN RADIAL CRACKING OF THE DIAPHRAGM.
Consequence Summary: A PERFORATED DIAPHRAGM CAN ALLOW FUEL TO LEAK FROM THEFUEL PUMP INTO THE UNDERHOOD AREA.  THIS COULD ULTIMATELY RESULT IN ANUNDERHOOD FIRE WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.  SUCH A FIRE COULD SPREAD TO THEPASSENGER COMPARTMENT.
Corrective Action: A FUEL VENTILATION HOSE KIT WILL BE INSTALLED TO PREVENT FUEL FROM ESCAPING INTO THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT IF THE FUEL PUMP DIAPHRAGM LEAKS AND THEREBY REDUCE THE POSSIBILITY OF AN UNDERHOOD FIRE.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:RESTRAINT:BELT ANCHOR AND ATTACHM
Recall Description: THE BUCKLE PORTION OF THE SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY MAY NOT HAVE BEEN PROPERLY ANCHORED TO THE FLOOR.
Consequence Summary: IF THIS CONDITION EXISTS, THE SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY WOULDNOT WITHSTAND A SUBSTANTIAL IMPACT LOAD AND WOULD BE A POTENTIAL FOR PERSONALINJURY.
Corrective Action: INSPECT AND MAKE PROPER INSTALLATION OF SEAT BELT AND BUCKLE ANCHOR BOLTS, IF NECESSARY.

Subject: STRUCTURE:BODY:CAB TRUCK (8/82)
Recall Description: LEFT AND RIGHT CAB STEPS, LOCATED DIRECTLY UNDER THE DRIVER AND PASSENGER CAB DOORS, COULD FAIL FROM CORROSION.
Consequence Summary: SHOULD THE STEP FAIL WHILE BEING USED IT COULD CAUSE PERSONAL INJURY.
Corrective Action: REPLACE STEEL TUBULAR STEPS WITH NEW ALUMINUM STEPS.

Subject: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT:BEARING WHEEL
Recall Description: FRONT INNER WHEEL BEARINGS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN LUBRICATED ADEQUATELY AT TIME OF ASSEMBLY.
Consequence Summary: IF THIS CONDITION WERE TO OCCUR, FRICTION WILL CAUSEPREMATURE DETERIORATION OF THE WHEEL BEARINGS AND STEERING CONTROL COULD BEAFFECTED ADVERSELY.
Corrective Action: INSPECT AND REPLACE ANY BEARING OR RACE SHOWING SIGNS OF GALLING OR HEAT SPOTS.

Subject: TIRES:TREAD
Recall Description: TIRE MAY DEVELOP A TREAD SEPARATION IN THE SHOULDER AREA WHEN TESTED TO THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 119.
Consequence Summary: TIRES FAIL TO MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTORVEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD 119.
Corrective Action: REPLACEMENT OF TIRE WITH NEW ONE WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM DATE OF NOTIFICATION AT NO COST TO CUSTOMER.

Subject: TIRES:TREAD
Recall Description: A DEFECT EXISTS IN THE CURING PROCEDURE.  TIRES COULD DEVELOP TREAD SEPARATION IN THE SHOULDER AREA.
Consequence Summary: TIRES MAY FAIL DURING OPERATION FROM LOSS OF AIR DUE TOTREAD SEPARATION.
Corrective Action: REPLACE TIRE WITH NEW ONE AT NO COST WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM DATE OF NOTIFICATION.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:ARM:PITMAN
Recall Description: THERE MAY NOT BE PROPER ENGAGEMENT BETWEEN THE MALE TAPER OF THE BALL STUD AND THE FEMALE TAPER OF THE PITMAN ARM.
Consequence Summary: STEERING DRAG LINK COULD LOOSEN AND DISENGAGE FROM THESTEERING GEAR PITMAN ARM, AND RESULT IN A TOTAL LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL.
Corrective Action: REPAIR TO ENSURE THAT COACHES HAVE A GOOD, TIGHT PITMAN ARM/DRAG LINK JOINT.

Subject: BRAKES:MECHANICAL SERVICE:OTHER
Recall Description: REAR BRAKE MAY FAIL AS A RESULT OF MOTORCYCLE EVER HAVING BEEN DROPPED ONTO ITS RIGHT SIDE OR HAVING RECEIVED AN IMPACT TO THE RIGHT SIDE OF THE FOOT PEG BRACKET.
Consequence Summary: BRAKE PADS/ROTOR WOULD REMAIN PARTIALLY CLOSED AND WEAREXCESSIVELY; ALSO, CONTROL DIFFICULTIES COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE REAR BRAKE LEVER AND INSTALL A SUPPORT BRACKET FOR THE REAR BRAKE PEDAL SYSTEM.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:OTHER LABELS
Recall Description: STICKERS CONCERNING HANDLING AND MANEUVERABILITY WHICH ARE AFFIXED TO DRIVERS SUN VISOR SLEEVES DO NOT MEET CRITERIA FOR PERMANENT ADHESION.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLES DO NOT MEET FORMATS SPECIFIED BY PARTS 573 AND579 OF 49CFR.
Corrective Action: OWNERS WILL BE MAILED NEW SUN VISOR SLEEVES WITH ALL APPLICABLE DECAL INFORMATION PERMANENTLY AFFIXED.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL:CAM:FAST IDLE
Recall Description: EXCESSIVE WEAR OF IDLE STABILIZER COULD CAUSE IDLE FLUCTUATIONS.
Consequence Summary: IDLE FLUCTUATIONS COULD RESULT IN UNSATISFACTORYDRIVEABILITY.
Corrective Action: REPLACE IDLE STABILIZER.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:MASTER CYLINDER
Recall Description: DEFECTIVE SEALS ON MASTER CYLINDER ALLOWS LEAKAGE OF BRAKE FLUID FROM EITHER THE PRIMARY OR SECONDARY RESERVOIRS.
Consequence Summary: CONTINUED USE AND LEAKAGE CAN CAUSE BRAKE FAILURERESULTING IN POSSIBLE ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ALL SUSPECT SEALS AT NO COST TO THE CONSUMER.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT
Recall Description: PLASTIC SHIELD CRACKED IN DYNAMIC SLED TEST ALLOWING EXCESSIVE CHILD HEAD EXCURSION GREATER THAN THE 22 INCH MAXIMUM.
Consequence Summary: THE EXCESSIVE HEAD MOVEMENT MAY ALLOW CHILD TO CONTACTOBJECT INSIDE THE VEHICLE AND CAUSE PERSONAL INJURY.
Corrective Action: REPLACE THE BOOSTER SEAT WITH A NEW CHILD RESTRAINT SYSTEM.

Subject: FURNACE:RECREATIONAL VEHICLE
Recall Description: THE DIRECT SPARK IGNITION DEFECT COULD RESULT IN UNBURNED GAS FLOWING INTO THE COMBUSTION CHAMBER OF THE FURNACE.
Consequence Summary: UPON MAIN IGNITION, THIS CONDITION COULD RESULT IN ANEXPLOSION OR FIRE AND CAUSE SERIOUS PERSONAL INJURY OR DEATH TO ANYONE WITHINOR IN THE VICINITY OF THE VEHICLE.
Corrective Action: INSPECT AND REPLACE DEFECTIVE SPARK MODULE.

Subject: LIGHTING:FLASHER:TURN SIGNAL
Recall Description: FAILURE TO MEET DURABILITY, FLASH RATE AND CURRENT REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 108.
Consequence Summary: FAILURE TO PROPERLY SIGNAL DIRECTION OF VEHICLE TOTRAFFIC.  THIS COULD RESULT IN AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACEMENT OF FLASHERS WITHOUT CHARGE TO CUSTOMERS.

Subject: LIGHTING:GENERAL OR UNKNOWN COMPONENT:OTHER PART L
Recall Description: THE FLASHING MODE OF THE DECELERATION LIGHT SYSTEM IS NOT IN COMPLIANCE WITH FMVSS 108.
Consequence Summary: FLASHING DECELERATION LIGHTS MAY BE CONFUSING TO OTHERDRIVERS; BUSES DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 108.
Corrective Action: MODIFY DECELERATION LIGHTS TO REMOVE THE FLASHING MODE.

Subject: STEERING:COLUMN:TILT
Recall Description: AN INCORRECT BOLT MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED TO RETAIN THE TILT STEERING COLUMN PIVOT BUSHINGS.
Consequence Summary: BOLT MAY NOT MAINTAIN SPECIFIED TORQUE AND COULD BREAKOR WORK LOOSE AND FALL OUT, RESULTING IN LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL.
Corrective Action: INSTALL PROPER SAE GRADE 5 BOLT.

Subject: STEERING:COLUMN:TILT
Recall Description: STEERING COLUMN LOWER SHAFT MAY BE TOO LONG ALLOWING EXCESSIVE THRUST LOAD TO BE APPLIED TO UPPER HOUSING BEARINGS AND STEERING TRANSFER BOX BEARINGS.
Consequence Summary: BEARINGS COULD FAIL OR SEIZE, RESULTING IN LOSS OFSTEERING CONTROL.
Corrective Action: REPLACE STEERING COLUMN ASSEMBLY WITH ONE OF PROPER LENGTH.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:ARM:PITMAN
Recall Description: THERE MAY NOT BE PROPER ENGAGEMENT BETWEEN THE MALE TAPER OF THE BALL STUD AND THE FEMALE TAPER OF THE PITMAN ARM.
Consequence Summary: STEERING DRAG LINK COULD LOOSEN AND DISENGAGE FROM THESTEERING GEAR PITMAN ARM, AND RESULT IN A TOTAL LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL.
Corrective Action: REPAIR TO ENSURE THAT COACHES HAVE A GOOD, TIGHT PITMAN ARM/DRAG LINK JOINT.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:HARNESS:FRONT:UNDERHOOD
Recall Description: ENGINE WIRING HARNESS COULD CHAFE AGAINST AN AIR CONDITIONING PIPE.
Consequence Summary: A SHORT CIRCUIT AND MALFUNCTIONING OF THE ELECTRICALSYSTEM, AS WELL AS CHARRING OF THE WIRING INSULATION, COULD RESULT.
Corrective Action: RELOCATE WIRING HARNESS AND SECURE WITH A NEW BRACKET AND CLAMP.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT
Recall Description: THE SHIELD POPS OPEN WHILE VEHICLE IS MOVING.  THIS IS DUE TO FAILURE TO FULLY DEPRESS LOCKING HANDLE.
Consequence Summary: WITH THE SHIELD IN A UNLOCKED POSITION THE CHILD WILLNOT BE RESTRAINED IN THE SEAT AND CAN BE INJURIED IN CASE OF AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A BRIGHT COLOR LABEL MARKED LOCK-UNLOCK WHICH IS VISIBLE WHEN THE LOCKING HANDLE IS NOT FULLY DEPRESSED.

Subject: WHEELS:LUGS:NUTS:BOLTS
Recall Description: THE FRONT LEFT WHEEL LUG NUTS MAY HAVE BEEN IMPROPERLY TORQUED.
Consequence Summary: AN IMPROPERLY TORQUED WHEEL MAY LOOSEN OVER A PERIOD OFTIME AND COULD EVENTUALLY SEPARATE, CAUSING AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSPECT AND RE-TORQUE LEFT FRONT WHEEL LUG NUTS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:TRACKS AND ANCHORS:FRONT SEAT:MAN
Recall Description: THE METAL FLOOR PAN ANCHOR BAR COULD FATIGUE AND BREAK AROUND THE LEFT FRONT OUTER SEAT ADJUSTER STUD OF THE DRIVERS SEAT, ALLOWING THE STUD TO SEPARATE FROM THE FLOOR PAN ANCHOR BAR.
Consequence Summary: DRIVERS SEAT COULD TIP REARWARD UNEXPECTEDLY; THIS COULDRESULT IN LOSS OF CONTROL AND A VEHICLE CRASH WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A REINFORCEMENT BRACKET ON THE FLOOR PAN ANCHOR BAR AT THE LEFT FRONT OUTER SEAT ADJUSTER POSITION OF THE DRIVERS SEAT.

Subject: STRUCTURE:HOOD ASSEMBLY:LATCHES
Recall Description: LOSS OF SKID PLATE COULD LEAD TO DISENGAGEMENT OF BOTH SECONDARY AND PRIMARY HOOD LATCHES.
Consequence Summary: HOOD COULD OPEN UNEXPECTANTLY; IF VEHICLE WERE INMOTION, THE HOOD COULD CONTACT THE WINDSHIELD, REDUCE THE DRIVERS VISION AREA,AND A CRASH COULD OCCUR WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A SECONDARY LATCH SKID PLATE AND/OR SECONDARY LATCH SKID PLATE RETAINING SCREWS.

Subject: STEERING:GEAR:RACK AND PINION
Recall Description: DURING THE REMANUFACTURING PROCESS, YOKES MAY HAVE BEEN IMPROPERLY ADJUSTED ON CERTAIN POWER RACK AND PINION STEERING UNITS.
Consequence Summary: THE ABOVE IMPROPER ADJUSTMENT COULD RESULT IN MOMENTARYDISENGAGEMENT OF THE RACK AND THE PINION, SKIPPING OF THE STEERING GEAR TEETHAND A RATCHETING SOUND.  IF THIS CONDITION OCCURS AND THERE IS A LOSS OF POWERSTEERING ASSIST, ENGINE STALLING, POWER STEERING PUMP, BELT OR HOSE FAILURE,LOSS OF STEERING MIGHT OCCUR WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING AND COULD RESULT IN AVEHICLE CRASH.
Corrective Action: REPLACE OR REPAIR POWER STEERING REMANUFACTURED UNITS.

Subject: TIRES
Recall Description: TIRES FAILED TO MEET HIGH SPEED ENDURANCE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR SAFETY STANDARD 109.
Consequence Summary: FAILURE OF TIRES TO MEET FMVSS 109.
Corrective Action: TIRES WILL BE REPLACED AT NO COST TO CONSUMER WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM DATE OF NOTIFICATION.

Subject: SUSPENSION:TANDEM AXLE:REAR:V-BOLT AND ATTACHMENTS
Recall Description: INCORRECT GRADE BOLTS WERE USED IN ATTACHING THE BODY TO THE CHASSIS AND IN ATTACHING THE SEAT ONTO THE CHASSIS.
Consequence Summary: PROPER TORQUE COULD NOT BE ACHIEVED AND BODY COULDSEPARATE FROM THE CHASSIS DURING AN IMPACT.
Corrective Action: REPAIR TO ELIMINATE INCORRECT BOLT PROBLEM.

Subject: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:LEAF SPRING HANGER:BRA
Recall Description: THE SPRING HANGER BRACKET MAY CONTAIN INCORRECT WELDS.
Consequence Summary: THE BRACKETS MAY BECOME LOOSE AFTER EXTENDED OPERATION.THIS LOOSENESS COULD RESULT IN BREAKAGE AND AXLE SEPARATING FROM THE VEHICLE,RESULTING IN A RISK TO TRAFFIC SAFETY AND POTENTIAL VEHICLE CRASH.
Corrective Action: INSTALL SET SCREWS IN THE SIDE LEGS OF THE BRACKET, FOUR PER BRACKET AND WELDED IN PLACE.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL RETURN SPRING
Recall Description: DIESEL ENGINE GOVEERNOR LEVER ASSEMBLIES MAY HAVE BEEN IMPROPERLY ASSEMBLED SO THAT ONE OR MORE OF THREE RETAINING PRONGS MAY NOT BE ENGAGED IN THE GOVERNOR LEVER PIVOT SHAFTS.
Consequence Summary: SEPARATION OF ACCELERATOR LINKAGE AND RETURN SPRINGSCOULD OCCUR, CAUSING THE TIME FOR THE ENGINE TO RETURN TO IDLE FROM AN OPENTHROTTLE POSITION TO SUBSTANTIALLY INCREASE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE GOVERNOR LEVER ASSEMBLIES.

Subject: SUSPENSION:I-BEAM:SOLID:FRONT HANGER:BRACKET
Recall Description: INTERFERENCE BETWEEN THE BRAKE SLACK ADJUSTER AND THE AXLE HANGER BRACKET ON THE FORWARD DRIVE AXLE MAY PREVENT FULL BRAKE APPLICATION ON THAT AXLE.
Consequence Summary: THIS WOULD RESULT IN INCREASED TRUCK STOPPING DISTANCE.
Corrective Action: REPAIR SO AS TO ELIMINATE INTERFERENCE PROBLEM.

Subject: WHEELS:LUGS:NUTS:BOLTS
Recall Description: LUG NUTS COULD GALL AND POSSIBLY SEIZE ON THE WHEEL STUDS WITHOUT PROVIDING ADEQUATE CLAMPING LOAD ON THE WHEELS.
Consequence Summary: WHEEL STUDS COULD FRACTURE CREATING A RISK OF A WHEELSEPARATING WITH LITTLE FOREWARNING.
Corrective Action: REPLACE WHEEL LUG NUTS AND IF NECESSARY, REPLACE WHEELS AND WHEEL STUDS.

Subject: WHEELS:RIM BASE
Recall Description: TWO PIECE ALUMINUM WHEELS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN WELDED AT POINT WHERE WHEEL IS PRESS FITTED ONTO THE RIM.
Consequence Summary: WHEEL COULD SEPARATE FROM RIM CREATING THE POTENTIAL FORAN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE WHEELS AS APPROPRIATE.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CENTER OF GRAVITY INDICATOR LABEL
Recall Description: INCORRECT CENTER OF GRAVITY.
Consequence Summary: FAILS TO MEET REQUIREMENT OF FMVSS 126 TRUCK CAMPERLOADING.  THIS CONDITION COULD, IF THE LOADING IS SEVERLY INCORRECT, ADVERSELYAFFECT THE HANDLING OF THE VEHICLE.
Corrective Action: MAKE AVAILABLE THE CORRECT CENTER OF GRAVITY TO EACH CUSTOMER.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CENTER OF GRAVITY INDICATOR LABEL
Recall Description: INCORRECT CENTER OF GRAVITY.
Consequence Summary: FAILS TO MEET REQUIREMENT OF FMVSS 126 TRUCK CAMPERLOADING.
Corrective Action: FURNISH INSTRUCTION FOR PROPER CENTER OF GRAVITY.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:OTHER PART
Recall Description: THE TRAILER LIGHT CORD IS WIRED SO THAT WHEN LEFT TURN SIGNAL IS FLASHING ON THE TRAILER, THE RIGHT TURN SIGNAL WILL FLASH.  ALSO, WHEN SWITCH FOR TAIL LIGHT AND LICENSE PLATE LIGHT ARE TURNED ON, THE MARKER LIGHTS BURN.
Consequence Summary: MALFUNCTIONING OF TRAILER LIGHTING COULD CONFUSE OTHERDRIVERS AND PRESENT A SAFETY HAZARD.
Corrective Action: CORRECT WIRING SO THAT LIGHTS FUNCTION PROPERLY.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT BUCKLES
Recall Description: THE PRESS BUTTON IN THE BUCKLE ASSEMBLY IS LONGER DUE TO WORN TOOLING THAT STAMPS OR PUNCHES THE METAL PARTS.  THE LONGER BUTTON CAUSES THE LATCH WHICH HOLDS THE TONGUE TO DEPRESS AND NOT MAKE FULL CONTACT WITH THE TONGUE.
Consequence Summary: AS A RESULT OF THE ABOVE THE SURFACE OF THE LATCH ISSHORTENED AND, THEREFORE DOES NOT HAVE MAXIMUM SURFACE AREA WITH THE TONGUE.THIS COMBINATION OF BUCKLE AND LATCH MAY CAUSE THE BUCKLE TO RELEASE WITH LESSPULL THAN REQUIRED BY FMVSS 209 AND RESULT IN DAMAGE OR PERSONAL INJURY.
Corrective Action: INSPECT AND REPAIR SEAT BELT BY INSTALLING THE PROPER SEAT BELT BUCKLE.

Subject: LIGHTING:SWITCH:BUTTON:RING:HEAD LIGHTS
Recall Description: HEADLIGHT CIRCUIT BREAKER MAY FAIL WHEN ALL FOUR HEADLIGHTS ARE ON BECAUSE OF EXCESSIVE AMPERAGE DRAW.
Consequence Summary: HEADLIGHTS WOULD GO OFF FOR SEVERAL MINUTES CREATING THEPOTENTIAL FOR AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: INSTALL 20 AMP CIRCUIT BREAKERS IN PLACE OF THE 15 AMP BREAKERS.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:PEDALS AND LINKAGES
Recall Description: BRAKE PEDAL ASSEMBLY USED IN RIGHT HAND STATION MAY HAVE BEEN IMPROPERLY WELDED AND COULD FAIL.
Consequence Summary: NORMAL BRAKING CONTROL WOULD BE AFFECTED CREATING THEPOTENTIAL FOR A CRASH.
Corrective Action: REPAIR BRAKE PEDAL ASSEMBLY.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:SPEED CONTROL:LINKAGES(12:83)
Recall Description: SPEED CONTROL SYSTEM CABLES MAY PARTIALLY DISENGAGE AND BIND AT THE CARBURETOR THROTTLE LEVER ATTACHMENT.
Consequence Summary: THROTTLE WOULD STAY PARTIALLY OPEN WHEN ACCELERATORPEDAL IS RELEASED.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A WASHER AT SPEED CONTROL CABLE TO CARBURETOR THROTTLE LEVER ATTACHMENT TO ELIMINATE POTENTIAL FOR THIS CONDITION.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL LINES:HOSES:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: FUEL HOSES (5) IN ENGINE COMPARTMENT COULD DETERIORATE OVER TIME.
Consequence Summary: FUEL LEAKAGE COULD OCCUR, RESULTING IN ENGINECOMPARTMENT FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FIVE FUEL HOSES/CLAMPS.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL PUMP
Recall Description: FUEL PUMP, LOCATED INSIDE FUEL TANK, COULD SEIZE DURING HIGH AMBIENT TEMPERATURES BECAUSE OF AN EXTREME FINE MESH FUEL FILTER RESTRICTING THE FUEL FLOW.
Consequence Summary: FUEL SUPPLY TO ENGINE WOULD BE PARTIALLY INTERRUPTED,RESULTING IN STALLING.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A MODIFIED FUEL PUMP AND FILTER.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:PIPE:FILLER:NECK
Recall Description: FUEL TANK FILLER NECK PIPE MAY NOT SEAT PROPERLY IN THE FUEL TANK OPENING.  ALSO, THE SENDING UNIT COVER MAY BE DEFORMED.
Consequence Summary: FUEL COULD ESCAPE, CREATING THE POTENTIAL FOR A FIRE.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A REDESIGNED FILLER NECK PIPE AND REPLACE THE SENDING UNIT GASKET.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK
Recall Description: USAGE OF FUEL WITH REID PRESSURE UP TO 14 PSI COULD, UNDER HIGH ENGINE LOAD AND HIGH AMBIENT TEMPERATURES, LEAD TO STALLING.
Consequence Summary: FUEL FLOW COULD BECOME RESTRICTED AND CAUSE THE ENGINETO STALL.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A NEW FUEL TANK, CONTAINING A REDESIGNED FUEL FILTER, AS WELL AS MODIFIED CONTROL UNITS.

Subject: WHEELS:RIM BASE
Recall Description: WHEEL WHICH CONSISTS OF TWO SEPARATE PARTS, A DISC AND RIM ARE WELDED TOGETHER TO FORM THE FINISH ASSEMBLY.  THE WHEELS CONTAIN AN INAPPROPRIATE ANGLE OF THE ASSEMBLY WELD, WHICH MAY CRACK AND PROGRESS THROUGH THE RIM.
Consequence Summary: IF THE WELD CRACK PROGRESSES THROUGH THE RIM A SLOW LEAKCAUSING THE LOSS OF INFLATING AIR WILL OCCUR.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ALL WHEELS THAT FAIL TO MEET WELDING SPECIFICATIONS.

Subject: ENGINE:OTHER PARTS
Recall Description: VACUUM HARNESS ASSEMBLY HOSES BECOME LOOSE AND CAN CONTACT ENGINE EXHAUST PORTS.  CONTACT WITH EXHAUST EXPOSES HOSES TO HIGH TEMPERATURE WHICH CAUSES CARBONIZATION OF THE HOSES MATERIAL.
Consequence Summary: AS A RESULT, COMBUSTION OR AUTO IGNITION CAN TAKE PLACEAND THE HOSE IGNITES WHICH CAN CAUSE SEVERE ENGINE COMPARTMENT DAMAGE ANDPOSSIBLE LOSS OF VEHICLE DUE TO FIRE.
Corrective Action: REROUTE VACUUM HOSES TO PRECLUDE CONTACT WITH EXHAUST SYSTEM.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:ATTACHMENTS
Recall Description: STEEL STRAP USED TO FASTEN ALUMINUM FUEL TANKS FAILED TO PROPERLY MAINTAIN THE TANK.
Consequence Summary: THE ABOVE CONDITION COULD RESULT IN SEPARATION OF THEFUEL TANK OR LOOSENING OF THE TANK DURING VEHICLE OPERATION, WITH THEPOSSIBILITY OF HARM OR DAMAGE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE TANKS AND STRAPS ON ALL AFFECTED VEHICLES.

Subject: LIGHTING:SWITCH:BUTTON:RING:HEAD LIGHTS
Recall Description: THE TWILIGHT SENTINEL POTENTIOMETER (THUMBWHEEL CONTROL) MIGHT HAVE BEEN MANUFACTURED WITH ELECTRICAL CONTACTS WHICH COULD RESULT IN AN INTERMITTENT HEADLIGHT CIRCUIT.
Consequence Summary: WITH THE TWILIGHT SENTINEL SYSTEM ON, THE INTERMITTENTCIRCUIT COULD CAUSE HEADLIGHT AND INSTRUMENT PANEL LIGHTS TO GO OUT.  SUDDENLOSS OF HEADLIGHTS COULD REDUCE DRIVER VISIBILITY AND MIGHT RESULT IN A VEHICLECRASH WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A NEW PART IN ONE OF THE VEHICLES CONTROL COMPUTERS TO PREVENT THIS CONDITION FROM OCCURING.

Subject: TIRES
Recall Description: THE SPITFIRE S55 TOWING RADIAL TIRES CAUSES, WOBBLING, WANDERING, AND WEAVING ON MOTORCYCLES WITH HEAVY LOADS AND SPEED.
Consequence Summary: MOTORCYCLES ARE UNSTABLE UNDER HIGH SPEED AND HEAVYLOADS.
Corrective Action: TIRES WILL BE REPLACED WITH TIRES FOR STABLE PERFORMANCE OF MOTORCYCLES.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:ELECTRIC POWER ACCESSORIES:LOCKS:DOOR
Recall Description: DRIVERS SIDE POWER DOOR LOCK SWITCH MAY SEPARATE DURING ACTUATION, EXPOSING THE ELECTRICAL TERMINAL.
Consequence Summary: THE TERMINAL MAY CONTACT THE STEEL REMOTE MIRROR CABLE,A SHORT CAN OCCUR WITHOUT BLOWING A FUSE.  THIS MAY ALLOW THE CABLE TO OVERHEATAND COULD RESULT IN A VEHICLE FIRE.
Corrective Action: INSPECT AND MODIFY POWER DOOR LOCK SWITCH AS REQUIRED.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC SYSTEM
Recall Description: IMPROPER SIZE REAR BRAKE ASSEMBLIES WERE INSTALLED.
Consequence Summary: TRUCKS COULD EXCEED THE MAXIMUM STOPPING DISTANCEPERMITTED BY FMVSS 105, HYDRAULIC BRAKE SYSTEMS, CREATING THE POTENTIAL FOR AVEHICLE CRASH.
Corrective Action: REPLACE REAR AXLE BRAKE ASSEMBLIES WITH PROPER SIZE ASSEMBLIES.

Subject: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT ATTACHING MECHANISMS:
Recall Description: INCORRECT GRADE 5 BOLTS MAY HAVE BEEN USED TO INSTALL THE FRONT SPRING FRONT PIN CAP, INSTEAD OF THE GRADE 8 REQUIRED.
Consequence Summary: BOLT COULD YIELD, STRIP OR BREAK WHICH COULD ALLOW THESPRING TO BECOME DETACHED FROM ITS ANCHOR BRACKET AND AFFECT VEHICLE STABILITY.
Corrective Action: INSTALL CORRECT GRADE 8 BOLTS.

Subject: WHEELS:RIM BASE
Recall Description: ON DUAL REAR WHEELS MANUFACTURED BY CUSTOM AND COMMERICAL WHEELS, THE WELD BETWEEN THE CENTER DISK AND THE RIM MAY CRACK.
Consequence Summary: TIRES COULD DEFLATE AND AFFECT VEHICLE CONTROL.
Corrective Action: REPLACE DUAL REAR WHEELS.

Subject: POWER TRAIN:CLUTCH ASSEMBLY
Recall Description: PLASTIC HYDRAULIC CLUTCH SYSTEM COMPONENTS ARE SUBJECT TO EXHAUST SYSTEM HEAT DAMAGE DUE TO PROLONGED COLD, HIGH SPEED IDLE OPERATION.
Consequence Summary: CONSEQUENCE OF DEFECT:  HYDRAULIC FLUID LEAKAGE COULD OCCUR CREATING THE POTENTIAL FOR A MINOR FIRE FROM FLUID CONTACTING THE HOT EXHAUST.
Corrective Action: INSTALL PROTECTIVE HEAT SHIELDS BETWEEN THE EXHAUST SYSTEM AND AFFECTED CLUTCH SYSTEM COMPONENTS.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT BUCKLES
Recall Description: IN STAMPING THE METAL PARTS IT APPEARS THE WORN TOOLING CAUSED THE DIMENSION OF PARTS TO CHANGE.  THE PRESS BUTTON, DUE TO THESE CHANGED DIMENSIONS, CAUSES THE LATCH WHICH HOLDS THE TONGUE TO HAVE LESS SURFACE AREA WITH WHICH TO CONNECT TO THE TONGUE.
Consequence Summary: THE BELT FAILS TO MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 209.ALSO, THE BELT WILL FAIL TO RESTRAINT THE PASSENGER IN CASE OF A CRASH.
Corrective Action: NEW LATCHES, PRESS BUTTONS AND BUCKLE COVERS WILL BE SUPPLIED TO ALL OWNERS OF THE MOTORHOMES.

Subject: TIRES:LINER
Recall Description: CRACKS OR BULGE IN LOWER SIDEWALL.
Consequence Summary: CRACKS IN LOWER SIDEWALL MAY RESULT IN RAPID LOSS OFINFLATING AIR.
Corrective Action: REPLACEMENT WILL BE MADE WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM DATE OF MODIFICATION AT NO COST TO THE CONSUMER.

Subject: WHEELS:LUGS:NUTS:BOLTS
Recall Description: ALUMINUM WHEELS MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED WITH IMPROPER LUG NUTS.
Consequence Summary: WHEEL COULD BECOME LOOSE OR EVEN SEPARATE FROM THE HUBAND AXLE ASSEMBLY WHILE THE VEHICE IS IN MOTION.
Corrective Action: CHANGE TAPERED STYLE LUG NUTS TO SHORT SHANK STYLE LUG NUTS.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT
Recall Description: CHILD BOOSTER SEAT SHIELD HAS SURFACES THAT DO NOT MEET PROTRUSION AND RADIUS OF CURVATURE, REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 213.
Consequence Summary: THE SURFACES COULD CAUSE INJURIES TO CHILD IN THE EVENTOF A CRASH.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A SNAP ON PLASTIC COVER OVER THE EXISTING SHIELD.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES:ACCELERATOR:RIGID
Recall Description: VEHICLE MAY CONTAIN AN OUT OF TOLERANCE THROTTLE BODY.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD PREVENT THE ACCELERATOR FROM RETURNING TOIDLE WHEN RELEASED.
Corrective Action: REPLACE SUSPECT THROTTLE BODIES.

Subject: SUSPENSION:AXLE UNKNOWN NON-POWER
Recall Description: WELD CRACKS AND AXLE FRACTURES COULD OCCUR DUE TO INCOMPATIBILITY OF NEWAY RC 122 SUSPENSION AND ROCKWELL AXLES.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLE HANDLING WILL BE IMPAIRED.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW AXLES AND SPRING SUSPENSIONS.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CERTIFICATION LABEL
Recall Description: CERTIFICATION LABEL FAILS TO MEET REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 126.
Consequence Summary: LABEL FAILS TO MEET REQUIREMENT OF FMVSS 126.
Corrective Action: AFFIX CERTIFICATION LABEL IN CORRECT POSITION AND USE PRINTING WITH CONTRASTING COLOR.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL LINES:HOSES:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: CLAMP WHICH SECURES THE FUEL FILLER HOSE TO THE BODY IS MISSING.
Consequence Summary: HOSE COULD SAG ONTO REAR SPRING WEARING A HOLE IN THEHOSE; THIS COULD ALLOW FUEL TO SPILL ONTO GROUND WHILE FILLING OR DRIVINGTRUCK.
Corrective Action: INSTALL MISSING CLAMP AND REPLACE FILLER HOSE IF IT HAS BEEN RUBBED BY SPRING.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:PIPE:FILLER:NECK
Recall Description: THE THREADS IN SOME FUEL FILLER NECK INSERTS ARE NOT PROPERLY FORMED.
Consequence Summary: FUEL FILLER CAPS CAN BIND AND RATCHET BEFORE SEALING.
Corrective Action: INSTALL REPLACEMENT FUEL FILLER NECK.

Subject: SUSPENSION:AXLE UNKNOWN NON-POWER
Recall Description: WELD CRACKS AND AXLE FRACTURES COULD OCCUR DUE TO INCOMPATIBILITY OF NEWAY RC 122 SUSPENSION AND ROCKWELL AXLES.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLE HANDLING WILL BE IMPAIRED.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW AXLES AND SPRING SUSPENSIONS.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:GLASS:WINDSHIELD
Recall Description: POOR BOND ADHESION BETWEEN THE WINDSHIELD GLASS AND MOUNTING COULD ALLOW THE WINDSHIELD TO SEPARATE DURING A 30 MPH FRONTAL BARRIER TEST REQUIRED BY FMVSS 212.
Consequence Summary: IF WINDSHIELD GLASS SEPARATION OCCURS DURING ANACCIDENT, AN UNBELTED OCCUPANT COULD BE EJECTED FROM THE VEHICLE AND INJURED.
Corrective Action: REINSTALL WINDSHIELDS TO ASSURE PROPER BOND ADHESION.

Subject: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT RETRACTORS
Recall Description: SEAT BELT MOUNTING BRACKET STRENGTH MAY BE BELOW REQUIREMENT OF FMVSS 209 AND COULD CRACK.
Consequence Summary: SEAT BELT MAY NOT PROPERLY RESTRAIN OCCUPANT; ALSO,VEHICLES DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 209.
Corrective Action: REPLACE 3 POINT SEAT BELT RETRACTOR MOUNTING BOLT 601-B BRACKETS.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL LINES:HOSES:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: RETURN FUEL LINE HOSE MAY NOT BE OZONE RESISTANT.
Consequence Summary: FUEL HOSE COULD CRACK, RESULTING IN A FUEL LEAK ANDENGINE COMPARTMENT FIRE.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A NEW HOSE WHICH IS OZONE RESISTANT.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES:ACCELERATOR:RIGID
Consequence Summary: IF THE THROTTLE STICKS IN AN OPEN POSITION THE VEHICLECOULD BECOME UNCONTROLABLE AND RESULT IN VEHICLE CRASH.
Corrective Action: INSTALL A THROTTLE LINKAGE KIT TO MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 124.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:METALLIC
Recall Description: THERE MAY BE CONTACT BETWEEN THE REAR BRAKE LINES AND THE CHASSIS ANTI SWAY BRACKETS.
Consequence Summary: PROLONGED CONTACT CAN RESULT IN FAILURE OF REAR BRAKESAND LONGER STOPPING DISTANCE.
Corrective Action: GRIND AWAY PORTIONS OF LEFT SIDE AND RIGHT SIDE ANTI SWAY BRACKETS TO AVOID CONTACT WITH BRAKE OIL LINES.

Subject: TIRES:LINER
Recall Description: DAMAGE TO INNER LINER IN THE LOWER SIDEWALL AREA.
Consequence Summary: LOSS OF AIR WILL RESULT IN OPERATION OF THE TIRE IN ANUNDERINFLATED CONDITION.
Corrective Action: TIRES WILL BE REPLACED WITHOUT CHARGE WITHIN 60 DAYS FROM DATE OF NOTIFICATION.

Subject: SUSPENSION:AXLE UNKNOWN:NON-POWER:AXLE ASSEMBLY
Recall Description: WELD CRACKS AND AXLE FRACTURES COULD OCCUR DUE TO INCOMPATIBILITY OF NEWAY RC 122 SUSPENSION AND ROCKWELL AXLES.
Consequence Summary: CRACKS COULD LEAD TO COMPLETE FAILURE OF AXLE BEAM;VEHICLE HANDLING WOULD BE IMPAIRED.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ROCKWELL AXLES WITH AN APPROVED ALTERNATIVE.

Subject: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:PEDAL
Recall Description: WELDS THAT ATTACH THE BRAKE PEDAL ARM TO THE CROSS SHAFT MAY NOT WITHSTAND A PANIC STOP AND/OR FATIGUE LOAD INPUTS.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF BRAKING CAPABILITY.
Corrective Action: REPLACE BRAKE PEDAL ASSEMBLY WITH NEW ASSEMBLY.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CERTIFICATION LABEL
Recall Description: CERTIFICATION LABEL FAILS TO MEET REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 126.
Consequence Summary: INCORRECT INFORMATION ON CERTIFICATION LABEL COULD LEADTO POSSIBLE OVERLOADING OF TRUCK.
Corrective Action: INSTALL CERTIFICATION LABEL WITH CORRECTED LOAD WEIGHTS.

Subject: LIGHTING:LAMP OR SOCKET:TAIL LIGHTS
Recall Description: LAMPS FAILED TO MEET THE REQUIREMENT OF FMVSS 108, STOP LAMPS PHOTOMETRIC REQUIREMENTS.
Consequence Summary: FAILED TO MEET REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 108.
Corrective Action: LAMPS WILL BE RETURNED AND PURCHASE PRICE WILL BE REFUNDED.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:HARNESS:REAR COMPARTMENT
Recall Description: ELECTRICAL WIRING HARNESS MAY HAVE BEEN INCORRECTLY INSTALLED AND COULD CAUSE A SHORT CIRCUIT.
Consequence Summary: SHORT CIRCUIT COULD RESULT IN A ELECTRICAL FIRE.
Corrective Action: REROUTE HARNESS; IF CHAFED OR DAMAGED CONDITION WILL BE CORRECTED.

Subject: SUSPENSION:AXLE UNKNOWN NON-POWER
Consequence Summary: VEHICLE HANDLING WILL BE IMPAIRED.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW AXLES AND SPRING SUSPENSIONS.

Subject: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:LEAF SPRING HANGER:BRA
Recall Description: WELDCRACKS AND AXLE FAILURE COULD OCCUR DUE TO INCOMPATIBILITY OF NEWAY RC 122 SUSPENSION AND ROCKWELL AXLES.
Consequence Summary: VEHICLE HANDLING WILL BE IMPAIRED.
Corrective Action: INSTALL NEW AXLES AND/OR SPRING SUSPENSION.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:SPEED CONTROL
Recall Description: CRUISE CONTROL MODULE COULD HAVE INCONSISTENT CRUISE CONTROL OPERATION.
Consequence Summary: INCONSISTENT CRUISE CONTROL OPERATION COULD RESULT INLOSS OF CONTROL AND AN ACCIDENT.
Corrective Action: REPLACE MODULE, AS NECESSARY.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:TIE ROD:INNER
Recall Description: INNER TIE ROD TO RELAY ROD NUTS ON STEERING LINKAGE MAY BE IIMPROPERLY TORQUED AND NOT CRIMPED.
Consequence Summary: LOSS OF ONE OR BOTH NUTS COULD LEAD TO INNER TIE RODDISENGAGEMENT, WHICH COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF STEERING CONTROL AND A TRUCKCRASH.
Corrective Action: REPLACE STEERING LINKAGE ASSEMBLY.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:BATTERY:CABLE:FUSIBLE
Recall Description: UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS, AN ELECTRICAL SHORT CIRCUIT CAN DEVELOP.
Consequence Summary: SHORT CIRCUIT COULD RESULT IN TRUCKS CATCHING FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE EXISTING PICTURE FRAME TYPE BATTERY RETAINER WITH AN I FRAME RETAINER AND INSTALL CONVOLUTED TUBING OVER POSITIVE BATTERY CABLE.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:ARM:IDLER AND ATTACHMENT
Consequence Summary: DRIVER WOULD EXPERIENCE A CLUNKING NOISE ON TURNS AND ALOOSE FEELING IN THE STEERING WHEEL; STEERING CONTROL WOULD BE MAINTAINED.
Corrective Action: REPLACE IDLER ARM ASSEMBLY.

Subject: SUSPENSION:TANDEM AXLE:REAR:LEAF SPRING ASSEMBLY:H
Recall Description: WELDS JOINING THE AXLE SUPPORT BRACKET TO THE REAR DRIVE AXLE MAY BE DEFECTIVE DUE TO INSUFFICIENT COVERAGE AND/OR PENETRATION.
Consequence Summary: WELDS COULD FAIL, RESULTING IN REAR AXLE SEPARATING FROMTHE SUSPENSION.
Corrective Action: REMOVE EXISTING WELDS AND REWELD BY A CERTIFIED WELDER.

Subject: VISUAL SYSTEMS:WINDSHIELD WIPER:MOTOR
Recall Description: ROAD SALT INDUCED EROSION OF THE WIPER MOTOR CONDUCTOR STRIPS COULD CAUSE LOCALIZED THERMAL STRESS WITHIN THE GLASS.
Consequence Summary: GLASS COULD FRACTURE WHILE STATION WAGON IS BEING DRIVENOR PARKED, CREATING A RISK OF INJURY TO OCCUPANTS OR SUDDEN DISTRACTION TO THEDRIVER.
Corrective Action: APPLY SEALANT TO CONDUCTOR STRIPS AND PROTECTIVE TAPE TO LOWER BACKLITES.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:EMERGENCY EXIT LABEL
Recall Description: BUSES HAVE ONLY TWO EMERGENCY WINDOW EXITS IDENTIFIED ON LEFT SIDE, INSTEAD OF THREE REQUIRED BY FMVSS 217.
Consequence Summary: BUSES DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 217.
Corrective Action: ADD EMERGENCY EXIT INSTRUCTIONS TO 3RD WINDOW ON LEFT SIDE.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CERTIFICATION LABEL
Recall Description: CERTIFICATION LABEL FAILS TO MEET REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 126.  OWNER'S MANUAL MISSING REQUIRED LOADING INFORMATION.
Consequence Summary: WITHOUT CERTIFICATION LABEL SHOWING CORRECT INFORMATION,IT IS POSSIBLE FOR AN OVERLOADING CONDITION TO EXIST.
Corrective Action: FURNISH CORRECT CERTIFICATIO N LABEL AND THE MISSING INFORMATION FOR THE OWNERS MANUAL.

Subject: SUSPENSION:MOTORCYCLE FRONT
Recall Description: FRONT WHEEL BEARING COULD FAIL DUE TO LACK OF LUBRICATION.
Corrective Action: REPLACE BEARINGS AND AXLE COLLARS ON IN USE MOTORCYCLES; REPLACE AXLE COLLARS AND ENSURE PROPER BEARING LUBRICATION ON UNSOLD MOTORCYCLES.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CERTIFICATION LABEL
Recall Description: CERTIFICATION LABEL FAILS TO MEET REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 126.  ALSO, NO OWNER MANUALS.
Consequence Summary: WITHOUT CERTIFICATION LABEL SHOWING CORRECT WEIGHTS, ITIS POSSIBLE FOR AN OVERLOADING CONDITION TO EXIST.
Corrective Action: AFFIX CERTIFICATION LABEL WITH CORRECT WEIGHT IN A MANNER IT CANNOT BE REMOVED WITHOUT DEFACING.  ALSO, FURNISH OWNER'S MANUAL INFORMATION.

Subject: EQUIPMENT:CERTIFICATION LABEL
Recall Description: CERTIFICATION LABEL FAILS TO MEET REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 126.  NO OWNER'S MANUAL.
Consequence Summary: WITHOUT CERTIFICATION LABEL SHOWING CORRECT WEIGHTS ITIS POSSIBLE FOR AN OVERLOADING CONDITION ON THE VEHICLE.
Corrective Action: AFFIX CERTIFICATION LABEL WITH CORRECT WEIGHT IN A MANNER IT CANNOT BE REMOVED WITHOUT DEFACING.  ALSO, FURNISH OWNER'S MANUAL INFORMATION.

Subject: FUEL:FUEL LINES:HOSES:NON-METALLIC
Recall Description: THE FUEL HOSE BETWEEN THE PRESSURE REGULATOR AND THE INJECTOR FUEL RAIL MAY RUPTURE DUE TO STRESS.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN A FUEL LEAK AND POSSIBLY A FIRE.
Corrective Action: REPLACE FUEL HOSE WITH NEW PREFORMED PLASTIC HOSE.

Subject: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL
Recall Description: ACCELERATOR CONTROL CABLE MAY CONTAIN WATER WHICH COULD FREEZE WHILE VEHICLE IS PARKED CAUSING TRAVEL OF ACCELERATOR CONTROL CABLE TO BECOME RESTRICTED WHEN THROTTLE IS INITIALLY OPENED.
Consequence Summary: ENGINE SPEED MAY NOT DECREASE WHICH COULD RESULT IN LOSSOF ACCELERATOR CONTROL AND A CRASH WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: REPLACE ACCELERATOR CONTROL CABLE.

Subject: STEERING:LINKAGES:ROD:RELAY:CONNECTING
Recall Description: STEERING CENTERLINKS MAY BREAK AT A BEND LOCATION.
Consequence Summary: STEERING CONTROL WOULD BE DIMINISHED, WITH REDUCEDCONTROL OF LEFT WHEEL ONLY AND CONSIDERABLE STEERING WHEEL FREE PLAY.
Corrective Action: REPLACE STEERING CENTERLINK.

Subject: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:AIR SUSPENSION SYSTEM
Recall Description: CROSSMEMBER CAN BE OVERSTRESSED AND CAN FAIL, ALLOWING THE BROKEN CROSSMEMBER TO PROTUDE ABOVE THE TOP OF THE FRAME AND INTERFERE WITH CHASSIS COMPONENTS.
Consequence Summary: TRAILER HANDLING COULD BE AFFECTED DURING TURNINGMANEUVERS WHICH COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF TRUCK CONTROL AND A CRASH.  ALSO, ACOMPLETELY SEPARATED CROSSMEMBER COULD AFFECT HEIGHT OF SUSPENSION AIR SPRINGSAND THE RESULTING LEAN COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF CONTROL.
Corrective Action: INSTALLATION OF A BOLTED DOUBLE PLATE TYPE CROSSMEMBER TO REPLACE THE STANDARD CHANNEL TYPE CROSSMEMBER.

Subject: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:ALTERNATOR:GENERATOR
Recall Description: ENGINE AND BRAKE BACKUP SYSTEM HAVE COMMON ELECTRICAL POWER SOURCE; ENGINE COULD DIE FROM ELECTRICAL FAILURE OF THE MAIN POWER FEED FROM THE ALTERNATOR.
Consequence Summary: THIS COULD RESULT IN BRAKE FAILURE WHICH COULD RESULT INA CRASH WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.
Corrective Action: SEPARATE ENGINE AND BRAKE BACK UP CIRCUITS.
